summary_en.motivation: To evaluate a 3D-printed porous PLA implant for total vertebral body replacement through in vitro and in vivo assessment.
summary_en.method: A porous PLA scaffold was designed and fabricated via FDM, followed by in vitro cytotoxicity and cell viability assays, in vivo implantation in 35 rats, and sequential histomorphometric analysis.

summary_en.result: The mechanical properties are insensitive to loading rate but highly dependent on volume fraction; damage exhibits ductile-brittle synergistic characteristics.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests and numerical simulations were used to validate mechanical performance and failure modes.

summary_en.motivation: This review synthesizes evidence on wear behavior, material properties, and design parameters in total hip arthroplasty to address implant longevity challenges.

summary_en.motivation: Reconstructing time-resolved flow fields from sparse velocimetry measurements with principled uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A sparse variational Gaussian process with Kolmogorov-Arnold network topology (SVGP-KAN) is proposed for uncertainty-aware flow reconstruction.
summary_en.result: SVGP-KAN achieves comparable reconstruction accuracy to classical methods while providing well-calibrated uncertainty estimates.
summary_en.validation: Validation on synthetic pulsed impingement jet flow data with fractional PIV sampling rates from 0.5% to 10%.

summary_en.motivation: To overcome high mesh generation costs and symplectic drift in simulating reaction-diffusion dynamics on complex non-Euclidean manifolds.
summary_en.method: The Intrinsic-Metric PINN embeds the Riemannian metric tensor into the automatic differentiation graph to analytically compute the Laplace-Beltrami operator in a mesh-free manner.
summary_en.result: On a stochastic cloth manifold with extreme curvature, IM-PINN recovers Turing patterns and achieves lower global mass conservation error than the Surface Finite Element Method.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks against SFEM on a challenging manifold demonstrate improved mass conservation and pattern reproduction.

summary_en.motivation: Autoregressive neural operator surrogates suffer from compounding errors in long-horizon predictions without online error monitoring or correction.
summary_en.method: ANCHOR adaptively couples a pretrained neural operator with a classical numerical solver using a physics-informed residual-based error estimator with exponential moving average.
summary_en.result: The hybrid framework bounds long-horizon error growth and improves robustness over standalone neural operators on four canonical PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on 1D/2D Burgers', 2D Allen-Cahn, and 3D heat conduction equations with numerical benchmarks.

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian processes suffer from prohibitive computational complexity and inaccurate fitting in high-dimensional spaces, motivating a more efficient surrogate model.
summary_en.method: Proposes order-preserving Bayesian optimization (OPBO) that replaces the Gaussian process with an order-preserving neural network as the surrogate model.
summary_en.result: OPBO significantly outperforms traditional BO methods on black-box optimization problems with dimensions over 500.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on multiple high-dimensional numerical benchmark functions.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种协调预训练生成模型进行系统级设计的方法，可迁移到生物力学植入物设计中的多约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or implant-specific biomechanics; it focuses on system-level generative design with differentiable models.

summary_zh.motivation: 协调多个预训练生成模型以生成满足系统级约束的可行设计。
summary_zh.method: 提出GLUE框架，通过数据驱动或无数据方式协调冻结的生成模型，并施加可行性、最优性和多样性约束。
summary_zh.result: 无数据方法在性能和可行性上与贝叶斯优化相当，但计算效率提高两个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 在无人机设计问题中验证，包含五个耦合约束，对比了数据驱动和无数据方法。

summary_en.motivation: To coordinate multiple pre-trained generative models for generating feasible, diverse, and high-performing system-level designs under coupling constraints.
summary_en.method: GLUE orchestrates frozen, differentiable generative models using either data-driven training on pre-generated designs or a data-free approach with a differentiable geometry layer, enforcing system-level constraints.
summary_en.result: The data-free approach achieves competitive performance and feasibility compared to Bayesian optimization and gradient-based methods while requiring over two orders of magnitude fewer geometry evaluations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a UAV design problem with five coupling constraints, comparing data-driven and data-free approaches against Bayesian optimization and gradient-based optimization.

title: Digital Twin-Driven Zero-Shot Fault Diagnosis of Axial Piston Pumps Using Fluid-Borne Noise Signals
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的数字孪生与PINN虚拟传感器方法可迁移至生物力学代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或接触力学。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant mechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification, and focuses on fault diagnosis rather than design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决轴向柱塞泵故障诊断中标记数据稀缺的问题
summary_zh.method: 构建数字孪生模型生成合成故障信号，结合PINN虚拟传感器和Grad-CAM可视化
summary_zh.result: 在真实基准测试中诊断准确率超过95%
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验对比校准与未校准数字孪生模型的诊断性能

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the scarcity of labeled fault data for axial piston pump diagnosis by leveraging a digital twin framework.
summary_en.method: A high-fidelity digital twin model calibrated with healthy-state data generates synthetic fault signals; a PINN serves as a virtual sensor for flow ripple estimation, and Grad-CAM visualizes decision-making.
summary_en.result: Training on signals from the calibrated digital twin achieves over 95% diagnostic accuracy on real-world benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation compares diagnostic performance between calibrated and uncalibrated digital twin models.

title: Characterization of microstructure and defects in the Ti-6Al-4V alloy produced by 3D printing SLM technology
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM制造Ti-6Al-4V的微观结构和缺陷，但未涉及应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合等核心问题。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on microstructure and defect characterization of Ti-6Al-4V produced by SLM, but lacks mechanical testing, fatigue analysis, surface roughness or osseointegration evaluation, and does not address stress shielding or stiffness matching.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热等静压对SLM打印Ti-6Al-4V合金微观结构和缺陷的影响
summary_zh.method: 使用光学显微镜、扫描电镜和显微CT表征微观结构与缺陷
summary_zh.result: 热等静压显著影响孔隙尺寸和微观组织转变
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微成像和CT观察，未进行力学验证

summary_en.motivation: To characterize the microstructure and defects of Ti-6Al-4V alloy produced by selective laser melting and investigate the effect of hot isostatic pressing.
summary_en.method: Optical microscopy, scanning electron microscopy, and micro-computed tomography were used to analyze microstructure and defects.
summary_en.result: Hot isostatic pressing significantly affected pore size and induced microstructural transformation.
summary_en.validation: Material characterization via microscopy and CT, without mechanical property testing.

title: Additive manufacturing of Al-based metal matrix composites: A review with bibliometric perspective on biomedical applications

relevance_to_user: 该综述涉及铝基复合材料增材制造用于生物医学，但未聚焦于应力遮挡或疲劳测试，与用户方向间接相关。
why_not_core: This is a review on Al-MMCs for biomedical applications, not specifically on porous structure for stress shielding, LPBF fabrication with mechanical testing, fatigue, or osseointegration of implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述铝基复合材料增材制造在生物医学中的应用现状与挑战
summary_zh.method: 通过文献计量分析和系统综述，涵盖多种AM工艺及后处理
summary_zh.result: 总结了工艺-结构-性能关系，指出孔隙率、离子释放等关键问题
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述

summary_en.motivation: To review the state-of-the-art in additive manufacturing of aluminum matrix composites for biomedical applications, identifying trends and challenges.
summary_en.method: A comprehensive review combined with bibliometric analysis covering SLM, DED, EBM, binder jetting, and post-processing techniques.
summary_en.result: Key issues such as porosity control, aluminum ion leaching, and process reproducibility are highlighted, with future directions including functionally graded composites and AI-driven optimization.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; this is a literature review.

title: Regularized Random Fourier Features and Finite Element Reconstruction for Operator Learning in Sobolev Space
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种正则化随机傅里叶特征方法，结合有限元重建，用于从噪声数据中学习算子，可迁移到生物力学代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification for design constraints, and does not address multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决核方法在大训练集和噪声数据下的计算瓶颈与过拟合问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出正则化随机傅里叶特征结合有限元重建的算子学习方法。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准PDE问题上，该方法对噪声鲁棒，训练时间减少，精度与核方法相当。
summary_zh.validation: 在平流、Burgers、达西流、Helmholtz、Navier-Stokes和结构力学等数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational cost and noise sensitivity of kernel-based operator learning for large training sets.
summary_en.method: Proposes a regularized random Fourier feature approach with finite element reconstruction (RRFF-FEM) for learning PDE solution operators from noisy data.
summary_en.result: The method achieves robust performance under noise, reduced training time, and competitive accuracy compared to kernel and neural operator baselines on multiple benchmark PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks including advection, Burgers', Darcy flow, Helmholtz, Navier-Stokes, and structural mechanics problems.

title: More Consistent Accuracy PINN via Alternating Easy-Hard Training
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种交替训练策略以提高PINN的精度和鲁棒性，但未涉及FEA替代建模或生物力学设计中的约束处理与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN训练策略在精度和一致性上存在权衡，需改进。
summary_zh.method: 提出硬优先与软优先交替训练算法。
summary_zh.result: 在陡梯度、非线性和高维PDE上实现O(10^-5)至O(10^-6)的相对L2误差。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个PDE基准问题上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Current PINN training strategies exhibit trade-offs and inconsistent accuracy across PDE types, motivating a hybrid approach.
summary_en.method: An alternating training algorithm that combines hard and easy prioritization is developed.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves consistently high accuracy with relative L2 errors mostly in the range of 10^-5 to 10^-6 on challenging PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on PDEs with steep gradients, nonlinearity, and high dimensionality.

title: Microstructure-based Variational Neural Networks for Robust Uncertainty Quantification in Materials Digital Twins
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物打印中的数字孪生建模，但未涉及生物打印流程或实验验证。
why_not_core: No integration with bioprinting workflow stages (pre/in/post-printing), no experimental validation on bioprinted constructs, and no autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 材料数字孪生中微观结构不确定性难以量化
summary_zh.method: 提出变分深度材料网络，嵌入变分分布并利用泰勒展开传播不确定性
summary_zh.result: 在增材制造聚合物复合材料中预测并验证了力学性能变异性
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试实验验证预测的变异性

summary_en.motivation: Aleatoric uncertainties in microstructure pose a major challenge for robust materials digital twins.
summary_en.method: A Variational Deep Material Network (VDMN) embeds variational distributions in a hierarchical mechanistic architecture and propagates uncertainty via Taylor-series expansion and automatic differentiation.
summary_en.result: The VDMN predicts and experimentally validates nonlinear mechanical variability in additively manufactured polymer composites.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing on additively manufactured polymer composites validates the predicted variability.

title: MINPO: Memory-Informed Neural Pseudo-Operator to Resolve Nonlocal Spatiotemporal Dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种统一的非局部算子学习框架，可迁移至生物力学中的非局部接触或损伤建模。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics application, no FEA surrogate for structural mechanics, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有方法求解非局部时空动力学效率低且缺乏通用性。
summary_zh.method: 提出记忆信息神经伪算子，结合KAN或MLP学习非局部算子及其逆。
summary_zh.result: 在多种核类型和维度上准确且鲁棒，优于经典和神经方法。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，与A-PINN、fPINN等对比。

summary_en.motivation: Classical methods for solving integro-differential equations are computationally expensive and lack generalizability across different nonlocal structures.
summary_en.method: MINPO learns the nonlocal operator and its inverse via neural representations (KAN or MLP) with a lightweight nonlocal consistency loss.
summary_en.result: MINPO demonstrates superior accuracy and robustness across diverse kernel types and dimensionalities compared to classical and state-of-the-art neural solvers.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on fractional PDEs and other IDEs, compared against A-PINN, fPINN, and their KAN variants.

title: Learning Generalizable Neural Operators for Inverse Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的逆问题神经算子框架可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化与约束处理。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant design problems, no explicit handling of constraints, and no demonstration on expensive simulation sampling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子难以处理逆问题的病态性。
summary_zh.method: 提出B2B-1框架，解耦函数表示与逆映射，在系数空间学习可逆模型。
summary_zh.result: 在六个逆PDE基准上实现一致的重模拟性能，并捕获不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证，包括两个新数据集。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators struggle with ill-posed inverse problems due to violations of continuity and uniqueness assumptions.
summary_en.method: We propose B2B-1, an inverse basis-to-basis neural operator that decouples function representation from the inverse map by learning neural basis functions and operating in coefficient space.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves consistent re-simulation performance across six inverse PDE benchmarks, including probabilistic models that capture uncertainty and remain robust to noise.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical PDE benchmarks, including two novel datasets, with comparisons against existing invertible neural operator baselines.

title: Convolutional-neural-operator-based transfer learning for solving PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于卷积神经算子的迁移学习方法，可提高PDE求解的采样效率，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计中的约束处理与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective constraints, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design scenarios.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升卷积神经算子在少样本场景下的PDE求解能力
summary_zh.method: 预训练卷积神经算子后，采用微调、低秩适应或神经元线性变换进行参数调整
summary_zh.result: 神经元线性变换策略在多个PDE上取得最高代理精度
summary_zh.validation: 在Kuramoto-Sivashinsky、Brusselator和Navier-Stokes方程上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To extend convolutional neural operators to few-shot learning scenarios for efficient PDE solution.
summary_en.method: Pre-train a convolutional neural operator on a source dataset, then adapt parameters via fine-tuning, low-rank adaptation, or neuron linear transformation.
summary_en.result: Neuron linear transformation achieves the highest surrogate accuracy on Kuramoto-Sivashinsky, Brusselator, and Navier-Stokes equations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on three PDE systems demonstrate the effectiveness of the transfer learning strategies.

title: BumpNet: A Sparse MLP Framework for Learning PDE Solutions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种稀疏MLP框架用于PDE求解，其网格无关性和可训练基函数特性可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant-related FEA problems; no uncertainty quantification; no constraint handling in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PDE数值求解和算子学习的效率与精度。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于稀疏MLP和可训练基函数的BumpNet框架，并与PINN、EDNN、DeepONet结合。
summary_zh.result: 数值实验表明BumpNet在多个PDE问题上具有高效性和准确性。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准问题上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop an efficient and accurate meshless framework for PDE solution and operator learning using sparse MLPs.
summary_en.method: BumpNet constructs basis functions from sigmoid activations in a sparse multi-layer framework, integrated with PINNs, EDNNs, and DeepONets.
summary_en.result: Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate the efficiency and accuracy of BumpNets on various PDE problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard PDE benchmarks including Poisson, Burgers, and wave equations.

relevance_to_user: 该论文使用3D生物打印构建患者来源的肿瘤模型，但未涉及AI技术，与AI生物打印方向相关性较低。
why_not_core: This paper does not integrate AI into any bioprinting workflow stage, lacks experimental validation of AI models, and does not advance from observation to autonomous decision.

summary_zh.motivation: 缺乏生理相关的体外GIST模型来预测治疗反应。
summary_zh.method: 使用3D生物打印构建患者来源的GIST模型并进行药物筛选。
summary_zh.result: 模型准确重现肿瘤特征，可在10天内提供个性化治疗建议。
summary_zh.validation: 通过组织学、基因组学和转录组学分析验证模型与亲本肿瘤的一致性。

summary_en.motivation: The lack of robust and physiologically relevant in vitro models for gastrointestinal stromal tumors hinders personalized treatment prediction.
summary_en.method: Patient-derived GIST models were constructed using 3D bioprinting, followed by histopathological, genomic, and transcriptomic analyses and drug screening.
summary_en.result: The 3DP-GIST models accurately recapitulated tumor histology and molecular features, enabling individualized treatment recommendations within 10 days post-surgery.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through histopathological assessment, whole-exome sequencing, and transcriptomic profiling to confirm model fidelity to parental tumors.

title: Multivariate Uncertainty Quantification with Tomographic Quantile Forests
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多变量不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及有限元仿真或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate application, no biomechanics context, no implant design or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 多变量条件分布的非参数估计仍具挑战，现有方法局限于凸分位数区域。
summary_zh.method: 提出断层分位数森林，通过方向投影和切片Wasserstein距离重建多变量分布。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试和真实数据实验。

summary_en.motivation: Nonparametric estimation of multivariate conditional distributions remains challenging, with existing directional-quantile methods producing only convex regions.
summary_en.method: Tomographic Quantile Forests learn conditional quantiles of directional projections and reconstruct the multivariate distribution by minimizing sliced Wasserstein distance.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates effective uncertainty quantification on synthetic and real-world datasets.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks and real-world data experiments.

title: Geometric Laplace Neural Operator
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的几何拉普拉斯神经算子可处理非欧几里得几何上的PDE，对生物力学中复杂几何形状的代理建模具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant mechanics problems; no uncertainty quantification; no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子难以处理非周期激励和任意黎曼流形上的PDE。
summary_zh.method: 提出几何拉普拉斯神经算子，将拉普拉斯谱表示嵌入拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子本征基。
summary_zh.result: 在PDE/ODE和真实数据集上优于现有模型。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个数值基准和真实数据集上验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators struggle with non-periodic excitations and PDEs on arbitrary Riemannian manifolds.
summary_en.method: Proposes Geometric Laplace Neural Operator (GLNO) that embeds Laplace spectral representation into eigenbasis of Laplace-Beltrami operator.
summary_en.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art models on PDE/ODE and real-world datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks and real-world datasets.

key_terms.zh: 拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子

title: PIP$^2$ Net: Physics-informed Partition Penalty Deep Operator Network
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进的算子学习方法，可加速参数化PDE求解，其分区惩罚正则化技术有望迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant-related FEA problems; lacks uncertainty quantification and constraint handling for design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有算子网络训练数据需求大且缺乏物理结构，需提升稳定性和局部逼近能力。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于分区单位正则化的物理信息分区惩罚深度算子网络（PIP² Net）。
summary_zh.result: 在三个非线性PDE上预测精度和鲁棒性均优于DeepONet、PI-DeepONet和POU-DeepONet。
summary_zh.validation: 在粘性Burgers、Allen-Cahn和扩散反应方程上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Existing operator networks require large training datasets and lack explicit physical structure, motivating a more stable and local approximation framework.
summary_en.method: The paper proposes PIP² Net, a physics-informed partition penalty deep operator network that improves trunk network coordination via a simplified partition-of-unity regularization.
summary_en.result: PIP² Net consistently outperforms DeepONet, PI-DeepONet, and POU-DeepONet in prediction accuracy and robustness on three nonlinear PDE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on viscous Burgers, Allen-Cahn, and diffusion-reaction equations demonstrate the method's effectiveness.

title: Nonparametric Stochastic Subspaces via the Bootstrap for Characterizing Model Error
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于bootstrap的随机子空间方法用于模型误差表征，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it address expensive simulation sampling efficiency or multi-objective constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 工程中模型误差影响预测可靠性，但现有表征方法复杂且假设多。
summary_zh.method: 利用bootstrap对状态快照矩阵重采样，构建随机子空间模型以表征模型误差。
summary_zh.result: 在计算力学和结构动力学算例中，该方法比现有方法更准确地表征模型误差。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例与现有方法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Reliable forward UQ in engineering requires accounting for model error, but existing characterization methods are often assumption-heavy and complex.
summary_en.method: A bootstrap-based stochastic subspace model is introduced, which induces a sampling distribution over principal subspaces from the empirical data distribution of state snapshots.
summary_en.result: The proposed method improves model error characterization in computational mechanics compared to existing approaches, demonstrated on numerical examples.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated against existing approaches using numerical benchmarks in computational mechanics and structural dynamics.

title: Interpretable Multivariate Conformal Prediction with Fast Transductive Standardization
relevance_to_user: 该方法提供了一种高效的多变量共形预测框架，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的不确定性量化中。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, implant design, or any biomedical/mechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有共形预测方法在多输出场景下区间过宽或计算成本高。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于坐标标准化和全共形预测的快速多变量预测区间构建方法。
summary_zh.result: 在模拟和真实数据上比基线方法获得更紧的预测区间，同时保证有限样本覆盖。
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟数据和真实数据集与现有基线对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing conformal prediction methods for multiple outputs often produce overly wide intervals or incur high computational cost.
summary_en.method: A novel coordinate-wise standardization procedure combined with transductive conformal prediction is proposed to construct tight simultaneous prediction intervals for multivariate regression.
summary_en.result: The method yields tighter prediction intervals than existing baselines while maintaining valid finite-sample coverage on simulated and real datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on simulated and real datasets by comparing interval tightness and coverage against baseline methods.

title: Bayesian Updating of constitutive parameters under hybrid uncertainties with a novel surrogate model applied to biofilms
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的混合不确定性下的贝叶斯更新框架和降阶模型方法，可迁移至植入物力学仿真中的参数校准与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper applies Bayesian updating and surrogate modeling to biofilm growth, not to implant biomechanics or structural FEA, and lacks validation on mechanical or biomedical design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 生物膜建模中存在混合不确定性，需高效校准参数。

summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on two-species and four-species biofilm simulation case studies.

summary_en.result: Accurate forward surrogates and reliable inverse permeability recovery without manual tuning.

title: Probabilistic Predictions of Process-Induced Deformation in Carbon/Epoxy Composites Using a Deep Operator Network
relevance_to_user: 本文提出了基于DeepONet的代理模型并融合不确定性量化，可迁移至植入物力学设计的仿真替代。

summary_zh.motivation: 复合材料固化变形预测困难，需高效代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 使用FiLM-DeepONet结合迁移学习和集合卡尔曼反演进行概率预测。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型能准确预测变形时间历程并量化不确定性，支持固化工艺优化。
summary_zh.validation: 高保真仿真与实验测量数据联合训练，实验验证最终变形。

summary_en.motivation: Accurate prediction of process-induced deformation in composites is computationally expensive, motivating the development of data-driven surrogate models.
summary_en.method: A FiLM-DeepONet is trained on simulation and experimental data, with transfer learning and Ensemble Kalman Inversion for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: The probabilistic surrogate predicts deformation time histories and quantifies uncertainty, enabling optimization of curing schedules.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing surrogate predictions with experimental measurements of final deformation from manufacturing trials.

title: Actively Learning Joint Contours of Multiple Computer Experiments
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种主动学习联合等高线的方法，可迁移到多目标约束下的生物力学设计优化中。

summary_zh.motivation: 高效定位多个独立计算机实验的联合等高线，以识别稳定飞行条件。
summary_zh.method: 提出联合等高线定位方案，平衡探索与利用，使用浅层和深度高斯过程代理。
summary_zh.result: 联合等高线定位显著优于传统单响应等高线策略。
summary_zh.validation: 通过飞行器扭矩模拟实验验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently locate the joint contour where multiple independent computer experiments simultaneously achieve pre-specified response values, motivated by identifying stable flight conditions.
summary_en.method: Proposes a joint contour location (jCL) scheme that balances exploration and exploitation using shallow and deep Gaussian process surrogates.
summary_en.result: The jCL designs significantly outperform existing single-response contour location strategies in locating the joint contour.
summary_en.validation: Validated on computer experiments of rotational torques on a vehicle in flight.

title: PIS: A Generalized Physical Inversion Solver for Arbitrary Sparse Observations via Set Conditioned Flow Matching
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过流匹配实现稀疏观测下的PDE参数反演，可迁移至植入物生物力学设计的高效代理建模与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: The method is validated on geophysical and structural health monitoring benchmarks, not on implant biomechanics or structural FEA surrogate models.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决稀疏观测下PDE参数反演的高病态性与低效问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出集合条件流匹配结合余弦退火稀疏课程学习的统一反演框架。
summary_zh.result: 在极端稀疏条件下误差降低88.7%，实现瞬时推理。
summary_zh.validation: 在地下水、波动及结构健康监测等数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome accuracy and efficiency bottlenecks in PDE-constrained inverse problems with sparse and irregular observations.
summary_en.method: A unified Physical Inversion Solver (PIS) coupling Set-Conditioned Flow Matching with a Cosine-Annealed Sparsity Curriculum for stable inversion from arbitrary off-grid sensors.
summary_en.result: PIS achieves up to 88.7% error reduction under extreme sparsity (<1%) and instantaneous inference (50 NFEs) across multiple benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks including subsurface characterization, wave-based characterization, and structural health monitoring.

title: Mind the Jumps: A Scalable Robust Local Gaussian Process for Multidimensional Response Surfaces with Discontinuities
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种鲁棒局部高斯过程模型，能够处理响应曲面中的不连续性和异常值，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的非平稳问题。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling, no implant or biomechanics context, no uncertainty quantification for design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有高斯过程模型难以处理响应曲面中的突变和不连续性。

summary_zh.validation: 在多个真实世界数据集上评估预测精度和可扩展性。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian process models struggle with abrupt jumps and discontinuities in response surfaces due to stationarity assumptions.
summary_en.method: The Robust Local Gaussian Process integrates adaptive nearest-neighbor selection with a sparsity-driven mean-shift adjustment after multivariate perspective transformation.
summary_en.result: RLGP achieves high predictive accuracy near discontinuities and maintains competitive computational efficiency in higher-dimensional settings.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on real-world datasets with sharp transitions and complex response structures, including scalability tests.

title: Uncertainty Quantification for Machine Learning: One Size Does Not Fit All
relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论了不确定性量化（UQ）中不同度量方法的适用性，对FEA代理模型中的UQ设计有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply UQ to FEA surrogate modeling or biomechanical implant design; it is a general theoretical study on UQ measures for classification tasks.

summary_zh.motivation: 机器学习在安全关键应用中需要合适的不确定性量化方法。
summary_zh.method: 使用灵活的不确定性度量族，区分总不确定性、偶然不确定性和认知不确定性，并通过适当评分规则实例化。
summary_zh.result: 不同任务需要不同特性的不确定性度量，选择性预测应匹配任务损失，OOD检测中互信息最优，主动学习中基于零一损失的认知不确定性最佳。
summary_zh.validation: 在分类基准数据集上通过数值实验验证各度量在不同任务中的表现。

summary_en.motivation: To address the need for task-specific uncertainty quantification in safety-critical machine learning applications.
summary_en.method: A flexible family of uncertainty measures distinguishing total, aleatoric, and epistemic uncertainty is instantiated via proper scoring rules to control characteristics.
summary_en.result: Different tasks require different uncertainty measures: selective prediction benefits from matching the task loss, out-of-distribution detection favors mutual information, and active learning is best with zero-one loss-based epistemic uncertainty.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on classification datasets demonstrate the performance of various uncertainty measures across selective prediction, OOD detection, and active learning tasks.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过Zr合金化改善SLM制备Ti6Al4V的力学和生物性能。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the mechanical and biological performance of SLM-fabricated Ti6Al4V for biomedical implants through Zr alloying.
summary_en.method: Zr/Ti6Al4V alloys with up to 4 wt% Zr were fabricated by selective laser melting and characterized for microstructure, mechanical properties, corrosion resistance, and cytocompatibility.

title: Safe Bayesian optimization across noise models via scenario programming
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种适用于不同噪声模型的贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移到植入物设计中的约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or multi-objective constraints specific to implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有安全贝叶斯优化假设噪声同方差，不适用于异方差重尾噪声场景。
summary_zh.method: 利用场景方法推导噪声上界，构建置信区间，提出跨噪声模型的安全贝叶斯优化算法。
summary_zh.result: 算法在合成示例和机器人控制器调优中证明了安全性和最优性。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成数据和Franka Emika机械臂仿真中验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing safe Bayesian optimization assumes homoscedastic sub-Gaussian noise, which is violated in many real-world applications with heteroscedastic heavy-tailed noise.
summary_en.method: A scenario approach is used to derive high-probability bounds on measurement noise, which are integrated into confidence intervals for safe Bayesian optimization across various noise models.
summary_en.result: The proposed algorithm guarantees safety and optimality, demonstrated on synthetic examples and a robot controller tuning task.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic examples and a simulation of the Franka Emika manipulator controller.

title: Integrating Uncertainty Quantification into Computational Fluid Dynamics Models of Coronary Arteries Under Steady Flow
relevance_to_user: 该论文将不确定性量化引入冠状动脉CFD模型，其方法（多项式混沌展开）可迁移至植入物生物力学FEA代理建模中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on cardiovascular CFD, not on implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate modeling, or structural optimization with constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高冠状动脉CFD模型临床可信度，解决输入参数不确定性被忽略的问题。
summary_zh.method: 利用多项式混沌展开构建代理模型，量化输入参数对壁面剪切应力的敏感性。
summary_zh.result: 速度在解析模型中主导WSS变异（~79%），粘度在患者特异性模型中主导（~59%）。
summary_zh.validation: 先验证解析解（泊肃叶流），再应用于患者特异性左主冠状动脉模型。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the credibility of computational fluid dynamics models in clinical settings by accounting for aleatoric uncertainty in input parameters.
summary_en.method: An uncertainty quantification framework using polynomial chaos expansion (UncertainSCI) was employed to build an emulator and extract Sobol sensitivity indices for wall shear stress.
summary_en.result: Velocity dominated WSS variability in the analytical model (~79%), while viscosity dominated in the patient-specific model (~59%), with unary interactions contributing over 93% of total variance.
summary_en.validation: The framework was validated on an analytical Poiseuille flow solution and then applied to a patient-specific left main coronary artery model.

title: Generalized Spherical Neural Operators: Green's Function Formulation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的球形神经算子框架可迁移至生物力学中的球面几何问题（如髋关节表面），但未涉及植入物设计或有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate modeling, no implant mechanics, no biomedical design optimization, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有球形神经算子缺乏处理非等变系统的灵活性，需建立更通用的算子设计框架。
summary_zh.method: 基于可设计的球形格林函数及其谐波展开，提出绝对/相对位置依赖的格林函数，构建GSNO算子与SHNet层次架构。
summary_zh.result: 在扩散MRI、浅水动力学和全球天气预报任务上，GSNO和SHNet一致优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在三个不同领域的基准数据集上进行数值实验对比。

summary_en.motivation: Existing spherical neural operators lack flexibility for non-equivariant systems, motivating a general operator-design framework based on spherical Green's functions.
summary_en.method: Propose a Green's-function Spherical Neural Operator (GSNO) with absolute and relative position-dependent Green's functions, and a hierarchical architecture SHNet combining multi-scale spectral modeling with spherical up-down sampling.

summary_zh.method: 提出合作神经网络框架，集成插补模型与强度预测代理模型，通过合作训练实现单次前向推理。
summary_zh.result: R平方达0.87-0.92，均方误差较基线降低50%-70%。
summary_zh.validation: 与自编码器和高斯过程贝叶斯推断进行数值基准对比。

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient partial inverse design of high-performance concrete under practical constraints with interdependent variables.
summary_en.method: A cooperative neural network framework combining an imputation model and a surrogate strength predictor, trained jointly to generate valid mix designs in a single forward pass.
summary_en.result: Achieves R-squared of 0.87-0.92 and reduces mean squared error by approximately 50% and 70% compared to autoencoder and Bayesian inference baselines.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark against autoencoder models and Gaussian process surrogates on concrete mix design datasets.

title: Hankel-FNO: Fast Underwater Acoustic Charting Via Physics-Encoded Fourier Neural Operator
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的Hankel-FNO方法可用于加速声学仿真，其物理编码策略和泛化能力可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on underwater acoustics, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or FEA surrogate for structural mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统声学仿真计算慢，深度学习代理模型分辨率固定或依赖PDE公式。
summary_zh.method: 提出Hankel-FNO，结合声传播知识和水深数据，实现高效声学制图。
summary_zh.result: Hankel-FNO在速度和精度上均优于传统求解器和数据驱动方法，尤其长距离预测。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多种环境和水声源设置的仿真实验验证模型适应性和泛化能力。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional acoustic solvers are computationally expensive and deep learning surrogates suffer from fixed-resolution or PDE-dependence, hindering real-time large-scale charting.
summary_en.method: Hankel-FNO incorporates sound propagation physics and bathymetry into a Fourier Neural Operator to enable fast and accurate acoustic field prediction.
summary_en.result: The proposed model outperforms traditional solvers in speed and data-driven alternatives in accuracy, especially for long-range predictions, with minimal fine-tuning across environments.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation cases in diverse underwater environments and source settings, demonstrating adaptability and generalization.

title: Validation of material-invariant mechanical models for triply periodic minimal surface structures

summary_zh.validation: 与文献中不同材料的实验结果及有限元分析对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To validate material-invariant mechanical models for TPMS sheet networks as load-bearing cellular structures.
summary_en.method: Cubic polymeric TPMS specimens (Gyroid and Primitive) with relative densities 0.1–0.7 were fabricated via SLS and SLA, and quasi-static compression tests were performed with normalization to solid material properties.
summary_en.result: Relative stiffness, strength, and energy absorption of Gyroid and Primitive structures showed marginal differences and were well approximated by a linear function of relative density.
summary_en.validation: Experimental results were compared with previous FE analyses and experimental data from other studies, confirming material-independent mechanical characteristics.

title: TwinPrint: A dual-arm robotic 3D bioprinting solution for multi-material biofabrication of soft matter constructs

summary_zh.method: 开发了双机械臂生物打印系统TwinPrint，集成同轴喷嘴、微流泵和Python软件界面。
summary_zh.result: 系统实现了多材料打印，细胞存活率高，结构保真度好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过无细胞和细胞打印测试结构保真度、打印精度、细胞活性和增殖。

summary_en.motivation: Current 3D bioprinters lack sufficient degrees of freedom and multi-material capability for complex tissue fabrication.
summary_en.method: A dual-arm robotic bioprinting system, TwinPrint, was developed with a coaxial nozzle, microfluidic pumps, and a Python-based GUI for integrated control.
summary_en.result: The system demonstrated high structural fidelity, multi-material layering, and good cell viability and proliferation.
summary_en.validation: Acellular and cellular constructs were tested for structural fidelity, printing accuracy, cell viability, and proliferation.

title: Design-marginal calibration of Gaussian process predictive distributions: Bayesian and conformal approaches

summary_zh.validation: 数值基准函数实验

summary_en.motivation: To improve the calibration of Gaussian process predictive distributions in the interpolation setting from a design-marginal perspective.
summary_en.method: Two methods are introduced: cps-gp adapting conformal predictive systems and bcr-gp using a generalized normal model with Bayesian selection rules.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments on benchmark functions demonstrate improved calibration metrics and predictive accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark functions with calibration and accuracy metrics.

title: An Operator-Consistent Graph Neural Network for Learning Diffusion Dynamics on Irregular Meshes
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的算子一致图神经网络可用于不规则网格上的扩散动力学学习，其方法可迁移至生物力学中的有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization; it focuses on diffusion PDEs on irregular meshes without uncertainty quantification or biomedical validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 经典数值方法在不规则网格上不稳定，需开发稳定且准确的PDE求解方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出算子一致图神经网络，结合节点-边消息传递与一致性损失，确保图结构上的梯度-散度关系。
summary_zh.result: 在不规则网格扩散问题上，该方法比图卷积和MLP基线更稳定准确，接近Crank-Nicolson求解器性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在物理驱动演化网格和真实扫描表面上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Classical numerical methods become unstable on irregular meshes, motivating the development of stable and accurate PDE solvers for such domains.
summary_en.method: An operator-consistent graph neural network is proposed, coupling node-edge message passing with a consistency loss that enforces the gradient-divergence relation via the graph incidence matrix.
summary_en.result: The model demonstrates improved temporal stability and prediction accuracy over graph convolutional and MLP baselines on diffusion processes over irregular meshes, approaching Crank-Nicolson solver performance.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on physically driven evolving meshes and real-world scanned surfaces.

title: Uncertainty Quantification for Scientific Machine Learning using Sparse Variational Gaussian Process Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (SVGP KAN)

summary_en.motivation: Standard Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks lack principled uncertainty quantification, limiting their use in scientific applications.
summary_en.method: Proposes Sparse Variational Gaussian Process Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (SVGP KANs) by integrating sparse variational GP inference with additive KAN topology for scalable Bayesian UQ.
summary_en.result: The framework distinguishes aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty in three benchmarks: heteroscedastic noise calibration, multi-step forecasting, and out-of-distribution detection.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical experiments: fluid flow reconstruction, advection-diffusion forecasting, and convolutional autoencoder OOD detection.

summary_en.result: The new guarantee remains informative for small data sizes and is validated on multiple examples, offering a more applicable uncertainty quantification framework.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a suite of numerical examples, demonstrating convergence and improved relevance compared to classic conformal prediction.

summary_en.method: A hybrid approach combining the Parameterized Background Data-Weak (PBDW) framework with a DeepONet that learns model discrepancy as an orthogonal complement to the reduced-order manifold.
summary_en.result: The method effectively estimates states and predicts under various modeling errors, demonstrated on the Helmholtz equation with uncertain boundary conditions and source terms.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a numerical benchmark problem of the Helmholtz equation with multiple sources of modeling error.

summary_en.motivation: Existing diffusion-based PDE solvers suffer from slow gradient-based guidance and optimization instability.

summary_en.validation: The method is validated on five benchmark PDEs, demonstrating accuracy and inference speedup.

summary_en.validation: Validated on multiple regression benchmark datasets.

summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks demonstrate scalability and uncertainty quantification capabilities.

summary_en.motivation: To achieve accurate temporal extrapolation in reduced-order modeling of parameterized PDEs on unstructured grids, which remains challenging due to the need for both temporal causality and parametric generalizability.
summary_en.method: A graph convolutional autoencoder is combined with tensor train decomposition and Operator Inference, enhanced by a multi-fidelity DeepONet approach where spatial and temporal cores serve as trunk networks and the parametric core as the branch network.
summary_en.result: The proposed method demonstrates strong performance in extrapolating dynamics for complex geometries on heat-conduction, advection-diffusion, and vortex-shedding problems, outperforming state-of-the-art methods like MeshGraphNets.

summary_en.result: Demonstrates high accuracy and data efficiency on a battery degradation DAE and standard constrained benchmarks, while highlighting trade-offs between physical consistency, computational cost, and numerical stability.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有共形预测局限于标量分数，缺乏多变量预测分布。
summary_zh.method: 利用最优传输定义向量排序，结合共形校准构建多变量共形预测分布。
summary_zh.result: 首次实现具有有限样本校准的多变量共形预测分布，覆盖保证成立。

summary_en.motivation: Conformal prediction is limited to scalar non-conformity scores, lacking a principled method for multivariate predictive distributions with finite-sample guarantees.
summary_en.method: We leverage optimal transport to define vector-valued ranks and multivariate quantile regions, then conformalize them to construct predictive distributions.
summary_en.result: The proposed method yields the first multivariate conformal predictive distributions with finite-sample calibration, ensuring valid coverage for any derived uncertainty region.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks demonstrate coverage guarantees and distributional calibration.

title: PAS-Net: Physics-informed Adaptive Scale Deep Operator Network
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自适应尺度算子网络方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或生物力学验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address the difficulty of learning localized steep gradients and multiscale dynamics in nonlinear PDEs.

summary_en.result: Achieves higher accuracy and faster convergence than standard DeepONet and PI-DeepONet on three benchmark PDE problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on 1D viscous Burgers, nonlinear diffusion-reaction, and 2D eikonal equations.

why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on a mechanical mixing strategy without autonomous decision-making or model training.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决水凝胶构建体血管化与力学稳定性不足的问题。
summary_zh.method: 采用Kenics静态混合器打印头实现多材料混沌打印，制造含微通道的增强水凝胶纤维。

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of combining vascularization and mechanical stability in hydrogel constructs for long-term tissue culture.
summary_en.method: A chaotic bioprinting strategy using a Kenics Static Mixer printhead to fabricate reinforced hydrogel filaments with embedded microchannels via multimaterial layering.
summary_en.result: Optimized filaments maintained high cell viability (>90%) over 21 days and enhanced cell proliferation, spreading, and alignment compared to solid fibers.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing, degradation analysis, and in vitro cell culture with C2C12 myoblasts validated the structural integrity and biological performance.

title: Enforcing hidden physics in physics-informed neural networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种增强PINN物理一致性的正则化方法，可迁移至生物力学FEA代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and focuses on PDE solving rather than design optimization or biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统PINN未能充分体现不可逆物理过程的单向性，导致预测误差。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种不可逆性正则化策略，将隐藏物理定律作为软约束加入训练。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准问题上，预测误差降低一个数量级以上。
summary_zh.validation: 通过波动传播、燃烧、冰融化等数值基准验证。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional PINNs fail to enforce the one-way nature of irreversible physical processes, leading to inaccurate predictions.
summary_en.method: A simple irreversibility-regularized strategy is introduced to enforce hidden physical laws as soft constraints during training.
summary_en.result: The proposed regularization reduces predictive errors by more than an order of magnitude across diverse benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks including traveling wave propagation, steady combustion, ice melting, corrosion evolution, and crack growth.

title: Method of Manufactured Learning for Solver-free Training of Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过解析合成数据训练神经算子，避免了昂贵的数值求解器，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective constraints, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics-specific applications; it focuses on solver-free training for canonical PDEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 避免依赖数值求解器生成训练数据，降低神经算子训练成本。
summary_zh.method: 通过解析构造满足控制方程的合成数据训练神经算子，推理时置零强迫项恢复原方程。
summary_zh.result: 在热方程、对流、Burgers等基准上实现高谱精度和低残差，泛化能力强。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，与解析解或数值解对比谱误差和残差。

summary_en.motivation: To eliminate the dependency on computationally expensive numerical solvers for generating training data in neural operator learning.
summary_en.method: The Method of Manufactured Learning (MML) trains neural operators on analytically synthesized function pairs, where forcing terms are derived by applying the governing differential operator to manufactured solutions, and set to zero during inference.
summary_en.result: MML achieves high spectral accuracy and low residual errors on canonical PDE benchmarks, demonstrating strong generalization to unseen conditions without solver-generated data.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on heat, advection, Burgers, and diffusion-reaction equations, comparing spectral accuracy and residual errors against analytical or numerical references.

summary_zh.method: 利用藻酸盐-胶原生物墨水与黄原胶-胶原支撑浴的流变学优化，通过三轴喷嘴同步打印血管结构

summary_en.motivation: To improve clinical drug prediction accuracy by constructing vascularized tissue models that recapitulate the in vivo microenvironment.

summary_zh.method: 基于Wasserstein距离训练随机神经网络，并改进训练方法

summary_en.motivation: To address the curse of dimensionality in reconstructing multidimensional random field models from limited data.
summary_en.method: A Wasserstein-distance-based training approach for stochastic neural networks is proposed and improved.
summary_en.result: The generalization error bound is shown to be independent of dimensionality under heterogeneous noise, mitigating the curse of dimensionality.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on multidimensional uncertainty quantification tasks demonstrate the robustness of the method.

title: xLSTM-PINN: Memory-Gated Spectral Remodeling for Physics-Informed Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种通过记忆门控和残差微步进行谱重塑的xLSTM-PINN架构，可缓解谱偏差并提高高频成分的学习能力，对代理建模中的高波数PDE求解具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses solely on improving PINN spectral bias on generic PDE benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: PINN因谱偏差难以学习高频现象和外推，需改进架构。
summary_zh.method: 提出xLSTM-PINN，通过记忆门控和残差微步在表示层进行谱重塑。
summary_zh.result: 在四个PDE基准上谱误差和RMSE显著降低，高频核权重提升，收敛加快。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE数值基准上对比RMSE和谱误差。

summary_en.motivation: Physics-informed neural networks suffer from spectral bias that limits their ability to learn high-frequency components and extrapolate, motivating a new architecture.
summary_en.method: xLSTM-PINN performs representation-level spectral remodeling via memory gating and residual micro-steps without altering automatic differentiation or physics loss.
summary_en.result: The method consistently achieves lower spectral error and RMSE across four PDE benchmarks, elevates high-frequency kernel weights, and broadens the stable learning-rate window.
summary_en.validation: Validation is conducted on four numerical PDE benchmarks by comparing root mean square error and spectral error distributions.

title: The modified Physics-Informed Hybrid Parallel Kolmogorov--Arnold and Multilayer Perceptron Architecture with domain decomposition
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进的物理信息神经网络架构，用于解决高频和多尺度问题，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not address constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服物理信息神经网络在高频多尺度问题中的训练困难。
summary_zh.method: 提出混合并行KAN与MLP的PINN架构，结合可训练权重和重叠域分解。
summary_zh.result: 相比手动调参，降低了训练成本并提高了计算效率。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准上验证了方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the high-frequency and multiscale challenges in Physics-Informed Neural Networks.
summary_en.method: A hybrid parallel Kolmogorov-Arnold Network and Multilayer Perceptron architecture with a trainable convex combination weight and overlapping domain decomposition.
summary_en.result: The method reduces training costs and improves computational efficiency compared to manual hyperparameter tuning.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks for high-frequency multiscale problems.

title: Sumudu Neural Operator for ODEs and PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于Sumudu变换的神经算子，可应用于偏微分方程求解，但其方法尚未在生物力学或植入物设计中进行验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not handle constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高神经算子对偏微分方程的求解精度和泛化能力。
summary_zh.method: 利用Sumudu变换分解输入空间，在变换域中参数化神经算子。
summary_zh.result: 在多个ODE和PDE任务上优于FNO，与LNO精度相当。
summary_zh.validation: 在Duffing振子、Lorenz系统、Euler-Bernoulli梁等标准数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and generalization of neural operators for solving ordinary and partial differential equations.
summary_en.method: The Sumudu Neural Operator decomposes the input space via polynomial expansions of transform pairs and parameterizes the operator in the Sumudu space.
summary_en.result: SNO achieves superior performance to FNO on several PDEs and competitive accuracy with LNO, including the lowest error on the Euler-Bernoulli Beam and Diffusion Equation.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical benchmarks including the Duffing oscillator, Lorenz system, Euler-Bernoulli beam, and Burgers' equation.

title: One-Shot Transfer Learning for Nonlinear PDEs with Perturbative PINNs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的扰动PINN与迁移学习方法可加速非线性PDE求解，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计中的约束优化与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no validation on implant or biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速非线性PDE求解，避免传统PINN重复训练。
summary_zh.method: 将非线性PDE分解为线性子问题，用多头PINN学习线性算子，实现单次迁移。
summary_zh.result: 在KPP-Fisher和波动方程上误差约1e-3，新实例适应时间小于0.2秒。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，与经典求解器对比精度和速度。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate solving nonlinear PDEs by avoiding retraining PINNs for each new instance.
summary_en.method: Decompose nonlinear PDEs into linear subproblems via perturbation theory and learn the linear operator with a Multi-Head PINN for one-shot transfer.
summary_en.result: Achieves errors around 1e-3 on KPP-Fisher and wave equations, adapting to new instances in under 0.2 seconds.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks, comparing accuracy and speed against classical solvers.

title: Credal Ensemble Distillation for Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种不确定性量化方法，可迁移至代理模型以评估预测置信度，但未涉及有限元或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on classification tasks and does not address expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低深度集成模型推理时的高计算和内存成本
summary_zh.method: 提出信义集成蒸馏框架，将深度集成压缩为单模型输出概率区间
summary_zh.result: 在分布外检测中取得与深度集成相当的不确定性估计，同时显著降低推理开销
summary_zh.validation: 在标准分布外检测基准上对比多个基线方法

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high computational and memory costs of deep ensembles during inference for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: Proposes credal ensemble distillation (CED) that compresses a deep ensemble into a single model predicting class-wise probability intervals defining a credal set.
summary_en.result: Achieves superior or comparable uncertainty estimation on out-of-distribution detection benchmarks while substantially reducing inference overhead compared to deep ensembles.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on standard out-of-distribution detection benchmarks against several baselines.

title: An integrated computational materials engineering framework for process–structure–property mapping in laser powder bed fusion
first_author_affiliation: Research Center for Structural Materials, National Institute for Materials Science, 1-2-1 Sengen, Tsukuba, 305-0047 Ibaraki, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Fabien Briffod
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Research Center for Structural Materials, National Institute for Materials Science, 1-2-1 Sengen, Tsukuba, 305-0047 Ibaraki, Japan

relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于Hastelloy-X合金的LPBF工艺-结构-性能映射，未涉及生物医学植入物、应力遮挡或多孔结构。
why_not_core: No porous structure, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, no biomedical implant context, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 建立LPBF工艺-结构-性能映射，减少试错实验。
summary_zh.method: 耦合热传递、元胞自动机和晶体塑性有限元模拟。
summary_zh.result: 成功预测了熔池几何、晶粒结构和力学性能随工艺参数的变化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过单道实验校准热模型，并与实验微观结构对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop an experimentally validated ICME framework for mapping process-structure-property relationships in LPBF of Hastelloy-X, reducing reliance on trial-and-error experiments.
summary_en.method: A coupled workflow integrating heat transfer simulation, cellular automata solidification, and crystal plasticity finite elements, calibrated with Bayesian inference from single-track experiments.
summary_en.result: The framework accurately reproduced melt pool geometry, grain morphology, and crystallographic texture, revealing direct correlations between process parameters and mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Calibrated against single-track experiments and validated by comparing predicted microstructures and mechanical responses with experimental data.

title: Torch-Uncertainty: A Deep Learning Framework for Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提供了深度学习不确定性量化的统一框架，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的预测不确定性评估。
why_not_core: This paper is a general-purpose UQ library for deep learning, with no application to FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 缺乏统一的深度学习不确定性量化工具，阻碍实际应用。
summary_zh.method: 基于PyTorch和Lightning构建UQ框架，集成多种方法和评估指标。
summary_zh.result: 在分类、分割和回归任务上对多种UQ方法进行了基准测试。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准图像和回归数据集上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: The lack of a unified tool for uncertainty quantification in deep learning hinders its adoption in critical applications.
summary_en.method: Torch-Uncertainty is a PyTorch and Lightning-based framework that integrates diverse UQ methods and evaluation metrics for streamlined training and benchmarking.
summary_en.result: Comprehensive experiments benchmark multiple UQ techniques across classification, segmentation, and regression tasks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard datasets (e.g., CIFAR, ImageNet, UCI regression) validate the framework's effectiveness.

title: SVD-NO: Learning PDE Solution Operators with SVD Integral Kernels
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种新的神经算子架构，可提高PDE求解效率，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计，方法具有迁移潜力。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on general PDE solution operators without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子对核积分算子结构假设过强，限制表达能力。
summary_zh.method: 提出SVD-NO，用SVD显式参数化核，两个轻量网络学习奇异函数，对角矩阵学习奇异值。
summary_zh.result: 在五个基准方程上达到新最优，尤其对高空间变化PDE提升显著。
summary_zh.validation: 在五个标准PDE基准数据集上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators impose strong assumptions on kernel integral operator structure, limiting expressivity.
summary_en.method: SVD-NO explicitly parameterizes the kernel via SVD, using two lightweight networks for singular functions and a diagonal matrix for singular values, with Gram-matrix regularization for orthonormality.
summary_en.result: SVD-NO achieves state-of-the-art performance on five diverse PDE benchmarks, with greater gains on highly spatially variable solutions.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on five standard PDE datasets (e.g., Darcy flow, Burgers' equation).

title: Noise-Aware Optimization in Nominally Identical Manufacturing and Measuring Systems for High-Throughput Parallel Workflows
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了噪声感知的贝叶斯优化框架，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的多设备不确定性优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constraint handling in design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高通量增材制造中设备间噪声差异导致的优化效率与可靠性问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出噪声感知决策算法，通过分布分析与聚类选择单设备或鲁棒多设备贝叶斯优化策略。
summary_zh.result: 在三台名义相同的3D打印机上实验，降低了冗余与资源消耗，提高了可靠性。
summary_zh.validation: 三台同型号3D打印机的实际打印实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address reproducibility and efficiency issues caused by device-to-device noise variability in high-throughput additive manufacturing systems.
summary_en.method: A noise-aware decision-making algorithm that quantifies device-specific noise profiles and adaptively selects between single-device and robust multi-device Bayesian optimization using distributional analysis and clustering.
summary_en.result: Experimental validation on three nominally identical 3D printers demonstrated reduced redundancy, lower resource usage, and improved reliability.
summary_en.validation: Experimental case study with three identical 3D printers (same brand, model, close serial numbers).

title: Impact of anatomical adaptation in cemented femoral stems on mechanical properties and alignment
first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Faculty of Medicie, Graduate School of Medicine, Hokkaido University, Kita-15 Nishi-7, Kita-ku, Sapporo, 060-8638, Hokkaido, Japan. simitom@wg8.so-net.ne.jp

corresponding_authors.name: Tomohiro Shimizu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Faculty of Medicie, Graduate School of Medicine, Hokkaido University, Kita-15 Nishi-7, Kita-ku, Sapporo, 060-8638, Hokkaido, Japan. simitom@wg8.so-net.ne.jp

relevance_to_user: 该论文评估了适应亚洲解剖结构的骨水泥股骨柄的力学性能和放射学对齐，但未涉及应力遮挡或微动分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it focuses on rotational resistance and alignment without FEA or intact vs. implanted comparison.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估适应亚洲解剖结构的骨水泥股骨柄的力学性能和对齐效果。
summary_zh.method: 通过机械测试和回顾性放射学分析比较VLIAN柄与Exeter柄。
summary_zh.result: VLIAN柄在Dorr C型股骨中内翻角显著减小，力学性能无差异。
summary_zh.validation: 机械测试（旋转阻力、刚度）和临床放射学分析。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate whether an anatomically adapted cemented femoral stem improves alignment and maintains mechanical properties compared to a standard stem in Asian populations.
summary_en.method: Mechanical testing of rotational resistance and stiffness using composite femurs, combined with retrospective radiographic analysis of 654 patients.
summary_en.result: The anatomically adapted stem showed significantly smaller varus angles in Dorr type C femurs without compromising rotational resistance or stiffness.
summary_en.validation: Validation through mechanical testing (rotational torque, load-displacement) and clinical radiographic assessment.

title: Accelerating the Serviceability-Based Design of Reinforced Concrete Rail Bridges under Geometric Uncertainties induced by unforeseen events: A Surrogate Modeling approach
relevance_to_user: 该论文将代理模型用于桥梁设计中的不确定性传播和失效分类，其方法可迁移至植入物设计中的不确定性量化与约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or bone-implant interface; it focuses on civil engineering structures.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决桥梁设计因几何不确定性导致的重复计算和成本问题
summary_zh.method: 采用Kriging、多项式混沌展开和支持向量回归等代理模型替代有限元模拟
summary_zh.result: 代理模型能高效探索设计场景并分类失效与安全状态
summary_zh.validation: 通过多纤维有限元模型生成数据集，对比不同代理模型性能

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational overhead and enable efficient probabilistic design of reinforced concrete rail bridges under geometric uncertainties from unforeseen construction constraints.
summary_en.method: Surrogate models including Kriging, polynomial chaos expansion, and support vector regression are trained on a multi-fiber finite element model to approximate bridge performance functions.
summary_en.result: The surrogate-based approach efficiently explores design scenarios and classifies failure versus safe states with minimal finite element simulations.
summary_en.validation: The surrogate models are validated against a finite element model of a four-span reinforced concrete bridge deck using a design of experiments.

title: Guaranteeing Conservation of Integrals with Projection in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过投影保证PINN中的积分守恒，可迁移至生物力学FEA代理模型中确保物理一致性。
why_not_core: No application to biomedical or implant mechanics; no FEA surrogate or optimization; no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: PINN软约束无法保证积分守恒，需强制满足物理定律。
summary_zh.method: 提出投影方法，通过求解约束优化问题修正PINN输出以守恒线性和二次积分。
summary_zh.result: 积分守恒误差降低3-4个数量级，PDE解误差略有减小。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准上测试守恒误差和收敛性。

summary_en.motivation: Soft constraints in PINNs fail to guarantee conservation of integral quantities, motivating a projection method to enforce physical laws.
summary_en.method: A projection method is introduced that solves constrained nonlinear optimization problems to modify PINN outputs, ensuring conservation of linear and quadratic integrals separately or jointly.
summary_en.result: The proposed PINN-Proj reduces conservation errors by three to four orders of magnitude and marginally decreases PDE solution error.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks, demonstrating improved conservation and convergence.

title: Amortized Multi-Objective Optimization Across Tasks with Generative Solution Modeling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种跨任务参数化多目标贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵多目标优化问题。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant design problems; no contact mechanics or stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决连续任务参数空间下无限多个昂贵多目标优化问题的求解效率。
summary_zh.method: 学习逆模型，通过条件生成模型和采集函数交替优化实现跨任务摊销。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实基准上验证了方法无需重新评估即可预测新任务的Pareto解。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，包括合成问题和真实世界基准。

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of solving infinite families of expensive multi-objective optimization problems under varying operational conditions without re-evaluation.
summary_en.method: Proposes a parametric multi-objective Bayesian optimizer that learns an inverse model via alternating generative solution sampling and acquisition-driven search across tasks.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates direct solution prediction for unseen parameterized problems without re-evaluations, with theoretical convergence guarantees.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic and real-world benchmarks, showing effectiveness over existing methods.

title: Global Optimization on Graph-Structured Data via Gaussian Processes with Spectral Representations
relevance_to_user: 该方法将贝叶斯优化扩展到图结构数据，其代理建模思想可迁移到FEA替代模型的采样效率问题，但未涉及力学仿真或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, does not handle constraints in optimization, and lacks experimental validation in biomechanics or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化图结构上的昂贵黑箱函数，现有方法难以扩展到大图或部分观测图。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于低秩谱表示的GP代理模型，联合推断图结构和节点嵌入。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实数据集上实现更快收敛和更优优化性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实图数据集上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: This paper addresses the challenge of Bayesian optimization over graph-structured data, which is difficult for existing methods when graphs are large or partially observed.
summary_en.method: A scalable framework is introduced that uses low-rank spectral representations to construct Gaussian process surrogates from sparse observations, jointly inferring graph structure and node embeddings.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves faster convergence and better optimization performance compared to prior approaches on both synthetic and real-world graph datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical experiments on synthetic and real-world graph datasets.

title: Eliminating defects and improving microstructure and mechanical properties of additively manufactured TiAl alloy via spark plasma sintering post-treatment

why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or surface roughness relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 消除LPBF制造TiAl合金中的缺陷以提高力学性能
summary_zh.method: 采用放电等离子烧结后处理消除裂纹和孔隙
summary_zh.result: 获得无裂纹、孔隙率0.04%、抗拉强度353.2 MPa的TiAl样品

summary_en.motivation: To eliminate defects in LPBF-fabricated TiAl alloys that degrade mechanical properties and reliability.
summary_en.method: A spark plasma sintering post-treatment is applied to heal cracks and pores while preserving fine microstructure.
summary_en.result: Crack-free TiAl samples with 0.04% porosity and tensile strength of 353.2 MPa are achieved.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile) and microstructural characterization (SEM, EBSD) confirm defect elimination and property enhancement.

why_not_core: This paper does not include LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), stress shielding analysis, or as-built surface morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 钛合金生物惰性导致骨整合差，需表面改性。
summary_zh.method: 在多孔钛支架上引入含镁明胶水凝胶界面。

summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和体内大鼠骨缺损模型验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the bioinertness of titanium alloy implants that limits osseointegration.
summary_en.method: A magnesium-incorporated gelatin macroporous hydrogel was coated onto porous titanium alloy scaffolds.
summary_en.result: The hydrogel-modified scaffolds enhanced cell adhesion, osteogenesis, and angiogenesis, leading to improved osseointegration in a rat model.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays and in vivo rat bone defect models were used for validation.

title: A novel L-BFGS-B optimized machine learning model for predicting tensile strength of SLM-manufactured Ti-6Al-4V alloys
first_author_affiliation: APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India

why_not_core: This paper does not cover porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration, which are core to the AM biomedical direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高SLM制造Ti-6Al-4V合金拉伸强度预测的准确性。

summary_zh.validation: 通过实验拉伸测试数据验证模型。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy of predicting tensile strength of SLM-manufactured Ti-6Al-4V alloys using machine learning.
summary_en.method: A machine learning model optimized by the L-BFGS-B algorithm is developed to predict tensile strength.
summary_en.result: The optimized model achieves higher prediction accuracy compared to conventional methods.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated against experimental tensile test data.

title: A Neural-Operator Preconditioned Newton Method for Accelerated Nonlinear Solvers
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种神经算子预条件牛顿法，可加速非线性求解器，其方法有潜力迁移到生物力学有限元代理模型中。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not address implant/biomechanics design constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服牛顿法在不平衡非线性下的停滞或不稳定问题
summary_zh.method: 提出固定点神经算子学习迭代到解的映射，自适应采用负步长
summary_zh.result: 在强非线性应用中展示了计算效率和鲁棒性
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome stagnation or instability of Newton iterations caused by unbalanced nonlinearities in parametric nonlinear systems.
summary_en.method: A fixed-point neural operator (FPNO) learns the direct mapping from current iterate to solution by emulating fixed-point iterations, adaptively employing negative step sizes.
summary_en.result: The NP-Newton method demonstrates computational efficiency and robustness across multiple real-world applications with very strong nonlinearities.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical experiments on several benchmark problems.

title: Walsh-Hadamard Neural Operators for Solving PDEs with Discontinuous Coefficients
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的Walsh-Hadamard神经算子能有效处理间断系数PDE，可迁移至生物力学中材料属性突变的代理建模。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant-related problems, no uncertainty quantification, and no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准傅里叶神经算子处理间断系数PDE时存在吉布斯现象，需新方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出Walsh-Hadamard神经算子，结合矩形波谱与可学习权重。
summary_zh.result: 在达西流、热传导和Burgers方程上，WHNO优于FNO，且集成模型误差降低35-40%。
summary_zh.validation: 在三个标准PDE基准问题上与FNO进行数值对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Fourier neural operators suffer from Gibbs phenomenon when solving PDEs with discontinuous coefficients, motivating a spectral basis better suited for piecewise constant fields.
summary_en.method: The Walsh-Hadamard Neural Operator (WHNO) uses Walsh-Hadamard transforms with learnable spectral weights to capture sharp interfaces and global dependencies.
summary_en.result: WHNO outperforms FNO on Darcy flow, heat conduction, and Burgers equation, and weighted ensembles of WHNO and FNO reduce MSE by 35-40%.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on three PDE problems with discontinuous coefficients, comparing against FNO under identical conditions.

title: Intelligent Optimization of Multi-Parameter Micromixers Using a Scientific Machine Learning Framework
relevance_to_user: 该论文将科学机器学习（Sci-ML）框架用于多参数微混合器的优化，其方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真采样效率问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not handle constraints beyond single-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决传统仿真优化方法计算耗时且只能单问题优化的局限。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于深度强化学习与参数化PINN的Sci-ML框架，实现多参数微混合器即时优化。
summary_zh.result: 优化后效率始终高于基线，最大提升约32%。
summary_zh.validation: 与遗传算法对比验证框架优势。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational inefficiency and single-problem limitation of traditional simulation-based optimization methods.
summary_en.method: A scientific machine learning framework combining deep reinforcement learning with a parametric physics-informed neural network is proposed for instantaneous multi-parameter optimization.
summary_en.result: The optimized micromixer designs consistently exceed baseline efficiency, with a maximum improvement of approximately 32% at a Schmidt number of 13.3.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated through a comparative analysis with a genetic algorithm under equivalent conditions.

title: Transolver is a Linear Transformer: Revisiting Physics-Attention through the Lens of Linear Attention
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的线性注意力机制用于PDE求解，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on PDE surrogate modeling with linear attention but does not address multi-objective constraints, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics-specific applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低Transformer神经算子在PDE求解中的计算复杂度
summary_zh.method: 将Physics-Attention重写为线性注意力，提出LinearNO
summary_zh.result: 在六个标准PDE基准上达到SOTA，参数减少40%，计算成本降低36%
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准和两个工业数据集上验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the quadratic computational complexity of Transformer-based neural operators for PDE solving.
summary_en.method: Reformulates Physics-Attention as a special case of linear attention and proposes LinearNO, a canonical linear attention neural operator.
summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on six PDE benchmarks with 40% fewer parameters and 36.2% lower computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard PDE benchmarks and two industrial datasets (AirfRANS and Shape-Net Car).

title: Cross-Field Interface-Aware Neural Operators for Multiphase Flow Simulation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的界面感知神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学中具有材料不连续性的问题，如骨-植入物界面模拟。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on multiphase flow simulation and does not address implant biomechanics, structural FEA, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 多相流模拟计算成本高，神经算子难以处理界面不连续和谱偏差。
summary_zh.method: 提出界面信息感知神经算子，利用界面拓扑和位置编码增强高频特征学习。
summary_zh.result: 在多个多相流案例中精度提升约10%，且在低数据和高噪声下泛化良好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准案例与现有神经算子基线对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Multiphase flow simulation is computationally expensive, and neural operators struggle with spectral bias and data scarcity due to phase interfaces.
summary_en.method: The Interface Information Aware Neural Operator (IANO) incorporates interface topology and geometry-aware positional encoding to capture high-frequency features.
summary_en.result: IANO achieves up to 10% accuracy improvement over baselines and shows strong generalization under low-data and noisy conditions.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmark cases of multiphase flow against existing neural operator baselines.

title: Constraint-Informed Active Learning for End-to-End ACOPF Optimization Proxies
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的约束感知主动采样框架可迁移至生物力学代理模型的训练数据生成，但未涉及植入物设计或有限元分析。

summary_zh.motivation: 提高ACOPF优化代理的训练数据质量与泛化能力
summary_zh.method: 提出基于主动约束集的主动采样框架生成多样训练数据
summary_zh.result: 在同等训练预算下显著优于现有采样方法
summary_zh.validation: 在标准ACOPF算例上验证泛化性能

summary_en.motivation: To improve the quality and diversity of training data for ACOPF optimization proxies, enhancing their generalization.
summary_en.method: A constraint-informed active sampling framework that uses active constraint sets to generate realistic and diverse problem specifications.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves superior generalization over existing sampling methods under the same training budget.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard ACOPF benchmarks demonstrate improved proxy performance.

title: A framework of discontinuous Galerkin neural networks for iteratively approximating residuals
relevance_to_user: 该方法可提升PDE求解精度，但未涉及采样效率、约束处理或UQ，需评估是否可迁移至生物力学代理建模。

summary_zh.motivation: 提高神经网络求解偏微分方程的精度和收敛性。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于单元神经网络的间断伽辽金框架，结合h-精化与残差最小化。
summary_zh.result: 相比PINN，相对L2误差降低一个数量级，计算成本低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例验证，比较相对L2误差。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and convergence of neural network-based PDE solvers by reducing residual errors.
summary_en.method: Proposes a discontinuous Galerkin neural network (DGNN) framework with element-wise neural networks and h-refinement for iterative residual minimization.
summary_en.result: The DGNN method achieves at least one order of magnitude improvement in relative L2 error over PINN with low computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark PDE problems by comparing relative L2 errors against existing PINN algorithms.

summary_zh.motivation: 刚性ODE参数化求解计算昂贵，GP代理模型在非平稳区域性能差。

summary_zh.result: 重参数化后GP性能显著提升，计算开销小。

summary_en.method: A reparameterization preprocessing step transforms stiff ODE solutions into more stationary functions to improve GP performance.
summary_en.result: The proposed method recovers good GP accuracy with minimal computational overhead across multiple examples.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on several stiff ODE systems demonstrate the effectiveness of the reparameterization.

title: Hard-constraint physics-residual networks enable robust extrapolation for hydrogen crossover prediction in PEM water electrolyzers
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的硬约束物理残差网络方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但应用于电解槽而非植入物设计。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome catastrophic extrapolation failures of data-driven and soft-constraint PINNs under sparse training conditions.
summary_en.method: A hard-constraint physics-residual network (PR-Net) embeds analytical transport equations as a deterministic backbone, learning only systematic deviations.
summary_en.result: PR-Net achieves R² > 97% under 2.5-fold extrapolation, with 39-fold reduction in training variance.
summary_en.validation: Validated on 184 experimental points across six membrane types and extreme pressure conditions up to 200 bar.

title: Physics-Guided Machine Learning for Uncertainty Quantification in Turbulence Models

summary_zh.validation: 在典型湍流算例上数值验证。

summary_en.method: A CNN-based modulation of Eigenspace Perturbation Method magnitudes is proposed to combine physics-based and data-driven uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: The hybrid ML-EPM framework yields substantially tighter and better-calibrated uncertainty estimates than baseline EPM.
summary_en.validation: Numerical validation on canonical turbulent flow cases.

title: Consecutive Preferential Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种考虑生产成本的连续偏好贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移到植入物设计优化中，但未涉及有限元仿真或生物力学约束。

summary_zh.method: 提出连续偏好贝叶斯优化，通过约束比较涉及已有候选解并引入最小可觉差阈值。
summary_zh.result: 在高生产成本或模糊反馈场景下显著提升优化精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实基准问题上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing preference-based optimization ignores the cost of generating candidate solutions, which is critical in expensive real-world settings.
summary_en.method: This work proposes Consecutive Preferential Bayesian Optimization, which reduces production cost by constraining comparisons to previously generated candidates and incorporates a Just-Noticeable Difference threshold to model perceptual ambiguity.
summary_en.result: The method achieves notable accuracy improvements in setups with high production costs or indifference feedback.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic and real-world benchmark problems using numerical experiments.

title: Block-structured Operator Inference for coupled multiphysics model reduction

summary_en.motivation: Efficiently reduce sampling cost for coupled multiphysics simulations while preserving system structure.
summary_en.method: Proposes a block-structured Operator Inference approach that learns reduced-order models by specifying governing equation structures per physics component and coupling terms.
summary_en.result: Achieves 20% online speedup over monolithic Operator Inference on the AGARD 445.6 wing benchmark across flow regimes while maintaining accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a numerical benchmark (aeroelastic analysis of the AGARD 445.6 wing).
