title: Conformal Prediction-Driven Adaptive Sampling for Digital Water Twins
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于共形预测的自适应采样方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的主动学习采样，但缺乏对约束处理和不确定性量化的深入探讨。

summary_zh.motivation: 数字水网中传感器资源有限，均匀采样浪费资源。
summary_zh.method: 结合LSTM预测与共形预测估计节点不确定性，自适应选择高不确定性节点采样。
summary_zh.result: 在三个基准网络上，需求误差降低33-34%，经验覆盖率达89.4-90.2%。

summary_en.motivation: Accurate state estimation in digital water twins is hindered by limited sensors and inefficient uniform sampling.
summary_en.method: An adaptive sampling framework that combines LSTM forecasting with conformal prediction to estimate node-wise uncertainty and focus sensing on the most uncertain points.
summary_en.result: The proposed method reduces demand error by 33-34% compared to uniform sampling at 40% coverage while maintaining 89.4-90.2% empirical coverage with only 5-10% extra computation.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three benchmark water distribution networks: Hanoi, Net3, and CTOWN.

title: Comparing EPGP Surrogates and Finite Elements Under Degree-of-Freedom Parity
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种边界约束的高斯过程代理模型，用于求解波动方程，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on the wave equation with homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or structural FEA with contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较边界约束高斯过程代理与有限元方法在波动方程求解中的精度。
summary_zh.method: 采用B-EPGP代理模型，通过指数多项式基精确满足PDE和边界条件，并用惩罚最小二乘估计系数。
summary_zh.result: 在自由度匹配下，B-EPGP的L2误差比CN-FEM低约两个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 通过二维波动方程数值基准测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to benchmark a boundary-constrained Ehrenpreis-Palamodov Gaussian Process surrogate against classical finite elements for solving the 2D wave equation.
summary_en.method: The B-EPGP surrogate uses exponential-polynomial bases derived from the characteristic variety to exactly enforce the PDE and boundary conditions, with coefficients estimated via penalized least squares.
summary_en.result: Under a degrees-of-freedom matching protocol, B-EPGP achieves approximately two orders of magnitude lower space-time L2 error than CN-FEM.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on the 2D wave equation with homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions.

title: Provable Accelerated Bayesian Optimization with Knowledge Transfer
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种利用源任务知识加速贝叶斯优化的方法，可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency in the context of FEA or biomechanics, nor does it handle constraints or provide UQ for point predictions.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速目标任务的贝叶斯优化，利用源任务历史知识。
summary_zh.method: 提出DeltaBO算法，对源与目标函数差值进行不确定性量化。
summary_zh.result: DeltaBO的遗憾界优于非迁移BO，且实验验证了有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 在超参数调优和合成函数上对比基线方法。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate Bayesian optimization on a target task by transferring knowledge from related source tasks with theoretical guarantees.
summary_en.method: Proposes DeltaBO, which constructs an uncertainty quantification on the difference function between source and target functions in possibly different RKHSs.
summary_en.result: DeltaBO achieves a regret bound of order Õ(√(T(T/N + γ_δ))), outperforming non-transfer BO when source and target are similar.
summary_en.validation: Empirical studies on real-world hyperparameter-tuning tasks and synthetic functions verify the theoretical claims.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化SLM Ti6Al4V的微观结构和力学性能
summary_zh.method: 采用棋盘扫描策略，对比三种扫描方式
summary_zh.result: 棋盘扫描细化晶粒至88.64 μm，抗拉强度1179 MPa，延伸率7.9%

summary_en.motivation: To optimize the microstructure and mechanical properties of SLM-fabricated Ti6Al4V alloy through scanning strategy modification.
summary_en.method: A chessboard scanning strategy was systematically compared with alternating and stripe strategies, with microstructural characterization via SEM, EBSD, and TEM.
summary_en.result: The chessboard strategy refined grain size to 88.64 μm, increased α′ phase to 53.3%, and achieved tensile strength of 1179 MPa with 7.9% elongation.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile) and microstructural analysis (SEM, EBSD, TEM) validated the improvements.

title: Multi-Region Matrix Interpolation for Dynamic Analysis of Aperiodic Structures under Large Model Parameter Perturbations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种多区域矩阵插值方法，用于处理大参数扰动下的动态结构代理建模，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型中的参数空间划分与约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on dynamic mechanical metamaterials and frequency response, not on static or quasi-static implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or patient-specific FEA surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决大参数扰动下动态结构代理模型精度不足的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出多区域矩阵插值策略，结合Craig-Bampton模态降阶与采样边界识别
summary_zh.result: 多区域方法在扰动增大时仍保持高精度，优于传统拉格朗日插值
summary_zh.validation: 通过方形板单元和梁结构两个数值算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the accuracy limitations of surrogate models for dynamic structures under large parametric perturbations and aperiodic substructures.
summary_en.method: A multi-region matrix interpolation strategy is proposed, building on Craig-Bampton modal reduction with a sampling-based procedure to identify usable parameter regions.
summary_en.result: The multi-region approach maintains high accuracy across different perturbation levels, while traditional Lagrange interpolation deviates significantly.
summary_en.validation: Two numerical examples: a unit cell with square plate and circular core, and a beam-like structure with vibration attenuation bands.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Network-based Reliability Analysis of Buried Pipelines
relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN代理模型与蒙特卡洛模拟结合用于管道可靠性分析，其方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的不确定性量化与高效采样。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, lacks contact mechanics or patient-specific geometry, and does not handle multi-objective constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统管道可靠性分析依赖昂贵有限元模拟，效率低。
summary_zh.method: 提出PINN-RA方法，用PINN代理模型替代有限元，结合蒙特卡洛采样。
summary_zh.result: 显著降低计算成本，加速可靠性评估。
summary_zh.validation: 通过参数化微分方程系统验证，未涉及实验或真实数据。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional reliability analysis of buried pipelines relies on computationally expensive finite element simulations, limiting its application in stochastic sampling.
summary_en.method: This study introduces PINN-RA, a physics-informed neural network surrogate model integrated with Monte Carlo simulation to solve parametric differential equations for pipeline-soil interaction.
summary_en.result: The proposed method drastically reduces computational effort while maintaining accuracy, enabling efficient reliability assessment under uncertainties.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation cases of parametric differential equations without experimental or field data.

title: Hybrid DeepONet Surrogates for Multiphase Flow in Porous Media
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的混合DeepONet代理模型可显著降低多相流模拟的计算成本，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on multiphase flow in porous media, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical FEA application.

summary_zh.motivation: 多相流PDE求解计算昂贵，需高效代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出混合DeepONet架构，分支网络集成FNO/MLP/KAN，主干网络处理时间维度。
summary_zh.result: 混合模型以更少参数实现高精度代理建模，适用于大规模油藏模拟。
summary_zh.validation: 在2D达西流及2D/3D SPE10基准问题上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Solving multiphase flow PDEs in porous media is computationally expensive, motivating the development of efficient surrogate models.
summary_en.method: A hybrid DeepONet framework is proposed, integrating Fourier Neural Operators, MLPs, and KANs in the branch network while the trunk network handles temporal learning.
summary_en.result: The hybrid surrogates achieve accurate predictions with significantly fewer parameters on large-scale reservoir simulations.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on steady 2D Darcy flow and 2D/3D SPE10 benchmark problems.

title: Partial Trace-Class Bayesian Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的部分迹类贝叶斯神经网络方法可高效量化不确定性，有望迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化任务。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, does not handle constraints or optimization, and lacks any biomedical or implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准贝叶斯神经网络计算成本高，需要更高效的UQ方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出三种部分迹类贝叶斯神经网络架构，仅对部分参数进行贝叶斯推断。
summary_zh.result: 在保持UQ质量的同时显著降低计算和内存需求。
summary_zh.validation: 数值模拟和真实数据集验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Bayesian neural networks are computationally prohibitive, motivating the need for more efficient uncertainty quantification methods.
summary_en.method: Three partial trace-class Bayesian neural network architectures are proposed that apply Bayesian inference only to a subset of parameters ordered by trace-class priors.
summary_en.result: The proposed methods achieve comparable uncertainty quantification to full BNNs with substantially reduced computational and memory costs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulation studies and a real-world dataset demonstrate the claimed benefits.

title: Fast PINN Eigensolvers via Biconvex Reformulation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种加速PINN求解特征值问题的双凸优化方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元替代建模中的特征值问题（如模态分析）。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on eigenvalue problems and does not address implant-specific biomechanics, stress shielding, or multi-objective constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统PINN求解特征值问题速度慢，需加速。
summary_zh.method: 将特征值问题重写为双凸优化，采用交替凸搜索算法。
summary_zh.result: 收敛速度比梯度下降PINN快500倍，精度高。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINN training for eigenvalue problems is orders of magnitude slower than classical solvers, motivating a faster reformulation.
summary_en.method: The eigenpair search is cast as a biconvex optimization problem solved by alternating convex search with analytically optimal updates.
summary_en.result: The proposed PINN-ACS achieves up to 500x speedup over gradient-based PINN training while maintaining high accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on benchmark eigenvalue problems demonstrate convergence speed and accuracy.

summary_en.result: Post-processing effectively reduces defects and enhances fatigue life, but the optimal treatment depends on alloy and loading conditions.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper synthesizes existing literature findings.

title: Bioinspired Polydopamine Coating-Driven Oriented Lamellar Nanocrystalline 3Y-TZP Structures Enhance Cell Bridge Formation for Osteogenic Differentiation via Mechanotransduction.
first_author_affiliation: Department of Periodontology, The Affiliated Stomatological Hospital of Nanjing Medical University, Jiangsu 210029, China.; Jiangsu Province Key Laboratory of Oral Disease, Nanjing Medical University, Jiangsu 210029, China.; Jiangsu Province Engineering Research Center of Stomatological Translational Medicine, Jiangsu 210029, China.

corresponding_authors.name: Yan Xu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Periodontology, The Affiliated Stomatological Hospital of Nanjing Medical University, Jiangsu 210029, China.; Jiangsu Province Key Laboratory of Oral Disease, Nanjing Medical University, Jiangsu 210029, China.; Jiangsu Province Engineering Research Center of Stomatological Translational Medicine, Jiangsu 210029, China.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及氧化锆植入体的表面结构设计，但未涉及LPBF制造、应力遮挡或疲劳测试。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善氧化锆种植体的骨整合性能
summary_zh.method: 通过冷冻铸造和聚多巴胺涂层制备定向层状纳米晶结构
summary_zh.result: 层状结构促进细胞桥形成和成骨分化
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和体内植入验证

summary_en.motivation: To enhance osseointegration of zirconia dental implants through biomimetic surface architecture.
summary_en.method: Oriented lamellar nanocrystalline structures were fabricated by freeze-casting nanosized 3Y-TZP particles coated with polydopamine.
summary_en.result: The lamellar architecture promoted mesenchymal stem cell polarization and osteogenic differentiation via mechanotransduction.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays and in vivo implantation in a rat model.

key_terms.zh: 3 mol%氧化钇稳定四方氧化锆多晶

title: Bayesian Adaptive Polynomial Chaos Expansions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种贝叶斯自适应多项式混沌展开方法，可用于不确定性量化和代理建模，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真替代问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, nor does it handle constrained optimization or patient-specific design.

summary_zh.motivation: 多项式混沌展开在统计学中缺乏贝叶斯公式和高效实现。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种新的贝叶斯自适应PCE方法，包含新颖的提议分布和改进的g先验。
summary_zh.result: 在仿真和实际UQ任务中展示了竞争性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过仿真研究和实际UQ应用验证。

summary_en.motivation: Polynomial chaos expansions lack fully Bayesian formulations and accessible implementations in the statistics community.
summary_en.method: A novel Bayesian adaptive PCE method is developed with a new proposal distribution for data-driven interaction selection and a modified g-prior tailored to PCE structure.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates competitive performance for surrogate modeling, global sensitivity analysis, and ordinal regression tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation studies and real-world UQ applications.

title: Auto-Adaptive PINNs with Applications to Phase Transitions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自适应采样方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的训练，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no application to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN在相变问题中界面区域的求解精度。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于网络梯度的自适应采样策略，无需后处理重采样。
summary_zh.result: 在Allen-Cahn方程上优于残差自适应方法。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试（Allen-Cahn方程）。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy of Physics-Informed Neural Networks in resolving sharp interfaces in phase transition problems.
summary_en.method: An auto-adaptive sampling method that uses network gradients to guide sample placement without post-hoc resampling.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated superior accuracy over residual-adaptive frameworks on the Allen-Cahn equation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on the Allen-Cahn phase field equation.

title: Application of the Hull Cell for Identifying Electropolishing Parameters to Adjust Surface Morphology in Additive Manufacturing
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF金属零件的电抛光后处理，涉及表面粗糙度调控，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on electropolishing surface finish of LPBF parts, but does not address porous structure design, stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过电抛光调控LPBF金属零件的表面粗糙度以满足植入物要求。
summary_zh.method: 采用Hull电池和三电极系统研究电流密度对表面粗糙度和材料去除的影响。
summary_zh.result: 实现了表面粗糙度降低90%以上，Sa<0.3 μm。
summary_zh.validation: 通过激光扫描和SEM表征表面形貌，并与电荷量关联验证。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve smooth surfaces on LPBF metal parts for medical implants by optimizing electropolishing parameters.
summary_en.method: Hull cell experiments and three-electrode setup were used to correlate current density with surface roughness and mass removal.
summary_en.result: Surface roughness was reduced by over 90% to Sa < 0.3 μm.
summary_en.validation: Surface morphology was characterized by laser scanning and SEM, and results were correlated with electrical charge.

title: Schrodinger Neural Network and Uncertainty Quantification: Quantum Machine
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的量子启发式条件密度估计方法可用于替代传统代理模型，实现不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元仿真或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate application, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有概率预测方法难以同时保证归一化、多模态和解析矩计算。
summary_zh.method: 提出薛定谔神经网络，将输入映射为波函数，通过Born规则得到条件密度。
summary_zh.result: 模型天然满足归一化、支持多模态，且矩和校准诊断可解析计算。
summary_zh.validation: 理论推导与数值示例验证了方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Existing probabilistic prediction methods struggle to simultaneously guarantee normalization, multimodality, and closed-form moment computation.
summary_en.method: The Schrodinger Neural Network maps each input to a wave function and computes conditional densities via the Born rule using spectral expansion coefficients.
summary_en.result: The model inherently ensures positivity and normalization, supports multimodality via interference, and yields closed-form moments and calibration diagnostics.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical foundations and numerical examples demonstrate the method's properties and effectiveness.

title: Informed Initialization for Bayesian Optimization and Active Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进贝叶斯优化初始化的方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constraint handling in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化中初始采样策略忽略超参数学习与不确定性降低的平衡。
summary_zh.method: 提出超参数信息预测探索（HIPE）采集函数，基于信息论平衡预测不确定性与超参数学习。
summary_zh.result: HIPE在预测精度、超参数识别和后续优化性能上优于标准初始化策略。
summary_zh.validation: 在主动学习和少样本贝叶斯优化基准问题上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard initialization strategies for Bayesian optimization neglect the trade-off between space-filling and hyperparameter learning, limiting surrogate model quality.
summary_en.method: HIPE acquisition function balances predictive uncertainty reduction and hyperparameter learning via information-theoretic principles, with a closed-form expression for Gaussian processes.
summary_en.result: HIPE outperforms standard initialization in predictive accuracy, hyperparameter identification, and subsequent optimization performance in few-shot settings.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical experiments on active learning and few-shot Bayesian optimization benchmarks demonstrate effectiveness.

title: In situ tailoring of Ti6Al4V microstructure via laser powder bed fusion with secondary laser processing
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology
relevance_to_user: 该论文主要关注Ti6Al4V的微观结构调控，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses on microstructure tailoring via secondary laser processing.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过二次激光处理调控Ti6Al4V微观结构以优化力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 在LPBF过程中引入二次激光扫描，改变热循环以细化晶粒。
summary_zh.result: 二次激光处理显著细化微观结构，提高了硬度和强度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过金相观察和力学测试验证微观结构变化和性能提升。

summary_en.motivation: To tailor the microstructure of Ti6Al4V during laser powder bed fusion for improved mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: A secondary laser scanning step is integrated into the LPBF process to modify thermal cycles and refine grain structure.
summary_en.result: Secondary laser processing significantly refines the microstructure, leading to enhanced hardness and strength.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization and mechanical testing confirm the grain refinement and property improvements.

title: Bayesian neural networks with interpretable priors from Mercer kernels
relevance_to_user: 该方法为贝叶斯神经网络提供可解释先验，可迁移至FEA替代模型的构建与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, biomechanics, or implant design; it is purely methodological without domain application.

summary_zh.motivation: 结合高斯过程可解释性与贝叶斯神经网络可扩展性，提高不确定性量化质量。
summary_zh.method: 从Mercer核表示推导网络参数先验，使BNN样本近似指定GP。
summary_zh.result: 所提先验使BNN在保持可扩展性的同时具备GP的近似行为。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成数据集上数值实验验证先验有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To combine the interpretability of Gaussian processes with the scalability of Bayesian neural networks for improved uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: Introduces Mercer priors defined from the Mercer representation of a covariance kernel, directly specifying a prior over network parameters so that BNN samples approximate the target GP.
summary_en.result: The proposed Mercer priors enable BNNs to approximate GP behavior while retaining scalability to large datasets.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic datasets demonstrate that the BNN with Mercer priors closely matches the target GP posterior.

title: Bayesian Nonlinear PDE Inference via Gaussian Process Collocation with Application to the Richards Equation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的高斯过程配点法可用于非线性PDE的贝叶斯推断，其不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或接触力学。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks constraint handling, and focuses on agricultural PDEs rather than solid mechanics or biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效推断非线性PDE中的未知参数，避免传统方法的计算负担和不稳定性
summary_zh.method: 提出高斯过程配点法构建近似后验，结合重要性采样校正偏差
summary_zh.result: 在模拟和真实农业数据中实现鲁棒参数估计与不确定性量化
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟研究和真实农业数据集验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently infer unknown parameters in nonlinear PDEs while avoiding the computational cost and instability of conventional methods.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process collocation method constructs an approximate posterior from observed data without structural PDE assumptions, corrected via importance sampling.
summary_en.result: Robust parameter estimates with uncertainty quantification are achieved in both simulation studies and a real agricultural dataset.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation studies and application to a real agricultural dataset.

title: A data free neural operator enabling fast inference of 2D and 3D Navier Stokes equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无数据的神经算子方法，可高效求解2D和3D Navier-Stokes方程，其方法有潜力迁移到生物力学有限元代理模型中。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or structural FEA; it focuses on fluid dynamics (Navier-Stokes) without any biomedical or solid mechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统神经算子需要大量配对数据且难以泛化到3D流场。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种无数据的物理驱动神经算子，直接以初始/边界条件和外力为输入。
summary_zh.result: 在2D和3D Navier-Stokes基准上精度优于现有神经算子，且支持实时集成预测。
summary_zh.validation: 在2D和3D数值基准算例上验证，与数值求解器对比。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators require costly paired data and generalize poorly to 3D flows, limiting their use in real-time ensemble simulations.
summary_en.method: A data-free neural operator is proposed that takes initial/boundary conditions and forcing functions as inputs, using a physics-grounded architecture to eliminate the need for paired solution data.
summary_en.result: The method outperforms prior neural operators on 2D benchmarks and 3D test cases, achieving greater efficiency than conventional solvers for ensemble forecasts.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on 2D and 3D numerical benchmarks (e.g., Navier-Stokes equations) by comparing accuracy and efficiency against traditional numerical solvers.

title: A Physics-informed Multi-resolution Neural Operator
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无数据、多分辨率的物理信息算子学习方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决算子学习对高保真数据依赖及多分辨率数据挑战
summary_zh.method: 扩展RINO框架，用预训练基函数投影输入，MLP近似算子，物理信息通过有限差分强制执行
summary_zh.result: 在多个多分辨率数值算例上验证了方法的有效性
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，比较不同分辨率下的预测精度

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the need for large high-fidelity datasets and handle unevenly discretized multi-resolution data in operator learning.
summary_en.method: Extends the Resolution Independent Neural Operator (RINO) to a fully data-free setup by projecting input functions onto a latent space via pre-trained bases and approximating the PDE operator with an MLP, enforcing physics through a finite difference solver.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves accurate predictions on multi-resolution numerical benchmarks with both coarse and fine discretizations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on several numerical examples with varying input resolutions, demonstrating robustness to discretization changes.

title: Topology-driven deformation and damage behavior of TPMS-reinforced TC4/Mg interpenetrating-phase composites
first_author_affiliation: College of Materials Science and Engineering, Chongqing University of Technology, 400054, Chongqing, China

corresponding_authors.name: Fei Guo
corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Materials Science and Engineering, Chongqing University of Technology, 400054, Chongqing, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了TPMS增强TC4/Mg互穿相复合材料的变形与损伤行为，涉及多孔结构力学性能，但未直接针对生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding or stiffness matching for biomedical implants, lacks LPBF fabrication and mechanical testing of the composite, and does not report surface roughness, as-built morphology, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索TPMS增强TC4/Mg互穿相复合材料的变形与损伤机制
summary_zh.method: 制备不同TPMS结构的复合材料并进行力学测试与微观表征
summary_zh.result: 揭示了拓扑结构对变形模式和损伤演化的影响规律
summary_zh.validation: 通过准静态压缩实验和SEM观察验证力学行为

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the deformation and damage behavior of TPMS-reinforced TC4/Mg interpenetrating-phase composites under mechanical loading.
summary_en.method: Composites with various TPMS architectures were fabricated and subjected to mechanical testing combined with microstructural characterization.
summary_en.result: The influence of topology on deformation modes and damage evolution was elucidated.
summary_en.validation: Quasi-static compression experiments and SEM observations were used to validate the mechanical behavior.

title: Graph Neural Network Assisted Genetic Algorithm for Structural Dynamic Response and Parameter Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文将GNN代理模型与遗传算法结合用于结构参数优化，方法可迁移至植入物设计中的有限元代理建模与多目标优化。
why_not_core: This paper uses a simple SDOF system and does not address multi-constraint optimization, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统有限元方法在迭代优化中计算成本高，需高效代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出GNN代理模型结合遗传算法，学习结构参数与动态响应的映射。
summary_zh.result: 框架收敛性好、泛化能力强，显著降低计算成本。
summary_zh.validation: 基于Newmark Beta法生成SDOF系统数据集进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional FEM and CFD simulations are computationally prohibitive for iterative structural optimization, motivating the need for efficient surrogate models.
summary_en.method: A hybrid framework integrating a Graph Neural Network (GNN) surrogate with a Genetic Algorithm (GA) is proposed to learn the nonlinear mapping from structural parameters to dynamic displacement responses and optimize parameters.
summary_en.result: The GNN-GA framework achieves strong convergence and robust generalization while drastically reducing computational cost compared to traditional simulations.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a synthetic dataset of single-degree-of-freedom (SDOF) system responses generated using the Newmark Beta method.

title: Data-driven dimensionally decomposed generalized polynomial chaos expansion for forward uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的数据驱动UQ方法可迁移至植入物力学仿真中的高维不确定性量化，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context; no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization; only forward UQ without surrogate model for expensive simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统DD-GPCE需要输入分布先验知识，实际中难以获得。
summary_zh.method: 用平滑自举KDE从样本推断输入分布，结合DD-GPCE进行高维UQ。
summary_zh.result: 相比假设高斯分布的方法，输出均值和方差估计更准确。
summary_zh.validation: 数学算例和三维移动设计随机动力学分析。

summary_en.motivation: Standard DD-GPCE requires prior knowledge of input distributions, which is often unavailable in practice.
summary_en.method: Input distributions are inferred from sample data via smoothed-bootstrap KDE, and a whitening transformation enables construction of measure-consistent orthonormal bases.
summary_en.result: The proposed method yields more accurate estimates of output mean and variance compared to conventional data-driven approaches assuming Gaussian inputs.
summary_en.validation: Validated on mathematical examples and a stochastic dynamic analysis of a 3D mobility design with 20 random inputs.

title: Tunable stiffness and crashworthiness of selective laser melted AlSi10Mg sinusoidal auxetic structures
first_author_affiliation: Additive Manufacturing of Functional Materials (AMFM) Research Group, University of Wolverhampton, Telford Innovation Campus, Telford TF29NT, United Kingdom

corresponding_authors.name: Manpreet Singh
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Additive Manufacturing of Functional Materials (AMFM) Research Group, University of Wolverhampton, Telford Innovation Campus, Telford TF29NT, United Kingdom

relevance_to_user: 该论文使用RSM构建代理模型优化力学性能，方法可迁移至植入物设计中的多目标优化和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on crashworthiness of auxetic structures for lightweight applications, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or patient-specific design.

summary_zh.motivation: 设计可调刚度和耐撞性的新型正弦辅助结构，避免应力集中。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制造AlSi10Mg正弦韧带辅助结构，结合FEA和RSM代理模型进行多目标优化。
summary_zh.result: 获得负泊松比-0.113，最大比吸能17.23 kJ/kg，代理模型R²>0.92。
summary_zh.validation: 通过准静态压缩实验验证FEA，偏差<3.7%。

summary_en.motivation: To design a novel sinusoidal auxetic structure with tunable stiffness and crashworthiness while minimizing stress concentrations inherent in re-entrant designs.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting of AlSi10Mg was used to fabricate the sinusoidal auxetic structure, and finite element analysis combined with response surface methodology surrogate models enabled multi-objective parametric optimization.
summary_en.result: The structure achieved a negative Poisson's ratio of -0.113, a maximum specific energy absorption of 17.23 kJ/kg, and surrogate models with R² > 0.92.
summary_en.validation: Quasi-static compression experiments validated the finite element model with deviations below 3.7% across six mechanical metrics.

title: Mechanical properties of cellular structures fabricated by laser powder bed fusion of TiNi powder
first_author_affiliation: Institute of Problems of Chemical and Energy Technologies SB RAS, Biysk 659322, Russian Federation

corresponding_authors.name: K. A. Zheronkina
corresponding_authors.affiliation: National Research Tomsk State University, Tomsk 634050, Russian Federation

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了TiNi合金激光粉末床熔融制备多孔结构的力学性能，与用户关注的AM生物医学植入物方向相关，但未涉及应力遮挡或骨整合。
why_not_core: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching for biomedical implants, nor does it report surface roughness, as-built morphology, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究TiNi合金多孔结构的力学性能，为生物医学应用提供基础。
summary_zh.method: 采用激光粉末床熔融制备不同孔隙率的TiNi多孔结构，并进行压缩和疲劳测试。
summary_zh.result: 多孔结构表现出良好的超弹性和可恢复应变，但疲劳寿命受孔隙率影响。
summary_zh.validation: 通过准静态压缩和循环加载实验验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanical properties of TiNi cellular structures fabricated by LPBF for potential biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: TiNi cellular structures with varying porosities were fabricated via laser powder bed fusion and subjected to compression and fatigue testing.
summary_en.result: The cellular structures exhibited excellent superelasticity and recoverable strain, but fatigue life was dependent on porosity.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through quasi-static compression and cyclic loading experiments.

title: Mechanical and cell attachment evaluation of additively manufactured biomimetic architected scaffolds for tissue engineering
venue: Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials/Journal of mechanical behavior of biomedical materials
first_author_affiliation: University of Stavanger, Faculty of Science and Technology, Department of Mechanical and Structural Engineering and Materials Science, Kjell Arholms gate 41, 4021, Stavanger, Norway. Electronic address: yosef.w.adugna@uis.no

corresponding_authors.name: Yosef W. Adugna
corresponding_authors.affiliation: University of Stavanger, Faculty of Science and Technology, Department of Mechanical and Structural Engineering and Materials Science, Kjell Arholms gate 41, 4021, Stavanger, Norway. Electronic address: yosef.w.adugna@uis.no

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了TPMS支架的力学和细胞附着性能，但使用SLA工艺而非LPBF，且未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳测试。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no fatigue testing, no stress shielding analysis, and no osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估TPMS支架的力学与生物性能，用于骨组织工程。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLA工艺制备均匀和梯度TPMS支架，进行压缩测试和细胞实验。
summary_zh.result: 梯度结构（Split P和Neovius）具有更高的压缩强度和能量吸收，Gyroid促进早期细胞增殖。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩测试、SEM和A549细胞活力实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the mechanical and biological properties of TPMS-based scaffolds for bone tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: Uniform and graded TPMS scaffolds (Gyroid, Split P, Neovius) were fabricated via SLA at 60% relative density and tested under compression and with A549 cell line.
summary_en.result: Graded Split P and Neovius showed superior compressive strength and energy absorption, while Gyroid promoted early cell proliferation.
summary_en.validation: Validation via compression testing, SEM imaging, and cell viability assays (A549).

title: PINN Balls: Scaling Second-Order Methods for PINNs with Domain Decomposition and Adaptive Sampling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合域分解和自适应采样的二阶PINN训练方法，可提高求解PDE的效率，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, nor does it address constraints or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 二阶方法训练PINN内存需求大，难以扩展。
summary_zh.method: 提出PINN Balls模型，结合局部专家混合与对抗自适应采样实现域分解。
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE基准上达到更高精度，同时保持可扩展性。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE数值基准上验证精度与可扩展性。

summary_en.motivation: Second-order training of PINNs suffers from high memory cost, limiting scalability.
summary_en.method: PINN Balls uses a local Mixture of Experts with adversarial adaptive sampling for learnable domain decomposition.
summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on PDE benchmarks while maintaining scalability.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical PDE benchmarks.

title: Deep Jump Gaussian Processes for Surrogate Modeling of High-Dimensional Piecewise Continuous Functions
relevance_to_user: 该方法针对高维分段连续函数的代理建模，具有不确定性量化能力，可迁移至生物力学代理建模中的复杂约束优化问题。
why_not_core: No biomedical or implant design context; no FEA validation or constraint handling demonstrated.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维分段连续函数的代理建模面临挑战，现有方法难以处理。
summary_zh.method: 提出深度跳跃高斯过程，结合区域特定线性投影与跳跃GP。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和基准数据集上预测精度和不确定性量化优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 合成数据和基准数据集上的数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Surrogate modeling of high-dimensional piecewise continuous functions is challenging due to the curse of dimensionality and discontinuities.
summary_en.method: Deep Jump Gaussian Processes integrate region-specific locally linear projections with Jump Gaussian Processes to capture local low-dimensional structures.
summary_en.result: Superior predictive accuracy and more reliable uncertainty quantification on synthetic and benchmark datasets compared to existing methods.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic and benchmark datasets with oracle error bound analysis.

title: Deep Gaussian Processes for Functional Maps
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的深度高斯过程函数映射方法可用于构建高保真代理模型，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计应用。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling, no implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有函数回归方法难以处理复杂非线性关系并提供可靠不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 在函数空间中构建基于高斯过程的线性与非线性变换序列，采用核积分变换和变分推断。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实基准数据集上预测精度和不确定性校准优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个基准数据集上对比预测误差和校准曲线。

summary_en.motivation: Existing function-on-function regression methods struggle to capture complex nonlinear relationships and provide reliable uncertainty quantification under noisy or sparse data.
summary_en.method: A sequence of GP-based linear and nonlinear transformations is constructed directly in function space using kernel integral transforms and variational inference with inducing points.
summary_en.result: The proposed DGPFM achieves superior predictive accuracy and uncertainty calibration on both synthetic and real-world benchmark datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on multiple benchmark datasets by comparing prediction error and calibration metrics against state-of-the-art methods.

title: Deep Ensembles for Epistemic Uncertainty: A Frequentist Perspective
relevance_to_user: 该论文从频率派角度解释了深度集成在估计认知不确定性上的有效性，其方法可迁移至FEA代理模型的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to any FEA or biomechanics problem, lacks validation on surrogate modeling tasks, and does not address constraints or optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 深度集成在认知不确定性估计上表现优异但缺乏频率派理论解释。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于自助法的认知不确定性估计器，并证明其渐近正确性；将深度集成分解为数据变异性和训练随机性。
summary_zh.result: 深度集成主要捕获训练随机性成分，该成分构成认知不确定性的大部分，从而解释了其有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证理论分解与估计器的正确性。

summary_en.motivation: Deep ensembles achieve strong empirical performance in epistemic uncertainty estimation, but a theoretical understanding from a frequentist perspective is lacking.
summary_en.method: A bootstrap-based estimator for epistemic uncertainty is proposed and proven asymptotically correct; deep ensembles are decomposed into data variability and training stochasticity components.
summary_en.result: The training stochasticity component constitutes the majority of epistemic uncertainty, explaining the effectiveness of deep ensembles.
summary_en.validation: Empirical studies on synthetic and benchmark datasets validate the theoretical decomposition and the bootstrap estimator.

title: PathFormer: A Transformer with 3D Grid Constraints for Digital Twin Robot-Arm Trajectory Generation
relevance_to_user: 该论文将Transformer与3D网格约束结合用于机器人轨迹生成，其数字孪生和路径规划方法可迁移至生物打印中的运动规划与数字孪生应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve bioprinting, bioink, or any biomedical context; it focuses on general robot-arm trajectory generation.

summary_zh.motivation: 机器人臂轨迹规划需考虑运动结构，现有序列模型常产生无效轨迹。
summary_zh.method: 提出PathFormer，采用3D网格表示和约束掩码解码，编码运动结构。
summary_zh.result: 在xArm Lite 6上达到97.5%到达率和92.5%抓取成功率，端到端成功率达86.7%。
summary_zh.validation: 在数字孪生环境中进行物理机器人实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Robotic arm trajectory planning requires motion structure awareness, which sequence models often ignore, leading to invalid or inefficient executions.
summary_en.method: A Path-based Transformer is proposed, encoding robot motion with a 3D grid representation and constraint-masked decoding to enforce lattice-adjacent moves and workspace bounds.
summary_en.result: The method achieves up to 97.5% reach and 92.5% pick success on an xArm Lite 6 digital twin, with 86.7% end-to-end success across 60 language-specified tasks.
summary_en.validation: Physical robot experiments with a depth-camera digital twin validate the approach in controlled and cluttered scenes.

title: MOBO-OSD: Batch Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization via Orthogonal Search Directions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多目标贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题，但未涉及生物力学或约束处理。
why_not_core: No application to implant/biomechanics design, no constraint handling beyond Pareto front, and no uncertainty quantification for point predictions.

summary_zh.motivation: 多目标贝叶斯优化中解集多样性不足且计算开销大。
summary_zh.method: 沿正交搜索方向分解多目标问题，结合帕累托前沿估计生成多样解。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实基准上超体积性能优于现有算法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准多目标优化基准函数上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization suffers from insufficient solution diversity and high computational cost.
summary_en.method: Decomposes the multi-objective problem along orthogonal search directions and leverages Pareto front estimation to generate diverse solutions.
summary_en.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art algorithms on synthetic and real-world benchmarks in terms of hypervolume.
summary_en.validation: Numerical validation on standard multi-objective optimization benchmark functions.

title: Compositional Generation for Long-Horizon Coupled PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的组合扩散方法可用于解决耦合PDE系统的长时程模拟，其思想可迁移至生物力学中多物理场耦合的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate for stress/strain, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on diffusion models for coupled PDEs without biomedical or constraint-handling context.

summary_zh.motivation: 耦合PDE系统模拟计算量大，传统联合训练代理模型需要大量数据。
summary_zh.method: 提出组合扩散方法，仅用解耦数据训练扩散模型，推理时组合恢复耦合场。
summary_zh.result: 组合扩散模型在长时程耦合轨迹重建中误差较低，v参数化提升精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在反应扩散和修正Burgers方程上验证，与傅里叶神经算子对比。

summary_en.motivation: Simulating coupled PDE systems is computationally expensive, and training surrogates on joint data requires large datasets.
summary_en.method: A compositional diffusion approach is proposed, where diffusion models are trained on decoupled PDE data and composed at inference to recover the coupled field.
summary_en.result: Compositional diffusion models achieve low error in reconstructing long-horizon coupled trajectories, with v-parameterization improving accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on Reaction-Diffusion and modified Burgers equations, benchmarked against a Fourier Neural Operator trained on coupled data.

title: Optimizing the Unknown: Black Box Bayesian Optimization with Energy-Based Model and Reinforcement Learning
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出了一种结合能量模型和强化学习的贝叶斯优化框架，可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统贝叶斯优化存在单步偏差，易陷入局部最优。
summary_zh.method: 提出REBMBO，结合高斯过程局部引导与能量模型全局结构，用PPO实现多步前瞻。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实基准测试中表现优于传统BO方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准优化基准上进行了数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional Bayesian optimization suffers from one-step bias leading to local optima in complex tasks.
summary_en.method: REBMBO integrates Gaussian Processes for local guidance with an Energy-Based Model for global structure, using PPO for adaptive multi-step lookahead.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms existing BO methods on synthetic and real-world benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical optimization benchmarks.

title: Iterative Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Fourier-enhanced Features
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的迭代训练策略和傅里叶特征增强方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，解决高频PDE逼近问题。
why_not_core: No biomedical or implant-specific application; no FEA validation on structural mechanics; no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服PINN训练中的频谱偏差，提高高频PDE逼近精度。
summary_zh.method: 提出IFeF-PINN，通过随机傅里叶特征增强潜在空间，两阶段迭代训练。
summary_zh.result: 在经典基准问题上优于现有方法，频率域逼近能力显著提升。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个PDE基准问题上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome spectral bias in PINNs and improve approximation of high-frequency PDE solutions.
summary_en.method: Proposes IFeF-PINN, an iterative training algorithm that enriches the latent space with Random Fourier Features and solves a two-stage convex regression problem.
summary_en.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art PINN methods on classical benchmarks, demonstrating enhanced frequency-domain approximation.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical evaluation on standard PDE benchmark problems.

title: In-situ Dynamic laser area heating during diode point melting for thermal gradient reduction in laser powder bed fusion
first_author_affiliation: Department of Automotive Engineering, Cukurova University, Adana, Türkiye, 01250

corresponding_authors.name: Alkim Aydin
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Automotive Engineering, Cukurova University, Adana, Türkiye, 01250

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的动态激光区域加热方法可改善LPBF工艺的微观结构和表面质量，对生物医学植入物的制造有潜在参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding, does not include fatigue testing, and does not report osseointegration or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低LPBF过程中热梯度以减少缺陷。
summary_zh.method: 提出动态激光区域加热（DLAH）方法，在熔池附近进行空间可控加热。
summary_zh.result: 实现近全致密（99.99%）和改善表面粗糙度（Ra=2.84 µm），并粗化α′马氏体。
summary_zh.validation: 通过密度、表面粗糙度和微观结构表征验证。

summary_en.motivation: To mitigate steep thermal gradients and associated defects in laser powder bed fusion of Ti6Al4V.
summary_en.method: A Dynamic Laser Area Heating (DLAH) method using a defocused diode laser is integrated into a Diode Point Melting platform to provide spatially controlled in-situ heating.
summary_en.result: DLAH achieves near-full density (99.99%), improved surface finish (Ra=2.84 µm), and coarser α′ martensite with reduced aspect ratio.
summary_en.validation: Validation through density measurements, surface roughness characterization, and microstructural analysis.

title: XRePIT: A deep learning-computational fluid dynamics hybrid framework implemented in OpenFOAM for fast, robust, and scalable unsteady simulations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的混合仿真框架（残差引导的神经代理+传统求解器）可迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模，提高采样效率并保证长期稳定性。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics (buoyancy-driven flow) and does not address solid mechanics, implant design, or biomechanical constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决自回归神经代理在长期仿真中的误差累积和非物理漂移问题
summary_zh.method: 提出基于OpenFOAM的残差引导混合框架XRePIT，自动切换神经代理与数值求解器
summary_zh.result: 混合循环实现2.91倍加速，相对L2误差保持在1e-3量级，且稳定效果与神经架构无关
summary_zh.validation: 在3D浮力驱动流算例中验证，并与纯代理和纯求解器对比

summary_en.motivation: To overcome error accumulation and non-physical drift in autoregressive neural surrogates for long-term unsteady simulations.
summary_en.method: Proposes XRePIT, an OpenFOAM-based hybrid framework that automatically switches between a neural surrogate and a numerical solver based on a monitored residual threshold.
summary_en.result: The hybrid loop achieves up to 2.91x wall-clock speedup while maintaining relative L2 errors within O(1e-3), and the stabilization is agnostic to the neural architecture.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a 3D buoyancy-driven flow benchmark, comparing against standalone surrogate and pure solver.

title: Towards Universal Solvers: Using PGD Attack in Active Learning to Increase Generalizability of Neural Operators as Knowledge Distillation from Numerical PDE Solvers
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种对抗性教师-学生蒸馏框架，通过主动采样提高神经算子的泛化能力，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的昂贵采样问题。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context; validation only on fluid dynamics PDEs (Burgers, Navier-Stokes), no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经算子对分布外输入泛化差，需提升鲁棒性。
summary_zh.method: 用可微数值求解器监督紧凑神经算子，PGD主动采样搜索最坏输入扩充训练集。
summary_zh.result: 对抗蒸馏显著提升OOD鲁棒性，保持低参数和快速推理。
summary_zh.validation: 在Burgers和Navier-Stokes方程上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators suffer from poor out-of-distribution generalization, limiting their practical deployment.
summary_en.method: An adversarial teacher-student distillation framework uses a differentiable numerical solver to supervise a compact neural operator, with PGD-style active sampling to mine worst-case inputs under smoothness and energy constraints.
summary_en.result: Adversarial distillation substantially improves OOD robustness while preserving low parameter cost and fast inference.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on Burgers and Navier-Stokes equations demonstrate the effectiveness.

title: Ensemble based Closed-Loop Optimal Control using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于PINN的集成控制框架可迁移至生物力学设计中的约束优化问题，但未涉及FEA代理建模或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on optimal control via HJB equation and does not address expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决HJB方程数值求解计算成本高的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出多阶段集成PINN框架学习最优代价函数和控制信号
summary_zh.result: 成功实现含噪声和扰动系统的闭环控制
summary_zh.validation: 通过稳态非线性系统仿真验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational burden of numerically solving the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation for optimal control.
summary_en.method: A multi-stage ensemble physics-informed neural network framework is proposed to learn the optimal cost-to-go and control signal without stabilizer terms.
summary_en.result: The ensemble and singular control policies successfully achieve closed-loop control of a nonlinear system under noisy and perturbed conditions.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via simulation of a steady-state time-invariant two-state continuous nonlinear system with infinite time horizon.

key_terms.zh: 哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼方程

title: Trace Regularity PINNs: Enforcing $\mathrm{H}^{\frac{1}{2}}(\partial Ω)$ for Boundary Data
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过改进边界损失函数提高了PINN的收敛性和精度，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的边界条件处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN在边界条件处理上精度不足，需改进损失函数。
summary_zh.method: 提出TRPINN，使用H^{1/2}范数强化边界损失，并优化计算效率。
summary_zh.result: 在振荡边界条件下，TRPINN收敛更快且精度提升1-3个十进制位。
summary_zh.validation: 通过Laplace方程数值实验验证，并与标准PINN对比。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs suffer from insufficient accuracy in enforcing boundary conditions, motivating a more rigorous boundary loss formulation.
summary_en.method: We propose TRPINN, which enforces the boundary loss using the Sobolev-Slobodeckij H^{1/2} norm and reduces computational cost by computing only the essential semi-norm part.
summary_en.result: TRPINN achieves faster convergence and up to three decimal digits improvement in accuracy on highly oscillatory Dirichlet boundary problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on the Laplace equation with oscillatory boundary conditions demonstrate the method's superiority over standard PINNs.

title: Manufacturing of Complex NiTi Geometries with LPBF and Adapted Scanning Strategies
first_author_affiliation: Fraunhofer Institute for Machine Tools and Forming Technology IWU, Dresden, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Sandra Herzig
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Fraunhofer Institute for Machine Tools and Forming Technology IWU, Dresden, Germany

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及LPBF制造NiTi晶格结构，但未直接研究应力遮挡或骨整合，与AM生物医学方向部分相关。
why_not_core: No stress shielding analysis, no stiffness matching to bone, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索LPBF制造复杂NiTi晶格结构的可行性
summary_zh.method: 采用定制扫描策略在标准LPBF设备上制备NiTi晶格
summary_zh.result: 定制扫描策略可制造均匀复杂几何并调控热力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过光学显微镜、DSC和压缩测试表征

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the feasibility of fabricating complex NiTi lattice structures with tailored properties via LPBF using adapted scanning strategies.
summary_en.method: Adapted scanning strategies were employed on a standard LPBF machine to produce NiTi lattice structures with controlled local energy input.
summary_en.result: The adapted scanning strategies enabled the fabrication of homogeneous complex geometries and significantly influenced the thermal and mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Characterization via optical microscopy, differential scanning calorimetry, and compression testing.

title: Infinite Neural Operators: Gaussian processes on functions
relevance_to_user: 该论文将无限宽神经网络与高斯过程的关系扩展到神经算子，为算子学习提供不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的UQ。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to any biomedical or implant design problem, nor does it address constrained optimization or expensive simulation sampling efficiency.

summary_zh.motivation: 将无限宽神经网络的高斯过程先验推广到神经算子，以提升不确定性量化能力。
summary_zh.method: 推导了任意深度神经算子在高斯卷积核下收敛到函数值高斯过程的条件，并计算了FNO的协方差函数。
summary_zh.result: 实现了神经算子高斯过程在回归和PDE求解中的后验计算，揭示了FNO的归纳偏置。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准PDE求解器回归任务上验证了后验预测性能。

summary_en.motivation: Extend the Gaussian process prior connection from infinitely wide neural networks to neural operators to improve uncertainty quantification in operator learning.
summary_en.method: Derive conditions under which arbitrary-depth neural operators with Gaussian-distributed convolution kernels converge to function-valued GPs, and compute covariance functions for two parametrizations including the Fourier neural operator.
summary_en.result: Compute GP posteriors in regression scenarios including PDE solution operators, revealing inductive biases of current FNO architectures.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark PDE regression tasks by comparing posterior predictions.

title: Efficient High-Accuracy PDEs Solver with the Linear Attention Neural Operator
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的线性注意力机制可提升神经算子的计算效率与精度，有望迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及约束优化或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses solely on improving PDE solver accuracy and efficiency.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决神经算子中注意力机制的精度与效率权衡问题
summary_zh.method: 提出基于代理令牌的线性注意力机制，实现线性复杂度与高精度
summary_zh.result: 在标准基准上平均精度提升19.5%，超越现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 在多个PDE基准数据集上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the scalability-accuracy trade-off in transformer-based neural operators for PDE solving.
summary_en.method: Introduces an agent-based linear attention mechanism with O(MNd) complexity that preserves softmax-level expressiveness.
summary_en.result: Achieves 19.5% average accuracy improvement over state-of-the-art neural PDE solvers on standard benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on multiple standard PDE benchmark datasets with numerical experiments.

title: ARCO-BO: Adaptive Resource-aware COllaborative Bayesian Optimization for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Design
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多智能体贝叶斯优化框架可迁移至异构代理（如不同实验室或仿真）协同优化植入物设计，但未涉及生物力学或FEA代理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical design context; it focuses on multi-agent optimization with heterogeneous resources and objectives.

summary_zh.motivation: 多智能体优化中异构性导致资源浪费和信息共享低效
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应资源感知协作贝叶斯优化框架，结合共识机制、异步采样和部分空间共享
summary_zh.result: 在合成和工程问题上优于独立BO和现有协作方法
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试和工程问题验证

summary_en.motivation: Multi-agent optimization suffers from heterogeneity in objectives, budgets, and design spaces, leading to redundancy and poor coordination.
summary_en.method: ARCO-BO integrates a similarity-aware consensus mechanism, budget-aware asynchronous sampling, and partial input space sharing to handle heterogeneous multi-agent settings.
summary_en.result: The framework consistently outperforms independent BO and existing collaborative BO on synthetic and high-dimensional engineering problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks and engineering design problems, without experimental or biomedical validation.

title: A hierarchical Bayesian approach for population-based structural health monitoring in ship hull structures
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了层次贝叶斯方法在结构健康监测中的应用，其处理数据稀疏性和不确定性量化的框架可迁移至植入物设计中的代理建模与优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or multi-objective design optimization; its application is limited to ship hull structures and deflection monitoring.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决数据稀疏条件下结构健康监测的不确定性量化问题
summary_zh.method: 采用层次贝叶斯模型结合代理模型和MCMC进行参数推断
summary_zh.result: 层次模型在数据稀疏时比独立模型提供更稳健的不确定性估计
summary_zh.validation: 基于有限元模型生成的数值模拟数据进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve uncertainty quantification in structural health monitoring under data scarcity by leveraging population-level information.
summary_en.method: A hierarchical Bayesian model is applied with a surrogate model for likelihood computation and Markov Chain Monte Carlo for inference.
summary_en.result: The hierarchical model yields more robust uncertainty estimates compared to independent modeling when data are sparse.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using numerical simulation data from a finite element model of ship hull plate elements.

key_terms.zh: 基于群体的结构健康监测

why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage; it is purely experimental rheology and printability optimization without machine learning or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究海藻酸钠分子量和灭菌对生物墨水可打印性的影响
summary_zh.method: 制备不同分子量海藻酸钠的GelMA/SA生物墨水，测试流变性和打印质量
summary_zh.result: 低分子量海藻酸钠提高离子交联度，优化打印性而不损害水凝胶性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过流变测试、压缩分析和打印实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how sodium alginate molar mass and sterilization affect the rheology and printability of GelMA/SA bioinks.
summary_en.method: Bioinks with different SA molar masses were prepared and characterized by rheometry, compression testing, and printing experiments.
summary_en.result: Lower molar mass SA enhances ionic crosslinking and improves printability without compromising hydrogel mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via rheological, mechanical, and printability tests.

title: Recursive Inference for Heterogeneous Multi-Output GP State-Space Models with Arbitrary Moment Matching
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多输出高斯过程状态空间模型递归推理方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的在线学习与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, implant design, or biomechanics problems; it focuses on general system dynamics learning.

summary_zh.motivation: 在线学习复杂多通道非线性系统动力学，提高计算效率与精度。
summary_zh.method: 设计异构多输出核与诱导点管理，统一递归推理框架支持多种矩匹配方法。
summary_zh.result: 在合成与真实数据集上，精度与离线方法相当，速度提升100倍；噪声下精度优于在线方法70%。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成与真实系统数据集上对比离线与在线高斯过程状态空间模型。

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient online learning of complex multi-channel nonlinear system dynamics for engineering control and decision-making.
summary_en.method: A heterogeneous multi-output kernel and inducing-point management are designed, and a unified recursive inference framework for GPSSMs is derived supporting EKF, UKF, and ADF moment matching.
summary_en.result: The proposed method matches the accuracy of state-of-the-art offline GPSSMs with 1/100 runtime and surpasses online GPSSMs by 70% in accuracy under heavy noise with 1/20 runtime.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic and real-world system datasets, comparing against offline and online GPSSM baselines.

key_terms.zh: 高斯过程状态空间模型

title: Nonlinear Dimensionality Reduction Techniques for Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的非线性降维贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的高维昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: No validation on FEA or biomechanics design problems; no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification beyond standard GP.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化在高维空间扩展困难，需非线性降维方法。
summary_zh.method: 采用VAE进行潜在空间贝叶斯优化，并耦合序列域缩减。
summary_zh.result: 结构化潜在流形提升优化性能，VAE优于随机投影。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准基准函数上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization struggles with high-dimensional problems, motivating nonlinear dimensionality reduction for latent-space optimization.
summary_en.method: Variational autoencoders with deep metric loss and retraining are used for latent-space Bayesian optimization, combined with sequential domain reduction in the latent space.
summary_en.result: Structured latent manifolds improve optimization quality, and VAE-based methods outperform random embeddings on benchmark tasks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard benchmark functions demonstrate improved optimization performance.

title: MNO: Multiscale Neural Operator for 3D Computational Fluid Dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多尺度神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on CFD on irregular domains and does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子在三维不规则域上精度和可扩展性不足
summary_zh.method: 提出多尺度神经算子，融合全局、局部和微观注意力模块
summary_zh.result: 在稳态和非稳态流场预测中误差降低5%-50%
summary_zh.validation: 在多个三维CFD基准数据集上验证

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators suffer from limited accuracy and scalability on 3D irregular domains with multiscale flow structures.
summary_en.method: A Multiscale Neural Operator (MNO) is proposed, combining global dimension-shrinkage attention, local graph attention, and micro point-wise attention.
summary_en.result: MNO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing prediction errors by 5% to 50% across steady and unsteady flow benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on diverse 3D CFD benchmarks with up to 300k points, covering steady-state and unsteady flow scenarios.

title: Effect of 3D grading thickness on mechanical and deformation behaviour of gyroid structures produced via powder bed fusion with electron beam
first_author_affiliation: Department of Management and Production Engineering (DIGEP), Integrated Additive Manufacturing Center (IAM@PoliTo), Polytechnic University of Turin, Corso Duca degli Abruzzi 24,  10129, Turin, Italy

corresponding_authors.name: Danilo Bruson

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了三维梯度厚度对Gyroid结构力学性能的影响，与用户关注的LPBF制造和多孔结构应力屏蔽相关，但未涉及生物医学植入物或疲劳测试。
why_not_core: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching for biomedical implants, does not report fatigue testing, and lacks surface roughness or osseointegration data.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索三维厚度梯度对Gyroid结构力学性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用PBF-EB制造三种梯度Gyroid结构，结合X射线CT表征
summary_zh.result: 三维厚度梯度显著影响结构力学行为，优于均匀厚度设计
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和CT表征验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of three-dimensional thickness gradation on the mechanical and deformation behavior of gyroid structures fabricated by PBF-EB.
summary_en.method: Three types of initiator surfaces (diagonal plane, cross-shape, sphere) were used to create spatial wall thickness variations, and samples were fabricated via PBF-EB and characterized by X-ray computed tomography.
summary_en.result: Three-dimensional thickness gradation significantly influenced mechanical properties and deformation mechanisms, offering improved structural integrity compared to uniform thickness designs.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and X-ray computed tomography were used to correlate morphometric parameters with mechanical performance.

title: Automotive Crash Dynamics Modeling Accelerated with Machine Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了机器学习代理模型在汽车碰撞动力学中的应用，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant design, stress shielding, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it focuses on automotive crash dynamics.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低汽车碰撞有限元仿真的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 基于MeshGraphNet和Transolver构建代理模型，采用时间条件、自回归及稳定性增强自回归策略
summary_zh.result: 代理模型以较低精度捕捉整体变形趋势，计算速度提升数个数量级
summary_zh.validation: 在包含150个LS-DYNA仿真的白车身碰撞数据集上评估

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational expense of high-fidelity finite element simulations in automotive crashworthiness assessment.
summary_en.method: Surrogate models using MeshGraphNet and Transolver architectures are developed within the NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo framework, employing time-conditional, autoregressive, and stability-enhanced autoregressive strategies.
summary_en.result: The models capture overall deformation trends with reasonable fidelity, achieving orders-of-magnitude speedup over full FE simulations.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a Body-in-White crash dataset of 150 detailed LS-DYNA simulations.

title: Simulation-Based Optimization over Discrete Spaces using Projection to Continuous Latent Spaces
relevance_to_user: 该方法可用于植入物设计中的离散参数优化，但需验证其在生物力学FEA中的有效性。
why_not_core: No biomedical or implant design application, no FEA surrogate validation, no uncertainty quantification focus.

summary_zh.motivation: 离散参数空间的仿真优化因组合爆炸而计算昂贵。
summary_zh.method: 利用变分自编码器将离散空间投影到连续潜空间，结合贝叶斯优化高效搜索。
summary_zh.result: 在化工蒸馏系统设计中大幅减少昂贵的仿真调用次数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个化工过程案例验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Simulation-based optimization over discrete decision spaces suffers from combinatorial explosion and prohibitive computational cost.
summary_en.method: A variational autoencoder projects the discrete decision space into a continuous latent space, enabling efficient Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.result: The approach significantly reduces the number of expensive simulations in designing complex distillation systems.
summary_en.validation: Effectiveness is demonstrated via two chemical engineering case studies for liquid-liquid extraction and extractive dividing wall column.

title: Neural Networks for Bayesian Inverse Problems Governed by a Nonlinear ODE
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了神经网络在贝叶斯逆问题中高效推断参数和量化不确定性的能力，方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型中的参数估计与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element analysis, surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on ODE-based inverse problems in neuroscience.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决非线性ODE参数估计中传统方法面临的非凸性和计算挑战
summary_zh.method: 使用神经网络近似参数重建映射，实现贝叶斯逆问题求解
summary_zh.result: 神经网络能高效推断动力学参数、噪声参数和后验协方差，仅需一次前向传播
summary_zh.validation: 在FitzHugh-Nagumo模型数值基准上验证，对比不同网络架构和噪声水平

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the mathematical and computational challenges of classical parameter estimation methods for nonlinear ODEs with nonconvexity and sharp gradients.
summary_en.method: Neural networks are employed to approximate reconstruction maps for parameter estimation within a Bayesian inverse problem framework, enabling inference of dynamics parameters, noise parameters, and posterior covariance in a single forward pass.
summary_en.result: Neural networks accurately estimate hidden parameters and quantify uncertainties for the FitzHugh-Nagumo model, demonstrating robustness to noise and efficiency across architectures.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on the FitzHugh-Nagumo ODE system with synthetic noisy data, comparing multiple NN architectures and noise levels.

title: Unveiling the Role of Zinc on the Nanotitania Network in Determining the
first_author_affiliation: Process Engineering Division, CSIR-Central Electrochemical Research Institute, Karaikudi, Tamil Nadu 630003, India.; Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research (AcSIR), Ghaziabad-201002, India.

corresponding_authors.name: Deepak K Pattanayak
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Process Engineering Division, CSIR-Central Electrochemical Research Institute, Karaikudi, Tamil Nadu 630003, India.; Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research (AcSIR), Ghaziabad-201002, India.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及LPBF多孔钛支架的表面改性，但未直接研究应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on surface coating and osseointegration, not on stress shielding, stiffness matching, or fatigue testing of the porous structure.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发锌掺杂纳米二氧化钛涂层以改善钛植入物的骨整合和抗菌性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过碱处理和热处理在LPBF多孔钛支架上构建Zn-纳米TiO2网络涂层。
summary_zh.result: 优化Zn浓度涂层促进骨整合并抑制细菌，大鼠模型显示优于裸钛支架。
summary_zh.validation: 大鼠骨缺损模型结合X射线、micro-CT和基因表达验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a Zn-incorporated biomimetic nanotitania coating on Ti implants for enhanced osseointegration and antibacterial activity.
summary_en.method: Alkali treatment and heat treatment were used to form a Zn-doped nanotitania network on LPBF porous Ti scaffolds.
summary_en.result: The optimized Zn concentration coating promoted bone integration and inhibited bacteria, outperforming bare Ti scaffolds in a rat model.
summary_en.validation: In vivo rat bone defect model evaluated by X-ray, micro-CT, and osteogenic gene expression.

title: Surface Finishing of Additive Manufactured Titanium Alloy by Plasma Electrolytic Polishing Without Pretreatments
first_author_affiliation: School of Biomedical and Precision Engineering, Bern University, 3010 Bern, Switzerland

corresponding_authors.name: Adel Ghezri
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Biomedical and Precision Engineering, Bern University, 3010 Bern, Switzerland

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及增材制造钛合金的后处理抛光，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳测试，与用户研究方向间接相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not cover porous structure design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses solely on surface finishing of solid Ti64 parts.

summary_zh.motivation: SLM钛合金表面粗糙度影响疲劳和耐腐蚀性，需高效后处理。
summary_zh.method: 采用等离子电解抛光（PEP）对SLM Ti64进行单步表面处理。
summary_zh.result: 粗糙度从9-10 µm降至0.38-0.5 µm，满足卫生级要求。
summary_zh.validation: 通过表面粗糙度测量和形貌观察验证抛光效果。

summary_en.motivation: The high surface roughness of SLM-produced Ti64 parts limits their fatigue life and corrosion resistance, necessitating efficient post-processing.
summary_en.method: Plasma electrolytic polishing (PEP) was applied as a single-step finishing process for 3D-printed Ti64 components without pretreatments.
summary_en.result: PEP reduced surface roughness from 9-10 µm to 0.38-0.5 µm within 15-20 minutes, meeting hygienic standards.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed by measuring surface roughness and observing morphology before and after PEP.

title: Physics-augmented Multi-task Gaussian Process for Modeling Spatiotemporal Dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理增强多任务高斯过程方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但其验证场景为心脏电动力学而非植入物力学。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or structural FEA; it focuses on spatiotemporal dynamics in cardiac electrophysiology.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维时空数据建模面临不规则几何和快速动态挑战。
summary_zh.method: 提出几何感知多任务高斯过程，结合物理正则化约束。
summary_zh.result: 在3D心脏电动力学任务上显著提升预测精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟与现有方法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Modeling high-dimensional spatiotemporal data on complex geometries with rapid dynamics and multiple interrelated variables remains challenging.
summary_en.method: A geometry-aware multi-task Gaussian Process is developed with a physics-based regularization scheme to enforce consistency with governing dynamical laws.
summary_en.result: The proposed framework achieves significantly improved prediction accuracy on a 3D cardiac electrodynamics modeling task compared to existing methods.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on simulated cardiac electrophysiology data demonstrate the effectiveness of incorporating physical constraints and geometric priors.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Network Modeling of Vehicle Collision Dynamics in Precision Immobilization Technique Maneuvers
relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN应用于车辆碰撞动力学，其处理约束、不确定性量化和多网络框架的方法可迁移至生物力学植入物代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, bone-implant interface, or any biomedical context; it focuses on vehicle collision dynamics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决车辆碰撞动力学预测中效率与精度的权衡问题
summary_zh.method: 提出双PINN框架，分别学习冲击力分布和后碰撞动力学，集成高斯混合模型与自适应约束加权
summary_zh.result: 冲击力预测相对误差低于15%，轨迹预测误差降低63.6%，计算效率达毫秒级
summary_zh.validation: 通过FEA仿真、动力学建模和缩比车辆实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the trade-off between computational efficiency and prediction accuracy in vehicle collision dynamics modeling.
summary_en.method: A dual PINN framework is proposed: one network with Gaussian Mixture Models learns impact force distributions from FEA data under physics constraints, and another adaptive PINN with dynamic constraint weighting predicts post-collision dynamics with an adaptive physics guard layer.
summary_en.result: The impact force model achieves relative errors below 15%, and the vehicle dynamics model reduces average trajectory prediction error by 63.6% compared to traditional models, while maintaining millisecond-level efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using FEA simulations, dynamic modeling, and scaled vehicle experiments.

title: Functional tensor train neural network for solving high-dimensional PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的功能张量列神经网络方法可用于高维PDE求解，其处理非均匀网格和不规则域的能力对生物力学代理建模有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on solving high-dimensional PDEs with tensor train methods.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服传统张量列方法对均匀网格和规则域的依赖，解决高维PDE求解的维度灾难。
summary_zh.method: 用神经网络近似张量列核心函数，结合物理信息损失函数和Gauss求积计算高维积分。
summary_zh.result: FTTNN在规则和不规则域上的高维PDE求解性能优于PINN。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个高维PDE数值算例验证，包括规则和不规则域。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the limitation of traditional tensor train methods that require uniform grids on regular domains, enabling high-dimensional PDE solving on non-uniform grids or irregular domains.
summary_en.method: The PDE solution is represented in a functional tensor train format where TT-core functions are approximated by neural networks, and a physics-informed loss function with Gauss quadrature is used for training.
summary_en.result: The proposed FTTNN outperforms Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINN) on high-dimensional PDE examples with both regular and irregular domains.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on several high-dimensional PDEs, including those on irregular domains, demonstrate the method's effectiveness.

title: AMORE: Adaptive Multi-Output Operator Network for Stiff Chemical Kinetics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种多输出神经算子框架，可处理多目标约束和自适应损失，对生物力学代理模型中的多输出预测和约束处理有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on stiff chemical kinetics in combustion, not on FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks biomedical context and structural mechanics validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决刚性化学动力学时间积分计算成本高的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应多输出算子网络AMORE，包含自适应损失函数和精确约束映射。
summary_zh.result: 在合成气和GRI-Mech 3.0案例中验证了模型的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个标准化学动力学基准案例进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of time integration in stiff chemical kinetics systems by developing a reliable operator learning surrogate.
summary_en.method: AMORE framework with adaptive loss functions that penalize errors per output variable and per sample, and an invertible analytical map to enforce mass-fraction constraints exactly.
summary_en.result: The proposed DeepONet accurately predicts thermochemical states for syngas and GRI-Mech 3.0, demonstrating efficacy for stiff kinetics surrogates.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on two standard chemical kinetics mechanisms (syngas and GRI-Mech 3.0) with comparison to reference solutions.

title: nuGPR: GPU-Accelerated Gaussian Process Regression with Iterative Algorithms and Low-Rank Approximations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的GPU加速高斯过程回归方法可显著降低计算成本，适用于用户方向中的代理模型构建，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on computational efficiency of GPR without any application to FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低高斯过程回归的高计算成本
summary_zh.method: 结合预条件共轭梯度法和低秩近似，使用数值梯度优化超参数，并在GPU上并行化
summary_zh.result: 训练时间减少2倍，峰值内存减少12倍
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实数据集上与现有GPU实现对比

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high computational cost of Gaussian Process Regression training.
summary_en.method: Combines preconditioned conjugate gradient method, low-rank approximations of off-diagonal blocks, numerical gradient optimization, and CUDA-based GPU parallelization.
summary_en.result: Achieves up to 2x reduction in training time and 12x reduction in peak memory consumption compared to the best existing GPU-based GPR implementation.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on synthetic and real-world datasets against state-of-the-art GPU GPR frameworks.

title: Towards Foundation Inference Models that Learn ODEs In-Context
