summary_zh.method: 在ANSYS中对八种带圆形穿孔的股骨柄构型进行有限元模拟
summary_zh.result: 钛合金V2设计减重19.7%且安全裕度可接受
summary_zh.validation: 仅仿真，无实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To design lightweight femoral stems for total hip arthroplasty without compromising mechanical strength.
summary_en.method: Finite element simulations in ANSYS Workbench were performed on eight stem configurations with circular perforations at five locations, using Ti-6Al-4V and CoCr alloy under ASTM/ISO loading.
summary_en.result: The titanium V2 design achieved the greatest mass reduction (19.7%) while maintaining acceptable safety margins and fatigue resistance.
summary_en.validation: Validation is limited to simulation-based comparison with standard stem; no experimental or clinical validation.

title: Compressive Behavior of 316L Stainless Steel Lattice Structures for Additive Manufacturing: Experimental Characterization and Numerical Modeling
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Universidad de La Frontera, Temuco 4811230, Chile

corresponding_authors.name: Víctor Tuninetti
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Universidad de La Frontera, Temuco 4811230, Chile

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF制造的316L不锈钢点阵结构的压缩行为，但未涉及应力遮挡或生物医学植入物的疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration, which are core to the AM biomedical direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究LPBF制造的点阵结构力学性能受几何和工艺参数的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过改变支柱直径获得不同相对密度，进行准静态压缩实验和有限元模拟。
summary_zh.result: 力学性能与密度正相关，垂直构建试样性能略优，单胞模拟在低密度时低估刚度。
summary_zh.validation: 实验与模拟对比验证了Gibson-Ashby标度律。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how geometry, process parameters, and boundary conditions affect the compressive behavior of LPBF-fabricated lattice structures.
summary_en.method: BCC 316L stainless steel lattices with four relative densities were fabricated by LPBF in two orientations, tested under quasi-static compression, and simulated using finite element models.
summary_en.result: Mechanical properties scaled with density; vertical build orientation yielded slightly better performance; single-cell simulations underestimated stiffness at low density due to unconstrained buckling.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests and finite element simulations were compared, confirming Gibson-Ashby scaling for elastic modulus and yield strength.

title: A review on auxetic structures: Applications, properties, classifications, finite element analysis, manufacturing methods, and selective laser melting process parameters
relevance_to_user: 该综述涵盖了辅助结构在生物医学中的应用，但未涉及应力屏蔽或疲劳性能的具体研究。
why_not_core: This is a broad review on auxetic structures; it does not present original experimental data on LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, or osseointegration specific to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述辅助结构的独特性能及其在多个领域的应用潜力。
summary_zh.method: 基于变形机制对辅助结构进行分类，并讨论有限元分析和制造方法。
summary_zh.result: 总结了SLM工艺参数对辅助结构制造的影响，并指出未来研究方向。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: This review aims to consolidate the properties, classifications, and manufacturing methods of auxetic structures, highlighting their potential in various fields including biomedical engineering.
summary_en.method: The paper categorizes auxetic structures by deformation mechanism (re-entrant, chiral, etc.) and discusses finite element analysis studies and selective laser melting process parameters.
summary_en.result: Key SLM parameters such as scanning speed and laser power are reviewed, and future research directions on novel auxetic designs and elevated-temperature applications are identified.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is performed; the paper is a literature review.

title: PO-CKAN:Physics Informed Deep Operator Kolmogorov Arnold Networks with Chunk Rational Structure
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息算子网络方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant/biomechanics application, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升物理信息算子网络对参数化PDE的求解精度与效率
summary_zh.method: 将分块有理KAN子网络嵌入DeepONet架构，结合PINN残差损失进行物理约束
summary_zh.result: 在Burgers方程上相对L2误差较PI-DeepONet降低约48%
summary_zh.validation: 在Burgers、Eikonal和扩散-反应基准问题上与高保真解对比

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and efficiency of physics-informed operator networks for parametric PDEs.
summary_en.method: A DeepONet with Chunkwise Rational KAN sub-networks is trained with a PINN-style PDE residual loss.
summary_en.result: The method reduces mean relative L2 error by 48% on Burgers' equation compared to PI-DeepONet.
summary_en.validation: Validated on Burgers', Eikonal, and diffusion-reaction benchmark problems against high-fidelity solutions.

title: Multi-fidelity Batch Active Learning for Gaussian Process Classifiers
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真批量主动学习方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的采样优化，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on GP classifiers for binary simulation outputs, not on surrogate modeling for continuous FEA or implant design, and does not address constraints or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效分配多保真仿真预算以加速参数空间探索。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于一阶泰勒近似的伯努利参数互信息批量主动学习算法。
summary_zh.result: 在合成案例和火箭燃烧室仿真中，该方法优于基线，预测精度更高。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个合成测试和一个真实火箭燃烧室仿真案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently allocate a multi-fidelity simulation budget for binary output problems, accelerating parameter space exploration.
summary_en.method: Introduces Bernoulli Parameter Mutual Information (BPMI), a batch active learning algorithm for multi-fidelity GP classifiers using a first-order Taylor expansion of the link function.
summary_en.result: BPMI achieves higher predictive accuracy than baselines on synthetic and real-world rocket combustor simulations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two synthetic test cases and a complex laser-ignited rocket combustor simulation.

title: Surrogate Modeling for the Design of Optimal Lattice Structures using Tensor Completion
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出张量补全作为替代模型加速晶格结构设计，其处理非均匀采样和约束优化的方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context; validation is on lattice structure design with R² metrics, not on FEA surrogate or UQ for biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决非均匀采样下材料设计空间搜索效率低的问题
summary_zh.method: 使用张量补全作为替代模型，与高斯过程和XGBoost对比
summary_zh.result: 张量补全在偏采样下R²提升约5%，均匀采样下性能相当
summary_zh.validation: 在晶格结构设计数据集上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate materials design under non-uniformly random sampling of the design space, where classic ML methods struggle.
summary_en.method: Proposes tensor completion as a surrogate model and compares it with Gaussian Process and XGBoost on lattice structure design tasks.
summary_en.result: Tensor completion achieves about 5% higher R² under biased sampling and comparable performance under uniform sampling.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on lattice structure datasets with synthetic property labels.

title: StruSR: Structure-Aware Symbolic Regression with Physics-Informed Taylor Guidance
relevance_to_user: 该方法利用PINN提取局部物理先验来指导符号回归，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的显式表达式发现。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification, nor does it apply to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有符号回归难以利用结构化物理先验从时间序列中发现全局符号表达式。
summary_zh.method: 利用PINN的泰勒展开提取局部导数信息，通过掩码归因机制指导进化算子以保留重要子结构。
summary_zh.result: 在基准PDE系统上收敛更快，符号表达式结构保真度和可解释性优于传统方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个偏微分方程基准系统上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the lack of structured physical priors in symbolic regression for discovering global symbolic expressions from time series data.
summary_en.method: Proposes a structure-aware framework that extracts local derivative information via Taylor expansions of a trained PINN and uses a masking-based attribution to guide genetic programming mutations and crossovers.
summary_en.result: Achieves faster convergence, higher structural fidelity, and better interpretability of discovered expressions on benchmark PDE systems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on several canonical partial differential equation systems through numerical benchmarks.

title: RAISE: A self-driving laboratory for interfacial property formulation discovery
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了AI驱动的自驱动实验室在液体配方优化中的应用，其闭环实验设计和贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至生物打印中的墨水配方优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on liquid formulation optimization for wettability, not on bioprinting workflow stages (pre/in/post) or cell-laden bioink development.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现液体配方与表面润湿性关联的自动化优化。
summary_zh.method: 构建RAISE自驱动实验室，集成液体混合、液滴成像与贝叶斯优化。
summary_zh.result: 系统可每分钟测量一个接触角，多目标优化找到最优配方。
summary_zh.validation: 通过表面活性剂配方实验验证系统性能。

summary_en.motivation: To automate the optimization of liquid formulations for targeted surface wettability using a closed-loop self-driving laboratory.
summary_en.method: RAISE integrates robotic liquid handling, automated droplet imaging, and Bayesian optimization to iteratively explore formulation space.
summary_en.result: The system achieves a measurement rate of one contact angle per minute and successfully identifies optimal formulations via multi-objective Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation with surfactant formulations demonstrates the system's ability to compensate for purity variations and meet application-specific goals.

title: Development of TunableHard and Soft Lattice Scaffoldsfor Multiscale Tissue Engineering Applications
relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及多孔支架的力学性能调控和表面改性，但未使用LPBF制造，也未涉及疲劳测试或应力屏蔽分析。
why_not_core: This paper uses FDM (not LPBF) for PLA scaffolds, does not include fatigue testing, and does not address stress shielding or osseointegration in the context of load-bearing implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发可调谐的硬质和软质晶格支架用于多尺度组织工程。
summary_zh.method: 计算设计并3D打印PLA和藻酸盐水凝胶支架，结合表面改性和力学测试。
summary_zh.result: PLA支架模量可调（82-405 MPa），PDA涂层促进矿化沉积。
summary_zh.validation: 压缩测试、Micro-CT、细胞实验和成骨分化评估。

summary_en.motivation: To develop tunable hard and soft lattice scaffolds for multiscale tissue engineering applications.
summary_en.method: Computationally designed and 3D-printed PLA gyroid/diamond scaffolds with varying thicknesses and infills, and bioprinted alginate-HAP hydrogels in different geometries, with surface modification via polydopamine.
summary_en.result: PLA scaffolds exhibited tunable compressive moduli (82–405 MPa) and porosity (63–85%), and PDA coating enhanced hMSC attachment and mineral deposition, with diamond scaffolds showing highest calcium deposition.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical compression testing, micro-CT structural analysis, in vitro cell assays (metabolic activity, DNA content, osteogenic differentiation).

key_terms.en: human bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stem cells (hMSCs)

title: Development of Tunable Hard and Soft Lattice Scaffolds for Multiscale Tissue Engineering Applications
first_author_affiliation: Alabama State University

corresponding_authors.name: Vineeth M. Vijayan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Alabama State University

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及多尺度支架的力学可调性，但未直接研究应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no fatigue testing, no stress shielding analysis, and no osseointegration quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发可调刚度的硬/软支架用于多尺度组织工程。
summary_zh.method: 3D打印PLA和藻酸盐支架，结合拓扑优化和PDA涂层。
summary_zh.result: PDA涂层金刚石支架钙沉积最高，软支架中六边形蜂窝活性最高。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和力学测试验证支架性能。

summary_en.motivation: To develop tunable hard and soft lattice scaffolds for multiscale tissue engineering by combining topology, material reinforcement, and surface biofunctionalization.
summary_en.method: Hard scaffolds were 3D-printed from PLA with diamond and gyroid topologies and coated with polydopamine; soft scaffolds were bioprinted from alginate-hydroxyapatite composites with gyroid, hexagonal, and square honeycomb geometries.
summary_en.result: PDA-coated diamond scaffolds showed the highest calcium deposition, while square honeycomb soft scaffolds exhibited the highest metabolic activity and DNA content.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays (hMSC attachment, osteogenic differentiation, fibroblast encapsulation) and rheological testing validated scaffold bioactivity and print fidelity.

title: AutoBalance: An Automatic Balancing Framework for Training Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种新的PINN训练框架，可提高多目标损失平衡效率，对生物力学代理模型中的约束优化有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant design problems, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not address expensive simulation sampling or constraint handling in design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN训练中多损失项平衡困难的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出后组合训练范式，为每个损失项分配独立自适应优化器再聚合更新
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE基准上显著降低误差，优于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE数值基准上测试，与多种PINN方法对比

summary_en.motivation: To address the difficulty of balancing multiple loss terms with conflicting objectives and different curvatures in PINN training.
summary_en.method: Introduces a post-combine training paradigm that assigns an independent adaptive optimizer to each loss component and aggregates preconditioned updates.
summary_en.result: Achieves significant error reduction on challenging PDE benchmarks, outperforming existing frameworks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard PDE numerical benchmarks with comparisons to multiple PINN methods.

title: Optimizing LPBF of ball-milled HDH-Ti powder via DEM-guided spreading control and laser parameter screening for enhanced mechanical properties
first_author_affiliation: Department of Physics, School of Physics and Materials Science, Nanchang University, Nanchang, 330031, China

corresponding_authors.name: Yue Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Advanced Manufacturing, Nanchang University, Nanchang, 330031, China

corresponding_authors.name: Yulong Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Advanced Manufacturing, Nanchang University, Nanchang, 330031, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于LPBF工艺参数优化与粉末特性，未涉及植入物设计或生物力学性能。
why_not_core: No porous structure design, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, and no osseointegration or surface morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化球磨HDH-Ti粉末的LPBF工艺以提升致密度与力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 结合DEM模拟铺粉与激光参数筛选实验。
summary_zh.result: 优化参数下致密度达99.5%，抗拉强度与延伸率显著提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试与显微组织表征验证。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize the LPBF process for ball-milled HDH-Ti powder by integrating DEM-guided spreading control and laser parameter screening.
summary_en.method: DEM simulations were used to analyze powder spreading behavior, followed by experimental design of laser parameters.
summary_en.result: Optimized parameters achieved 99.5% density, with improved tensile strength and elongation.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile) and microstructural characterization validated the results.

title: NeST-BO: Fast Local Bayesian Optimization via Newton-Step Targeting of Gradient and Hessian Information
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过高斯过程学习梯度和Hessian信息实现快速局部贝叶斯优化，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant biomechanics; it focuses on unconstrained optimization with gradient/Hessian learning.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维贝叶斯优化收敛慢，需利用曲率信息加速。
summary_zh.method: 提出NeST-BO，联合学习梯度和Hessian，通过一步前瞻误差界选择采样点。
summary_zh.result: 在数千维问题上比现有方法收敛更快、最终值更优。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和高维实际问题（如未知活动子空间）上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization struggles in high dimensions; leveraging curvature information can accelerate convergence.
summary_en.method: NeST-BO jointly learns gradient and Hessian via Gaussian processes and selects evaluations by minimizing a one-step lookahead bound on the Newton-step error.
summary_en.result: It achieves faster convergence and better final values than state-of-the-art methods on problems with thousands of variables.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic and real-world high-dimensional problems, including those with unknown active subspaces.

title: Monte Carlo-Type Neural Operator for Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种新的神经算子框架，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, no implant or biomechanics application, only 1D PDE benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服傅里叶神经算子对平移不变核的依赖，提升算子学习灵活性。
summary_zh.method: 用蒙特卡洛采样近似积分算子，核函数表示为可学习张量。
summary_zh.result: 在一维PDE基准上达到竞争精度，理论证明偏差和方差有界。
summary_zh.validation: 在一维PDE标准算例上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the translation-invariant kernel assumption of Fourier Neural Operators and improve flexibility in learning solution operators for PDEs.
summary_en.method: The kernel is represented as a learnable tensor over sampled input-output pairs, and the integral operator is approximated via a Monte Carlo-type approach with uniform random sampling.
summary_en.result: Competitive accuracy on standard 1D PDE benchmarks with efficient computational cost, and theoretical proof of bounded bias and variance.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard 1D PDE problems.

title: Mechanical Performance and Energy Absorption of Ti6Al4V I-WP Lattice Metamaterials Manufactured via Selective Laser Melting
first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Jilin University, Changchun 130022, China

corresponding_authors.name: Xianyong Zhu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Jilin University, Changchun 130022, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了Ti6Al4V I-WP点阵结构的力学性能和能量吸收，但未涉及应力遮挡、疲劳性能或骨整合评估。
why_not_core: No fatigue testing, no stress shielding analysis, no osseointegration or surface morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 设计新型IWP-X点阵结构以提升轴向力学性能和能量吸收。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备Ti6Al4V IWP-X点阵，结合有限元模拟预测应力分布。
summary_zh.result: IWP-X结构抗压强度提升122.06%，能量吸收提升282.03%。
summary_zh.validation: 实验压缩测试与有限元模拟对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To design a novel IWP-X lattice metamaterial with enhanced axial mechanical properties and energy absorption for Ti6Al4V structures.
summary_en.method: IWP-X lattices were fabricated via selective laser melting and analyzed using finite element simulations to predict stress distribution and fracture sites.
summary_en.result: The IWP-X structure achieved a 122.06% improvement in ultimate compressive strength and a 282.03% improvement in energy absorption.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests were conducted and compared with finite element simulation results.

title: Material‐Gradient Enabled Enhancement of Strength and Strain‐Hardening of Lattice Structures
first_author_affiliation: Beijing Advanced Innovation Center for Materials Genome Engineering Institute for Advanced Materials and Technology University of Science and Technology Beijing  Beijing 100083 P. R. China

corresponding_authors.name: Xu Song
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Automation Engineering Chinese University of Hong Kong Shatin Hong Kong 999077 P. R. China

corresponding_authors.name: Baicheng Zhang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Beijing Advanced Innovation Center for Materials Genome Engineering Institute for Advanced Materials and Technology University of Science and Technology Beijing  Beijing 100083 P. R. China

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过LPBF制造梯度材料晶格结构并测试力学性能，与用户关注的AM生物医学植入物方向相关，但未涉及应力遮挡或骨整合。
why_not_core: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching for biomedical implants, nor does it report surface roughness, as-built morphology, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服传统几何驱动晶格设计的结构冗余和适应性不足。
summary_zh.method: 利用定制LPBF平台在BCC和Gyroid晶格中引入连续材料梯度。
summary_zh.result: 连续梯度使平台应力和能量吸收分别提升23.6%和25.4%（BCC）。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩实验验证力学性能提升和塑性流动稳定化。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome structural redundancy and limited adaptability of conventional geometry-driven lattice designs.
summary_en.method: Spatially continuous material gradients were introduced into BCC and Gyroid lattices using a custom LPBF platform with alloy composition control.
summary_en.result: Continuous gradients increased plateau stress and energy absorption by up to 23.6% and 25.4% in BCC lattices, respectively.
summary_en.validation: Compression experiments validated the enhancement of mechanical performance and stabilization of plastic flow.

title: Bilevel optimization for learning hyperparameters: Application to solving PDEs and inverse problems with Gaussian processes
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的双层优化方法可高效调整超参数，适用于高斯过程求解PDE和逆问题，其思想可迁移至生物力学代理模型的超参数学习。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification for design optimization, and does not handle multi-objective or constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效调整求解PDE和逆问题中高斯过程模型的超参数
summary_zh.method: 采用高斯-牛顿线性化内层优化，提供闭式更新，避免重复PDE求解
summary_zh.result: 相比随机初始化，显著提升精度和鲁棒性，适用于高维超参数优化
summary_zh.validation: 通过非线性PDE和逆问题的数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently tune hyperparameters in Gaussian process models for solving PDEs and inverse problems, which are critical for accuracy and stability.
summary_en.method: A bilevel optimization strategy with Gauss-Newton linearization of the inner loop, yielding closed-form updates that avoid repeated costly PDE solves.
summary_en.result: The method achieves substantial improvements in accuracy and robustness over random hyperparameter initialization, demonstrated on nonlinear PDEs and inverse problems.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical experiments on PDE and inverse problem benchmarks, including additive and deep kernels.

title: Bayesian Optimization under Uncertainty for Training a Scale Parameter in Stochastic Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯优化框架可处理随机模型中的超参数调优，其不确定性量化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的代理模型优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 随机模型中的超参数调优因噪声评估而计算昂贵，需高效优化方法。

summary_en.motivation: The lack of rigorous probabilistic calibration for Gaussian Process uncertainty estimates can degrade optimization convergence, motivating a formal kernel validation procedure.

summary_zh.method: 采用核壳Ti@Cu粉末进行激光粉末床熔融制备Ti-2.9Cu合金
summary_zh.result: 实现了高致密度、均匀微观组织，强度提升17%，塑性提升6.4%
summary_zh.validation: 通过Flow3D模拟和拉伸力学测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome solute segregation in Ti-Cu alloys fabricated by conventional methods.
summary_en.method: Core-shell Ti@Cu powders were used in laser powder bed fusion to fabricate hypoeutectoid Ti-2.9Cu alloys.
summary_en.result: The core-shell feedstock yielded >98.4% density, equiaxed grains, and improved strength-ductility synergy.
summary_en.validation: Flow3D simulations and tensile mechanical testing validated the approach.

title: Surrogate Modelling of Proton Dose with Monte Carlo Dropout Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文将蒙特卡洛丢弃不确定性量化应用于质子剂量代理模型，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或接触力学。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or structural FEA; it focuses on proton dose prediction in radiotherapy.

summary_zh.motivation: 质子剂量蒙特卡洛计算耗时，需快速代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 用蒙特卡洛丢弃神经网络构建代理模型，提供剂量预测与不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型显著加速，并分离认知与参数不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 一维解析基准、二维骨水模体、三维水模体验证。

summary_en.motivation: Monte Carlo dose calculation for proton therapy is computationally expensive, necessitating fast surrogates for iterative workflows.
summary_en.method: A neural surrogate with Monte Carlo dropout is developed to provide fast, differentiable dose predictions with voxelwise uncertainty.
summary_en.result: The surrogate achieves significant speedups over Monte Carlo while separating epistemic and parametric uncertainty contributions.
summary_en.validation: Validation includes a 1D analytic benchmark, 2D bone-water phantoms, and a 3D water phantom using TOPAS Geant4 simulations.

title: Learning Nonlinear Responses in PET Bottle Buckling with a Hybrid DeepONet-Transolver Framework
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的混合DeepONet-Transolver框架可用于替代昂贵有限元仿真，其多任务预测和几何泛化能力可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on PET bottle buckling rather than biomedical implant mechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not address constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决传统有限元分析计算成本高、难以泛化至非参数几何域的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出混合DeepONet-Transolver框架，同时预测节点位移场和反作用力时间演化。
summary_zh.result: 在四参数瓶体族上位移场平均相对误差2.5-13%，反作用力误差约2.4%。
summary_zh.validation: 使用Abaqus非线性有限元仿真生成254个设计样本进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the high computational cost and limited geometric generalization of traditional finite element analysis for nonlinear structural responses.
summary_en.method: A hybrid DeepONet-Transolver framework is introduced to simultaneously predict nodal displacement fields and time-dependent reaction forces under top load compression.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves mean relative L2 errors of 2.5-13% for displacement fields and about 2.4% for reaction forces on a four-parameter bottle family.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using nonlinear FEA simulations in Abaqus for 254 unique bottle designs per geometry family.

title: Stabilizing PINNs: A regularization scheme for PINN training to avoid unstable fixed points of dynamical systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PINN训练正则化方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的稳定训练。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on dynamical system stability rather than implant mechanics, constraint handling, or biomedical FEA surrogate validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN训练中固定点导致的物理错误解问题
summary_zh.method: 基于稳定性理论的正则化方案，惩罚不稳定固定点解
summary_zh.result: 在四个动力系统上有效避免错误解，提升训练成功率
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试（Lotka-Volterra, van der Pol等）

summary_en.motivation: To address local minima in PINN loss that correspond to physically incorrect fixed points of dynamical systems.
summary_en.method: A regularization scheme leveraging stability theory to penalize unstable fixed point solutions during training.
summary_en.result: The proposed scheme eliminates unphysical solutions and significantly improves training success rate on four dynamical systems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on Lotka-Volterra, van der Pol oscillator, and two other dynamical systems.

title: REGIONAL TRANSCRIPTIONAL AND PROTEOMIC CHARACTERIZATION OF HUMAN MENISCUS INFORMS PARAMETERS FOR GENERATION OF 3D-BIOPRINTED MENISCUS ANALOGUES
first_author_affiliation: University of Manchester, Manchester, United Kingdom

corresponding_authors.affiliation: University of Manchester, Manchester, United Kingdom

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D生物打印制造半月板替代物，但未集成AI/ML方法，仅使用成像数据指导打印，与AI驱动生物打印方向相关性有限。
why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it relies on conventional tissue characterization and manual bioink formulation without autonomous decision-making or model training.

summary_zh.motivation: 半月板损伤缺乏有效治疗，组织工程构建物难以模拟天然组织结构
summary_zh.method: 通过组织学、蛋白质组学和转录组学分析天然半月板，结合3D生物打印区域沉积细胞生物墨水
summary_zh.result: 成功制造出具有区域细胞和基质差异的3D半月板构建物
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞封装、组织学、基因表达和流变学验证

summary_en.motivation: Meniscal injuries lack effective treatments, and tissue-engineered constructs fail to replicate native tissue architecture and function.
summary_en.method: Regional histological, proteomic, and transcriptional analysis of native human meniscus guided the 3D bioprinting of zonally tailored cell-laden bioinks.
summary_en.result: A 3D bioprinted meniscal construct with regional variations in cell phenotype and matrix deposition was fabricated.
summary_en.validation: In vitro encapsulation, histology, gene expression, and rheology assays confirmed cell viability and zonal functionality.

title: Influence of process parameters on melt pool formation dynamics in laser powder bed fusion of dense WE43 magnesium alloy
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology
first_author_affiliation: Department of Engineering Technology, School of Engineering, South East Technological University, Waterford, Ireland

corresponding_authors.name: Prathviraj Upadhyaya
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Engineering Technology, School of Engineering, South East Technological University, Waterford, Ireland

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究WE43镁合金的LPBF工艺参数对熔池动力学的影响，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on LPBF process parameters for dense magnesium alloy, not on porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究LPBF工艺参数对WE43镁合金熔池形成的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过实验改变激光功率、扫描速度等参数，观察熔池形态
summary_zh.result: 确定了关键工艺参数对熔池尺寸和稳定性的影响规律
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量熔池几何尺寸并与理论模型对比

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of laser powder bed fusion process parameters on melt pool formation dynamics in dense WE43 magnesium alloy.
summary_en.method: Systematic variation of laser power, scanning speed, and other parameters with experimental observation of melt pool morphology.
summary_en.result: Key process parameters significantly affect melt pool dimensions and stability, providing guidance for defect-free fabrication.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurement of melt pool geometry compared with theoretical predictions.

title: FEDONet : Fourier-Embedded DeepONet for Spectrally Accurate Operator Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的FEDONet方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on PDE surrogate accuracy without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准DeepONet难以捕捉复杂PDE空间结构，需提升表示能力。
summary_zh.method: 在DeepONet主干网络中嵌入随机傅里叶特征以增强空间表示。
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE基准上相比传统DeepONet显著降低L2误差，尤其对混沌系统。
summary_zh.validation: 在Burgers、2D Poisson等五个PDE数据集上对比不同训练集大小和噪声水平。

summary_en.motivation: Standard DeepONet trunk networks with fully connected layers struggle to capture complex spatial structures in PDEs, motivating a Fourier-enhanced architecture.
summary_en.method: FEDONet integrates random Fourier features into the trunk network of DeepONet to improve spatial representation for operator learning.
summary_en.result: FEDONet achieves consistently lower relative L2 errors across multiple PDE benchmarks, with largest gains on chaotic and stiff systems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on five PDE datasets (Burgers, 2D Poisson, Eikonal, Allen-Cahn, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky) under varying training sizes and noise levels.

title: Data-driven balanced truncation for linear systems with quadratic outputs
relevance_to_user: 该方法虽未直接应用于生物力学，但其基于数据的平衡截断技术可迁移至植入物设计中的降阶建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraints, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics applications, focusing solely on model reduction for linear systems with quadratic outputs.

summary_zh.motivation: 扩展数据驱动平衡截断至二次输出线性系统，提升降阶精度。
summary_zh.method: 基于时频域正交规则的平衡截断方法，仅需采样冲激响应或传递函数。
summary_zh.result: 构建的降阶模型近似精度与侵入式投影平衡截断相当。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例验证框架有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Extends data-driven balanced truncation to linear systems with quadratic outputs, improving model reduction accuracy.
summary_en.method: Proposes a quadrature-based method (QuadBT) that samples extended impulse responses or transfer functions to construct reduced-order models.
summary_en.result: The resulting reduced-order model matches the approximation quality of intrusive projection-based balanced truncation.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a numerical example demonstrating the method's effectiveness.

title: Comparison of Deterministic and Probabilistic Machine Learning Algorithms for Precise Dimensional Control and Uncertainty Quantification in Additive Manufacturing
relevance_to_user: 该论文将概率机器学习应用于增材制造的尺寸控制与不确定性量化，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on dimensional control in additive manufacturing, not on FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics or stress shielding.

summary_zh.motivation: 增材制造中尺寸偏差的精确预测与不确定性量化
summary_zh.method: 对比确定性模型与概率模型（GPR、BNN）预测尺寸偏差
summary_zh.result: SVR精度接近工艺重复性，GPR可解释性强，BNN捕获认知与偶然不确定性
summary_zh.validation: 基于405个零件的实验数据集验证

summary_en.motivation: To achieve precise dimensional control and quantify uncertainties in additively manufactured components.
summary_en.method: Deterministic (SVR) and probabilistic (GPR, BNN) models are compared for predicting difference from target values using a dataset of 405 parts.
summary_en.result: SVR achieves accuracy near process repeatability, GPR offers strong interpretability, and BNNs capture both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties.
summary_en.validation: Validated on an experimental dataset of 405 parts from multiple machines, materials, and configurations.

title: BIOFABRICATION OF COMPLEX TISSUES FOR BONE REGENERATION VIA BIOPRINTING
first_author_affiliation: University of Crete, Heraklion, Greece

corresponding_authors.name: Μaria Chatzinikolaidou
corresponding_authors.affiliation: University of Crete, Heraklion, Greece

relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于生物墨水和挤出式生物打印用于骨再生，但未涉及任何AI或机器学习方法。
why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it is purely experimental biofabrication without computational modeling or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发用于骨再生的复杂组织生物制造方法
summary_zh.method: 使用弹性生物墨水结合挤出式生物打印构建骨软骨和血管化骨结构
summary_zh.result: 复合生物墨水提高了打印精度和细胞存活率，体内植入无免疫排斥
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和皮下小鼠模型验证

summary_en.motivation: To biofabricate complex osteochondral and vascularized bone constructs for sustained bone regeneration using extrusion bioprinting.
summary_en.method: Elastic bioactive bioinks containing gellan gum, PVA, and zinc-doped bioactive glass were used to print osteochondral constructs, while a dual-zone hydrogel system with conductive and nanocomposite properties was used for vascularized bone constructs.
summary_en.result: Composite bioinks improved printability and cell viability, and both construct types showed enhanced osteogenic and angiogenic markers in vitro and no adverse immune reactions in a subcutaneous mouse model.
summary_en.validation: In vitro biological assays (gene expression, ELISA, immunofluorescence) and a two-week subcutaneous mouse model.

title: A Comparative Structural Analysis of Total Hip Arthroplasty Designs
first_author_affiliation: University of Sarajevo - Faculty of Mechanical Engineering

corresponding_authors.affiliation: University of Sarajevo - Faculty of Mechanical Engineering

why_not_core: Does not report micromotion values, lacks patient-specific geometry, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur quantitatively.

summary_zh.method: 使用CATIA建立CAD模型，通过FEM分析两种假体在步态载荷下的力学响应
summary_zh.result: 现代假体应力应变分布更均匀，但接触应力更高，可能减少应力遮挡
summary_zh.validation: 仅基于有限元仿真，无实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To compare the stress and displacement distributions of conventional and modern total hip endoprosthesis designs under gait loads.
summary_en.method: CAD models of two hip implant designs were created in CATIA and analyzed using finite element method (FEM) to evaluate von Mises stresses and displacements.
summary_en.result: The modern design exhibited a more uniform stress-strain pattern but higher contact stresses at the stem-bone interface, potentially reducing stress shielding.
summary_en.validation: The study is purely computational with no experimental or clinical validation.

title: 4D BIOPRINTING OF VASCULARIZED AND INNERVATED TISSUE-ENGINEERED BONE FOR REPAIRING LARGE SEGMENTAL BONE DEFECTS

summary_en.validation: In vitro osteogenic differentiation of BMSCs and in vivo cranial defect implantation confirmed the regenerative capability.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Beijing Advanced Innovation Center for Materials Genome Engineering, State Key Laboratory for Advanced Metals and Materials, University of Science and Technology Beijing, Beijing, 100083, China

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of laser powder bed fusion parameters on the deformation behavior and stress-induced martensitic transformation of NiTi shape memory alloys.
summary_en.method: NiTi samples were fabricated by LPBF at a constant volumetric energy density while varying laser power and scanning speed, followed by mechanical testing and microstructural analysis.
summary_en.result: The deformation behavior and martensitic transformation were significantly affected by the process parameters, with notable differences in stress-strain response and transformation temperatures.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was performed through uniaxial compression tests, differential scanning calorimetry, and scanning electron microscopy.

title: Improvements on uncertainty quantification with variational autoencoders
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进的UQ-VAE方法，可高效量化高维参数空间的不确定性，对生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化有参考价值。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on inverse problems with benchmark tests including a 0D cardiocirculatory model but no structural mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维参数空间中UQ-VAE训练效率低和精度不足的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出移除样本均值项的新型损失函数，避免维度灾难导致的样本需求。
summary_zh.result: 新方法在泊松、非仿射及0D循环模型逆问题中提高了后验均值和协方差的近似精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过三个数值基准测试验证，包括一个0D心肺循环模型的前向UQ。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and training efficiency of UQ-VAEs for high-dimensional parameter spaces in Bayesian inverse problems.
summary_en.method: A novel loss function is proposed that removes the sample mean term, reducing the required number of samples and training time.
summary_en.result: The modified UQ-VAE achieves better approximation of posterior mean and covariance on Poisson, non-affine, and 0D cardiocirculatory inverse problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on three benchmark numerical tests, including forward UQ for a 0D cardiocirculatory model under clinical scenarios.

title: Physics-informed sensor coverage through structure preserving machine learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文将物理信息机器学习用于传感器覆盖和源定位，其结构保持数字孪生方法可迁移至生物打印中的过程监控和自适应控制。
why_not_core: This paper does not address bioprinting workflow stages, lacks experimental validation on bioprinting data, and does not involve autonomous decision-making for bioprinting.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现自适应源定位，利用结构保持数字孪生进行实时轨迹规划和数据同化。
summary_zh.method: 结合条件神经惠特尼形式与变压器算子学习，构建保持离散守恒的降阶环境模型。
summary_zh.result: 在复杂几何中，物理约束提高了源识别精度，结构保持提供了有效归纳偏置。
summary_zh.validation: 与物理无关的变压器架构进行数值基准比较。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve adaptive source localization by leveraging a structure-preserving digital twin for real-time trajectory planning and data assimilation.
summary_en.method: A machine learning framework combining conditional neural Whitney forms with transformer-based operator learning to build a reduced-order environmental model that preserves discrete conservation laws.
summary_en.result: Physical constraints improve source identification accuracy in complex geometries, demonstrating that structure preservation provides an effective inductive bias.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark comparisons against physics-agnostic transformer architectures.

title: A Certifiable Machine Learning-Based Pipeline to Predict Fatigue Life of Aircraft Structures
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过ML代理模型结合不确定性量化预测疲劳寿命，可迁移至植入物疲劳寿命预测，减少昂贵仿真。
why_not_core: Does not address implant-specific constraints, contact mechanics, or patient-specific geometries; domain is aerospace, not biomedical.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统疲劳寿命预测方法耗时且复杂，需要大量有限元仿真。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于机器学习的管道，根据飞行参数预测飞机机翼疲劳寿命。
summary_zh.result: 在真实用例中实现了准确预测，并进行了统计验证与不确定性量化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实际疲劳寿命估计用例验证，包含不确定性量化。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional fatigue life prediction methods are time-consuming and involve complex workflows requiring multiple finite element simulations.
summary_en.method: We propose a machine learning pipeline that predicts fatigue life at aircraft wing locations from flight mission parameters.
summary_en.result: The pipeline yields accurate predictions with thorough statistical validation and uncertainty quantification on a realistic use case.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a realistic aircraft fatigue life estimation scenario with statistical and uncertainty analysis.

title: ReBaNO: Reduced Basis Neural Operator Mitigating Generalization Gaps and Achieving Discretization Invariance
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的算子学习方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或生物医学应用。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no FEA validation on biomechanical problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有算子学习算法存在泛化差距且缺乏离散化不变性。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于贪婪算法和知识蒸馏的降阶基神经算子ReBaNO。
summary_zh.result: ReBaNO在泛化性能和离散化不变性上显著优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个PDE基准问题上与PCA-Net、DeepONet等对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing operator learning methods suffer from generalization gaps and lack strict discretization invariance.
summary_en.method: ReBaNO constructs a compact network via a greedy algorithm and knowledge distillation with task-specific activation functions.
summary_en.result: ReBaNO outperforms state-of-the-art operator learning algorithms in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution tests while achieving strict discretization invariance.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on multiple PDE problems compared against PCA-Net, DeepONet, FNO, and CNO.

title: Conditioning on PDE Parameters to Generalise Deep Learning Emulation of Stochastic and Chaotic Dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于PDE参数条件化的深度学习仿真器方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模，提高参数空间探索效率。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on stochastic and chaotic spatio-temporal systems (Kuramoto-Sivashinsky, turbulence) rather than solid mechanics or biomedical implant FEA, and lacks validation on biomechanical problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高随机混沌时空系统仿真效率，实现参数空间快速探索。

summary_zh.validation: 在混沌和随机偏微分方程数值基准上验证泛化能力。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate simulations of stochastic and chaotic spatio-temporal systems and enable efficient exploration of parameter spaces.
summary_en.method: A deep learning emulator conditioned on PDE parameters, pre-trained on a single parameter domain and fine-tuned on diverse data, with local attention for varying domain sizes.
summary_en.result: The emulator generalizes to interpolated parameter values on the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation and beta-plane turbulence, achieving significant computational speed-ups.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks of chaotic and stochastic PDEs, demonstrating generalization and uncertainty quantification.

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently estimate composition-dependent diffusion coefficients in ternary and quinary high-entropy alloys.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network (PINN) inversion of diffusion couple experiments is employed to extract diffusion coefficients across composition space.
summary_en.result: Tracer, intrinsic, and interdiffusion coefficients are mapped systematically, and the approach is extended to quinary systems.
summary_en.validation: Reliability is validated by comparing with interdiffusion coefficients from binary diffusion couples and Kirkendall marker plane data.

title: An Experimental Study on Tensile Characteristics of Ti-6Al-4V Thin Struts Made by Laser Powder-Bed Fusion: Effects of Strut Geometry and Linear Energy Density

title: Variational Rank Reduction Autoencoders for Generative Thermal Design
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合变分秩缩减自编码器与深度算子网络的混合框架，用于高效预测温度梯度，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理建模。

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真热模拟计算成本高，且传统生成模型潜空间不连续。
summary_zh.method: 提出VRRAE结合DeepONet，通过截断SVD实现结构化潜空间，并利用算子网络预测温度梯度。
summary_zh.result: 生成几何质量与梯度预测精度提升，推理效率显著优于传统数值求解器。
summary_zh.validation: 通过热设计案例验证生成与预测性能。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity thermal simulations are computationally expensive, and conventional generative models suffer from discontinuous latent spaces.
summary_en.method: A hybrid framework combining Variational Rank-Reduction Autoencoders (VRRAEs) with Deep Operator Networks (DeepONets) is proposed, using truncated SVD in the latent space for structured representations and operator learning for temperature gradient prediction.
summary_en.result: The approach improves geometric reconstruction quality and gradient prediction accuracy while offering substantial inference speedup over traditional solvers.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on thermal design cases, demonstrating generative and predictive performance.

title: Learning Turbulent Flows with Generative Models: Super-resolution, Forecasting, and Sparse Flow Reconstruction

why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics (turbulence) and does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or structural FEA surrogate modeling.

summary_en.motivation: Standard neural operators trained with L2 losses oversmooth fine-scale turbulent structures, limiting their accuracy in practical flow problems.
summary_en.method: Adversarially trained neural operators (adv-NO) and conditional generative models are applied to spatio-temporal super-resolution, forecasting, and sparse flow reconstruction.
summary_en.result: Adv-NO reduces energy-spectrum error by 15x for jet super-resolution and achieves 114x speed-up over diffusion-based forecasters for 3D turbulence.
summary_en.validation: Validated on Schlieren jet, 3D homogeneous isotropic turbulence, and cylinder wake flow benchmarks.

title: Bi-fidelity Interpolative Decomposition for Multimodal Data

why_not_core: This paper does not validate on any biomedical or implant mechanics problem, lacks uncertainty quantification for surrogate predictions, and focuses on a rocket combustor application.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准双保真方法无法处理多模态响应，导致近似精度下降。
summary_zh.method: 提出多模态插值分解方法，利用低保真样本构建基和插值规则。
summary_zh.result: 以16%的计算成本达到0.70-0.90的参数灵敏度相关性。
summary_zh.validation: 在激光点火火箭燃烧室仿真案例上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard bi-fidelity interpolative decomposition fails for multi-modal model responses with stochastic mode occupancy, motivating an extension.
summary_en.method: A multi-modal interpolative decomposition method is introduced that constructs a reduced basis and interpolation rule from low-fidelity samples to approximate high-fidelity data.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves high-fidelity approximation at 16% of the cost with correlation 0.70–0.90 for parameter sensitivities.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a laser-ignited methane-oxygen rocket combustor simulation exhibiting bifurcation-like phenomena.

title: Active Learning and Explainable AI for Multi-Objective Optimization of Spin Coated Polymers

summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve the multi-objective optimization problem of spin-coated polymer thin films while providing interpretable insights.
summary_en.method: An active Pareto front learning algorithm (PyePAL) with Gaussian process models is combined with UMAP visualization and fuzzy linguistic summaries.
summary_en.result: The framework efficiently identifies promising polymer designs and enhances interpretability through visual and linguistic explanations.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on numerical experiments using experimental data from spin coating.

summary_en.motivation: Conventional numerical methods for residual stress-induced deformation are computationally expensive and lack adaptability to varying geometries.

summary_en.result: The hybrid model predicts streamer shape, velocity, and evolution accurately for unseen incident fields, achieving 60x speedup.
summary_en.validation: Validated against FDTD plasma-fluid simulations for 2D microwave streamer formation with new incident fields not seen in training.

title: Active Learning of A Crystal Plasticity Flow Rule From Discrete Dislocation Dynamics Simulations
relevance_to_user: 该论文将主动学习与贝叶斯优化用于材料本构模型校准，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的构建与不确定性量化。

summary_zh.method: 用高斯过程表示晶体塑性流动法则，通过贝叶斯优化主动选择离散位错动力学模拟初始条件。
summary_zh.result: 自主循环生成的数据集与模型误差和不确定性均优于独立验证集。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently calibrate continuum-scale material models using lower-scale simulations without extensive expert intervention.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process representation of the crystal plasticity flow rule is combined with Bayesian optimization to autonomously select initial conditions for discrete dislocation dynamics simulations.
summary_en.result: The self-guided pipeline produces a dataset and model with validated error, uncertainty, and physical feature sensitivities against an independent dataset four times larger.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing the model's predictions to an independent dataset four times larger, assessing error, uncertainty, and sensitivity to physical features.

summary_en.motivation: To equip parallel-in-time solvers with probabilistic uncertainty quantification for differential equations.

summary_en.result: Demonstrates accuracy and robustness on five benchmark ODE systems and a PDE example, with theoretical error bounds.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on chaotic, stiff, and bifurcation ODEs, plus a PDE example using nearest-neighbor GPs.

title: RELift: Learned Coarse-to-Fine Propagators for Time-Dependent PDEs with Applications to Electron Dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的粗网格到细网格的神经算子框架可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或植入物设计。

summary_zh.motivation: 解决粗网格数值求解器无法捕捉细网格动力学细节的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出两阶段学习框架RELift，先学习超分辨率算子，再与粗网格积分器组合成细网格传播器
summary_zh.result: 在热方程、波动方程、Navier-Stokes和Vlasov-Poisson系统上实现高保真超分辨率和长时程准确预测
summary_zh.validation: 在四个PDE基准上对比标准超分辨率和神经算子基线，评估场级误差和物理诊断指标

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the limitation of coarse-grid numerical solvers in capturing fine-grid dynamics for time-dependent PDEs.
summary_en.method: A two-phase learning framework, RELift, that first learns a super-resolution operator from coarse to fine grids, then composes it with a coarse-grid integrator to form an effective fine-grid propagator.
summary_en.result: RELift achieves high-fidelity super-resolution and accurate long-horizon rollouts on heat, wave, Navier-Stokes, and Vlasov-Poisson equations, outperforming baselines in field-level error and physics-relevant diagnostics.
summary_en.validation: Benchmarked on four canonical PDEs with increasing complexity, comparing against standard super-resolution and neural operator baselines using field-level error metrics and physics-relevant diagnostics.

summary_en.motivation: To systematically investigate the energy absorption behavior of TPMS-based scaffolds under impact loading for bone tissue engineering applications.
summary_en.method: Uniform and porosity gradient Gyroid and IWP scaffolds were fabricated and tested at load-bearing angles from 0° to 90° using mechanical testing and finite element analysis.

summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing combined with finite element simulation validated the energy absorption characteristics.

title: CLINN: Conservation Law Informed Neural Network for Approximating Discontinuous Solutions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的守恒定律神经网络框架对解决不连续PDE问题具有参考价值，可迁移至植入物有限元代理模型中的激波捕捉任务。
why_not_core: No direct application to biomechanics or implant design; validation only on fluid dynamics benchmarks, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN在守恒律中不守恒和间断分辨率差的问题。
summary_zh.method: 在损失函数中引入有界性约束、隐式解形式和Rankine-Hugoniot条件，并加入残差自适应细化策略。
summary_zh.result: 在Burgers方程、交通流和Buckley-Leverett问题上均方误差最高降低99.2%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过三个经典数值算例与标准PINN对比验证精度和间断捕捉能力。

summary_en.motivation: Physics-informed neural networks fail to enforce conservation laws and resolve discontinuities in hyperbolic PDEs such as conservation laws.
summary_en.method: CLINN incorporates boundedness constraints, implicit solution forms, and the Rankine-Hugoniot condition into the loss, together with residual-based adaptive refinement near shocks.
summary_en.result: CLINN achieves up to 99.2% reduction in mean squared error on inviscid Burgers, LWR traffic flow, and Buckley-Leverett problems compared to vanilla PINN.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on three benchmark scalar conservation law problems with exact solutions demonstrate improved accuracy and reduced oscillations.

title: Trust-region filter algorithms utilizing Hessian information for gray-box optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的Hessian信息信任域滤波算法可显著减少黑箱评估次数，对生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification, and focuses on gray-box optimization rather than expensive simulation sampling efficiency in biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 灰盒优化中黑箱组件导数缺失，经典算法需大量调参和评估。
summary_zh.method: 提出四种利用Hessian信息的信任域滤波变体，结合低/高保真代理。
summary_zh.result: 新变体在迭代次数和黑箱评估上实现数量级减少，求解率高达92%-100%。
summary_zh.validation: 在25个灰盒基准和5个工程案例上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Gray-box optimization suffers from black-box components lacking analytic derivatives, requiring extensive tuning and evaluations.
summary_en.method: Four Hessian-informed trust-region filter variants are introduced, using projected positive definite Hessians and low/high-fidelity surrogates.
summary_en.result: The new variants achieve order-of-magnitude reductions in iterations and black-box evaluations, solving 92%-100% of problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on 25 gray-box benchmarks and five engineering case studies.

title: Sampling as Bandits: Evaluation-Efficient Design for Black-Box Densities
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于多臂老虎机的高效采样方法，可减少昂贵目标密度评估次数，其思想可迁移至有限元代理模型中的高效采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on sampling from black-box densities for Bayesian inference, not on surrogate modeling for expensive finite element simulations or implant design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少昂贵目标密度评估次数，实现高效采样。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于多臂老虎机的序贯样本选择框架，结合高斯过程代理指导采样。
summary_zh.result: 在多模态、重尾分布及真实贝叶斯推理任务中表现优越。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试和马尔可夫随机场案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To minimize the number of expensive target density evaluations while maintaining accurate sampling.
summary_en.method: Proposes a bandit importance sampling framework that sequentially selects samples using multi-armed bandits, with a practical strategy leveraging Gaussian process surrogates.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates superior performance on multimodal, heavy-tailed distributions and real-world Bayesian inference tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validated through comprehensive numerical benchmarks and a Markov random field case study.
