relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了贝叶斯优化在增材制造工艺参数优化中的应用，其多目标优化和不确定性量化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的FEA代理模型优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on process parameter optimization for LPBF of AA2024 alloy, not on surrogate modeling for biomechanical FEA or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效确定增材制造最优工艺参数以减少试错成本
summary_zh.method: 基于贝叶斯优化的机器学习框架，从少量初始数据出发进行单目标和双目标优化
summary_zh.result: 成功预测AA2024合金高密度无裂纹部件参数，双目标优化同时提升构建速率和密度
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和密度测量实验验证优化结果

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently identify optimal processing parameters for additive manufacturing, reducing costly trial-and-error experiments.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian optimization framework is applied to an initial dataset of only five parameter sets, extended to bi-objective optimization for build-up rate and density.
summary_en.result: The method accurately predicts parameters for crack-free, high-density AA2024 components, and bi-objective optimization significantly improves build-up rate while maintaining quality.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via tensile testing and density measurements confirms the predicted parameter sets.

title: Ancient Principles, Modern Impact: Increased Femoral Offset Demonstrates Decreased Load to Failure in Total Hip Arthroplasty
first_author_affiliation: From the Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Tulane University School of Medicine, New Orleans, LA (Dr. Sherman, Dr. Tate, Dr. Reinhart, Dr. Gabig, Verma, and Dr. Patel), and the Carle Illinois College of Medicine, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, Urbana, IL (Mr. Kim)

corresponding_authors.name: William F. Sherman
corresponding_authors.affiliation: From the Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Tulane University School of Medicine, New Orleans, LA (Dr. Sherman, Dr. Tate, Dr. Reinhart, Dr. Gabig, Verma, and Dr. Patel), and the Carle Illinois College of Medicine, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, Urbana, IL (Mr. Kim)

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了股骨偏心距对全髋关节置换术中股骨柄失效载荷的影响，与本方向相关但未涉及应力遮挡或微动分析。
why_not_core: Does not quantify stress shielding in Gruen zones, micromotion, or contact mechanics at bone-implant interface.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究股骨偏心距对假体周围骨折风险的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对复合股骨模型进行力学测试和有限元分析。
summary_zh.result: 高偏心距股骨柄降低了股骨失效载荷。
summary_zh.validation: 实验力学测试验证失效载荷差异。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of femoral offset on periprosthetic fracture risk in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Mechanical testing and finite element analysis were performed on osteoporotic composite femurs implanted with two stem designs.
summary_en.result: Higher femoral offset significantly decreased the ultimate load to failure of the femur.
summary_en.validation: Experimental load-to-failure tests on composite femurs validated the finite element findings.

title: A Kriging-HDMR-based surrogate model with sample pool-free active learning strategy for reliability analysis
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的Kriging-HDMR主动学习代理模型方法可解决高维可靠性分析中的计算效率问题，其框架可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on reliability analysis with high-dimensional model representation and does not address implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate for stress shielding, or multi-objective constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维可靠性分析中代理模型面临维数灾难及关键区域预测精度不足的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于Kriging-HDMR的三阶段主动学习代理模型，通过低维子模型组合逼近高维极限状态函数。
summary_zh.result: 数值实验表明该方法在保持高预测精度的同时显著提高了计算效率。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个高维数值算例验证了方法的准确性和效率。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the curse of dimensionality and improve prediction accuracy in critical regions for high-dimensional reliability analysis using surrogate models.
summary_en.method: A three-stage active learning Kriging-HDMR surrogate model is proposed, which approximates high-dimensional limit state functions via a composite of low-dimensional sub-surrogates.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments demonstrate high computational efficiency and strong predictive accuracy for high-dimensional reliability problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on multiple high-dimensional numerical benchmark problems.

title: Toward real-time optimization through model reduction and model discrepancy sensitivities
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合降阶模型和模型差异敏感性分析的方法，可加速优化并提高可靠性，对生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or stress shielding; it focuses on atmospheric contaminant control and wildfire ignition, with no biomedical or structural FEA context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决复杂系统优化中降阶模型在迭代超出训练数据时不可靠的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出超微分敏感性分析（HDSA-MD）在线校正降阶模型约束优化解
summary_zh.result: 仅需一次全阶模型评估即可显著提升优化解精度
summary_zh.validation: 通过大气污染物控制和野火点火位置两个数值算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve the reliability of reduced-order model (ROM)-constrained optimization when iterates leave the ROM training domain.
summary_en.method: Proposes hyper-differential sensitivity analysis with respect to model discrepancy (HDSA-MD) to augment ROM-constrained optimization with a few full-order model evaluations.
summary_en.result: The HDSA-MD update significantly improves the ROM-constrained optimization solution using only one full-order model evaluation online.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two numerical examples: atmospheric contaminant control and wildfire ignition location estimation.

title: Research on the dynamic mechanical properties of selective laser melting TC4 titanium alloy and the construction of J-C model
first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical Engineering, Nanjing University of Science and Technology, Nanjing 210094, China

corresponding_authors.name: Keqiang Dong
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical Engineering, Nanjing University of Science and Technology, Nanjing 210094, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选区激光熔化TC4钛合金的动态力学性能并构建了J-C本构模型，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能，与生物医学植入物方向间接相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration, which are core to the AM biomedical direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM TC4钛合金的动态力学行为并建立本构模型
summary_zh.method: 通过霍普金森杆实验获取不同应变率下的应力-应变数据，拟合J-C模型参数
summary_zh.result: 成功构建了能描述动态力学响应的J-C本构模型
summary_zh.validation: 实验数据与模型预测对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the dynamic mechanical behavior of selective laser melted TC4 titanium alloy and establish a constitutive model.
summary_en.method: Split Hopkinson pressure bar tests were conducted at various strain rates to obtain stress-strain data, and Johnson-Cook model parameters were fitted.
summary_en.result: A Johnson-Cook constitutive model was successfully constructed to describe the dynamic mechanical response.
summary_en.validation: Model predictions were validated against experimental data.

title: Calibrating a Finite-strain Phase-field Model of Fracture for Bonded Granular Materials with Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了将不确定性量化与高保真有限元模拟相结合的材料模型校准框架，可迁移至植入物力学建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on bonded granular materials for mock high explosives, not on implant biomechanics or surrogate modeling for design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 为粘结颗粒材料建立带不确定性量化的材料模型校准方法。
summary_zh.method: 利用GPU加速有限元软件进行数百次高保真模拟，校准有限应变相场断裂模型。
summary_zh.result: 制造温度影响弹性响应，初始颗粒构型影响可忽略，校准框架有效。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验数据与模拟对比验证校准框架的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a generalizable methodology for calibrating material models of bonded granular materials with quantified uncertainty.
summary_en.method: Hundreds of high-fidelity direct numerical simulations using a GPU-accelerated finite element solver were performed to calibrate a finite-strain phase-field fracture model against experimental data.
summary_en.result: Manufacturing temperature significantly influenced elastic response, while initial grain configuration had negligible impact on overall behavior.
summary_en.validation: The calibration framework was validated by comparing simulation results with experimental data across multiple manufacturing conditions.

title: Self-consistent clustering analysis for homogenisation of heterogeneous plates
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自洽聚类分析方法可用于板结构的快速多尺度均匀化，其降阶建模思路可迁移至生物力学中的植入物-骨界面多尺度模拟。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on plate homogenization with periodic microstructures, not on implant-bone interface mechanics, surrogate modeling for FEA, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决周期性微结构板结构的多尺度均匀化计算效率问题
summary_zh.method: 将自洽聚类分析与Lippmann-Schwinger方程耦合，结合k-means数据压缩和参考介质弱敏感性
summary_zh.result: 在保持精度的同时将计算成本降低一个数量级以上
summary_zh.validation: 在线性/非线性穿孔板和编织复合材料上对比FFT直接数值模拟

summary_en.motivation: To develop a reduced-order model for efficient multiscale homogenization of plate structures with periodic microstructures.
summary_en.method: Coupling self-consistent clustering analysis with the Lippmann-Schwinger equation, employing an offline-online strategy with k-means compression and exploiting weak sensitivity of the reference medium.
summary_en.result: The proposed model matches the accuracy of FFT-based direct numerical simulation while reducing computational cost by over an order of magnitude.
summary_en.validation: Validated on linear isotropic perforated plates, woven composites, and nonlinear elasto-plastic and damage cases against FFT-based DNS.

title: Preconditioned pseudo-time continuation for parameterized inverse problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种加速参数化反问题求解的预条件方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的UQ和优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on inverse problems and PDE-constrained optimization, not on surrogate modeling for forward FEA or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解参数化反问题以支持不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 引入自适应拟牛顿Hessian预条件子加速伪时间延续过程。
summary_zh.result: 在非线性反问题中实现了可靠且高效的计算。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个非线性反问题数值算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Efficiently solving parameterized inverse problems for uncertainty quantification by evolving the optimal solution along an auxiliary parameter path.
summary_en.method: An adaptive quasi-Newton Hessian preconditioner is introduced to accelerate pseudo-time continuation for solving variational inverse problems constrained by PDEs.
summary_en.result: The proposed preconditioner achieves reliable and efficient computation for two nonlinear inverse problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on two nonlinear inverse problems demonstrate the method's performance.

title: Polynomial Chaos Expansion for Operator Learning
relevance_to_user: 提出了一种基于多项式混沌展开的算子学习方法，天然具备不确定性量化能力，可迁移至植入物/生物力学代理建模。
why_not_core: Does not include constraint handling or application to implant/biomechanics design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 为算子学习提供高效且自带不确定性的替代方法。
summary_zh.method: 将多项式混沌展开框架扩展到数据驱动和物理信息驱动的算子学习。
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE问题上展现了高精度和计算效率，且UQ无额外成本。
summary_zh.validation: 通过不同PDE问题的数值实验验证了性能。

summary_en.motivation: To provide an efficient operator learning method with built-in uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: Extends polynomial chaos expansion to operator learning in both data-driven and physics-informed settings.
summary_en.result: Achieves high accuracy and computational efficiency on diverse PDE problems with UQ at no extra cost.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on multiple PDE benchmarks demonstrate strong performance.

title: A Mixture of Experts Gating Network for Enhanced Surrogate Modeling in External Aerodynamics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种混合专家门控网络，通过动态组合多个代理模型来提高预测精度，其方法可迁移至生物力学或植入物设计的代理建模中。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on external aerodynamics for automotive design, with no validation on biomedical or implant mechanics problems, and does not address constraints, uncertainty quantification, or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真CFD计算成本高，单一代理模型难以通用。
summary_zh.method: 提出混合专家门控网络，动态组合多个异构代理模型的预测。
summary_zh.result: 在DrivAerML数据集上，L2预测误差显著低于单个最优模型。
summary_zh.validation: 基于公开汽车空气动力学CFD基准数据集进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity CFD simulations are computationally expensive, and no single surrogate model universally excels across all aerodynamic prediction tasks.
summary_en.method: A Mixture of Experts framework with a gating network that learns spatially-variant weights to combine predictions from DoMINO, X-MeshGraphNet, and FigConvNet.
summary_en.result: The MoE model achieves lower L-2 prediction error than both the ensemble average and the best individual expert on the DrivAerML dataset.
summary_en.validation: Validated on the DrivAerML public benchmark dataset of high-fidelity CFD simulations for automotive aerodynamics.

title: Physics-Informed DeepONet Coupled with FEM for Convective Transport in Porous Media with Sharp Gaussian Sources
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的FEM-PI-DeepONet混合框架可加速多孔介质中的输运模拟，其模块化策略和自适应采样方法对生物力学中的代理模型构建具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context; it focuses on fluid transport in porous media with sharp sources.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多孔介质中尖锐高斯源引起的对流输运模拟效率低的问题
summary_zh.method: 将有限元求解达西流场与物理信息DeepONet结合，并引入自适应采样策略处理陡峭梯度
summary_zh.result: 与参考解高度一致，计算速度提升数个数量级
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证精度与效率

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the simulation of convective transport in porous media with sharp Gaussian sources while maintaining accuracy.
summary_en.method: A hybrid framework coupling FEM for Darcy flow with a physics-informed DeepONet for transport, enhanced by adaptive trunk collocation sampling.
summary_en.result: The method achieves orders-of-magnitude speedup over traditional solvers with good agreement to reference solutions.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark experiments comparing against reference solutions.

key_terms.zh: 物理信息深度算子网络

title: Neural Spline Operators for Risk Quantification in Stochastic Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: No implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification for design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有风险量化方法难以处理功能变化的系统动力学。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于B样条的神经算子框架NeSO，学习从功能动力学到风险概率的映射。
summary_zh.result: NeSO在变动力学和高维多智能体案例中显著提升在线计算速度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个仿真案例验证，并与现有方法对比。

summary_en.motivation: Existing risk quantification methods struggle with functional variations in system dynamics.
summary_en.method: Proposes Neural Spline Operators (NeSO), a physics-informed neural operator framework using B-spline representations to learn mappings from functional dynamics to risk probabilities.
summary_en.result: NeSO achieves significant online speed-up over existing methods in case studies with varying functional dynamics and high-dimensional multi-agent dynamics.
summary_en.validation: Validated through two simulation case studies comparing against sampling-based and PDE-based methods.

title: Multi-Order Monte Carlo IMEX hierarchies for uncertainty quantification in multiscale hyperbolic systems
relevance_to_user: 该方法在不确定性量化方面具有创新性，但应用于多尺度双曲型PDE，而非生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or biomedical design; focuses on hyperbolic PDEs and kinetic equations.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多尺度双曲型PDE中传统多层蒙特卡洛方法计算成本高的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出多阶蒙特卡洛方法，通过改变时空离散阶数构建层次结构。
summary_zh.result: 在保持渐近一致性的同时，有效降低误差和方差。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证了方法的精度和效率。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational cost of multi-level Monte Carlo methods for multiscale hyperbolic PDEs with stiff relaxation.
summary_en.method: Proposes a multi-order Monte Carlo framework that varies spatial and temporal discretization orders to construct a hierarchy.
summary_en.result: Achieves significant variance reduction and error reduction while maintaining asymptotic consistency.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on hyperbolic systems and kinetic equations demonstrate the method's effectiveness.

title: Conditional Normalizing Flow Surrogate for Monte Carlo Prediction of Radiative Properties in Nanoparticle-Embedded Layers
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的条件归一化流代理模型方法可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on radiative transfer surrogate modeling, not on finite element analysis (FEA) or implant biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决纳米颗粒嵌入层辐射特性蒙特卡洛仿真计算效率低的问题。
summary_zh.method: 使用条件归一化流学习辐射特性输出关于输入参数的条件分布。
summary_zh.result: 模型预测精度高且能提供可靠的不确定性估计。
summary_zh.validation: 基于Mie理论和蒙特卡洛仿真的数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently predict radiative properties of nanoparticle-embedded scattering media while avoiding expensive Monte Carlo simulations.
summary_en.method: A conditional normalizing flow surrogate learns the full conditional distribution of optical outputs given input parameters such as absorption and scattering coefficients.
summary_en.result: The model achieves high predictive accuracy and provides principled uncertainty quantification for reflectance, absorbance, and transmittance.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic data generated from Monte Carlo radiative transfer simulations with Mie-theory-derived optical properties.

title: Temperature-Aware Recurrent Neural Operator for Temperature-Dependent Anisotropic Plasticity in HCP Materials
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的温度感知递归神经算子（TRNO）可高效替代塑性本构模型，其时间分辨率无关性和多尺度加速特性有望迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模中。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context; it focuses on temperature-dependent plasticity in HCP materials.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有塑性代理模型训练慢、外推差，且难以处理复杂材料行为。
summary_zh.method: 提出温度感知递归神经算子（TRNO），实现时间分辨率无关的塑性响应预测。
summary_zh.result: TRNO在镁合金各向异性塑性预测中精度高、泛化强，训练效率优于GRU/LSTM。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多载荷、多温度、多时间分辨率下的数值模拟验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural network surrogates for plasticity suffer from long training times, poor extrapolation across time resolutions, and limited applicability to complex material behaviors.
summary_en.method: The Temperature-Aware Recurrent Neural Operator (TRNO) is introduced as a time-resolution-independent architecture for path-dependent constitutive modeling.
summary_en.result: TRNO achieves high accuracy and generalization for temperature-dependent anisotropic plasticity in polycrystalline magnesium, outperforming GRU and LSTM models in training efficiency and prediction.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical simulations across diverse loading cases, temperatures, and time resolutions, with multiscale simulations demonstrating three orders of magnitude speedup.

title: Graph Neural Network-Based Topology Optimization for Self-Supporting Structures in Additive Manufacturing
relevance_to_user: 该论文将图神经网络用于增材制造中的自支撑拓扑优化，其方法可迁移至生物打印中的结构优化或数字孪生。
why_not_core: This paper does not address bioprinting-specific materials, cell viability, or any biological context; it focuses on structural optimization for general additive manufacturing.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现增材制造中自支撑结构的拓扑优化，减少后处理需求。
summary_zh.method: 使用图神经网络作为神经场预测连续材料分布，集成增材制造过滤器确保可打印性。
summary_zh.result: 生成满足应力和体积约束的可制造拓扑，适用于多种载荷和边界条件。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证框架生成应力约束可制造拓扑的能力。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a topology optimization framework that produces self-supporting structures suitable for additive manufacturing, reducing the need for post-processing.
summary_en.method: A graph neural network is employed as a neural field over the finite element mesh to predict continuous material distributions, with an integrated AM filter to eliminate unsupported overhangs and stress constraints enforced via differentiable p-norm aggregation.
summary_en.result: The framework generates stress-constrained, manufacturable topologies under various loading and boundary conditions, demonstrating a practical pathway toward AM-ready designs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments validate the framework's ability to produce manufacturable topologies with stress constraints.

title: Data-Augmented Few-Shot Neural Emulator for Computer-Model System Identification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种数据增强策略，用于高效训练神经PDE替代模型，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective optimization, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification beyond neural PDE training, or implant/biomechanics-specific applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高神经PDE替代模型的训练样本效率，减少对大量轨迹数据的依赖。
summary_zh.method: 通过空间填充采样局部模板状态生成训练数据，替代长时程轨迹展开。
summary_zh.result: 仅用10个时间步的模拟数据即可训练出准确的神经PDE算子，性能优于传统ML代理。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个PDE系统上对比不同采样策略的预测精度和稳定性。

summary_en.motivation: To improve sample efficiency in training neural PDE emulators by reducing spatiotemporal redundancy in trajectory data.
summary_en.method: A data-augmentation strategy that generates training data via space-filling sampling of local stencil states, avoiding long-horizon rollout.
summary_en.result: Accurate neural PDE stencil operators are learned from the computational equivalent of 10 timesteps, outperforming traditional ML emulators trained on thousands of trajectories.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on multiple PDE systems comparing rollout accuracy and stability against naive sampling and traditional emulators.

title: Automated discovery of finite volume schemes using Graph Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了GNN自动发现数值格式的能力，可迁移至生物力学FEA代理模型的构建，但未涉及约束处理或UQ。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification, and lacks direct application to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索GNN能否超越传统代理角色，自动发现数值格式。
summary_zh.method: 用两节点图训练GNN，结合符号回归和PINN损失，发现有限体积格式。
summary_zh.result: GNN能恢复一阶FV格式，并自主发现二阶修正项和中点格式。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试和理论误差分析。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether Graph Neural Networks can go beyond surrogate modeling and autonomously discover numerical schemes for PDEs.
summary_en.method: A GNN trained on two-node graphs is combined with symbolic regression and a physics-informed residual loss to discover finite volume schemes.
summary_en.result: The GNN recovers the first-order FV scheme and autonomously discovers second-order correction terms and the midpoint scheme.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on unstructured meshes and theoretical error analysis.

title: Uncertain data assimilation for urban wind flow simulations with OpenLB-UQ
relevance_to_user: 该论文将不确定性量化与格子玻尔兹曼方法结合用于城市风场模拟，其非侵入式随机配置法和稀疏网格求积策略可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的不确定性传播问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant or biomechanics design; it focuses on urban wind flow using LBM, not solid mechanics or biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 城市风场模拟中边界条件不确定且计算成本高，需高效不确定性量化方法。
summary_zh.method: 采用基于广义多项式混沌的随机配置法与稀疏网格求积，非侵入式耦合格子玻尔兹曼求解器。
summary_zh.result: 在真实城市场景中高效计算了平均流场、标准差及置信区间，不确定性在尾流和剪切层区域显著。
summary_zh.validation: 基于真实测量数据构建相对误差噪声模型，通过实际城市算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Accurate urban wind flow prediction is hindered by uncertain boundary conditions and high computational cost of conventional CFD, motivating efficient uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A non-intrusive stochastic collocation lattice Boltzmann method using generalized polynomial chaos and sparse-grid quadrature is implemented within the OpenLB-UQ framework.
summary_en.result: Mean flow fields, standard deviations, and confidence intervals are efficiently computed for a real urban scenario, with uncertainty localized in wakes and shear layers.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using a real urban case with a relative-error noise model for inflow wind speeds based on actual measurements.

key_terms.zh: 非侵入式不确定性量化

title: Enhancing Trust-Region Bayesian Optimization via Newton Methods
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合牛顿方法的信任域贝叶斯优化，可提高昂贵黑箱函数的采样效率，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理模型优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification for biomedical design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高高维贝叶斯优化的采样效率
summary_zh.method: 在全局GP中提取梯度和Hessian构建局部二次模型，求解约束二次规划选择新样本
summary_zh.result: 方法在合成函数和实际应用中优于多种高维BO技术
summary_zh.validation: 在合成函数和实际优化问题上进行数值实验

summary_en.motivation: To improve sampling efficiency of Bayesian optimization in high-dimensional spaces while maintaining heterogeneous modeling.
summary_en.method: Constructs local quadratic models using gradients and Hessians from a global Gaussian process and selects new points by solving a bound-constrained quadratic program.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms a range of high-dimensional BO techniques on synthetic functions and real-world applications.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic functions and real-world optimization problems.

title: Balancing the exploration-exploitation trade-off in active learning for surrogate model-based reliability analysis via multi-objective optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多目标优化主动学习方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的失效概率估计，但未涉及植入物设计或生物力学具体问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, patient-specific geometry, or any biomedical application context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决主动学习中探索与利用的平衡问题，提高代理模型可靠性分析的效率。
summary_zh.method: 将样本获取建模为多目标优化问题，显式优化探索和利用两个竞争目标。
summary_zh.result: 自适应多目标优化策略在多种极限状态函数上实现了稳健的性能，并满足严格误差目标。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试比较相对失效概率误差轨迹和样本效率。

summary_en.motivation: To address the exploration-exploitation trade-off in active learning for surrogate-based reliability analysis by formulating sample acquisition as a multi-objective optimization problem.
summary_en.method: The acquisition strategy is cast as a multi-objective optimization with explicit exploration and exploitation objectives, yielding a Pareto set from which samples are selected using adaptive trade-off rules.
summary_en.result: Adaptive MOO-based strategies achieve robust overall performance across diverse limit-state functions, consistently meeting strict error targets.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmark limit-state functions, comparing relative failure-probability error trajectories and sample efficiency.

title: Machine Learning‐Based Design of 3D‐Printable Microneedles for Enhanced Tissue Anchoring with Reduced Tissue Damage
first_author_affiliation: Center for Bionics Korea Institute of Science and Technology  Seoul 02792 Korea

corresponding_authors.name: Deukhee Lee
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Center for Bionics Korea Institute of Science and Technology  Seoul 02792 Korea

corresponding_authors.name: Amy Kyungwon Han
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering Seoul National University  Seoul 08826 Korea

relevance_to_user: 该论文将贝叶斯优化与有限元方法结合，用于微针形状设计，其方法可迁移至植入物或生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真采样效率问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it focuses on microneedle anchoring and insertion force, not surrogate modeling for FEA in biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化微针形状以同时增强组织锚定并减少插入力。
summary_zh.method: 结合贝叶斯优化与有限元方法，优化可3D打印的微针设计。
summary_zh.result: 最优设计将拔出-穿透能量比提高5.2倍，实验验证提升6.0倍。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量拔出-穿透能量比进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize microneedle shape for simultaneously enhanced tissue anchoring and reduced insertion force, which are conflicting objectives.
summary_en.method: A machine learning-based methodology combining Bayesian optimization with finite element simulations to design 3D-printable microneedles.
summary_en.result: The optimal design achieved a 5.2-fold improvement in pull-out-to-penetration energy ratio over conventional cone-shaped microneedles, validated experimentally with a 6.0-fold improvement.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing measuring the pull-out-to-penetration energy ratio (PPR) confirmed the simulation predictions.

title: Quantifying Out-of-Training Uncertainty of Neural-Network based Turbulence Closures
relevance_to_user: 该论文比较了多种神经网络不确定性量化方法在湍流闭合模型中的应用，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on turbulence closures in CFD, not on FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, and lacks biomedical context or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经网络湍流闭合模型缺乏不确定性量化，尤其是训练外输入的不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 比较深度集成、MC Dropout、随机变分推断和高斯过程在代数湍流闭合模型上的不确定性量化性能。
summary_zh.result: 高斯过程精度最高但计算成本高，深度集成在训练外区域表现稳健且计算高效。
summary_zh.validation: 基于代数湍流闭合模型的标准数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Neural-network-based turbulence closures lack uncertainty quantification, especially for out-of-training inputs, hindering their widespread adoption in CFD.
summary_en.method: Compare epistemic uncertainty quantification of Deep Ensembles, Monte-Carlo Dropout, Stochastic Variational Inference, and Gaussian Process on a published algebraic turbulence closure.
summary_en.result: Gaussian Process achieves highest accuracy but with O(n^3) cost, while Deep Ensembles provide robust and intuitive UQ estimates at lower computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on an algebraic turbulence closure model.

title: Physics-Informed Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for multi-material elasticity problems in electronic packaging
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用物理信息KAN处理多材料弹性问题，其处理材料不连续性的能力可转移到生物力学植入物分析中。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, uncertainty quantification, or constrained optimization; it focuses on electronic packaging, not biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 使用单一网络处理多材料弹性问题中的材料不连续性
summary_zh.method: 能量法物理信息KAN，用B样条激活函数替代MLP
summary_zh.result: 在数值实验中实现了高精度和鲁棒性
summary_zh.validation: 通过多材料弹性数值算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To solve multi-material elasticity problems with a single neural network while handling material property discontinuities.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Physics-Informed Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (PIKAN) with energy-based formulation and trainable B-spline activation functions.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves excellent accuracy and robustness in numerical multi-material elasticity experiments.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmark problems for multi-material elasticity in electronic packaging.

key_terms.zh: 柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络

title: Learning Spatio-Temporal Dynamics via Operator-Valued RKHS and Kernel Koopman Methods
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于算子值RKHS和Koopman算子的时空动力学学习框架，可用于高维非线性系统的降阶建模和长期预测，其方法可迁移到生物力学有限元代理模型中。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on general spatio-temporal dynamics without constraint handling or uncertainty quantification in design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 为高维非线性时空系统提供数据驱动的降阶建模与预测方法。
summary_zh.method: 结合算子值再生核希尔伯特空间与核Koopman算子，建立非参数估计框架。
summary_zh.result: 证明了时间依赖OV-RKHS插值的表示定理、Sobolev逼近界和谱收敛保证。
summary_zh.validation: 理论证明与数值示例（未明确说明具体验证方式）。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a theoretically grounded, data-driven framework for reduced-order modeling and long-term prediction of high-dimensional nonlinear spatio-temporal systems.
summary_en.method: The framework integrates operator-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces with kernel-based Koopman operator methods for nonparametric estimation of time-evolving vector fields.
summary_en.result: Representer theorems, Sobolev-type approximation bounds, and spectral convergence guarantees are established for the proposed approach.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical proofs are provided, with numerical examples demonstrating the framework's effectiveness (though no explicit experimental validation is reported).

key_terms.zh: 算子值再生核希尔伯特空间

title: CP4SBI: Local Conformal Calibration of Credible Sets in Simulation-Based Inference
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的共形校准框架可用于提高仿真驱动推断中不确定性量化的可靠性，对生物力学代理模型中的不确定性校准具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on calibration of posterior credible sets in simulation-based inference, not on surrogate modeling for expensive FEA or implant design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: SBI后验近似常存在校准不足，导致可信区间覆盖不准确。
summary_zh.method: 提出CP4SBI框架，通过回归树和CDF两种局部校准方法实现有限样本局部覆盖保证。
summary_zh.result: 在多个SBI基准上，该方法改善了神经后验估计器的不确定性量化质量。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准SBI数值基准上验证校准性能。

summary_en.motivation: Posterior approximations in simulation-based inference are often miscalibrated, leading to undercoverage of true parameters.
summary_en.method: We propose CP4SBI, a model-agnostic conformal calibration framework that constructs credible sets with local Bayesian coverage via regression trees and CDF-based calibration.
summary_en.result: The proposed method improves uncertainty quantification quality for neural posterior estimators on widely used SBI benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard SBI numerical benchmarks using normalizing flows and score-diffusion models.

title: Uncertainty Propagation Networks for Neural Ordinary Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的不确定性传播网络（UPN）为神经ODE引入了不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性传播。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics, and no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经ODE缺乏不确定性量化，无法评估预测置信度。
summary_zh.method: 提出不确定性传播网络，通过耦合均值与协方差ODE同时建模状态演化与不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 在连续归一化流、时间序列预测和混沌系统轨迹预测中验证了有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准（如混沌系统）上测试，并与基线方法对比。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural ODEs lack uncertainty quantification, limiting their reliability in safety-critical applications.
summary_en.method: This paper proposes Uncertainty Propagation Networks (UPN) that parameterize coupled ODEs for mean and covariance dynamics to propagate uncertainty through nonlinear dynamics.
summary_en.result: UPN achieves well-calibrated uncertainty estimates in continuous normalizing flows, time-series forecasting, and chaotic trajectory prediction.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks including stable and chaotic dynamical systems, comparing against standard neural ODE baselines.

title: NOSTRA: A noise-resilient and sparse data framework for trust region based multi objective Bayesian optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多目标贝叶斯优化框架可处理噪声和稀疏数据，适用于生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化。
why_not_core: The paper does not validate on any FEA or biomechanics design problem, nor does it address constraints or uncertainty quantification beyond experimental noise.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有MOBO方法难以处理噪声和稀疏数据，导致资源浪费和次优设计。
summary_zh.method: 提出NOSTRA框架，集成先验不确定性知识并利用信任区域聚焦采样。
summary_zh.result: 在测试函数上优于现有方法，加速收敛并提高数据效率。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个含不同噪声水平的测试函数进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing multi-objective Bayesian optimization methods struggle with noisy, sparse, and scarce data, leading to inefficient resource allocation and suboptimal designs.
summary_en.method: NOSTRA integrates prior knowledge of experimental uncertainty and employs trust regions to focus sampling on promising areas of the design space.
summary_en.result: The framework outperforms existing methods on test functions, accelerating convergence to the Pareto frontier and improving data efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on two test functions with varying levels of experimental uncertainty.

title: Deformation mechanisms of L-PBF-processed Ti-6Al-4V investigated using a combined experimental and simulation approach
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V的变形机制，与AM生物医学方向相关，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not cover porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration, which are core to the AM biomedical direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V的变形机制，为工艺优化提供基础。
summary_zh.method: 结合原位高能X射线衍射与晶体塑性建模，分析α'和α相的变形行为。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了不同相在弹性各向异性和滑移激活顺序上的差异，并确定了临界剪切应力。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验衍射数据与模拟对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To understand the deformation mechanisms of L-PBF-processed Ti-6Al-4V, which is crucial for optimizing the mechanical performance of additively manufactured biomedical implants.
summary_en.method: In-situ high-energy X-ray diffraction (HEXRD) combined with crystal plasticity modeling was used to investigate the deformation behavior of the α' and α phases in as-built and heat-treated specimens.
summary_en.result: The α' and α phases exhibited similar elastic anisotropy but different slip activation sequences, with higher critical resolved shear stresses in the α' phase except for prismatic slip.
summary_en.validation: Experimental HEXRD data, including FWHM and peak intensity analyses, were compared with crystal plasticity simulations to validate the deformation mechanisms.

title: Data-Driven Multi-Objective Optimization of Large-Diameter Si Floating-Zone Crystal Growth
relevance_to_user: 该论文的代理模型与多目标优化框架可迁移至植入物设计中的有限元代理优化，但缺乏生物力学约束与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant biomechanics, no contact mechanics, no stress shielding or micromotion analysis, and no patient-specific geometry.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决大直径硅浮区晶体生长中多目标优化的计算效率问题
summary_zh.method: 使用深度集成神经网络作为代理模型，结合NSGA-II/III进行多目标优化
summary_zh.result: NSGA-II优于NSGA-III，优化解捕捉了晶体尺寸、拉速与热应力间的已知趋势
summary_zh.validation: 通过新有限元模拟验证部分复杂解，预测性能良好

summary_en.motivation: To address the computational burden of multi-objective optimization in large-diameter silicon floating-zone crystal growth.
summary_en.method: A surrogate-based optimization framework using a Deep Ensemble of neural networks trained on FEM data, coupled with NSGA-II and NSGA-III genetic algorithms.
summary_en.result: NSGA-II outperformed NSGA-III, and the optimal solutions correctly captured known trade-offs among crystal size, pulling rate, and thermal stress.
summary_en.validation: A subset of complex solutions was validated through new FEM simulations, demonstrating excellent prediction accuracy.

title: LFaB: Low fidelity as Bias for Active Learning in the chemical configuration space
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于低保真数据近似偏差的主动学习方法，可迁移至FEA代理模型中的高效采样，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constraint handling; it focuses on quantum chemistry and molecular simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 主动学习常因依赖方差最小化而效率低下，需改进采样策略。
summary_zh.method: 利用低保真数据近似模型偏差，替代方差最小化进行主动学习采样。
summary_zh.result: 在量子化学应用中，训练数据消耗降低一个数量级，接近最优采样误差。
summary_zh.validation: 在激发能和势能面预测任务上，与随机采样和标准主动学习对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Active learning often underperforms due to variance-based sampling; this work proposes bias minimization to improve efficiency.
summary_en.method: A bias approximation using cheap low-fidelity data (multi-fidelity) guides sample selection instead of variance.
summary_en.result: The method reduces training data consumption by up to an order of magnitude in quantum chemistry tasks, nearly matching the best-case greedy selection error.
summary_en.validation: Validated on predicting excitation energies and ab initio potential energy surfaces, compared against random and standard active learning.

title: Hybrid Least Squares/Gradient Descent Methods for DeepONets
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种加速DeepONet训练的混合最小二乘/梯度下降方法，可提高算子学习效率，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计应用。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on training acceleration of DeepONets without any application to FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速DeepONet训练，解决大规模最小二乘系统计算瓶颈。
summary_zh.method: 将大LS系统分解为分支网络和主干网络两个子问题，分别用最小二乘和梯度下降优化。
summary_zh.result: 所提混合方法在多个基准问题上显著提升训练效率。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准上测试，与纯梯度下降方法对比。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate DeepONet training by overcoming the computational bottleneck of solving a large least squares system for the last-layer parameters.
summary_en.method: Decomposes the large least squares system into two smaller subproblems for the branch and trunk networks, solved separately via least squares and gradient descent.
summary_en.result: The hybrid method achieves significantly faster training on several benchmark problems compared to pure gradient descent.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical benchmarks (e.g., ODEs, PDEs) with comparisons to baseline gradient descent training.

title: Beyond Imaging: Vision Transformer Digital Twin Surrogates for 3D+T Biological Tissue Dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该论文将视觉Transformer数字孪生代理用于生物组织3D+T动态建模，其方法可迁移至生物打印中的实时过程监控与预测。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve any bioprinting workflow stage (pre/in/post-printing), lacks experimental validation on bioprinted constructs, and does not address autonomous decision-making for bioprinting.

summary_zh.motivation: 为生物组织动态提供高保真预测代理，替代耗时成像。
summary_zh.method: 利用DINO预训练的视觉Transformer和多视图融合策略构建数字孪生代理网络。
summary_zh.result: 在果蝇中肠3D+T数据上实现低误差、高结构相似度的跨时间点重建。
summary_zh.validation: 通过不同层和生物重复验证模型鲁棒性与一致性。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a high-fidelity surrogate model for predicting 3D+T biological tissue dynamics, reducing reliance on time-resolved imaging.
summary_en.method: A Vision Transformer Digital Twin Surrogate Network (VT-DTSN) is proposed, leveraging DINO-pretrained Vision Transformers and multi-view fusion to reconstruct tissue dynamics.
summary_en.result: VT-DTSN achieves low error rates and high structural similarity in cross-timepoint reconstruction of Drosophila midgut imaging data.
summary_en.validation: Validation across imaging layers and biological replicates demonstrates robustness and consistency of the model.

title: Case Study in Biomechanical Engineering: Finite Element Stress Analysis of a Femur with a Surface Hip Spherical-Joint Implant
first_author_affiliation: Professional School of Mechatronics Engineering, Ricardo Palma University,Lima,Perú

corresponding_authors.name: Diego A. Rozas Llontop
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Professional School of Mechatronics Engineering, Ricardo Palma University,Lima,Perú

relevance_to_user: 该论文对股骨近端进行有限元应力分析，但未涉及应力遮挡或微动，且使用表面髋关节假体而非股骨柄假体。
why_not_core: Does not quantify stress shielding in Gruen zones, does not report micromotion with contact/friction modeling, and uses a surface hip implant rather than a femoral stem.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估表面髋关节假体在静态和动态条件下的生物力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 使用SolidWorks对股骨和假体建模，进行有限元应力分析。
summary_zh.result: 最大应力位于生物力学合理区域，且低于皮质骨和钛合金的弹性极限。
summary_zh.validation: 与文献结果定性比较，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the biomechanical performance of a surface hip implant under static and dynamic loading conditions using finite element analysis.
summary_en.method: A femur model with a surface hip prosthesis was created in SolidWorks and analyzed under four loading scenarios: standing and single-leg landing from a vertical jump.
summary_en.result: Maximum stresses occurred in biomechanically coherent regions and remained below the elastic limits of cortical bone and Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.validation: Qualitative comparison with literature results; no experimental validation.

title: OpenLB-UQ: An Uncertainty Quantification Framework for Incompressible Fluid Flow Simulations
relevance_to_user: 该论文将不确定性量化框架集成到格子玻尔兹曼方法中，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型中的UQ需求。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on incompressible fluid flow simulations using LBM, not on solid mechanics FEA, implant design, or biomechanics applications.

title: DyMixOp: A Neural Operator Designed from a Complex Dynamics Perspective with Local-Global Mixing for Solving PDEs

summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on six out of seven benchmark PDE systems, reducing prediction errors by up to 94.3% in chaotic regimes.

summary_en.motivation: To compare random field discretization strategies for efficient Bayesian identification of spatially varying material parameters in high-resolution finite element models.
summary_en.method: Three discretizations (Karhunen-Loève, wavelet, local average subdivision) are assessed within multilevel Markov chain Monte Carlo for plane stress elasticity with high-resolution displacement observations.
summary_en.result: Local average subdivision yields improved mixing and lower cost-to-error ratios at fine resolutions despite higher nominal parameter dimension.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on plane stress elasticity problems with synthetic displacement observations.

summary_en.motivation: Existing conformal prediction methods are computationally expensive and represent prediction sets as intervals, limiting their ability to capture dependencies in multi-dimensional outputs.
summary_en.method: We propose zono-conformal prediction, which embeds zonotopic uncertainty sets directly into the base predictor model and identifies them via a single data-efficient linear program.
summary_en.result: Zono-conformal predictors are less conservative than interval predictor models and standard conformal prediction methods while achieving similar coverage on test data.

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs suffer from poor H1 norm convergence due to boundary approximation errors, motivating a principled boundary enforcement method.
summary_en.method: The Sobolev-Stable Boundary Enforcement (SSBE) redefines the boundary loss using Sobolev norms to incorporate boundary regularity, with theoretical stability and generalization guarantees.
summary_en.result: SSBE consistently outperforms standard PINNs in relative L2 and H1 errors on linear and nonlinear elliptic/parabolic PDEs, including high-dimensional cases.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical experiments on Poisson, heat, and elliptic problems serve as validation benchmarks.

relevance_to_user: 该论文将物理信息神经网络与策略迭代结合求解随机最优控制问题，其方法可迁移至生物力学设计中的约束优化与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on stochastic optimal control and HJB equations, not on surrogate modeling for expensive finite element simulations or implant design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决随机最优控制中高维HJB方程求解困难的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出物理信息神经网络策略迭代框架，交替逼近值函数并更新策略
summary_zh.result: 在随机倒立摆、LQR等基准问题上验证了全局指数收敛性
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证方法有效性

summary_en.motivation: To address the computational challenge of solving high-dimensional Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equations in stochastic optimal control.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network policy iteration framework is proposed, alternating between value function approximation via linear PDE residual minimization and policy improvement.
summary_en.result: Global exponential convergence is demonstrated on benchmark problems including stochastic cartpole, pendulum, and up to 10D LQR.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks validate the method's effectiveness and convergence properties.

title: Fast Gaussian process inference by exact Matérn kernel decomposition
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了加速高斯过程推断的精确算法，可用于替代模型中昂贵的仿真采样，但未在生物力学或植入物设计场景中验证。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on algorithmic acceleration of Gaussian process inference for Matérn kernels, but does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification beyond conventional GP, or application to biomechanics/implant surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速大规模高斯过程推断中的核矩阵乘法
summary_zh.method: 基于加权经验累积分布函数的精确核分解快速算法
summary_zh.result: 在低维数百千数据点上显著加速推断
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验对比标准方法

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of Gaussian process inference for large datasets by accelerating kernel matrix-vector multiplication.
summary_en.method: An exact fast kernel matrix-vector multiplication algorithm is developed by decomposing the Matérn kernel into weighted empirical cumulative distribution functions using a divide-and-conquer strategy.
summary_en.result: The algorithm achieves substantial speedups for low-dimensional GP problems with hundreds of thousands of data points.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic data demonstrate effectiveness compared to standard GP implementations.

title: Efficient optimization of expensive black-box simulators via marginal means, with application to neutrino detector design
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的边际均值优化方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or stress shielding; it focuses on nuclear physics detector optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 昂贵黑箱仿真优化中现有方法在高维空间表现差
summary_zh.method: 提出基于边际均值的黑箱优化方法，利用加性高斯过程代理模型
summary_zh.result: 新方法在高维下优化性能优于传统选最优策略
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验和中微子探测器设计案例验证

summary_en.motivation: Existing black-box optimization methods suffer from poor performance in high-dimensional spaces due to reliance on pick-the-winner solutions.
summary_en.method: A novel Black-box Optimization via Marginal Means (BOMM) approach is proposed, leveraging marginal mean functions inferred via a transformed additive Gaussian process surrogate.
summary_en.result: The BOMM estimator achieves consistency and a favorable optimization rate that mitigates the curse of dimensionality, outperforming standard methods.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through numerical benchmarks and a real-world application to neutrino detector optimization.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Network Approaches for Sparse Data Flow Reconstruction of Unsteady Flow Around Complex Geometries
relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN应用于稀疏数据流场重建，方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: No implant mechanics, no structural FEA, no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决工程中稀疏数据流场重建的高计算成本问题
summary_zh.method: 采用PINN及BC-PINN，结合物理约束松弛与损失动态加权
summary_zh.result: 成功从稀疏数据重建二维圆柱绕流和三维集装箱船湍流场
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准数值模拟案例验证重建精度

summary_en.motivation: To reconstruct unsteady flow fields from sparse data with limited computational resources using physics-informed neural networks.
summary_en.method: Standard PINN and Backward Compatible PINN (BC-PINN) are applied with systematic relaxation of physics constraints and dynamic weighting of loss components.
summary_en.result: The models accurately reconstruct flow fields for 2D laminar cylinder wake and 3D turbulent flow around a large container ship from sparse data.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed against numerical simulation data for both 2D and 3D cases.

title: PGD-based local surrogate models via overlapping domain decomposition: a computational comparison
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于PGD和重叠域分解的局部代理模型方法，可显著加速参数化线性椭圆问题的求解，其思路有望迁移至生物力学植入物设计的有限元代理建模中。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on linear elliptic problems and does not address nonlinear mechanics, contact mechanics, or implant-specific constraints such as stress shielding or micromotion.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速参数化线性椭圆问题的求解，降低离线计算复杂度。
summary_zh.method: 结合PGD降维与重叠域分解，在界面节点独立施加Dirichlet条件构建局部代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 相比已有DD-PGD算法，离线阶段加速高达100倍，在线评估时间小于0.5秒。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值基准测试比较不同PGD局部代理模型的性能。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the solution of parametric linear elliptic problems by reducing offline computational complexity through local surrogate modeling.
summary_en.method: A non-intrusive strategy combining proper generalized decomposition (PGD) with overlapping domain decomposition, imposing arbitrary Dirichlet conditions independently at each interface node to construct local surrogate models.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves speed-ups up to 100 times in the offline phase compared to a previous DD-PGD algorithm, with online evaluation under half a second.
summary_en.validation: A computational comparison of different PGD-based local surrogate models is performed using a set of numerical benchmarks.

title: Multi-Operator Few-Shot Learning for Generalization Across PDE Families
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种多算子少样本学习方法，可泛化到不同PDE族，对生物力学代理模型构建具有潜在迁移价值。

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子方法难以跨PDE族泛化，需要大量训练数据。
summary_zh.method: 提出MOFS框架，结合多任务自监督预训练、文本条件算子嵌入和记忆增强多模态提示。
summary_zh.result: 在Darcy流和Navier-Stokes基准上，少样本泛化性能优于现有基线。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE数值基准上验证，包括消融实验。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators require abundant data per PDE and lack generalization across PDE families.
summary_en.method: MOFS integrates multi-task self-supervised pretraining, text-conditioned operator embeddings, and memory-augmented multimodal prompting for few-shot operator learning.
summary_en.result: The model outperforms baselines in few-shot generalization on Darcy Flow and Navier-Stokes benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard PDE numerical benchmarks with extensive ablation studies.

title: Fine-tuning physics-informed neural networks for cavity flows using coordinate transformation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的坐标变换微调方法可迁移至生物力学FEA代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。

summary_zh.result: 微调方法比随机初始化收敛更快，相似几何预训练效果更佳
summary_zh.validation: 方形、矩形、剪切变形和膨胀空腔流数值算例

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the training cost of PINNs by leveraging transfer learning across different geometries and flow conditions.
summary_en.method: A fine-tuning approach with coordinate transformation using deformation gradient tensor to reconcile reference and target geometries.
summary_en.result: The proposed fine-tuning improves training convergence over random initialization, with further gains when pre-trained on similar geometries.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on lid-driven cavity flows with square, rectangular, shear-deformed, and inflated geometries.

title: Extended Interface Physics-Informed Neural Networks Method for Moving Interface Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的扩展界面物理信息神经网络方法可迁移至生物力学中的移动界面问题，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。

summary_zh.method: 提出扩展界面PINN框架，结合水平集函数和NTK理论加速收敛
summary_zh.result: 数值实验验证了方法的精度和鲁棒性，收敛速度优于传统PINN
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值算例验证，包括Oseen方程

summary_en.motivation: To address the slow training convergence of conventional PINNs for moving interface problems.

summary_en.result: Numerical experiments demonstrate superior accuracy and robustness, with faster convergence than standard PINNs.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through comprehensive numerical benchmarks, including the Oseen equations.

title: On Some Tunable Multi-fidelity Bayesian Optimization Frameworks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种可调的多保真贝叶斯优化框架，其方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。

title: Light-Weight Diffusion Multiplier and Uncertainty Quantification for Fourier Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种轻量化的扩散乘子与不确定性量化方法，可应用于FNO，对提高代理模型的采样效率和UQ有参考价值。

summary_en.motivation: Fourier Neural Operators suffer from overparameterization and lack native uncertainty quantification, hindering their reliability in scientific applications.
summary_en.method: DINOZAUR replaces the dense tensor multiplier in FNOs with a diffusion multiplier having a single learnable time parameter per channel, and casts it as a Bayesian neural operator via priors on time parameters.
summary_en.result: The method achieves competitive or superior performance on multiple PDE benchmarks while drastically reducing parameters and providing calibrated uncertainty estimates.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical PDE benchmarks, assessing predictive accuracy and uncertainty calibration.

title: DD-DeepONet: Domain decomposition and DeepONet for solving partial differential equations in three application scenarios

summary_en.result: The framework reduces training difficulty, requires smaller datasets and VRAM per network, and accelerates solution acquisition for Laplace, Poisson, N-S, and drift-diffusion equations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on prototypical PDEs with varying geometry, BCs, and parameters demonstrate computational gains over standard DeepONet.

summary_en.result: MFNO demonstrates strong resolution generalization and comparable or superior performance to LSTM, TCN, and DeepONet, with faster sample path generation.

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational challenges of PDE-constrained gradient computation, discretization errors, and computational imbalance in ultrasound computed tomography.

summary_en.result: Achieves significant improvements in computational efficiency and reconstruction quality, especially under sparse-view and partial-view measurement scenarios.

title: MENO: Hybrid Matrix Exponential-based Neural Operator for Stiff ODEs. Application to Thermochemical Kinetics

why_not_core: This paper does not include finite element analysis, contact mechanics, or quantitative stress/strain data; it is purely a clinical radiographic study.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估短弯Fitmore股骨柄10年后的皮质肥大、下沉和股痛进展。
summary_zh.method: 前瞻性随访80例Fitmore柄，分析X线参数（皮质肥大、变薄、透亮线、下沉）和临床评分。
summary_zh.result: 皮质肥大率74%，下沉5.0 mm，但放射学参数与临床结果无相关性。
summary_zh.validation: 10年临床随访，放射学与患者报告结局。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the long-term progression of cortical hypertrophy, subsidence, and thigh pain after short curved Fitmore femoral stem implantation.
summary_en.method: A prospective 10-year follow-up of 80 Fitmore stems assessed radiographic parameters (cortical hypertrophy, thinning, radiolucency, subsidence) and clinical scores (Oxford Hip Score, Harris Hip Score, thigh pain).
summary_en.result: Cortical hypertrophy occurred in 74% of cases, subsidence averaged 5.0 mm, but radiographic findings did not correlate with clinical outcomes.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation through 10-year prospective radiographic and patient-reported outcome measures.

title: Multiobjective Aerodynamic Design Optimization of the NASA Common Research Model
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多目标贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的多目标优化问题，但缺乏生物力学约束和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, does not handle constraints, and lacks uncertainty quantification beyond Gaussian process surrogates.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多目标气动优化中样本效率低和无法并行评估的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出基于Thompson采样的批量Pareto最优贝叶斯优化方法
summary_zh.result: 在24维双目标气动优化中优于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成实验和NASA CRM气动设计案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome sample inefficiency and lack of parallelization in multiobjective aerodynamic design optimization.
summary_en.method: Proposes batch Pareto optimal Thompson sampling (qPOTS) using Gaussian process surrogates and Bayesian decision theory.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates superior sample efficiency and accuracy on synthetic benchmarks and a 24-dimensional two-objective aerodynamic design problem.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic experiments and the NASA Common Research Model aerodynamic design optimization.

title: Kernel-Adaptive PI-ELMs for Forward and Inverse Problems in PDEs with Sharp Gradients
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的KAPI-ELM方法通过贝叶斯优化自适应调整核参数，可高效求解具有尖锐梯度的PDE，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not validate on biomedical or implant-related FEA problems, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not address multi-objective optimization or constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决物理信息机器学习在尖锐梯度PDE中的求解困难
summary_zh.method: 提出核自适应物理信息极限学习机，贝叶斯优化径向基函数中心和宽度分布
summary_zh.result: 在1D对流扩散和2D泊松问题中准确捕捉陡峭层，参数效率高
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试（1D/2D PDE）及稳态Navier-Stokes方程验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the difficulty of physics-informed machine learning in solving PDEs with localized sharp gradients and singularly perturbed regimes.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Kernel-Adaptive Physics-Informed Extreme Learning Machine (KAPI-ELM) that uses Bayesian optimization to tune the distribution of RBF centers and widths in a low-dimensional interpretable space.
summary_en.result: KAPI-ELM accurately resolves steep layers in 1D convection-diffusion and 2D Poisson problems, matches or surpasses advanced methods with fewer tunable parameters, and extends to nonlinear Navier-Stokes equations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmark forward and inverse PDE problems with sharp gradients and on lid-driven cavity flow up to Re=100.

title: Facile Single‐Nanocomposite 4D Bioprinting of Dynamic Hydrogel Constructs with Thickness‐Controlled Gradient

relevance_to_user: 该论文将有限元分析与4D生物打印结合，但未使用AI/ML方法，对AI生物打印方向仅有间接参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it uses finite element analysis for shape prediction, not machine learning.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服4D生物打印中智能生物墨水有限和打印路径设计复杂的问题。
summary_zh.method: 开发MX/GG复合水凝胶，通过调节图案厚度实现空间交联梯度，结合有限元分析指导形状变形。
summary_zh.result: 成功打印多种仿生结构，细胞负载构建体在弯曲应变下保持增殖和功能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过有限元预测与实验弯曲构型对比验证，以及细胞活性实验。

summary_en.motivation: To address the limited availability of smart bioinks and the complexity of printing path design in 4D bioprinting.
summary_en.method: A smart composite hydrogel (MX/GG) was developed, and a facile 4D printing strategy using thickness-controlled crosslinking gradients with single UV exposure was proposed, guided by finite element analysis.
summary_en.result: Biomimetic constructs with unidirectional and bidirectional curvature were fabricated, and cell-laden constructs showed effective proliferation and function under bending strain.
summary_en.validation: Finite element predictions were validated against experimental shape transformations, and in vitro cell assays confirmed biocompatibility.

title: Physics-guided impact localisation and force estimation in composite plates with uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文的物理引导框架和不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物力学中的代理模型构建，但未涉及植入物设计或有限元分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or finite element surrogate modeling for biomedical design; it focuses on impact localization in composite plates.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决复合材料冲击识别中实验数据稀疏的问题
summary_zh.method: 结合一阶剪切变形理论与机器学习及不确定性量化的混合框架
summary_zh.result: 实现了高精度冲击定位和力重建，减少了对大量训练数据的依赖
summary_zh.validation: 通过复合材料板实验验证了框架的准确性和鲁棒性

summary_en.motivation: To achieve accurate and generalizable impact identification in composite structures under sparse experimental data.
summary_en.method: A hybrid framework integrating a data-driven First-Order Shear Deformation Theory model with machine learning and uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: The framework enables accurate impact localization and force reconstruction while reducing dependence on large training datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validated through composite plate experiments demonstrating accuracy, robustness, and efficiency.

title: Energy Dissipation Rate Guided Adaptive Sampling for Physics-Informed Neural Networks: Resolving Surface-Bulk Dynamics in Allen-Cahn Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的能量耗散率引导自适应采样方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的训练，提高PINN求解效率。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical FEA application; it focuses on phase-field PDEs (Allen-Cahn) with no structural mechanics or design optimization context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN求解热力学一致PDE的精度和效率
summary_zh.method: 利用局部能量耗散率密度引导自适应重采样关键配点
summary_zh.result: 相比传统RAR方法，均方误差降低六倍
summary_zh.validation: 在二维不规则域Allen-Cahn方程上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and efficiency of PINNs for thermodynamically consistent PDEs by leveraging physical structure.
summary_en.method: EDRAS uses local energy dissipation rate density as a metric to adaptively resample collocation points from interior and boundary.
summary_en.result: Achieves up to sixfold reduction in relative mean square error compared to residual-based adaptive refinement (RAR).
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on Allen-Cahn equation in 2D disk and ellipse domains with static and dynamic boundary conditions.

title: The BdryMatérn GP: Reliable incorporation of boundary information on irregular domains for Gaussian process modeling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的边界信息融合方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics application, no uncertainty quantification, no multi-objective or constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决不规则域上高斯过程难以融入边界信息的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出BdryMatérn协方差核，基于SPDE和有限元近似
summary_zh.result: 新模型能可靠融入Dirichlet/Neumann/Robin边界，样本路径光滑可控
summary_zh.validation: 在多个不规则域数值算例上验证边界融合效果

summary_en.motivation: To enable Gaussian process surrogates to reliably incorporate boundary information on irregular domains for expensive simulators.
summary_en.method: Proposes the BdryMatérn GP with a novel covariance kernel derived via SPDE and approximated by finite elements.
summary_en.result: The model guarantees sample paths satisfying prescribed boundaries with smoothness control and provides rigorous error bounds.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical experiments with Dirichlet, Neumann, and Robin boundaries on irregular domains.

title: From images to properties: a NeRF-driven framework for granular material parameter inversion
relevance_to_user: 该论文将NeRF与MPM结合，通过视觉观测反演材料参数，其贝叶斯优化框架可迁移至生物力学中的代理模型与参数标定。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate model, no implant or biomechanics context, no uncertainty quantification beyond Bayesian optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 从视觉观测中推断颗粒材料属性，避免直接测量困难。
summary_zh.method: 结合NeRF重建3D几何与MPM模拟，通过贝叶斯优化最小化图像损失。
summary_zh.result: 摩擦角估计误差在2度以内。
summary_zh.validation: 合成数据验证，模拟与渲染图像对比。

summary_en.motivation: To infer granular material properties from visual observations where direct measurement is impractical.
summary_en.method: Integrates NeRF for 3D geometry reconstruction from multi-view images with MPM simulation, using Bayesian optimization to minimize image loss between simulated and observed images.
summary_en.result: Friction angle is estimated with an error within 2 degrees.
summary_en.validation: Validation on synthetic experimental data by comparing rendered images of simulation with ground truth observations.

title: 3D-Printed PerfusableLab-on-a-Chip-Based Engineeringof MSC-Derived Exosome-Enriched Vascularized Grafts for Skin Regeneration
relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及生物打印和微血管构建，但未使用AI技术，与AI生物打印方向相关性较低。
why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on bioink formulation and biological validation without computational modeling or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决大组织构建中血管化不足导致细胞存活率低的问题。
summary_zh.method: 开发含外泌体的生物墨水，通过挤出式生物打印制造可灌注血管通道，并在芯片上共培养细胞。
summary_zh.result: 外泌体组显著增强内皮转分化和血管生成活性，形成早期血管形态和管腔。
summary_zh.validation: 通过转录组学、免疫荧光和蛋白组学验证血管生成标志物表达。

summary_en.motivation: To address the critical challenge of insufficient vascularization in large engineered tissue constructs, which limits cell survival and clinical translation.
summary_en.method: An exosome-enriched biocomposite bioink (chitosan, collagen, fibrinogen with vitamin D3 and stem cell-derived exosomes) was used to 3D-print perfusable vascular channels via extrusion bioprinting, followed by dynamic coculture in a lab-on-a-chip system.
summary_en.result: Exosome-loaded scaffolds significantly enhanced endothelial transdifferentiation and vasculogenic activity, with upregulated angiogenic markers and organized lumen formation.
summary_en.validation: Validation included transcriptomic analysis, proteomic immunofluorescence, and time-course imaging of vascular markers (α-SMA, vimentin, VEGF-A, etc.).

title: Data-driven Kinematic Modeling in Soft Robots: System Identification and Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文将不确定性量化方法应用于软体机器人运动学建模，其方法可迁移至FEA代理模型中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or structural optimization; it focuses on soft robot kinematics.

summary_zh.motivation: 软体机器人运动学建模中预测不确定性影响精度，现有研究缺乏量化。
summary_zh.method: 采用分裂共形预测框架，对多种机器学习模型进行不确定性量化。
summary_zh.result: 非线性集成方法泛化性能最优，共形预测提供有理论保证的预测区间。
summary_zh.validation: 利用有限仿真和真实数据验证模型性能。

summary_en.motivation: Precise kinematic modeling in soft robots is hindered by prediction uncertainty, which is underexplored in existing approaches.
summary_en.method: A conformal kinematic modeling framework using split conformal prediction is developed to quantify predictive position uncertainty across multiple machine learning models.
summary_en.result: Nonlinear ensemble methods show the most robust generalization, and conformal prediction provides distribution-free prediction intervals with theoretical guarantees.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using both limited simulation and real-world experimental data.

title: Towards Robust Surrogate Models: Benchmarking Machine Learning Approaches to Expediting Phase Field Simulations of Brittle Fracture
relevance_to_user: 该论文针对脆性断裂相场模拟的代理模型，其方法（PINN、FNO、UNet）和基准数据集可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fracture mechanics, not implant biomechanics or stress shielding; it lacks biomedical context and implant-specific constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有机器学习代理模型在断裂模拟中缺乏复杂基准，需建立标准化测试集。
summary_zh.method: 构建包含6000个相场断裂模拟的数据集，并评估PINN、FNO和UNet等模型。
summary_zh.result: 集成策略提升预测精度，但现有模型在复杂断裂场景下仍有局限。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试对比不同模型和集成策略的性能。

summary_en.motivation: Current ML surrogate models for fracture simulation lack challenging benchmarks that reflect real complexity, necessitating a standardized dataset.
summary_en.method: A dataset of 6,000 phase field fracture simulations with varying energy decompositions, boundary conditions, and crack configurations is introduced, and PINN, FNO, and UNet baselines are evaluated.
summary_en.result: Ensembling strategies improve prediction accuracy, but popular models still show limitations on complex fracture scenarios.
summary_en.validation: The models are validated on the proposed numerical benchmark dataset, comparing prediction accuracy across different configurations.

title: Noisy PDE Training Requires Bigger PINNs
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了噪声数据下PINN的网络规模需求，对FEA替代模型的不确定性量化有参考价值，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, multi-objective optimization, or transferability to implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on theoretical scaling laws for noisy PDE training.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究噪声数据下PINN达到低经验风险所需的网络规模下限。
summary_zh.method: 理论推导HJB方程的监督和无监督PINN下界，并在多个PDE上实验验证。
summary_zh.result: 发现网络参数必须超过阈值才能将经验风险降至噪声方差以下。
summary_zh.validation: 在HJB、Poisson和Navier-Stokes PDE上进行数值实验。

summary_en.motivation: To establish theoretical lower bounds on PINN size required to achieve empirical risk below noise variance in noisy PDE training.
summary_en.method: Derives lower bounds for supervised and unsupervised PINNs on the HJB equation, and validates with experiments on HJB, Poisson, and Navier-Stokes PDEs.
summary_en.result: Shows that a threshold model size is necessary for the empirical risk to fall below the variance of noisy labels.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on HJB, Poisson, and Navier-Stokes PDEs with Taylor-Green solutions.

title: Direct Regret Optimization in Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种直接优化遗憾值的贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统贝叶斯优化依赖手工采集函数和短视策略，难以最小化多步遗憾。
summary_zh.method: 提出直接遗憾优化框架，用集成高斯过程生成模拟轨迹训练决策变压器，联合学习模型与采集函数。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实基准上持续优于基线，在高维和噪声场景下更鲁棒。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional Bayesian optimization relies on hand-crafted acquisition functions and myopic strategies, failing to directly minimize multi-step regret.
summary_en.method: A direct regret optimization framework is proposed, using an ensemble of Gaussian processes to generate simulated BO trajectories for training a decision transformer that jointly learns the surrogate model and acquisition policy.
summary_en.result: The method consistently outperforms BO baselines on synthetic and real-world benchmarks, achieving lower simple regret and more robust exploration in high-dimensional or noisy settings.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic functions and standard machine learning benchmarks, comparing against multiple BO baselines.

title: An overlapping domain decomposition method for parametric Stokes and Stokes-Darcy problems via proper generalized decomposition
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的域分解PGD方法可加速参数化流动问题的求解，其非侵入式框架和计算效率提升对生物力学FEA代理建模具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on Stokes and Stokes-Darcy flows, not on solid mechanics or implant-related FEA, and lacks uncertainty quantification and constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速参数化Stokes及Stokes-Darcy问题的求解
summary_zh.method: 结合重叠域分解与PGD构建局部代理模型，在线阶段求解参数化界面系统
summary_zh.result: 数值算例展示了精度、鲁棒性和计算效率，优于基于高保真有限元的DD方法
summary_zh.validation: 通过Stokes-Stokes和Stokes-Darcy数值算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the solution of parametric Stokes and coupled Stokes-Darcy problems by constructing physics-based local surrogate models.
summary_en.method: An overlapping domain decomposition (DD) paradigm combined with proper generalized decomposition (PGD) is used to build local surrogates, which are assembled online by solving a parametric interface system without Lagrange multipliers.
summary_en.result: Numerical results demonstrate accuracy, robustness, and computational efficiency, outperforming high-fidelity finite element DD methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on parametric single-physics (Stokes-Stokes) and multi-physics (Stokes-Darcy) numerical benchmarks.

title: A generalized Wasserstein-2 distance approach for efficient reconstruction of random field models using stochastic neural networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的广义Wasserstein-2距离方法可用于高效训练随机神经网络重建随机场模型，其不确定性量化能力可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的随机场建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or implant/biomechanics design, and lacks validation on mechanical or biomedical problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效重建包含连续和分类分量的随机场模型
summary_zh.method: 提出广义局部平方Wasserstein-2损失函数训练随机神经网络
summary_zh.result: 在分类、混合变量分布重建和复杂动力系统学习任务中验证有效性
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试和不确定性量化任务验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently reconstruct random field models with both continuous and categorical components using stochastic neural networks.
summary_en.method: A generalized local squared Wasserstein-2 loss function is proposed to train stochastic neural networks under nonrestrictive conditions.
summary_en.result: The approach demonstrates effectiveness in classification, mixed random variable distribution reconstruction, and learning noisy dynamical systems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks and uncertainty quantification tasks including classification and spatiotemporal data.

title: AL-SPCE -- Reliability analysis for nondeterministic models using stochastic polynomial chaos expansions and active learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的主动学习框架用于随机仿真器的可靠性分析，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样效率问题。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high computational cost of reliability analysis for stochastic simulators with intrinsic randomness.
summary_en.method: An active learning framework for stochastic polynomial chaos expansions (SPCE) is introduced, leveraging the asymptotic normality of maximum likelihood estimators to quantify predictive uncertainty.
summary_en.result: AL-SPCE achieves high accuracy in failure probability estimates while substantially improving efficiency over conventional surrogate-based methods and Monte Carlo simulation.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on three numerical test cases, demonstrating accuracy and efficiency gains.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化牙种植体螺纹设计以改善骨内应力分布。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize the thread design of a dental implant for improved stress distribution in peri-implant bone.

summary_en.validation: In vivo rabbit tibia implantation experiments validated the osseointegration performance of the optimized implants.

title: PINN-DG: Residual neural network methods trained with Finite Elements
relevance_to_user: 该方法将神经网络与有限元结合，提高了求解PDE的效率，可迁移至生物力学中的代理模型构建。
why_not_core: No application to implant mechanics or biomechanics; no uncertainty quantification; only tested on elliptic PDEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN依赖点梯度计算，效率低且不稳定。
summary_zh.method: 提出PINN-DG，利用间断伽辽金有限元计算损失函数。
summary_zh.result: 数值实验表明该方法比传统PINN更高效、更鲁棒。
summary_zh.validation: 通过椭圆型PDE数值基准验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard collocation-based PINNs suffer from costly pointwise derivative evaluations and instability.
summary_en.method: A new PINN variant is proposed that computes the loss functional using discontinuous Galerkin finite element interpolation and integration.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments demonstrate improved efficiency and robustness over standard PINNs for elliptic PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks for elliptic PDEs.

title: Noise-robust multi-fidelity surrogate modelling for parametric partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种噪声鲁棒的多保真代理模型方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或生物医学应用。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling, no patient-specific or experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多保真代理模型中数值噪声导致过拟合和收敛损失的问题
summary_zh.method: 改进多指标随机配置法，通过监测谱衰减自动检测噪声并停止使用噪声保真度
summary_zh.result: 在平流扩散和湍流Navier-Stokes问题上验证了准确性和鲁棒性
summary_zh.validation: 两个数值基准案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome overfitting and convergence degradation in multi-fidelity surrogate models caused by numerical noise from low-fidelity PDE solvers.
summary_en.method: An enhanced Multi-Index Stochastic Collocation method that monitors spectral decay to automatically detect solver noise and halt the use of corrupted fidelities.
summary_en.result: The proposed method demonstrates accuracy and robustness on a parabolic advection-diffusion PDE and a turbulent Navier-Stokes problem.
summary_en.validation: Numerical validation on two challenging parametric PDE benchmarks.

summary_en.validation: This is a review paper with no original experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低生物打印设备成本，实现复杂组织制造

summary_en.motivation: To democratize advanced biofabrication by developing a low-cost, open-source bioprinter with commercial-grade performance.
summary_en.method: The LusoBioMaker is built on a modified Ender 3-V2 platform, integrating dual screw-driven extrusion, independent active temperature control, and in-situ 365 nm photocuring.
summary_en.result: The bioprinter achieves sub-50 μm positional error, 97% L929 cell viability after 14 days, and successfully prints a hollow nipple-areola complex.
summary_en.validation: Calibration and acceptance tests per ISO 230-1/2 standards, printability factor measurement, and cell viability assays.

title: Fast prediction of plasma instabilities with sparse-grid-accelerated optimized dynamic mode decomposition
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的稀疏网格加速动态模态分解方法可显著降低高维参数空间的数据生成成本，对生物力学代理模型中的采样效率问题具有借鉴意义。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on plasma instabilities in fusion, not on biomedical implant FEA or biomechanics, and lacks any validation on solid mechanics or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维参数空间下数据驱动降阶模型训练数据生成的计算瓶颈
summary_zh.method: 采用(L)-Leja点稀疏网格插值结合优化动态模态分解构建参数化降阶模型
summary_zh.result: 仅用28次高保真模拟即实现六参数等离子体不稳定性预测，加速三个数量级
summary_zh.validation: 在Cyclone基准案例和真实电子温度梯度驱动微不稳定性模拟中验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational burden of generating training data for parametric reduced-order models in high-dimensional parameter spaces.
summary_en.method: Sparse grid interpolation with (L)-Leja points is combined with optimized dynamic mode decomposition to construct efficient parametric ROMs.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves up to three orders of magnitude speedup using only 28 high-fidelity simulations for a six-parameter plasma instability problem.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on the Cyclone Base Case benchmark and a realistic electron-temperature-gradient-driven micro-instability simulation.
