relevance_to_user: 该综述总结了SLM制备可降解金属植入物的研究现状，但未涉及疲劳测试、表面粗糙度或应力遮挡的定量分析。
why_not_core: This is a review paper without original experimental data, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness characterization, and no direct link between porous structure and stress shielding.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述SLM制备可降解金属植入物的研究进展，避免二次手术。
summary_zh.method: 系统分析SLM工艺参数对Mg、Fe、Zn合金微观结构、力学性能和降解行为的影响。
summary_zh.result: SLM制备的Mg合金模量接近骨（40-45 GPa），Fe合金强度高但降解慢，Zn合金性能居中。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: To systematically review the current achievements and challenges in selective laser melting of biodegradable metallic implants for eliminating secondary removal surgeries.
summary_en.method: The review analyzes how SLM processing parameters influence microstructure, mechanical properties, and degradation kinetics of Mg, Fe, and Zn alloys, and discusses design strategies for porous/lattice structures.
summary_en.result: SLM-produced Mg alloys achieve bone-matching modulus (40–45 GPa) with moderate degradation, Fe-based systems provide superior strength but slower degradation, and Zn alloys offer intermediate properties.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; this is a literature review summarizing existing studies.

title: Mechanics Simulation with Implicit Neural Representations of Complex Geometries
relevance_to_user: 本文提出了结合隐式神经表示与移位边界方法进行线弹性仿真的框架，可应用于复杂几何形状，但未涉及不确定量化或多目标优化，对FEA代理建模有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulation sampling efficiency, does not include uncertainty quantification, and lacks demonstration on implant/biomechanics design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决复杂几何体有限元仿真中网格生成耗时的问题。
summary_zh.method: 将隐式神经表示与移位边界法结合，直接查询神经场实现无网格仿真。
summary_zh.result: 在复杂几何体（斯坦福兔子、埃菲尔铁塔等）上验证了精度和计算优势。
summary_zh.validation: 通过线弹性仿真案例（标准几何体）验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To eliminate the costly meshing step in finite element simulations of complex geometries by leveraging implicit neural representations.
summary_en.method: A computational framework that integrates implicit neural representations with the Shifted Boundary Method, directly using neural-encoded signed distance fields for boundary conditions.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates accurate linear elasticity simulations on complex geometries (Stanford Bunny, Eiffel Tower, gyroids) with significant computational advantages.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical simulation cases on standard complex geometries without experimental verification.

title: Linear Attention with Global Context: A Multipole Attention Mechanism for Vision and Physics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的线性复杂度注意力机制可用于构建高效的代理模型，但未涉及生物力学或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, no application to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: Transformer二次复杂度限制高分辨率输入的应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于多极展开的距离加权多尺度注意力机制。
summary_zh.result: 在图像分类和达西流模拟中实现线性复杂度且性能接近先进模型。
summary_zh.validation: 在ImageNet和达西流数值模拟上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Transformers' quadratic complexity hinders their use on high-resolution inputs, motivating a more efficient attention mechanism.
summary_en.method: The Multipole Attention Neural Operator (MANO) computes attention via distance-based multiscale interactions inspired by n-body simulation techniques.
summary_en.result: MANO achieves linear time and memory complexity while matching state-of-the-art models on image classification and Darcy flow prediction.
summary_en.validation: Validation on ImageNet classification and numerical Darcy flow benchmarks demonstrates competitive accuracy and reduced resource usage.

title: Constraint-Guided Symbolic Regression for Data-Efficient Kinetic Model Discovery
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合物理约束和不确定性量化的符号回归方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的构建，但未涉及有限元分析或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on kinetic model discovery in chemical engineering, not on FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统动力学模型依赖专家知识，数据驱动方法缺乏可解释性和物理一致性。
summary_zh.method: 提出PI-ADoK框架，将物理约束融入符号回归，并用Metropolis-Hastings进行不确定性量化。
summary_zh.result: 在多个催化案例中，该方法提高了模型保真度并降低了实验负担。
summary_zh.validation: 通过催化反应案例的数值基准测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional kinetic modeling requires extensive domain expertise, while data-driven approaches lack interpretability and physical consistency.
summary_en.method: The PI-ADoK framework integrates physical constraints into symbolic regression and employs Metropolis-Hastings for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: Benchmarking on catalytic case studies shows improved model fidelity and reduced experimental burden.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmarks on catalytic reaction case studies.

title: B-PL-PINN: Stabilizing PINN Training with Bayesian Pseudo Labeling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于贝叶斯PINN的伪标签方法，可稳定PINN训练，但未涉及FEA替代模型或生物力学设计。

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN训练中信息传播困难导致的收敛问题。
summary_zh.method: 用贝叶斯PINN替代集成，基于后验方差评估伪标签。
summary_zh.result: 在基准问题上优于集成方法，与Adam/LBFGS训练的集成PINN竞争力相当。

summary_en.motivation: To address convergence issues in PINN training by improving information propagation from initial conditions.
summary_en.method: Replaces ensemble consensus with Bayesian PINN posterior variance for pseudo-label selection.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms ensemble-based approaches on benchmark problems and matches the performance of PINN ensembles trained with Adam and LBFGS.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard PDE benchmark problems.

title: Cost-effective Reduced-Order Modeling via Bayesian Active Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯主动学习框架可降低代理模型训练成本，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计约束。
why_not_core: No biomechanics or implant design context; no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization; validation only on a 1D heat equation example.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低机器学习代理模型对大规模训练数据的依赖。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于贝叶斯POD的主动学习框架BayPOD-AL，通过不确定性指导采样。
summary_zh.result: 在杆温度演化预测中，BayPOD-AL减少了训练数据需求并保持精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准（一维热传导）上验证，并与其它主动学习策略对比。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the large training data requirement of machine learning surrogates for complex system dynamics.
summary_en.method: Proposes BayPOD-AL, an active learning framework combining Bayesian proper orthogonal decomposition with uncertainty-guided sampling.
summary_en.result: BayPOD-AL effectively selects informative data and reduces computational cost while maintaining accuracy on a rod temperature evolution problem.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a numerical benchmark (1D heat equation) and compared against other uncertainty-guided active learning strategies.

title: Surrogate normal-forms for the numerical bifurcation and stability analysis of navier-stokes flows via machine learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于机器学习的代理模型框架，用于Navier-Stokes流的分岔和稳定性分析，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics (Navier-Stokes) and does not address solid mechanics, implant design, or biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真Navier-Stokes模拟的分岔和稳定性分析计算成本高，且标准代理模型难以保持对称性。
summary_zh.method: 提出“嵌入-学习-提升”框架，结合流形学习和高斯过程回归构建最小维代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 基于扩散映射的代理模型在分岔和稳定性分析中优于POD代理模型，且能正确识别内在维度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证了代理模型在分岔图、极限环周期和稳定性计算中的准确性。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity Navier-Stokes simulations are computationally expensive for bifurcation and stability analysis, and standard machine-learning surrogates often fail to preserve symmetries.
summary_en.method: An 'embed-learn-lift' framework is proposed, combining manifold learning (POD and Diffusion Maps) with Gaussian process regression to construct minimal-dimensional surrogate ROMs.
summary_en.result: Diffusion Maps-based ROMs outperform POD-ROMs in bifurcation and stability analysis, providing geometrically consistent parametrization and correctly identifying intrinsic dimension.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated on numerical benchmarks, demonstrating accurate bifurcation diagrams, limit-cycle periods, and stability properties via Floquet multipliers.

title: Short-Term Outcomes of Cementless Total Hip Arthroplasty Using a 3D-Printed Acetabular Cup Manufactured by Directed Energy Deposition: A Prospective Observational Study.
first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Bucheon St. Mary's Hospital, College of Medicine, The Catholic University of Korea, Seoul 06591, Republic of Korea.

corresponding_authors.name: Young Wook Lim
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Seoul St. Mary's Hospital, College of Medicine, The Catholic University of Korea, Seoul 06591, Republic of Korea.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D打印髋臼杯的临床结果，但未涉及应力遮挡、疲劳测试或LPBF制造工艺。
why_not_core: This paper reports clinical outcomes of a DED-printed acetabular cup, but does not include LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), stress shielding analysis, or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估DED技术制造的3D打印髋臼杯的短期临床效果。
summary_zh.method: 前瞻性观察研究，纳入100名患者124髋，随访至少24个月。
summary_zh.result: 植入物存活率99.3%，HHS评分从56.6提升至91.4，骨整合可靠。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随访结合CT和X线影像评估骨整合及并发症。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate short-term clinical and radiographic outcomes of a DED-based 3D-printed acetabular cup in cementless THA.
summary_en.method: A prospective observational study enrolled 120 patients; 100 patients (124 hips) with minimum 24-month follow-up were analyzed using clinical scores and CT/X-ray imaging.
summary_en.result: Implant survival was 99.3% at mean 34.6 months, with significant improvement in HHS (56.6 to 91.4) and reliable osseointegration despite frequent small interfacial gaps.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation through prospective follow-up with patient-reported outcomes and radiographic assessment.

key_terms.zh: 非骨水泥全髋关节置换术

title: Real-time Terrain Analysis for Off-road Autonomous Vehicles
relevance_to_user: 该论文的贝叶斯校准和高斯过程代理模型方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但缺乏植入物设计约束和多目标优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization for biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决越野车辆因路面粗糙度变化导致的控制难题
summary_zh.method: 采用贝叶斯校准和高斯过程代理模型，从轴加速度反演路面粗糙度
summary_zh.result: 实现实时粗糙度估计，并集成Simplex控制器动态调整速度限制
summary_zh.validation: 在随机生成的不同粗糙度路面上进行仿真验证

summary_en.motivation: To address autonomous vehicle control challenges caused by road roughness variation that induces course deviations and loss of road contact.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian calibration framework using a Gaussian process surrogate model of a half-vehicle system to inversely estimate road roughness from axle accelerations.
summary_en.result: The system provides real-time roughness predictions with uncertainty quantification, enabling a Simplex controller to dynamically adjust velocity limits for enhanced safety.
summary_en.validation: Validation on stochastically generated surfaces with varying roughness regions demonstrates robust real-time characterization and improved operational safety.

title: Active Learning for Manifold Gaussian Process Regression
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合主动学习和流形高斯过程的回归框架，可提高高维空间中的采样效率，对代理模型构建具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高高维空间中高斯过程回归的采样效率与精度。
summary_zh.method: 联合优化神经网络降维与高斯过程回归，并由主动学习准则监督。
summary_zh.result: 在合成数据上优于随机顺序学习，能处理复杂不连续函数。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成数据集上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: To improve sampling efficiency and accuracy of Gaussian process regression in high-dimensional spaces.
summary_en.method: Jointly optimizes a neural network for dimensionality reduction and a Gaussian process regressor in latent space, supervised by an active learning criterion.
summary_en.result: Outperforms random sequential learning on synthetic data and handles complex discontinuous functions.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic datasets.

title: Variational Digital Twins
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的变分数字孪生框架可迁移至生物打印过程，实现实时不确定性感知的模型更新。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on energy systems and does not involve bioprinting, bioink, or any biomedical experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有数字孪生缺乏实时信息交换和不确定性量化框架。
summary_zh.method: 提出变分数字孪生框架，在标准神经网络后添加贝叶斯输出层并设计高效更新算法。
summary_zh.result: 在四个能源问题上实现高精度预测，主动学习减少47%实验，传感器丢失下仍保持性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过临界热流、可再生能源、核反应堆和锂电池四个案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Current digital twin frameworks lack real-time information exchange and calibrated uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A variational digital twin framework is proposed that augments standard neural architectures with a single Bayesian output layer and a novel updating algorithm for efficient retraining.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves high accuracy on four energy problems, reduces experiments by 47% via active learning, and maintains performance under 50% sensor loss.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on four energy-sector simulation cases: critical heat flux, renewable generation, nuclear reactor transient, and Li-ion battery.

title: Structural System Identification via Validation and Adaptation
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过生成对抗网络进行参数估计和不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的参数反演和验证。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on structural system identification from acceleration data, not on surrogate modeling for expensive finite element simulations or implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 从数据中估计结构系统参数并量化不确定性
summary_zh.method: 使用生成对抗网络将随机噪声映射为物理参数，通过运动方程生成伪数据并与真实数据比较
summary_zh.result: 在非线性结构系统中实现了准确的参数估计和模型验证
summary_zh.validation: 通过独立验证数据集和判别器网络进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To estimate governing equation parameters and quantify uncertainty from experimental data for complex structural systems.
summary_en.method: A generative adversarial network maps random noise to physically meaningful parameters, which are used in the known equation of motion to generate fake accelerations compared to real data via MSE loss.
summary_en.result: Accurate parameter estimation and model validation are demonstrated for nonlinear structural systems using analytical and real experiments.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using independent validation datasets and a discriminator network that distinguishes real from fake accelerations.

title: Ferrofluid‐Based Bioink for 3D Printed Skeletal Muscle Tissues with Enhanced Force and Magnetic Response

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D生物打印和磁性生物墨水，但未使用AI技术，与AI生物打印方向相关性较低。
why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage, lacks experimental validation of AI models, and does not advance towards autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发具有磁响应性的3D打印肌肉组织，增强力输出和可控性。
summary_zh.method: 将铁磁流体（氧化铁纳米颗粒）整合到含肌细胞的生物墨水中，通过挤出式3D打印制备铁磁肌肉。
summary_zh.result: 铁磁肌肉组织在电刺激下力输出增加，并具有磁导向能力，且细胞相容性良好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过电刺激力测试和细胞培养验证组织分化与生物相容性。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a magnetically responsive 3D printed muscle tissue with enhanced force output and controllability for bioactuator applications.
summary_en.method: Ferrofluid containing iron oxide nanoparticles was integrated into muscle cell-laden bioink and fabricated into ferromuscle tissue via extrusion-based 3D printing.
summary_en.result: The ferromuscle tissue exhibited increased force output upon electrical stimulation and magnetic guidance capability, with good cytocompatibility and biodegradability.
summary_en.validation: In vitro electrical stimulation force tests and cell culture assays validated tissue differentiation and biocompatibility.

title: Bactericidal nanotopography of titanium dental implants: in vitro and in vivo studies.
first_author_affiliation: Bioinspired Oral Biomaterials and Interfaces, Department Ciencia e Ingeniería de Materiales, Escola d'Enginyeria Barcelona Est, Technical University of Catalonia, Barcelona, Spain. javier.gil.mur@upc.edu.

corresponding_authors.name: Javier Gil
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Bioinspired Oral Biomaterials and Interfaces, Department Ciencia e Ingeniería de Materiales, Escola d'Enginyeria Barcelona Est, Technical University of Catalonia, Barcelona, Spain. javier.gil.mur@upc.edu.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了钛种植体表面纳米尖刺结构的杀菌能力和骨整合效果，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或LPBF制造。
why_not_core: This paper does not cover porous structure design, stress shielding, LPBF fabrication, or stiffness matching; it focuses on surface nanotopography of dental implants via chemical etching.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发具有杀菌能力且不损害骨整合的钛种植体表面。
summary_zh.method: 通过硫酸和过氧化氢处理形成纳米尖刺表面，并进行表征和生物学测试。
summary_zh.result: 纳米尖刺表面保持力学性能，提高润湿性和骨整合，杀菌率达70-90%。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验、细菌实验和兔胫骨体内植入验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a titanium dental implant surface with bactericidal properties without compromising osseointegration.
summary_en.method: A nanospike layer was created via sulfuric acid and hydrogen peroxide treatment, characterized by microscopy, roughness, wettability, and fatigue testing, followed by in vitro cell and bacterial assays and in vivo rabbit tibia implantation.
summary_en.result: The nanospike surface maintained mechanical properties, improved wettability and osteoblast adhesion, achieved 70-90% bactericidal reduction, and enhanced bone-implant contact (56% vs 41% control).
summary_en.validation: In vitro osteoblast adhesion and mineralization assays, bacterial colonization tests, and in vivo rabbit tibia implantation with bone contact index measurement.

title: Estimating Spatially-Dependent GPS Errors Using a Swarm of Robots
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用高斯过程回归构建空间误差代理模型，并通过信息路径规划优化采样，其思路可迁移至生物力学设计中的约束优化和不确定性量化问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on GPS error estimation in robotics, with no application to FEA, implant design, or biomechanics, and does not address constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 用机器人群估算随空间变化的GPS误差。
summary_zh.method: 状态偏差估计结合高斯过程回归与信息路径规划。
summary_zh.result: 信息路径规划优于开环策略。
summary_zh.validation: 仿真对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To estimate a static, spatially-varying GPS error function using a swarm of robots.
summary_en.method: A State Bias Estimation algorithm coupled with Gaussian Process Regression and informative path planning for data collection.
summary_en.result: The informative path planning strategy reduces uncertainty faster than an open-loop baseline in simulation.
summary_en.validation: Validated through comparative simulations of IPP versus open-loop planning.

relevance_to_user: 该论文使用3D生物打印构建脑血管狭窄模型，但未涉及AI技术，与AI生物打印方向关联较弱。
why_not_core: This paper does not integrate AI into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on bioink development and in vitro modeling without machine learning or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 构建体外脑血管狭窄模型以研究血流诱导的内皮炎症。
summary_zh.method: 使用3D同轴生物打印和机械增强ECM生物墨水制造狭窄血管。
summary_zh.result: 打印血管形成成熟屏障，扰动流下ICAM-1和VCAM-1上调。
summary_zh.validation: 通过免疫荧光、渗透性测试和CFD模拟验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a physiologically relevant in vitro model of stenotic brain vessels for investigating flow-induced endothelial inflammation.
summary_en.method: A mechanically enhanced ECM bioink was used in 3D-coaxial bioprinting to fabricate perfusable stenotic vessels with precise luminal diameters.
summary_en.result: The bioprinted vessels exhibited mature endothelial barrier function and upregulated inflammatory markers under disturbed flow.
summary_en.validation: Validation included immunostaining for junction proteins, permeability assays, and CFD simulations of flow patterns.

title: Convolution-weighting method for the physics-informed neural network: A Primal-Dual Optimization Perspective
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用于物理信息神经网络的卷积加权方法，可提高PDE求解精度，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计，其方法可迁移至代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not handle constrained optimization or biomechanical contexts.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN因有限采样点导致的收敛和精度问题
summary_zh.method: 提出从孤立点损失加权扩展到连续邻域的卷积加权方法
summary_zh.result: 相对L2误差显著降低
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准测试上验证

summary_en.motivation: To address convergence and accuracy issues in PINNs caused by finite collocation points.
summary_en.method: Proposes a convolution-based weighting scheme that adaptively extends loss weighting from isolated points to continuous neighborhood regions.
summary_en.result: The method achieves lower relative L2 errors on benchmark PDE problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical PDE benchmarks without experimental or biomechanical contexts.

title: Trustworthy Prediction with Gaussian Process Knowledge Scores
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的高斯过程知识分数可用于量化预测的不确定性，对代理模型中的不确定性量化有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanics design; it focuses on general GP prediction quality assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 高斯过程回归在无观测区域预测时，需要量化预测是否受数据支持。
summary_zh.method: 提出知识分数，基于观测数据减少预测不确定性的程度，值在0到1之间。
summary_zh.result: 知识分数能预测GPR模型预测的准确性，在异常检测、外推等任务中提升性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个数值基准实验上验证知识分数的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian process regression predictions in unobserved regions require a measure of how well-informed they are by training data.
summary_en.method: A knowledge score is proposed that quantifies the reduction in predictive uncertainty due to observed data, bounded between 0 and 1.
summary_en.result: The knowledge score anticipates prediction accuracy and improves performance in anomaly detection, extrapolation, and missing data imputation.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on multiple numerical benchmark experiments.

title: The Impact of As-Built Surface Characteristics of Selective-Laser-Melted Ti-6Al-4V on Early Osteoblastic Response for Potential Dental Applications

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM Ti-6Al-4V表面形貌对成骨细胞响应的影响，与AM生物医学方向相关，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not cover stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or porous structure design; it focuses solely on as-built surface characteristics and early osteoblastic response.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究SLM Ti-6Al-4V表面形貌对早期成骨细胞响应的影响。
summary_zh.method: 制备不同表面粗糙度的SLM样品，进行表面表征和MG-63细胞培养实验。
summary_zh.result: SLM表面形貌促进细胞增殖和骨架组织，效果优于对照组。
summary_zh.validation: 通过细胞增殖和骨架染色实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how as-built surface characteristics of selective-laser-melted Ti-6Al-4V influence early osteoblastic response for dental applications.
summary_en.method: SLM samples with varying surface roughness were fabricated and characterized, followed by MG-63 cell culture assays.
summary_en.result: As-built SLM surfaces enhanced cell proliferation and cytoskeletal organization by 1.5-fold compared to controls.
summary_en.validation: In vitro biological assays using osteoblast-like cells confirmed the improved early cellular response.

title: Exact Conditional Score-Guided Generative Modeling for Amortized Inference in Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该方法提供了一种高效的近似后验采样框架，可迁移至生物力学设计中的不确定量化任务，但未直接处理约束或与FEA结合。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA, implant biomechanics, or constrained optimization; it only validates on generic numerical benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效的条件采样用于不确定性量化，避免高计算成本
summary_zh.method: 利用高斯混合先验的精确条件分数训练前馈网络作为生成模型
summary_zh.result: 实现了快速、可扩展的后验采样，适用于高维多模态分布
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证了准确性和效率

summary_en.motivation: To achieve fast amortized conditional sampling for uncertainty quantification tasks without the computational burden of iterative diffusion models.
summary_en.method: Derive an exact conditional score from a Gaussian mixture prior to generate noise-labeled data, then train a feedforward network for direct posterior mapping.
summary_en.result: The method provides accurate and scalable conditional sampling for high-dimensional and multimodal posterior distributions.
summary_en.validation: Validated through a series of numerical experiments on benchmark problems.

title: A Physics-Informed Neural Network Framework for Simulating Creep Buckling in Growing Viscoelastic Biological Tissues
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于能量的PINN框架可用于模拟粘弹性蠕变和屈曲，其方法可迁移至植入物力学分析中的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific mechanics (e.g., stress shielding, micromotion) or surrogate modeling for expensive FEA sampling; it focuses on biological tissue growth and morphogenesis.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统有限元方法模拟粘弹性蠕变屈曲需显式网格和人工扰动，计算复杂。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于能量的PINN框架，通过最小化势能泛函隐式满足平衡和本构方程。
summary_zh.result: 框架无需预置缺陷即可自然捕捉蠕变屈曲，并预测组织形态演化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟均匀膨胀和差异生长诱导的圆柱结构屈曲进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional finite element methods require explicit meshing and artificial perturbations to simulate viscoelastic creep buckling, increasing computational complexity.
summary_en.method: An energy-based physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework is developed using an incremental approach to minimize the system's potential energy functional, implicitly satisfying equilibrium and constitutive laws.
summary_en.result: The framework naturally captures creep buckling without pre-imposed imperfections and predicts both uniform expansion and differential growth-induced buckling in cylindrical structures.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation cases of uniform expansion and differential growth-induced buckling in cylindrical structures.

title: LFR-PINO: A Layered Fourier Reduced Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Parametric PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的物理信息神经算子，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant mechanics problems, no uncertainty quantification, and no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有物理信息神经算子表达有限或计算成本高，需高效通用求解器。
summary_zh.method: 提出分层超网络与频域降维结合的LFR-PINO架构。
summary_zh.result: 在四个PDE基准上误差降低22.8%-68.7%，内存减少28.6%-69.3%。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE数值基准上验证，未涉及生物力学或植入物案例。

summary_en.motivation: Existing physics-informed neural operators suffer from limited expressiveness or high computational cost, motivating a more efficient and generalizable solver.
summary_en.method: LFR-PINO introduces a layered hypernetwork for layer-specific parameter generation and a frequency-domain reduction strategy to reduce parameter count while preserving spectral features.
summary_en.result: The method achieves 22.8%-68.7% error reduction and 28.6%-69.3% memory savings over state-of-the-art baselines on four parametric PDE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical PDE benchmarks without application to biomedical or implant mechanics.

title: Mesh-Informed Neural Operator : A Transformer Generative Approach
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的网格信息神经算子（MINO）能够处理非规则网格，对生物力学代理模型有潜在应用价值，但未涉及约束优化或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper introduces a generative neural operator architecture but lacks application to FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification, and does not validate on implant/biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服傅里叶神经算子对规则网格的依赖，扩展函数空间生成模型的应用范围。
summary_zh.method: 使用图神经算子和交叉注意力机制构建网格无关的生成神经算子。
summary_zh.result: 提出MINO框架，支持非规则域上的生成、逆问题和回归任务。
summary_zh.validation: 未提供实验验证，仅理论架构设计。

summary_en.motivation: Overcome the reliance of functional generative models on regular grids by introducing a mesh-informed neural operator that is domain- and discretization-agnostic.
summary_en.method: Integrate graph neural operators with cross-attention mechanisms to build a backbone that extends generative modeling to irregular domains.
summary_en.result: Propose MINO, a unified framework enabling generative, inverse, and regression tasks on arbitrary meshes with standardized evaluation metrics.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is provided; the paper focuses on architectural innovation and theoretical perspective.

title: Bayesian Joint Model of Multi-Sensor and Failure Event Data for Multi-Mode Failure Prediction
relevance_to_user: 该论文的贝叶斯联合建模方法可用于处理多源传感器数据与失效事件，其不确定性量化框架对生物力学代理模型中的多目标优化和约束处理具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or design optimization; it focuses on predictive maintenance with multi-sensor data.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有方法忽略多传感器与多失效模式间的关联，缺乏不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 提出层次贝叶斯框架，集成Cox比例风险模型、卷积多输出高斯过程和多项失效模式分布。
summary_zh.result: 在喷气发动机数据集上验证了准确预测与鲁棒不确定性量化的优势。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟和发动机案例数据进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing methods treat failure mode classification and RUL prediction independently, lacking uncertainty quantification and statistical rigor.
summary_en.method: A hierarchical Bayesian framework integrating Cox proportional hazards model, convolved multi-output Gaussian process, and multinomial failure mode distributions is proposed.
summary_en.result: The model achieves accurate RUL prediction with robust uncertainty quantification on a jet-engine dataset.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through extensive numerical studies and a case study using the C-MAPSS jet-engine dataset.

title: Leveraging Influence Functions for Resampling Data in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出基于影响函数的重采样方法提升PINN预测精度，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的训练数据优化。
why_not_core: No implant/biomechanics application, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升PINN训练数据质量以增强预测精度。
summary_zh.method: 利用影响函数对训练点进行重采样。
summary_zh.result: 重采样策略可提高PINN预测准确性。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve prediction accuracy of physics-informed neural networks by optimizing training data selection.
summary_en.method: Apply influence functions from explainable AI to resample spatio-temporal training points.
summary_en.result: Influence function-based resampling enhances PINN prediction accuracy on benchmark PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard PDE benchmarks (e.g., Burgers', Helmholtz).

title: FFINO: Factorized Fourier Improved Neural Operator for Modeling Multiphase Flow in Underground Hydrogen Storage
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的FFINO神经算子方法可加速多相流模拟，其架构和不确定性量化思路可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on multiphase flow in underground hydrogen storage, not on implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate for solid mechanics, or biomedical design constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 快速模拟地下储氢中多相流以支持实时管理。
summary_zh.method: 提出因子化傅里叶改进神经算子FFINO，参数化相对渗透率曲线作为不确定性输入。
summary_zh.result: FFINO相比FMIONet参数减少38.1%，训练时间缩短17.6%，精度提升9.8%-16.3%，推理速度比数值模拟快7850倍。
summary_zh.validation: 与数值模拟器对比，使用综合指标评估预测氢羽流和压力分布的准确性。

summary_en.motivation: Fast modeling of hydrogen plume migration and pressure evolution is essential for real-time management of underground hydrogen storage.
summary_en.method: A factorized Fourier improved neural operator (FFINO) is proposed, incorporating experimental relative permeability curves as uncertain inputs to accelerate multiphase flow simulation.
summary_en.result: FFINO reduces trainable parameters by 38.1%, training time by 17.6%, and improves accuracy by 9.8% for hydrogen plume and 16.3% for pressure buildup, with inference 7,850 times faster than numerical simulators.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated against numerical simulations using comprehensive metrics, with sensitivity analysis identifying injection rate as the most influential parameter.

title: Feasibility-Driven Trust Region Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种处理昂贵约束的贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not include any FEA validation, biomechanics context, or implant-specific constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 昂贵约束下可行域小且不规则，优化预算常浪费在寻找可行解上。
summary_zh.method: 提出FuRBO算法，利用目标与约束代理模型自适应调整信任区域的位置和大小。
summary_zh.result: 在BBOB约束基准和物理启发基准上，FuRBO显著加速了可行且高质量解的发现。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准和物理启发基准上对比多种基线方法。

summary_en.motivation: Expensive constraints with small, irregular feasible regions waste optimization budget on finding the first feasible solution.
summary_en.method: FuRBO adaptively shifts and resizes a trust region using surrogate models of both objective and constraints to rapidly refocus search.
summary_en.result: FuRBO consistently accelerates discovery of feasible, high-quality solutions on constrained BBOB and physics-inspired benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical benchmarks on the COCO constrained suite and physics-inspired problems with dimensions 2-60.

title: Active Digital Twins via Active Inference
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的主动数字孪生框架基于主动推理，可迁移至生物打印中的自适应过程控制，但未涉及生物打印的具体应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address any bioprinting workflow stage, lacks experimental validation in a biomedical context, and does not demonstrate autonomous decision-making for bioprinting.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统数字孪生被动吸收数据，在动态环境中适应性不足。
summary_zh.method: 基于主动推理的主动数字孪生框架，统一推理、决策和学习。
summary_zh.result: 在铁路桥梁结构健康监测中，主动数字孪生比传统方法具有更强的探索能力。
summary_zh.validation: 通过虚拟实验验证，未涉及物理实验。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional digital twins rely on passive data assimilation, limiting their adaptability in uncertain and dynamic environments.
summary_en.method: An active digital twin paradigm based on active inference, modeling the coupled physical-digital system as a partially observable Markov decision process to unify inference, decision-making, and learning.
summary_en.result: In virtual experiments of railway bridge structural health monitoring, active digital twins demonstrate superior exploration capabilities compared to traditional reactive approaches.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through virtual simulation experiments only, without physical or experimental validation.

key_terms.zh: 部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程

title: Vine Copulas as Differentiable Computational Graphs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的藤计算图方法可用于不确定性量化，可能迁移到生物力学代理模型中的多变量依赖建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or expensive simulation sampling; it focuses on vine copula computational graphs for general ML uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 将藤copula模型集成到现代深度学习管道中，实现可微的不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 提出藤计算图（有向无环图），并基于PyTorch实现GPU加速的torchvinecopulib库。
summary_zh.result: 藤copula自编码器性能提升，且藤UQ方法在锐度、校准和运行时间上优于MC-dropout、深度集成和贝叶斯神经网络。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准UQ基准数据集上对比实验。

summary_en.motivation: To integrate vine copula models into modern deep learning pipelines by making them differentiable and GPU-accelerated.
summary_en.method: Introduces a vine computational graph (DAG) that abstracts vine structure and computations, implemented in a PyTorch-based library torchvinecopulib.
summary_en.result: The vine computational graph improves Vine Copula Autoencoders and outperforms MC-dropout, deep ensembles, and Bayesian Neural Networks in sharpness, calibration, and runtime for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: Empirical evaluation on standard UQ benchmarks comparing against baseline methods.

title: Non-Asymptotic Stability and Consistency Guarantees for Physics-Informed Neural Networks via Coercive Operator Analysis
relevance_to_user: 该论文为PINN提供了理论稳定性与一致性保证，方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及具体工程约束或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper provides theoretical guarantees for PINNs but does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification in a practical implant/biomechanics design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 为PINN提供严格的稳定性和一致性理论保证
summary_zh.method: 基于算子强制性、变分公式和非渐近扰动理论建立统一框架
summary_zh.result: 证明了残差最小化在Sobolev范数下收敛，并给出样本复杂度界
summary_zh.validation: 在椭圆、抛物和非线性PDE上验证理论界的预测精度

summary_en.motivation: To establish rigorous stability and consistency guarantees for Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) through operator coercivity and non-asymptotic perturbation theory.
summary_en.method: A unified theoretical framework is developed using operator coercivity, variational formulations, and probabilistic concentration inequalities to bound generalization error.
summary_en.result: The framework proves convergence in energy and uniform norms under mild regularity and provides sample complexity guarantees for residual-based generalization.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on elliptic, parabolic, and nonlinear PDEs confirm the predictive accuracy of the theoretical bounds.

title: Dual guidance: ROM-informed field reconstruction with generative models
relevance_to_user: 该论文将降阶模型与生成模型结合用于稀疏观测下的流场重建，其方法可迁移至生物力学中基于稀疏传感器数据的全场重建或代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics reconstruction, not on solid mechanics, implant design, or biomechanical FEA surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用稀疏观测数据高效重建非定常不可压缩流场。
summary_zh.method: 结合基于互信息的传感器优化布局与物理约束扩散模型进行双引导重建。
summary_zh.result: 优化传感器布局在稀疏条件下实现低至0.05的L2误差，优于结构化布局。
summary_zh.validation: 在二维圆柱绕流数值基准上验证重建精度。

summary_en.motivation: To reconstruct unsteady incompressible flow fields from sparse observations with high accuracy and physical consistency.
summary_en.method: A dual-guided framework combining mutual information-based sensor placement with a physics-constrained denoising diffusion probabilistic model.
summary_en.result: Optimized sensor placement achieves L2 errors as low as 0.05 under sparse sensing, outperforming structured layouts.
summary_en.validation: Validated on 2D laminar cylinder wake flow numerical benchmarks.

title: Bayesian Active Learning of (small) Quantile Sets through Expected Estimator Modification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯主动学习方法可用于高效估计昂贵黑箱函数的极值分位数集，可迁移至植入物设计中的约束优化和不确定性量化问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization; it focuses on quantile set estimation for general expensive black-box functions.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效估计昂贵黑箱函数的分位数集，避免大量采样。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于高斯过程和期望估计器修改准则的贝叶斯主动学习策略，结合序贯蒙特卡洛实现批量设计。
summary_zh.result: 在合成算例和ROTOR37压缩机模型上验证了方法对极小分位数集估计的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成算例和工业压缩机仿真案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently estimate quantile sets of expensive black-box functions with deterministic and uncertain inputs, reducing the number of function evaluations.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian active learning strategy using Gaussian process modeling and a novel Expected Estimator Modification (EEM) sampling criterion, combined with sequential Monte Carlo for batch-sequential design.
summary_en.result: The proposed method accurately estimates small quantile sets on synthetic examples and an industrial ROTOR37 compressor model.
summary_en.validation: Validation via synthetic benchmarks and a simulation case of the ROTOR37 compressor model.

title: Taking the GP Out of the Loop
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种轻量级替代高斯过程的代理模型，可大幅提升贝叶斯优化的采样效率，适用于昂贵仿真场景，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate modeling, or constraint handling; it focuses on general Bayesian optimization with cheap observations.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决贝叶斯优化中高斯过程拟合计算量大的瓶颈
summary_zh.method: 提出基于K近邻的轻量级代理模型ENN，替代高斯过程
summary_zh.result: TuRBO-ENN在多达5万观测点上将拟合与采集时间降低1-2个数量级
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准上对比TuRBO，验证时间效率

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational bottleneck of Gaussian process hyperparameter fitting in Bayesian optimization with many observations.
summary_en.method: Proposes Epistemic Nearest Neighbors (ENN), a K-nearest-neighbor-based surrogate that estimates function values and uncertainty with linear scaling.
summary_en.result: TuRBO-ENN reduces proposal time by one to two orders of magnitude compared to TuRBO on up to 50,000 observations.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on standard numerical benchmarks demonstrates significant speedup while maintaining optimization performance.

title: Effect Decomposition of Functional-Output Computer Experiments via Orthogonal Additive Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的功能输出正交加性高斯过程方法可用于代理建模中的敏感性分析和不确定性量化，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on functional ANOVA for general computer experiments with no application to biomechanics, implant design, or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有功能输出方差分析方法缺乏灵活性，难以处理黑箱计算机实验中的非线性关系。
summary_zh.method: 提出功能输出正交加性高斯过程，通过条件正交约束实现数据驱动的正交效应分解。
summary_zh.result: 在仿真和实际案例中验证了正交效应分解和方差分解的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个仿真研究和机身形状控制案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing functional ANOVA methods lack flexibility to capture complex nonlinear relationships in black-box computer experiments.
summary_en.method: A functional-output orthogonal additive Gaussian process is proposed, enforcing conditional orthogonality on the separable prior process for data-driven decomposition.
summary_en.result: The model effectively performs orthogonal effect decomposition and variance decomposition, demonstrated on simulation studies and a fuselage shape control case.
summary_en.validation: Validation via two simulation studies and a real engineering case on fuselage shape control.

title: Using Deep Operators to Create Spatio-temporal Surrogates for Dynamical Systems under Uncertainty
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的全场扩展DeepONet方法可高效生成时空代理模型，适用于不确定性下的动力学系统，其框架可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or patient-specific design; it focuses on structural dynamics of civil infrastructure.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决动力学系统全时空响应预测的计算效率问题
summary_zh.method: 提出全场扩展DeepONet，增强分支网络表达力和主干网络预测能力
summary_zh.result: 在斜拉桥随机地震响应预测中精度和效率均优于传统DeepONet
summary_zh.validation: 通过斜拉桥模型随机地震动数值模拟验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently generate full spatio-temporal surrogates for dynamical systems under uncertainty, overcoming limitations of existing operator learning methods.
summary_en.method: Proposes a full-field Extended DeepONet (FExD) that enhances branch network expressiveness and trunk network predictive capacity for multi-output response predictions.
summary_en.result: FExD achieves superior accuracy and computational efficiency compared to vanilla DeepONet and a modified spatio-temporal Extended DeepONet on a cable-stayed bridge testbed.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a numerical simulation of a cable-stayed bridge subjected to stochastic ground motions.

title: Physics-informed neural network framework for solving forward and inverse flexoelectric problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PINN框架可解决高阶偏微分方程的正反问题，其能量法和硬约束边界条件方法可迁移至生物力学中的植入物FEA代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical application; it focuses on flexoelectricity in electromechanical systems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决柔性电问题中高阶PDE的计算挑战
summary_zh.method: 基于能量法的PINN框架，结合有限元数值积分和硬约束边界条件
summary_zh.result: 正反问题均与混合FEM结果吻合，逆问题准确恢复材料参数
summary_zh.validation: 与混合有限元解对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational challenges of solving fourth-order PDEs in flexoelectricity, which require C1-continuous solutions.
summary_en.method: A PINN framework based on an energy formulation, using the deep energy method for forward problems and a variational loss for inverse parameter identification, with finite-element quadrature and hard boundary constraints.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves excellent agreement with mixed-FEM solutions for both direct and converse flexoelectric effects and accurately recovers material parameters from sparse data.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks against mixed finite element method solutions.

title: Martingale Posterior Neural Networks for Fast Sequential Decision Making
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的在线贝叶斯决策方法可迁移至代理模型中的不确定性量化与高效采样，但未涉及有限元或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate modeling, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决贝叶斯神经网络在线决策中后验采样昂贵的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出鞅后验方法，直接参数化一步预测分布并通过卡尔曼滤波更新
summary_zh.result: 在非平稳上下文赌博机和贝叶斯优化中实现10-100倍加速且性能相当
summary_zh.validation: 在标准基准任务上对比Thompson采样

summary_en.motivation: To enable fast sequential decision making without costly posterior sampling in Bayesian neural networks.
summary_en.method: Proposes martingale posterior neural networks that directly parameterize the one-step-ahead predictive distribution and update via Kalman-filter-like recursions.
summary_en.result: Achieves 10-100x faster inference than Thompson sampling with comparable or superior performance in non-stationary contextual bandits and Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.validation: Empirically validated on standard benchmark tasks for contextual bandits and Bayesian optimization.

title: Learning to Integrate
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于传输映射的稀疏网格积分方法可用于生物力学设计中的不确定性量化，但未涉及植入物或生物力学具体问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on general UQ for PDEs with complex input distributions.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效计算复杂输入分布下昂贵仿真的期望值。
summary_zh.method: 用传输映射将复杂分布映射到标准正态，再结合稀疏网格积分。
summary_zh.result: 在扩散方程算例中验证了方法的准确性，并分析了多种误差来源。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验（多项式、扩散方程）验证积分精度。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently compute expectations of expensive simulations under complex input distributions that are not amenable to standard sparse grid quadrature.
summary_en.method: Transport maps (normalizing flows) are learned to transform complex distributions to multivariate standard normals, enabling sparse grid integration of the composed function.
summary_en.result: The method achieves accurate integration for stationary diffusion with Lévy random fields, with errors analyzed from learning, quadrature, and truncation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on monomials and diffusion PDEs with up to 25 random modes validate the approach.

title: Advanced 3D biomaterials and bioprinting strategies for in vitro modeling of neurodegenerative diseases
first_author_affiliation: Department of Pharmaceutics, Saveetha College of Pharmacy, Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences, Saveetha University, Chennai, 602105, India

corresponding_authors.name: J. Nandhini
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Pharmaceutics, Saveetha College of Pharmacy, Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences, Saveetha University, Chennai, 602105, India

relevance_to_user: 该综述讨论了AI在3D生物打印模型中的数据整合和优化，但未涉及AI直接控制打印过程或实验验证。
why_not_core: This is a review paper with no experimental validation, no AI integration into a specific bioprinting workflow stage, and no autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统模型无法模拟神经退行性疾病的复杂微环境，需要更先进的体外模型。
summary_zh.method: 综述了生物材料、3D生物打印、iPSCs和微流控平台在构建3D模型中的应用。
summary_zh.result: 先进生物材料和AI集成可提高模型的可扩展性和可重复性。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional models fail to recapitulate the complex microenvironment of neurodegenerative diseases, necessitating advanced in vitro platforms.
summary_en.method: This review summarizes the use of bioinspired biomaterials, 3D bioprinting, patient-derived iPSCs, and microfluidic systems to create physiologically relevant models.
summary_en.result: Advanced biomaterials and AI-driven data integration enhance model scalability, reproducibility, and translational potential.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; this is a literature review.

why_not_core: No AI/ML integration in any bioprinting workflow stage; purely a process comparison without autonomous decision-making or model training.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较自动化3D打印与手动铸造在骨支架制造中的效率和可重复性。
summary_zh.method: 优化3D打印参数，引入网格过滤器，结合自动浇铸与3D生物打印。
summary_zh.result: 自动化方法将处理时间缩短五倍，支架质量提高一倍，细胞活力良好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多能间充质基质细胞的体外实验验证细胞活力和粘附性。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the efficiency and reproducibility of automated 3D bioprinting versus manual casting for bone scaffold fabrication.
summary_en.method: Optimized 3D printing parameters, introduced a mesh filter, and combined automated casting with 3D bioprinting.
summary_en.result: Automated method reduced processing time fivefold and doubled scaffold mass while maintaining excellent cell viability.
summary_en.validation: In vitro studies using multipotent mesenchymal stromal cells confirmed cell viability and adhesion on automated scaffolds.

title: Employing Deep Neural Operators for PDE control by decoupling training and optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的解耦训练与优化的神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学FEA代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling (only unconstrained optimization), no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 简化PDE约束控制问题，避免复杂网络架构或耦合训练。
summary_zh.method: 使用DeepONet作为代理模型，通过物理信息训练后，用自动微分迭代优化控制变量。
summary_zh.result: 在非线性时变问题上精度与伴随法相当，迭代速度提升4倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在Poisson、Burgers和Stokes方程上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To simplify PDE-constrained control problems by decoupling the training of a neural operator from the optimization of control variables.
summary_en.method: A DeepONet is trained with a physics-informed loss, then reused for different tracking targets via automatic differentiation in an unconstrained optimizer.
summary_en.result: The approach achieves competitive accuracy with up to 4x faster iteration on nonlinear time-dependent problems compared to adjoint solvers.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on Poisson, viscous Burgers, and Stokes flow control problems.

title: Distributional encoding for Gaussian process regression with qualitative inputs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种处理定性输入的GP方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的混合变量场景。
why_not_core: Does not address FEA surrogate modeling specifically, lacks constraint handling, and is not validated on biomechanical or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 处理高斯过程回归中的定性输入变量以提高预测性能
summary_zh.method: 提出基于最大均值差异和Wasserstein距离的分布编码方法
summary_zh.result: 在多个合成和真实数据集上取得最先进结果
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实数据集上验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve Gaussian process regression with categorical inputs by leveraging distributional information of the target variable.
summary_en.method: A distributional encoding approach using maximum mean discrepancy and Wasserstein distance to represent categorical variables as probability distributions.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves state-of-the-art predictive performance on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on a variety of synthetic and real-world datasets, demonstrating superiority over existing encoding methods.

title: A mathematical phase field model predicts superparamagnetic nanoparticle accelerated fusion of HeLa spheroids for field guided biofabrication
first_author_affiliation: Department of Biomedical Engineering, Universidad de Los Andes, Cra. 1E No. 19a-40, 111711, Bogotá, Colombia. cf.rodriguez@uniandes.edu.co

relevance_to_user: 该论文将数学模型与实验验证结合，预测磁场辅助下的球体融合，对AI辅助生物打印中的过程建模有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI/ML into the bioprinting workflow; it uses a mathematical phase field model rather than a data-driven or AI-based approach.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有模型无法精确捕捉磁场辅助球体融合中的生物与磁力相互作用。
summary_zh.method: 开发了基于相场法的数学模型，结合细胞力学、流体动力学和静磁学，在COMSOL中实现。
summary_zh.result: 模型准确预测磁场加速融合，融合时间从7天缩短至2天，R²>0.99。
summary_zh.validation: 使用HeLa细胞球体与SPIONs进行体外实验，通过共聚焦显微镜和多种统计指标验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing mathematical models lack the precision to capture the interplay between biological dynamics and magnetic forces during spheroid fusion in magnetic bioprinting.
summary_en.method: A novel phase field model integrating cell mechanics, fluid dynamics, and magnetostatics was developed and implemented in COMSOL Multiphysics.
summary_en.result: The model accurately predicted accelerated spheroid fusion under magnetic manipulation, reducing fusion time from 7 days to 2 days with high R² values (>0.99).
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was performed using HeLa cell spheroids bioprinted with SPIONs, monitored by confocal microscopy, and evaluated with rigorous statistical metrics including MAE, RMSE, R², and Bland-Altman analysis.

title: A Gaussian process approach for rapid evaluation of skin tension
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用高斯过程回归解决逆问题，方法可迁移至生物力学中的代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on skin tension prediction via wave speed.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用非侵入性波速测量预测皮肤应力和预拉伸。
summary_zh.method: 基于有限元模拟数据训练高斯过程回归模型求解逆问题。
summary_zh.result: 模型预测性能良好（R²=0.957），实验验证与模拟一致。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成皮肤实验验证波速测量与模型预测。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a non-invasive method for predicting in vivo skin stress and pre-stretch using surface wave speed measurements.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process regression model was trained on a large dataset from 2D finite element simulations of wave propagation to solve the ill-posed inverse problem.
summary_en.result: The model achieved high predictive performance (R²=0.957) and was validated with experimental wave speed measurements on synthetic skin.
summary_en.validation: Experimental wave speeds from synthetic skin under controlled pre-stretch agreed well with FE simulations, confirming the model's accuracy.

title: GP-Recipe: Gaussian Process approximation to linear operations in numerical methods
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出基于高斯过程的数值算子近似方法，可迁移至有限元代理建模，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no FEA surrogate validation on structural problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高数值方法中线性算子近似的精度和鲁棒性
summary_zh.method: 利用高斯过程回归对有限差分、插值等算子进行非参数贝叶斯近似
summary_zh.result: GP近似解相比传统有限差分方法具有更高精度
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准数值测试问题验证精度提升

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and robustness of linear operator approximations in numerical methods.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process regression framework is used to approximate linear operators such as finite differences and interpolations in a non-parametric Bayesian manner.
summary_en.result: The GP-approximated solutions achieve higher accuracy compared to conventional finite-difference counterparts.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical benchmark problems.

title: Enhancing Experimental Efficiency in Materials Design: A Comparative Study of Taguchi and Machine Learning Methods
relevance_to_user: 该论文将主动学习与高斯过程回归应用于材料设计中的参数优化，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constraint handling; it focuses on experimental design for additive manufacturing process parameters.

summary_zh.motivation: 材料设计中全因子实验成本高，需高效采样方法。
summary_zh.method: 对比Taguchi正交阵列与基于主动学习的高斯过程回归在WAAM工艺参数优化中的表现。
summary_zh.result: GPR在预测精度和效率上均优于Taguchi方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过15个测试案例评估两种模型的准确性和效率。

summary_en.motivation: Full factorial experiments are impractical in materials design, necessitating efficient sampling strategies.
summary_en.method: This work compares Taguchi orthogonal arrays with an active learning Gaussian process regression model for optimizing weld parameters in wire arc additive manufacturing.
summary_en.result: The GPR model outperforms Taguchi in both prediction accuracy and sampling efficiency across 15 test cases.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on 15 test cases comparing predicted bead geometry metrics against experimental measurements.

title: Conformal Mixed-Integer Constraint Learning with Feasibility Guarantees
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的约束学习方法可用于植入物设计优化中的可行性保证，但未涉及生物力学或有限元代理模型。

summary_en.motivation: To address the issue of data-driven constraints violating true constraints in optimization problems.
summary_en.method: Proposes Conformal Mixed-Integer Constraint Learning (C-MICL) that integrates conformal prediction to provide probabilistic feasibility guarantees.
summary_en.result: Achieves target feasibility rates on real-world applications while maintaining competitive objective performance and reducing computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Validated on multiple real-world optimization problems demonstrating feasibility guarantees.

why_not_core: This paper does not cover porous structure design, stress shielding matching, LPBF fabrication, fatigue testing, or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 糖尿病条件下骨修复困难，需要兼具抗氧化和促骨整合的可降解植入物。
summary_zh.method: 开发Zn-Li-Sr三元合金，通过合金化提升力学性能和抗氧化能力。
summary_zh.result: 合金显著提高抗拉强度，促进成骨细胞增殖分化，体内实现骨整合。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和体内动物模型验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address poor bone healing under diabetic conditions by developing biodegradable implants with antioxidant and pro-osseointegration properties.
summary_en.method: A novel Zn-Li-Sr ternary alloy was designed and characterized for mechanical strength, degradation behavior, and biological performance.
summary_en.result: The alloy exhibited up to 6 times higher UTS and 8 times higher YS than pure Zn, promoted osteoblast proliferation and differentiation, and enhanced bone ingrowth in vivo.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays and in vivo animal implantation studies were conducted.

title: Discovery of Probabilistic Dirichlet-to-Neumann Maps on Graphs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种在图上学习Dirichlet-to-Neumann映射的概率方法，具有不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学中的多物理场耦合问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, bone remodeling, or contact mechanics; it focuses on graph-based PDE coupling without direct biomechanics application.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多物理场耦合中界面条件学习的数据稀缺问题
summary_zh.method: 结合离散外微分和高斯过程，在图上学习Dirichlet-to-Neumann映射
summary_zh.result: 在数据稀缺下仍保持高精度和校准的不确定性估计
summary_zh.validation: 通过地下裂缝网络和动脉血流两个模拟案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To learn Dirichlet-to-Neumann maps on graphs under data scarcity while enforcing conservation laws and providing uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: Combines discrete exterior calculus with Gaussian processes and maximum likelihood estimation to infer vertex-edge relationships with kernel complexity penalty.
summary_en.result: The method achieves high accuracy and well-calibrated uncertainty estimates even with severely limited observations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two simulation case studies: subsurface fracture networks and arterial blood flow.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及多孔钛合金的应力屏蔽缓解和羟基磷灰石涂层促进骨整合，与AM生物医学方向直接相关。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication (uses spacer holder method), no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or as-built morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统钛植入体刚度高导致应力屏蔽，需优化力学与生物相容性。
summary_zh.method: 以NaCl为造孔剂烧结多孔钛，并等离子喷涂羟基磷灰石涂层。
summary_zh.result: 多孔钛弹性模量降至16-23 GPa，接近皮质骨，细胞存活率>70%。
summary_zh.validation: XRD、SEM、压缩测试及体外细胞毒性实验。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional titanium implants cause stress shielding due to high stiffness, necessitating improved mechanical and biological compatibility.
summary_en.method: Porous titanium was fabricated using NaCl as a spacer via elution and sintering at 1250°C, followed by plasma-sprayed hydroxyapatite coating.
summary_en.result: Elastic moduli of porous titanium ranged from 16.37 to 22.56 GPa, matching cortical bone, and in vitro cell viability exceeded 70%.
summary_en.validation: Structural integrity was validated by XRD, SEM, and compression testing; biocompatibility by in vitro cytotoxicity assays with osteoblast cells.

title: PMNO: A novel physics guided multi-step neural operator predictor for partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种物理引导的多步神经算子方法，可提高长期预测的稳定性和外推能力，对生物力学FEA替代建模有潜在借鉴价值。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant-related FEA problems; no uncertainty quantification; no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子外推能力差且依赖大数据，需改进长期预测性能。
summary_zh.method: 提出PMNO框架，用多步历史输入和BDF隐式时间步进，结合因果训练策略。
summary_zh.result: 在多个物理系统上实现高精度长期预测，且具有分辨率不变性。
summary_zh.validation: 在2D线性系统、不规则域、波动和反应扩散方程上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators suffer from poor extrapolation and heavy data dependence, motivating a more stable and data-efficient approach for long-horizon predictions.
summary_en.method: PMNO integrates multi-step historical inputs and an implicit BDF time-stepping scheme during backpropagation, with a causal training strategy for end-to-end optimization.
summary_en.result: The proposed predictor achieves superior long-term accuracy and resolution invariance across diverse physical systems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on 2D linear systems, irregular domains, wave dynamics, and reaction-diffusion processes.

title: Principled Input-Output-Conditioned Post-Hoc Uncertainty Estimation for Regression Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无需访问模型参数的后验不确定性量化方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性估计。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or biomechanical implant design, and lacks validation on engineering simulation benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经网络常忽略不确定性估计，后验方法需访问参数或梯度，实用性受限。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于输入和冻结模型输出的辅助模型框架，通过最大似然估计实现精确后验不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 使用多样辅助数据显著提升OOD检测和指标性能，验证了模型输出包含可泛化的误差信息。
summary_zh.validation: 在玩具问题、UCI和深度回归基准上验证，并与基线方法对比。

summary_en.motivation: Uncertainty quantification is often omitted from neural networks due to performance trade-offs, and existing post-hoc methods require access to model parameters or gradients, limiting practical applicability.
summary_en.method: A theoretically grounded post-hoc uncertainty estimation framework is proposed, which fits an auxiliary model to both original inputs and frozen model outputs, recovering canonical MLE of Gaussian parameters without sampling.
summary_en.result: Using diverse auxiliary data, such as augmented training subsets, significantly improves OOD detection and metric performance, confirming that frozen outputs contain generalizable latent information about model error.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on toy problems, UCI benchmarks, and depth regression tasks, demonstrating proper input-dependent uncertainty estimation.

summary_en.motivation: Titanium implants face risks of bacterial infection and insufficient osseointegration, motivating the development of multifunctional surface textures.

summary_en.motivation: To understand how native ECM properties of NSCLC influence tumor behavior and drug response using biomimetic 3D models.
summary_en.method: A tunable 3D bioprinted model was constructed using light-based bioprinting to replicate interfacial structures and matrix stiffness of tumor and normal tissue.
summary_en.result: Reduced CCN1 expression in soft matrices attenuated tumor cell migration and proliferation.
summary_en.validation: Patient-derived bioprinted tissues validated model fidelity and predictive potential for combined chemo-immunotherapy responses.

why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication details, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no surface roughness or as-built morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估3D打印负泊松比多孔骨盆假体在肿瘤切除后的长期临床效果。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析12例患者，使用定制3D打印骨盆假体进行重建。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate long-term clinical outcomes of 3D-printed custom hemipelvic prostheses with auxetic porous structures after pelvic tumor resection.

summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up over a median of 48 months assessed oncological, functional, and radiographic outcomes.

title: Cell/Surface Interactions and Osseointegration of Ti-6AI-4V: Effects of Laser Microgrooves, Hydroxyapatite Nanorods, and Arginyl-Glycyl-Aspartic Acid (RGD) on Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.method: 制备激光微槽、羟基磷灰石涂层和RGD功能化三种表面，评估其对成骨细胞行为的影响

summary_en.motivation: To enhance osseointegration of Ti-6Al-4V implants through surface modifications combining laser microgrooves, hydroxyapatite, and RGD peptide.
summary_en.method: Three surface profiles (laser-grooved, HA-coated, and RGD-functionalized HA-coated) were fabricated and evaluated for hFOB cell attachment, spreading, proliferation, and ECM formation over 28 days.
summary_en.result: The RGD-functionalized HA-coated surface exhibited the highest cell density, areal coverage, and metabolic activity, especially during early culture stages.

title: DiffPINN: Generative diffusion-initialized physics-informed neural networks for accelerating seismic wavefield representation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于扩散模型初始化PINN参数的方法，可加速不同速度模型下的波场模拟，其思想可迁移至生物力学中不同植入物几何或材料参数下的快速FEA代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on seismic wavefield modeling, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical FEA application; no experimental validation or UQ is provided.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速PINN在不同速度模型下的重训练过程
summary_zh.method: 利用潜扩散模型生成PINN参数初始化向量，经自编码器解码为完整网络参数
summary_zh.result: 显著加速训练，在分布内和分布外速度场景下均保持高精度
summary_zh.validation: 在数值地震波场基准上验证，对比标准PINN训练

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the retraining of PINNs for seismic wavefield modeling under varying velocity models.
summary_en.method: A latent diffusion model generates PINN parameter vectors conditioned on velocity models, which are decoded by an autoencoder into full network parameters for initialization.
summary_en.result: The proposed method significantly reduces training time while maintaining high accuracy for both in-distribution and out-of-distribution velocity scenarios.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical seismic wavefield benchmarks, comparing training speed and accuracy against standard PINN training.

title: A Framework for Nonlinearly-Constrained Gradient-Enhanced Local Bayesian Optimization with Comparisons to Quasi-Newton Optimizers
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种处理非线性约束的贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA-based biomechanical design or implant optimization, nor does it include uncertainty quantification beyond standard Bayesian optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有贝叶斯优化方法缺乏对非线性约束的有效处理。
summary_zh.method: 提出两种基于精确增广拉格朗日和采集函数约束的局部贝叶斯优化方法。
summary_zh.result: 新方法在非线性约束问题上收敛更深，且比拟牛顿法更高效。
summary_zh.validation: 在2至30维的非线性约束单峰问题上与拟牛顿法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing Bayesian optimization methods are limited in handling nonlinear constraints, especially equality constraints.
summary_en.method: Two methods are developed: one using an exact augmented Lagrangian and another augmenting the acquisition function with additional constraints, both integrated with gradient-enhanced Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.result: Both methods achieve deeper convergence on nonlinear constrained problems and require fewer function evaluations than quasi-Newton optimizers for problems with 2 to 30 variables.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on three nonlinearly-constrained unimodal optimization problems compared against SciPy and MATLAB quasi-Newton solvers.

title: Neuro-Symbolic Operator for Interpretable and Generalizable Characterization of Complex Piezoelectric Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的神经符号算子框架可推广到生物力学有限元代理建模，但其应用领域为压电系统，未涉及植入物设计或生物力学约束。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical application; it focuses on piezoelectric hysteresis characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决神经算子可解释性和泛化性不足的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出神经符号算子框架，结合傅里叶神经算子与稀疏模型发现
summary_zh.result: 在压电滞回预测上优于现有方法，且对噪声和低保真数据鲁棒
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准上对比多种评价指标

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the lack of interpretability and poor generalization of neural operators for characterizing complex piezoelectric systems.
summary_en.method: A neuro-symbolic operator framework that first learns a Fourier neural operator and then discovers sparse analytical models via library-based regression.
summary_en.result: The proposed method accurately predicts voltage-displacement hysteresis, including butterfly-shaped curves, and outperforms state-of-the-art neural operators and model discovery methods.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks with noisy and low-fidelity data, using multiple evaluation metrics.

title: FeasibilityStudy of Bioactive Hydrogel Coatings onTi-6Al‑4V Gyroid Scaffolds for Bone Tissue Engineering
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了多孔钛支架的应力屏蔽问题，并采用水凝胶涂层改善力学匹配和生物活性，与用户方向相关但缺乏疲劳测试和表面形貌分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not include LPBF fabrication, fatigue testing, or as-built surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 钛合金支架刚度高导致应力屏蔽，需降低弹性模量并模拟细胞外基质。
summary_zh.method: 在Gyroid钛支架上涂覆含45S5生物活性玻璃的海藻酸钠-明胶水凝胶。
summary_zh.result: 水凝胶涂层增强了力学性能和粘附强度，并渗透入支架内部。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和粘附强度实验验证涂层性能。

summary_en.motivation: Titanium alloy scaffolds cause stress shielding due to high stiffness, necessitating porous designs and bioactive coatings to mimic the extracellular matrix.
summary_en.method: Gyroid Ti-6Al-4V scaffolds were coated with an alginate-gelatin hydrogel incorporating 45S5 bioactive glass to enhance mechanical properties and adhesion.
summary_en.result: The bioactive hydrogel coating improved mechanical strength and adhesion, and successfully penetrated the gyroid scaffold structure.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and adhesion strength measurements were performed to validate the coating performance.

summary_en.motivation: Titanium alloy scaffolds cause stress shielding due to high stiffness, requiring porous designs and bioactive coatings to mimic bone extracellular matrix.
summary_en.method: Gyroid Ti-6Al-4V scaffolds were coated with an alginate-gelatin hydrogel incorporating 45S5 bioactive glass to improve mechanical and adhesive properties.
summary_en.result: Bioactive glass enhanced hydrogel mechanical strength and adhesion, and the hydrogel penetrated the gyroid structure.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and adhesion strength measurements validated the coating performance.

title: Constrained Bayesian Optimization under Bivariate Gaussian Process with Application to Cure Process Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种考虑目标与约束函数相关性的约束贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的多约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, lacks uncertainty quantification beyond Gaussian process variance, and does not validate on any biomedical or implant design problem.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有约束贝叶斯优化假设目标与约束独立，不适用于实际相关场景。
summary_zh.method: 采用双变量高斯过程建模目标与约束的相关性，并推导约束期望改进采集函数。
summary_zh.result: 在制造固化过程优化中展示了方法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过一个制造案例验证了方法的性能。

summary_en.motivation: Existing constrained Bayesian optimization assumes independence between objective and constraint functions, which is unrealistic in many applications.
summary_en.method: A bivariate Gaussian process is used to model the dependence between objective and constraint, and a constrained expected improvement acquisition function is derived.
summary_en.result: The proposed method demonstrates improved optimization performance on a cure process optimization problem in manufacturing.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a single manufacturing case study without comparison to other constrained BO methods.

title: Challenges and perspectives in using finite element modeling to advance 3D bioprinting.
first_author_affiliation: Institute of Continuum Mechanics and Biomechanics, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg, 90762 Fürth, Germany.

corresponding_authors.name: Silvia Budday
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Continuum Mechanics and Biomechanics, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg, 90762 Fürth, Germany.

relevance_to_user: 该综述系统总结了有限元方法在挤出式生物打印三个关键阶段的应用，与AI生物打印方向相关，但未涉及AI/ML集成。
why_not_core: This paper is a review of FEM in bioprinting, not an AI-driven method; it lacks experimental validation and does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述有限元方法在挤出式生物打印中的应用，以克服实验难以获取的参数限制。
summary_zh.method: 系统回顾FEM在生物打印前、中、后三个阶段的应用案例。
summary_zh.result: FEM可预测组织构建物力学性能，但难以完全捕捉动态多尺度过程。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: To systematically review the applications of finite element modeling in extrusion-based bioprinting across pre-, during-, and post-printing stages, addressing experimentally inaccessible parameters.
summary_en.method: A comprehensive literature review of FEM simulations applied to bioprinting process optimization and tissue construct prediction.
summary_en.result: FEM enables prediction of mechanical properties and internal stress distributions, but current models are limited in capturing real-time cell-matrix interactions and bioink dynamics.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a review of existing simulation studies.

title: Adaptive Correction for Ensuring Conservation Laws in Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种自适应校正方法，确保神经算子输出满足守恒定律，可迁移到生物力学有限元代理模型中处理物理约束。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification, and is validated only on PDE benchmarks without biomedical or implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经算子常违反守恒定律，现有方法限制模型灵活性。
summary_zh.method: 提出轻量级可学习算子，在训练中自适应校正输出以满足守恒律。
summary_zh.result: 显著提升基线模型的精度和稳定性，优于现有守恒强制技术。
summary_zh.validation: 在多种神经算子架构和PDE基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators often violate conservation laws, and existing enforcement methods limit model flexibility.
summary_en.method: A lightweight learnable operator is introduced to adaptively correct outputs during training to strictly enforce target conservation laws.
summary_en.result: The method significantly improves accuracy and stability of baseline models, outperforming existing conservation-enforcement techniques on PDE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated across multiple neural operator architectures and representative PDEs.

title: Neural Interpretable PDEs: Harmonizing Fourier Insights with Attention for Scalable and Interpretable Physics Discovery
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种新的神经算子架构，可高效学习物理系统，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计中的约束优化或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics/implant design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高神经算子对物理系统的学习效率和可解释性
summary_zh.method: 结合线性注意力和傅里叶空间可学习核网络的神经算子架构
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准上超越现有方法，实现可扩展且可解释的物理学习
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准数据集上进行数值实验

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the scalability and interpretability of neural operators for learning physical systems from limited data.
summary_en.method: Proposes NIPS, a neural operator that combines linear attention with a learnable kernel network acting as channel-independent convolution in Fourier space.
summary_en.result: NIPS consistently outperforms NAO and other baselines on diverse PDE benchmarks, achieving efficient and interpretable physics learning.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical benchmarks for PDE learning, including Burgers', Darcy flow, and Navier-Stokes equations.

title: JAPAN: Joint Adaptive Prediction Areas with Normalising-Flows
relevance_to_user: 该方法提供了一种基于归一化流的共形预测框架，可生成自适应预测区域，适用于需要不确定性量化的代理模型，但尚未在生物力学或植入物设计中进行验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constrained optimization; it focuses on general uncertainty quantification for regression and forecasting.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有共形预测方法在处理多模态分布时预测区域过于保守且形状受限。
summary_zh.method: 提出JAPAN框架，利用归一化流估计密度并基于密度分数构建自适应预测区域。
summary_zh.result: 在多元回归和预测任务中，JAPAN实现了更紧凑的预测区域且保持有限样本覆盖保证。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个多元回归和预测数据集上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Existing conformal prediction methods produce overly conservative prediction regions that fail to capture complex multimodal distributions due to reliance on residual-based conformity scores.
summary_en.method: JAPAN uses normalizing flows to estimate predictive density and constructs prediction areas by thresholding density scores, enabling compact and context-adaptive regions.
summary_en.result: Empirical results on multivariate regression and forecasting tasks show that JAPAN yields tighter prediction regions with good calibration compared to baselines.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard multivariate regression and forecasting datasets.

summary_en.motivation: To address the blind deconvolution challenge in populational inverse problems where the observational noise distribution is unknown.
summary_en.method: A modified gradient descent algorithm jointly optimizes physical model parameters and a parameterized noise distribution, coupled with an active learning scheme using adaptive empirical measures to train a surrogate model.
summary_en.result: The methodology successfully recovers parameter distributions and noise models in porous medium flow, damped elastodynamics, and simplified atmospheric dynamics.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical simulation cases on three distinct physical systems.

title: BlastOFormer: Attention and Neural Operator Deep Learning Methods for Explosive Blast Prediction
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于Transformer的代理模型用于爆炸压力场预测，其网格到网格的注意力架构和SDF编码方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context; it focuses on blast pressure prediction in structural safety.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统爆炸压力预测方法在速度与精度之间难以平衡，需要快速准确的替代模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出BlastOFormer，基于SDF编码和网格注意力架构的Transformer代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 模型在R2得分上达到0.9516，推理速度比CFD快60万倍。
summary_zh.validation: 使用blastFoam生成的数值数据集进行基准测试，与CNN和FNO对比。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional blast pressure prediction methods suffer from a trade-off between speed and accuracy, motivating the need for a fast and accurate surrogate model.
summary_en.method: BlastOFormer is proposed, a Transformer-based surrogate model using signed distance function encoding and a grid-to-grid attention architecture inspired by OFormer and ViT.
summary_en.result: The model achieves an R2 score of 0.9516 and inference speed over 600,000 times faster than CFD simulations.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated on a numerical dataset generated by the blastFoam CFD solver, comparing against CNN and FNO baselines.

title: S$^2$GPT-PINNs: Sparse and Small models for PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种稀疏小模型方法用于求解参数化PDE，其高效性和领域定制化思路可迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant mechanics problems; no uncertainty quantification; no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN模型参数多、计算成本高的问题
summary_zh.method: 通过知识蒸馏和自适应下采样构建稀疏小模型S$^2$GPT-PINN
summary_zh.result: 在保持精度的同时大幅减少参数量和计算量
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准测试上验证效率与精度

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost and parameter count of PINNs while maintaining accuracy for parametric PDEs.
summary_en.method: Proposes S$^2$GPT-PINN, a sparse and small model using knowledge distillation from pre-trained PINNs and adaptive down-sampling of physics-informed loss points.
summary_en.result: Achieves orders of magnitude fewer parameters and computational cost with comparable or better accuracy on benchmark PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard parametric PDE benchmarks (e.g., Burgers', Poisson, etc.) with numerical error metrics.

title: PIGPVAE: Physics-Informed Gaussian Process Variational Autoencoders
relevance_to_user: 该方法将物理约束融入生成模型，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的少数据学习，但未涉及有限元或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no implant or biomechanics context, no uncertainty quantification for surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决有限数据下生成模型训练困难的问题
summary_zh.method: 在VAE中嵌入物理模型并引入高斯过程变分自编码器处理未建模动态
summary_zh.result: 在室内温度数据上达到最优性能，并能生成分布外样本
summary_zh.validation: 通过室内温度数据集验证生成质量与分布外鲁棒性

summary_en.motivation: To enable generative models to learn from limited data by incorporating physical constraints.
summary_en.method: Extends VAE with a physical model in the generative process and a latent Gaussian Process VAE to capture unmodeled dynamics.
summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on indoor temperature data and generates realistic samples under distribution shifts.
summary_en.validation: Validated on indoor temperature dataset, comparing against baselines and testing out-of-distribution generation.
