title: Optimal Conformal Prediction under Epistemic Uncertainty
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的共形预测方法可用于不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元代理模型或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, expensive simulation sampling, or biomechanical design constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 将二阶预测器融入共形预测框架以处理认知不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 提出伯努利预测集，在二阶预测有效时实现条件覆盖。
summary_zh.result: 伯努利预测集在给定二阶预测时产生最小预测集，并退化为自适应预测集。
summary_zh.validation: 理论推导与风险控制扩展。

summary_en.motivation: To incorporate second-order predictors into conformal prediction for representing epistemic uncertainty.
summary_en.method: Introduces Bernoulli prediction sets that achieve conditional coverage given valid second-order predictions.
summary_en.result: Bernoulli prediction sets yield the smallest prediction sets and reduce to adaptive prediction sets under first-order predictions.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical derivation and extension to conformal risk control for marginal coverage guarantees.

title: Scalable Deep Basis Kernel Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种可扩展的高斯过程回归方法，在不确定性量化和计算效率方面有优势，可迁移至生物力学代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to any FEA or biomechanics design problem, nor does it address constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高斯过程在大规模数据上的核学习与可扩展性问题
summary_zh.method: 提出基于深度基核的低秩结构，实现线性复杂度推理
summary_zh.result: 在多个大规模回归基准上预测精度和不确定性量化优于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 在标准回归基准数据集上进行数值实验

summary_en.motivation: To achieve scalable and expressive kernel learning for Gaussian processes on large datasets while maintaining tractable inference.
summary_en.method: A deep basis kernel (DBK) is constructed from a small set of neural-network-parameterized basis functions with explicit low-rank structure, enabling linear-complexity inference.
summary_en.result: DBKs demonstrate superior predictive accuracy, uncertainty quantification, and computational efficiency across large-scale regression benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Empirical evaluation on multiple standard regression benchmark datasets.

title: Learning Fluid-Structure Interaction with Physics-Informed Machine Learning and Immersed Boundary Methods
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的欧拉-拉格朗日PINN架构可迁移至生物力学中流固耦合问题的代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no uncertainty quantification, and no constraint handling for design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统PINN难以同时捕捉流固耦合中流体和结构的物理特性。
summary_zh.method: 提出欧拉-拉格朗日PINN架构，分别用两个网络处理流体和结构域，并通过物理约束耦合。
summary_zh.result: 在二维腔流问题中，压力误差从12.9%降至2.39%，精度提升24.1-91.4%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过二维移动固体腔流数值算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Unified PINN architectures struggle to capture distinct physics of fluid and structural domains in fluid-structure interaction problems with moving boundaries.
summary_en.method: An Eulerian-Lagrangian PINN architecture is proposed, employing separate neural networks for fluid and structural domains coupled via physics-based constraints, with learnable B-spline activations.
summary_en.result: On a 2D cavity flow with a moving solid, the method reduces pressure errors from 12.9% to 2.39% and improves overall accuracy by 24.1-91.4%.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a 2D numerical simulation case of cavity flow with a moving solid structure.

title: From Proxies to Fields: Spatiotemporal Reconstruction of Global Radiation from Sparse Sensor Sequences
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的时空神经算子架构可用于从稀疏传感器数据重建连续场，其方法可迁移至生物力学中基于稀疏测量重建应力/应变场，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or constrained optimization; it focuses on environmental field reconstruction from sparse data without any biomedical or structural mechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 从稀疏传感器序列重建全局连续场，避免高计算成本或密集传感器网络。
summary_zh.method: 提出时空辐射算子网络(TRON)，一种神经算子架构，从稀疏非均匀代理测量序列推断全局标量场。
summary_zh.result: 在宇宙辐射剂量重建中，相对L2误差低于0.1%，推理速度比蒙特卡洛方法快58000倍。
summary_zh.validation: 基于22年模拟数据训练，在65341个空间位置和8400天数据上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Reconstructing continuous global fields from sparse and indirect observations to overcome the high cost and latency of physics-based simulators or dense sensor networks.
summary_en.method: The Temporal Radiation Operator Network (TRON), a spatiotemporal neural operator, learns to map sequences of sparse, non-uniform proxy measurements to continuous global scalar fields.
summary_en.result: TRON achieves sub-second inference with relative L2 errors below 0.1% on global cosmic radiation dose reconstruction, a >58,000X speedup over Monte Carlo estimators.
summary_en.validation: Trained on 22 years of simulation data and validated across 65,341 spatial locations and 8,400 days with varying sequence lengths.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Schematic overview of the inverse dose estimation framework. (a) Primary cosmic rays interact with the atmosphere, producing secondary particles through electromagnetic and hadronic cascades. Neutron monitors detect these as indirect proxies of radiation exposure. (b) TRON learns a spatiotemporal mapping ℋ \mathcal{H} from temporal neutron counts ( 𝐘 \mathbf{Y} ) to effective dose fields ( 𝐗 \mathbf{X} ), enabling real-time reconstruction without traditional simulation.

title: Degradation-Aware and Machine Learning-Driven Uncertainty Quantification in Crystal Plasticity Finite Element: Texture-Driven Plasticity in 316L Stainless Steel
relevance_to_user: 该论文将机器学习代理模型与晶体塑性有限元结合进行不确定性量化，方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模与不确定性分析。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on crystal plasticity and texture-driven degradation in stainless steel, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or bone-implant interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化微观结构不确定性对晶体材料退化行为的影响
summary_zh.method: 耦合CPFE与多项式混沌展开代理模型，仅用200次仿真实现高效不确定性量化
summary_zh.result: 代理模型大幅降低计算成本，识别出Cube和Goss织构为退化关键因素
summary_zh.validation: 基于高吞吐EBSD数据校准的RVE仿真验证

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the impact of microstructural uncertainty on degradation-relevant plastic deformation in crystalline materials.
summary_en.method: A machine learning-driven framework coupling high-fidelity crystal plasticity finite element simulations with polynomial chaos expansion surrogate modeling, trained on only 200 simulations.
summary_en.result: The surrogate model reduces computational cost by orders of magnitude compared to Monte Carlo and identifies Cube and Goss texture components as key drivers of degradation.
summary_en.validation: Validation through high-throughput EBSD characterization and CPFE simulations on calibrated representative volume elements.

title: Predictive posterior sampling from non-stationnary Gaussian process priors via Diffusion models with application to climate data
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的扩散模型替代非平稳高斯过程后验采样的方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No FEA or surrogate modeling for biomechanics; application is climate data, not implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 非平稳高斯过程后验采样计算困难，需高效替代方法。
summary_zh.method: 用扩散生成模型替代GP先验，结合无训练引导算法采样后验。
summary_zh.result: 在非平稳GP上验证分布接近，并成功应用于环境科学反问题。
summary_zh.validation: 通过统计指标比较生成分布与GP后验分布。

summary_en.motivation: Sampling from predictive posterior distributions with non-stationary Gaussian process priors is computationally intractable.
summary_en.method: A diffusion generative model replaces the GP prior, and training-free guidance algorithms sample the posterior.
summary_en.result: The generated distributions closely match the GP posterior, and the method achieves state-of-the-art predictions in environmental inverse problems.
summary_en.validation: Statistical metrics compare the diffusion-based posterior samples to exact GP posterior samples.

title: Multiphysics Bench: Benchmarking and Investigating Scientific Machine Learning for Multiphysics PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提供了多物理场PDE求解的基准数据集和ML方法评估，对FEA代理建模有参考价值，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification, and no demonstration on design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有ML求解PDE研究多集中于单物理场，缺乏多物理场基准。
summary_zh.method: 构建首个通用多物理场数据集Multiphysics Bench，系统评估多种ML求解器。
summary_zh.result: 现有ML求解器在多物理场问题上表现不佳，提出改进技巧。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个多物理场PDE算例上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Machine learning for PDEs has focused on single-field problems, neglecting the coupled nature of real-world multiphysics systems.
summary_en.method: We introduce the first comprehensive multiphysics PDE dataset, Multiphysics Bench, and systematically evaluate representative ML solvers including PINNs, FNO, DeepONet, and DiffusionPDE.
summary_en.result: Existing ML solvers perform poorly on multiphysics problems, and we provide insights and practical tricks to improve their effectiveness.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on a diverse set of multiphysics PDE problems with varying coupling types and complexities.

title: Deep Operator Neural Network Model Predictive Control
relevance_to_user: 该论文将深度算子网络用于模型预测控制，其多步预测和自动超参数选择方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on control systems and does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决标准DeepONet在模型预测控制中多步预测效率低的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出MS-DeepONet架构，一次性计算多步输入序列对应的多步输出预测。
summary_zh.result: 在多个非线性基准系统上，MS-DeepONet在学习和预测控制任务中优于标准DeepONet。
summary_zh.validation: 通过van der Pol振荡器、四水箱和倒立摆系统的仿真验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of DeepONet-based model predictive control by enabling one-shot multi-step predictions.
summary_en.method: A multi-step DeepONet (MS-DeepONet) architecture is proposed that directly maps multi-step input sequences to multi-step output predictions.
summary_en.result: MS-DeepONet consistently outperforms the standard DeepONet in learning and control tasks on nonlinear benchmark systems.
summary_en.validation: Simulation case studies on van der Pol oscillator, quadruple tank, and cart-pendulum systems.

title: Multivariate Latent Recalibration for Conditional Normalizing Flows
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的潜在重校准方法可提升条件归一化流的多元分布预测校准性，对代理模型的不确定性量化有借鉴意义。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or expensive simulation sampling efficiency; it focuses on post-hoc recalibration of normalizing flows for general multivariate prediction.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有重校准方法局限于单变量，缺乏对多元条件分布校准性的评估与改进。
summary_zh.method: 提出潜在校准概念及潜在重校准方法，在条件归一化流的潜空间学习变换以提升校准性。
summary_zh.result: 在表格和图像数据集上，该方法持续降低了潜在校准误差和负对数似然。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数据集上通过数值实验验证校准误差和似然改进。

summary_en.motivation: Existing recalibration methods are limited to univariate settings and do not provide full multivariate density functions with calibration guarantees.
summary_en.method: This work introduces latent calibration and a post-hoc latent recalibration method that learns a transformation in the latent space of a conditional normalizing flow, yielding a recalibrated multivariate density with finite-sample bounds.
summary_en.result: Experiments on tabular and image datasets show consistent improvement in latent calibration error and negative log-likelihood.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard tabular and image benchmarks using numerical metrics for calibration and likelihood.

title: Acoustic holographic assembly of cell-dense tissue constructs.
first_author_affiliation: Max Planck Institute for Medical Research, Jahnstr. 29, 69120 Heidelberg, Germany.; Institute for Molecular Systems Engineering and Advanced Materials, Heidelberg University, Im Neuenheimer Feld 225, 69120 Heidelberg, Germany.

corresponding_authors.name: Kai Melde
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Max Planck Institute for Medical Research, Jahnstr. 29, 69120 Heidelberg, Germany.; Institute for Molecular Systems Engineering and Advanced Materials, Heidelberg University, Im Neuenheimer Feld 225, 69120 Heidelberg, Germany.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及声学全息组装技术用于生物制造，但未集成AI或机器学习方法。
why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it is purely a physical assembly method without autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有生物制造方法难以同时实现高细胞密度、大尺寸和可控几何形状。
summary_zh.method: 提出声学全息组装（AHA）方案，利用紧凑型台式仪器在明胶甲基丙烯酰水凝胶中快速组装细胞。
summary_zh.result: 成功组装厘米级分支状细胞致密结构，细胞密度达4000万/ml，存活率90.5%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过细胞培养和灌注实验验证了细胞活性和生长。

summary_en.motivation: Current biofabrication methods cannot simultaneously achieve high cell density, large size, and controllable geometry for tissue constructs.
summary_en.method: An acoustic holographic assembly (AHA) scheme is presented using a compact benchtop instrument to rapidly assemble cells in gelatin methacryloyl (GelMA) hydrogel.
summary_en.result: Centimeter-scale branch-shaped constructs with an average cell density of 40 million cells/ml and high viability (90.5%) were fabricated and cultured for five days.
summary_en.validation: In vitro culture with perfusion confirmed cell viability and growth within the hydrogel.

title: A practical guide to hydrogel working curves for bioprinting
first_author_affiliation: Applied Chemicals and Materials Division, National Institute of Standards and Technology, Boulder, CO USA

corresponding_authors.name: Rion J. Wendland
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Applied Chemicals and Materials Division, National Institute of Standards and Technology, Boulder, CO USA

corresponding_authors.name: Jason P. Killgore
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Applied Chemicals and Materials Division, National Institute of Standards and Technology, Boulder, CO USA

relevance_to_user: 该论文提供了水凝胶工作曲线的测量指南，但未涉及AI集成或自主决策，仅作为生物打印质量控制的基础背景。
why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage, lacks experimental validation of AI models, and does not advance towards autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 水凝胶工作曲线测量缺乏标准化，需要系统评估方法。
summary_zh.method: 对比接触式与非接触式测量方法，分析水凝胶的Jacobs模型行为。
summary_zh.result: 水凝胶在适当测量下呈现近理想对数线性行为，光学方法优于机械方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多种配方和分子量的实验验证测量方法的准确性。

summary_en.motivation: Hydrogel working curve measurements lack standardization, necessitating a systematic evaluation of measurement techniques.
summary_en.method: Various contact and non-contact measurement modalities were compared to assess hydrogel cure depth behavior against the Jacobs model.
summary_en.result: Hydrogels exhibit near-ideal log-linear behavior consistent with the Jacobs model when measured optically, while contact methods introduce systematic errors.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation across multiple hydrogel formulations with varying molecular weights and solids content confirmed the findings.

title: FR-Mamba: Time-Series Physical Field Reconstruction Based on State Space Model
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合傅里叶神经算子和状态空间模型的时空场重建方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的物理场重建任务。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics and does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical FEA validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有深度学习方法难以捕捉长时间依赖，导致时变物理场重建效果不佳。
summary_zh.method: 提出FR-Mamba框架，融合傅里叶神经算子与状态空间模型Mamba，分别提取全局空间特征和长时依赖。
summary_zh.result: 在流场重建任务中，该方法在长序列上显著优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准流场数值基准数据集上进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing deep learning methods struggle to capture long-range temporal dependencies in time-evolving physical systems, leading to suboptimal reconstruction performance.
summary_en.method: FR-Mamba integrates a Fourier Neural Operator for global spatial feature extraction and a state space model (Mamba) for efficient long-range temporal modeling with linear complexity.
summary_en.result: The proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on long-sequence flow field reconstruction tasks, outperforming existing methods.
summary_en.validation: Extensive experiments on numerical benchmark datasets for flow field reconstruction demonstrate the method's superiority.

title: Equivariant Eikonal Neural Networks: Grid-Free, Scalable Travel-Time Prediction on Homogeneous Spaces
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的等变神经网络方法可推广到生物力学中的旅行时间预测，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on Eikonal travel-time prediction on homogeneous spaces.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高Eikonal方程求解的效率和可扩展性
summary_zh.method: 将等变神经场与物理信息神经网络结合，通过潜变量条件化建模
summary_zh.result: 在2D、3D和球形基准数据集上优于现有神经算子方法
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准数据集上验证精度和可扩展性

summary_en.motivation: To achieve scalable and grid-free travel-time prediction on homogeneous spaces with improved representation efficiency.
summary_en.method: Integrates Equivariant Neural Fields with Physics-Informed Neural Networks, conditioning a shared backbone on latent point clouds in a Lie group.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决深度神经网络过拟合和校准差的问题。
summary_zh.method: 将SGHMC提议集成到SMC中，提出SMCSGHMC算法进行贝叶斯采样。
summary_zh.result: 在分类、OOD检测和迁移学习上优于SGD和深度集成。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准图像分类基准上评估校准和OOD检测性能。

summary_en.motivation: To address overfitting and poor calibration in deep neural networks by scalable Bayesian uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: Proposes SMCSGHMC, a sequential Monte Carlo algorithm with stochastic gradient Hamiltonian Monte Carlo proposals for mini-batch based sampling.
summary_en.result: Outperforms standard SGD and deep ensembles on image classification, out-of-distribution detection, and transfer learning tasks.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on standard image classification benchmarks for calibration and OOD detection.

key_terms.zh: 随机梯度哈密顿蒙特卡洛

title: FP64 is All You Need: Rethinking Failure Modes in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文揭示了PINN训练失败的根本原因是浮点精度不足，而非局部极小值，这对提高PINN在生物力学代理模型中的可靠性有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant design, does not handle constraints or uncertainty quantification, and lacks any biomedical or biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 揭示PINN失败模式的根本原因，而非归咎于局部极小值。
summary_zh.method: 通过对比FP32与FP64精度下LBFGS优化器的收敛行为，分析训练动态。
summary_zh.result: FP64精度可消除PINN的失败模式，使标准PINN可靠求解PDE。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准PDE基准上验证精度对收敛的影响。

summary_en.motivation: To identify the true cause of failure modes in Physics-Informed Neural Networks, challenging the prevailing belief that they stem from local minima.
summary_en.method: By comparing the convergence behavior of the LBFGS optimizer under FP32 and FP64 precision, the study reveals a three-stage training dynamic (unconverged, failure, success) that shifts with numerical precision.
summary_en.result: Upgrading to FP64 precision eliminates failure modes, enabling vanilla PINNs to solve PDEs reliably without special techniques.
summary_en.validation: The findings are validated on multiple standard PDE benchmarks, demonstrating that precision-induced stalls, not local minima, are the root cause.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Training Dynamic of PINN’s failure mode case and success case.

title: Enforced Interface Constraints for Domain Decomposition Method of Discrete Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的离散物理信息神经网络与域分解方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，提高大规模复杂几何问题的求解效率。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and focuses on general PDE solving rather than surrogate modeling for expensive simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高物理信息神经网络在域分解中的界面连续性，避免弱约束导致的不稳定预测。
summary_zh.method: 提出强制界面约束的离散PINN框架，基于有限元网格和高斯积分，支持独立子域网格。
summary_zh.result: 二维和三维数值实验验证了精度和并行训练的计算效率提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准数值算例（如泊松方程、弹性问题）验证框架准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To improve interface continuity in domain-decomposed physics-informed neural networks, avoiding unstable predictions caused by weak spatial constraints.
summary_en.method: A discrete PINN framework with enforced interface constraints is proposed, using finite element-style mesh discretization and Gaussian quadrature, allowing independent meshing per subdomain.
summary_en.result: Two- and three-dimensional numerical experiments demonstrate accuracy and computational efficiency gains through parallel training.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated on standard numerical benchmarks including Poisson and elasticity problems.

title: Dual-Balancing for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的双平衡损失加权方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型训练，提升PINN在植入物设计中的收敛速度和精度。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate or implant biomechanics; no uncertainty quantification; no constraint handling beyond PDE/BC/IC.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN训练中多目标损失不平衡导致的精度低和收敛慢问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出双平衡机制，通过间平衡和内部平衡动态调整损失权重。
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE基准上收敛速度和预测精度优于现有梯度加权方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE数值基准上对比多种梯度加权方法。

summary_en.motivation: To address the poor accuracy and slow convergence of vanilla PINNs caused by multi-objective loss imbalance.
summary_en.method: Proposes Dual-Balanced PINN (DB-PINN) with inter-balancing and intra-balancing to dynamically adjust loss weights based on gradient distribution and fitting difficulty.
summary_en.result: DB-PINN achieves superior convergence speed and prediction accuracy on multiple PDE benchmarks compared to popular gradient-based weighting methods.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical PDE benchmarks (e.g., Burgers, Helmholtz) with comparison to state-of-the-art weighting methods.

title: Convergence Rates of Constrained Expected Improvement
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了约束贝叶斯优化中约束期望改进算法的收敛率，其理论分析对代理模型辅助的植入物设计优化具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper provides theoretical convergence rates for constrained expected improvement but does not apply the method to any biomedical or implant design problem, nor does it include any FEA-based validation or uncertainty quantification beyond theoretical bounds.

summary_zh.motivation: 约束期望改进算法缺乏理论收敛率分析
summary_zh.method: 推导了CEI在RKHS和GP假设下的简单遗憾上界
summary_zh.result: 得到了平方指数和Matérn核下的收敛率
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验验证理论结果

summary_en.motivation: The theoretical convergence rate of the constrained expected improvement algorithm has not been established despite its widespread use.
summary_en.method: We derive simple regret upper bounds for CEI under the assumptions that objective and constraint functions lie in an RKHS or are sampled from GPs.
summary_en.result: Convergence rates of O(t^{-1/2} log^{(d+1)/2}(t)) for squared exponential kernels and O(t^{-ν/(2ν+d)} log^{ν/(2ν+d)}(t)) for Matérn kernels (ν>1/2) are obtained.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic benchmark functions validate the theoretical convergence rates.

title: Constrained Preferential Bayesian Optimization and Its Application in Banner Ad Design
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的约束偏好贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的多约束优化问题，但未涉及有限元仿真或生物力学场景。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate, no implant mechanics, no biomechanics context, no uncertainty quantification beyond preference noise.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有偏好贝叶斯优化无法处理实际中的不等式约束。
summary_zh.method: 提出约束偏好贝叶斯优化，设计新的采集函数以探索可行区域。
summary_zh.result: 方法成功找到最优解，并在广告设计用户研究中验证有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验和设计师用户研究验证。

summary_en.motivation: Preferential Bayesian optimization lacks the ability to handle inequality constraints common in real-world optimization tasks.
summary_en.method: We propose constrained preferential Bayesian optimization (CPBO) with a novel acquisition function that balances objective preference and constraint satisfaction.
summary_en.result: CPBO successfully identifies optimal solutions by focusing on feasible regions, demonstrated in both synthetic tests and a designer-in-the-loop banner ad system.
summary_en.validation: Validation includes synthetic benchmark problems and a user study with professional ad designers.

title: Bidirectional Information Flow (BIF) -- A Sample Efficient Hierarchical Gaussian Process for Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的双向信息流分层高斯过程方法可提高贝叶斯优化的采样效率，适用于解决昂贵仿真中的采样问题，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on unconstrained Bayesian optimization for neurostimulation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高分层高斯过程在贝叶斯优化中的采样效率
summary_zh.method: 提出双向信息流框架，实现父模型与子模型之间的双向信息交换
summary_zh.result: 在合成和神经刺激优化任务中，R²分数提升高达4倍和3倍
summary_zh.validation: 在合成数据和真实神经刺激优化任务上验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve sample efficiency in hierarchical Gaussian process Bayesian optimization by enabling bidirectional information exchange between parent and child models.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Bidirectional Information Flow (BIF) framework that establishes top-down feedback from parent to child GPs during online learning, complementing the bottom-up information flow.
summary_en.result: BIF achieves up to 4x and 3x higher R² scores for parent and child models respectively on synthetic and real-world neurostimulation optimization tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic benchmarks and a real-world neurostimulation optimization problem.

title: Adaptive Linear Embedding for Nonstationary High-Dimensional Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过自适应线性嵌入处理高维非平稳优化问题，可迁移至植入物设计中的多目标约束优化与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on general Bayesian optimization for high-dimensional black-box functions.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维贝叶斯优化受限于全局低维假设和静态嵌入，无法处理非平稳目标。
summary_zh.method: 提出SA-REMBO，使用多个随机高斯嵌入并通过乘积核联合建模嵌入选择和优化变量。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实高维基准上优于传统REMBO等低秩方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成函数和真实高维优化基准验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization in high dimensions is limited by global low-dimensional assumptions and static embeddings, failing to capture nonstationary objectives.
summary_en.method: SA-REMBO generalizes REMBO by using multiple random Gaussian embeddings and jointly modeling the embedding choice and latent variable via a product kernel in a Gaussian Process.
summary_en.result: The method outperforms traditional REMBO and other low-rank BO methods on synthetic and real-world high-dimensional benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic functions and real-world high-dimensional optimization benchmarks.

title: A Physics-Informed Spatiotemporal Deep Learning Framework for Turbulent Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息时空代理模型方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on turbulent fluid dynamics (Rayleigh-Benard convection) rather than solid mechanics, implant design, or biomechanical FEA, and does not address multi-objective constraints or patient-specific geometry.

summary_zh.motivation: 直接数值模拟湍流系统计算成本过高，需要高效代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 结合卷积神经网络与类大语言模型循环架构，并加入物理信息损失和共形预测不确定性量化。
summary_zh.result: 模型在显著降低计算成本的同时，复现了瑞利-贝纳德对流的关键物理特征。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准（瑞利-贝纳德对流模拟）验证代理模型精度与不确定性。

summary_en.motivation: Direct numerical simulation of turbulent systems is computationally prohibitive, motivating the need for efficient surrogate models.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed spatiotemporal surrogate combining convolutional neural networks for spatial reduction and a recurrent architecture inspired by large language models for temporal dynamics, with PDE-based loss and conformal prediction for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: The model replicates key physical features of Rayleigh-Benard convection while drastically reducing computational cost compared to DNS.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark simulations of Rayleigh-Benard convection, demonstrating accuracy and uncertainty calibration.

title: Development and Comparison of Two 3D-Printed Scaffolds of Biosilica from Marine Sponges for Bone Tissue Engineering
first_author_affiliation: Department of Biosciences, Federal University of São Paulo (UNIFESP), Silva Jardim Street, 136, Santos, SP 11015020, Brazil

corresponding_authors.name: Ana Cláudia Muniz Rennó
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Biosciences, Federal University of São Paulo (UNIFESP), Silva Jardim Street, 136, Santos, SP 11015020, Brazil

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D打印支架的力学性能，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳测试，且材料为生物硅而非金属植入物。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no fatigue testing, no stress shielding analysis, and material is biosilica not biomedical metal alloy.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较两种3D打印生物硅支架的理化与生物学性能。
summary_zh.method: 制备网格与螺旋结构支架，进行SEM、压缩测试及细胞实验。
summary_zh.result: 螺旋结构支架力学强度更高，细胞形态更好。
summary_zh.validation: 压缩测试与细胞粘附实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the physicochemical and biological performance of two 3D-printed biosilica scaffold architectures for bone tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: Grid and gyroid scaffolds were fabricated via 3D printing and characterized by SEM, compression testing, and in vitro cell assays.
summary_en.result: The gyroid scaffold exhibited higher compressive strength and better cell adhesion and morphology than the grid scaffold.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical compression tests and in vitro cell adhesion assays with osteoblastic and fibroblastic cell lines.

title: Crack Path Prediction with Operator Learning using Discrete Particle System data Generation
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用算子学习预测裂纹扩展，方法可迁移至生物力学中的代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on crack propagation in engineering materials.

summary_zh.motivation: 准确预测裂纹扩展对工程结构安全至关重要
summary_zh.method: 使用CPD模拟数据训练DeepONet和Fusion DeepONet预测裂纹
summary_zh.result: Fusion DeepONet在非断裂情况下表现更优，断裂驱动场景仍有挑战
summary_zh.validation: 通过三种不同几何构型的模拟案例验证

summary_en.motivation: Accurate prediction of crack propagation is critical for preventing catastrophic failure in engineering structures.
summary_en.method: Operator learning models (DeepONet and Fusion DeepONet) are trained on data from Constitutively Informed Particle Dynamics simulations to predict time-evolving crack propagation.
summary_en.result: Fusion DeepONet outperforms vanilla DeepONet, especially in non-fracturing cases, while fracture-driven scenarios remain challenging.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on three simulation cases with varying geometries (notch height and hole radius) using discrete particle data.

title: Scaling Gaussian Process Regression with Full Derivative Observations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的可扩展高斯过程方法能够处理全导数观测，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的高效采样与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or multi-objective optimization; it focuses on GP scalability with derivative observations in general regression tasks.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有高斯过程方法难以处理大规模全导数观测数据。
summary_zh.method: 提出DSoftKI，通过局部温度向量改进软最大插值，构建可扩展近似核及其导数。
summary_zh.result: 在合成基准、物理模拟、标准回归和高维分子力场预测中验证了准确性和可扩展性。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个数值基准和实际数据集上测试，包括高维分子力场预测。

summary_en.motivation: Existing Gaussian Process methods struggle to scale to large datasets with full derivative observations.
summary_en.method: DSoftKI extends SoftKI by replacing global temperature with local temperature vectors, enabling scalable kernel approximation including first and second-order derivatives via interpolation.
summary_en.result: The method achieves accurate predictions and scales to larger datasets with derivative observations, demonstrated on synthetic benchmarks, physics simulation, regression datasets, and high-dimensional molecular force fields.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks, a toy n-body physics simulation, standard regression datasets with synthetic gradients, and high-dimensional molecular force field prediction.

title: Mechanical performance of graded lattice structures with periodic density variations fabricated by selective laser melting
first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Soochow University, Suzhou, Jiangsu 215000, China

corresponding_authors.name: Xing Zhang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Soochow University, Suzhou, Jiangsu 215000, China

corresponding_authors.name: Jiaqiang Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Soochow University, Suzhou, Jiangsu 215000, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了通过选择性激光熔化制备的周期性密度梯度晶格结构的力学性能，与用户关注的AM生物医学植入物中的应力屏蔽和刚度匹配相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not include biomedical context, osseointegration, fatigue testing, or surface roughness characterization for implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服传统梯度晶格结构力学性能次优的局限
summary_zh.method: 设计并SLM制备了正弦/余弦周期密度梯度BCC晶格结构
summary_zh.result: 周期梯度结构实现了分段坍塌，能量吸收效率比均匀结构高148%
summary_zh.validation: 准静态压缩实验与形貌表征

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the suboptimal mechanical performance of conventional graded lattice structures with monotonic gradients.
summary_en.method: Body-centered cubic lattice structures with periodic sine-wave and cosine-wave density variations were designed and fabricated via selective laser melting.
summary_en.result: Periodic graded lattice structures exhibited segmented collapse behavior and achieved 148% higher energy absorption efficiency than uniform lattices.
summary_en.validation: Quasi-static compression tests and strut surface morphology analysis were performed.

title: PCS-UQ: Uncertainty Quantification via the Predictability-Computability-Stability Framework
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于PCS框架的不确定性量化方法，可迁移至有限元代理模型中的不确定性量化，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constrained optimization; it focuses on general ML UQ without domain-specific validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统UQ方法对模型误设不鲁棒，共形推断区间过大且未考虑模型选择。
summary_zh.method: 基于PCS框架，通过预测检查筛选模型，结合自助法评估样本变异和算法不稳定性，并设计局部自适应校准。
summary_zh.result: 在17个回归和6个分类数据集上，PCS-UQ达到目标覆盖率且区间宽度比共形方法减少约20%。
summary_zh.validation: 在回归和分类基准数据集以及计算机视觉基准上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional UQ methods are not robust to model misspecification, and conformal inference ignores model selection, leading to large prediction intervals.
summary_en.method: PCS-UQ uses a prediction check to screen models, fits algorithms across multiple bootstraps to assess variability and instability, and proposes a local calibration scheme.
summary_en.result: PCS-UQ achieves desired coverage and reduces interval width by approximately 20% over conformal methods across 17 regression and 6 classification datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks including regression, classification, and computer vision datasets.

title: Extreme Conformal Prediction: Reliable Intervals for High-Impact Events
relevance_to_user: 该方法将极值统计与共形预测结合，可迁移至生物力学设计中高可靠性预测区间的构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant design, or biomechanics; it focuses on extreme quantile regression for high-impact events like flooding.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统共形预测在高置信度下因数据不足产生无限宽区间，需新方法。
summary_zh.method: 融合极值统计与共形预测，利用黑箱极值分位数回归构建可靠预测区间。
summary_zh.result: 在模拟和洪水预测中，新方法在高置信度下提供有限且信息丰富的区间。
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟研究和洪水风险预测应用验证。

summary_en.motivation: Classical conformal prediction yields uninformative infinite intervals when desired confidence is too high relative to calibration data, motivating a new approach.
summary_en.method: We bridge extreme value statistics and conformal prediction to construct reliable prediction intervals with high-confidence coverage using any black-box extreme quantile regression method.
summary_en.result: The proposed extreme conformal prediction method provides finite and informative intervals at high confidence levels, demonstrated in simulation and flood risk forecasting.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via a simulation study and an application to flood risk forecasting.

title: Design and mechanical characterization of TPMS cellular structures additively manufactured by the selective laser melting process for use in intervertebral lumbar cages
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Isfahan University of Technology, Isfahan, 84156-83111, Iran

corresponding_authors.name: Mohammad Reza Reshadinezhad
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Isfahan University of Technology, Isfahan, 84156-83111, Iran

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及TPMS多孔结构的LPBF制造与力学表征，但面向腰椎融合器而非髋关节植入物，且未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: No stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, and the application is intervertebral cages rather than hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 设计并表征用于腰椎融合器的TPMS多孔结构力学性能
summary_zh.method: 采用LPBF制造TPMS多孔结构并进行准静态压缩测试
summary_zh.result: 获得了不同TPMS结构的力学性能数据，评估了其作为椎间融合器的潜力
summary_zh.validation: 通过准静态压缩实验验证力学性能

summary_en.motivation: To design and mechanically characterize TPMS cellular structures fabricated by LPBF for potential use in intervertebral lumbar cages.
summary_en.method: TPMS cellular structures were designed and manufactured via selective laser melting, followed by quasi-static compression testing.
summary_en.result: Mechanical properties of various TPMS structures were obtained, demonstrating their suitability for intervertebral cage applications.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical validation was performed through quasi-static compression experiments.

title: Solving Nonlinear PDEs with Sparse Radial Basis Function Networks
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过稀疏径向基函数网络求解非线性PDE，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及约束优化或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective constrained optimization, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics-specific applications.

summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard PDE benchmarks validate the method's effectiveness and advantages.

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently map microstructure transitions during rapid solidification in a multidimensional parameter space without exhaustive high-fidelity simulations.

summary_en.validation: Phase-field predictions are validated against the classical Kurz-Giovanola-Trivedi (KGT) model for planar interface stability.

summary_en.motivation: To address the high computational cost and difficulty of enforcing physical constraints in conventional data assimilation methods.

summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical simulation of the Madden-Julian Oscillation, comparing against standard EnKF and constrained EnKF.

title: Reduced-order structure-property linkages for stochastic metamaterials

summary_zh.motivation: 解决随机超材料设计空间大、物理仿真计算昂贵的问题。
summary_zh.method: 使用两点相关函数的主成分分析提取特征，结合FFT均匀化和高斯过程回归构建降阶代理模型。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently establish structure-property linkages for stochastic metamaterials with a vast design space, avoiding expensive physics-based simulations.
summary_en.method: Principal component analysis of two-point correlation functions extracts salient features, and Gaussian process regression with active learning builds a reduced-order surrogate mapping unit cell designs to homogenized elastic stiffness.

summary_zh.result: 自适应复制显著提高了求解精度数个数量级，并提升了计算效率。

summary_en.motivation: Stochastic simulation optimization suffers from high objective variance, requiring many evaluations for accurate estimation.
summary_en.method: A trust-region-based Bayesian optimization method with adaptive replication is developed, using modified acquisition functions and cost-aware evaluation strategies to allocate repeated evaluations.

summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments comparing against baseline methods.

title: FigBO: A Generalized Acquisition Function Framework with Look-Ahead Capability for Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种具有前瞻能力的通用采集函数框架，可提升贝叶斯优化的采样效率，对解决昂贵仿真中的采样问题具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraints, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on unconstrained single-objective optimization on synthetic benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有采集函数缺乏前瞻能力，限制了贝叶斯优化的性能。
summary_zh.method: 提出FigBO框架，将候选点对全局信息增益的未来影响融入采集函数。
summary_zh.result: 在多种任务上实现了最先进的性能和更快的收敛速度。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和标准基准函数上进行了数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Myopic acquisition functions in Bayesian optimization lack look-ahead capability, limiting their performance on expensive black-box functions.
summary_en.method: FigBO is proposed as a generalized acquisition function framework that incorporates the future impact of candidate points on global information gain, compatible with most myopic acquisition functions.
summary_en.result: Extensive experiments show that FigBO achieves state-of-the-art performance and significantly faster convergence compared to existing methods.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on diverse synthetic and benchmark optimization tasks.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高两相随机材料应力预测精度及应力图像分辨率，以观察相界应力集中。
summary_zh.method: 提出MC U-net预测低分辨率应力，结合物理信息神经网络SRPINN实现任意倍数超分辨率。

summary_en.motivation: To improve stress prediction accuracy and image resolution for two-phase random materials, enabling observation of stress concentration at phase boundaries.
summary_en.method: A Multiple Compositions U-net (MC U-net) predicts stress at low resolution, and a Mixed Physics-Informed Neural Network (MPINN) based super-resolution method (SRPINN) enhances resolution without paired training data.
summary_en.result: The proposed framework achieves satisfactory accuracy and generalization across different phase volume fractions and loading conditions.

title: Introducing Interval Neural Networks for Uncertainty-Aware System Identification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的区间神经网络方法可用于不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性传播问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on system identification for dynamical systems, not on FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 深度学习模型缺乏不确定性量化，影响系统辨识的可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 将预训练神经网络的参数转化为区间值，构建区间神经网络并设计训练框架。
summary_zh.result: 区间LSTM和区间神经常微分方程在系统辨识中有效生成预测区间。
summary_zh.validation: 在系统辨识基准实验上验证预测区间覆盖效果。

summary_en.motivation: Deep learning models for system identification lack uncertainty quantification, posing challenges for reliability and safety.
summary_en.method: A systematic framework transforms pre-trained neural network parameters into interval-valued ones using interval arithmetic, and a training framework with a UQ loss function is proposed.
summary_en.result: Interval LSTM and Interval Neural ODE architectures generate prediction intervals that effectively capture target coverage in system identification tasks.
summary_en.validation: The methods are validated on system identification benchmark experiments, demonstrating their effectiveness in producing calibrated prediction intervals.

title: $PINN - a Domain Decomposition Method for Bayesian Physics-Informed Neural Networks

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently quantify epistemic and aleatoric uncertainties in large-scale multi-scale PDE problems using PINNs.
summary_en.method: A domain decomposition method combining local Bayesian Physics-Informed Neural Networks (BPINNs) with flux continuity across subdomain interfaces.
summary_en.result: The proposed method recovers global uncertainty by computing local uncertainties concurrently, improving efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on 1D and 2D PDEs with up to 15% random noise added to training data demonstrate robustness.

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the limitations of conventional penalty-based boundary condition enforcement in PINNs, which suffer from inaccuracy and sensitivity to penalty parameters.
summary_en.method: An integrated framework combining normalized distance fields via R-functions with bias-corrected adaptive weight tuning for accurate and efficient inverse analysis.
summary_en.result: The proposed method yields more accurate and efficient solutions to inverse problems with non-convex geometries and complex boundary conditions compared to penalty-based approaches.
summary_en.validation: Validated on several numerical benchmark inverse problems.

summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through microstructural observation and mechanical testing of polished samples.

title: Integrating Engineered Living Materials with 3D Bioprinting
first_author_affiliation: Synthetic Biology Group J. Craig Venter Institute  La Jolla CA 92037 USA

corresponding_authors.name: Kyungsuk Yum
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering University of Texas at Arlington  Arlington TX 76019 USA

relevance_to_user: 该论文综述了工程活材料与3D生物打印的整合，但未涉及AI在生物打印中的应用。
why_not_core: This paper is a perspective/review that does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage, lacks experimental validation, and does not advance from observation to autonomous decision.

summary_zh.motivation: 整合工程活材料与3D生物打印，利用生物可编程性创造自适应结构。
summary_zh.method: 综述近期进展，讨论生物打印与ELM交叉领域的机会。
summary_zh.result: 提出将合成生物学、微生物生长和形状变形材料整合到生物打印中。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，仅为观点性综述。

summary_en.motivation: To synergize the genetic programmability of engineered living materials with the geometric control of 3D bioprinting for creating adaptive constructs.
summary_en.method: This perspective reviews recent advances and discusses opportunities at the intersection of 3D bioprinting and ELMs, including bioink design, synthetic biology integration, and post-printing microbial growth.
summary_en.result: The paper highlights potential for 4D printing of ELMs through shape-morphing materials and living fabrication processes.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a forward-looking perspective without empirical data.

title: Uncertainty Quantification in Graph Neural Networks with Shallow Ensembles
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的轻量级不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，提高预测可靠性。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on materials modeling with GNNs and does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constraint handling in design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: GNN在材料预测中缺乏可靠的不确定性估计，难以识别域外数据。
summary_zh.method: 将浅层集成直接传播（DPOSE）集成到SchNet模型中，实现轻量级不确定性量化。
summary_zh.result: DPOSE能有效区分域内和域外样本，对未观测分子类别表现出更高不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 在QM9、OC20和Gold Molecular Dynamics数据集上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Graph neural networks for materials modeling often produce unreliable predictions on out-of-domain data without proper uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: We integrate Direct Propagation of Shallow Ensembles (DPOSE) into the SchNet model as a computationally efficient alternative to deep ensembles for uncertainty estimation.
summary_en.result: DPOSE effectively distinguishes in-domain from out-of-domain samples, exhibiting higher uncertainty for unobserved molecule and material classes.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on diverse Density Functional Theory datasets including QM9, OC20, and Gold Molecular Dynamics.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Comparison of the Original Architecture and the DPOSE Architecture. The Original Architecture produces a single output ( y y ) using a deep neural network. The DPOSE Architecture consists of multiple shallow ensembles in the last layer predict outputs ( y 1 , y 2 , … , y n y_{1},y_{2},\dots,y_{n} ), with the final output ( y ¯ \bar{y} ) computed as their average and the uncertainty ( σ \sigma ) estimated as their variance.

title: Physics Informed Constrained Learning of Dynamics from Static Data
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种从静态数据学习动力学的物理信息约束学习方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的非时间序列数据建模。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no implant/biomechanics context, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN依赖完整时间序列数据，获取成本高。
summary_zh.method: 提出约束学习框架MPOCtrL，从静态或部分观测数据学习一阶导数。
summary_zh.result: 在代谢通量分析任务上优于现有数据驱动方法。
summary_zh.validation: 合成数据与真实数据实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing PINNs require fully observed time-course data, which is often prohibitive to acquire.
summary_en.method: This work develops a Constrained Learning paradigm and MPOCtrL optimizer to learn first-order derivatives from static or partially observed data.
summary_en.result: MPOCtrL effectively detects nonlinear dependencies and outperforms existing data-driven flux estimators on metabolic flux analysis.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic and real-world datasets, including metabolic flux analysis benchmarks.

title: Deep Material Network: Overview, applications and current directions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的深度材料网络（DMN）是一种可解释的多尺度材料建模框架，其物理可解释性和高效计算特性可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper is a review of DMN for multiscale materials modeling, not applied to implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多尺度材料模拟中计算成本高的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出具有物理可解释性的深度材料网络（DMN）层次化树结构
summary_zh.result: DMN可在线性弹性数据上训练并外推至非线性响应，显著降低计算成本
summary_zh.validation: 综述性论文，未提供具体验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational cost of multiscale materials simulations while maintaining accuracy and interpretability.
summary_en.method: Proposes Deep Material Network (DMN), a hierarchical tree-structured model with physically interpretable parameters encoding RVE geometry.
summary_en.result: DMN trained on linear elastic data can extrapolate to nonlinear responses, achieving efficient multiscale predictions.
summary_en.validation: This is a review paper; no specific validation is presented.

title: Multi-scale DeepOnet (Mscale-DeepOnet) for Mitigating Spectral Bias in Learning High Frequency Operators of Oscillatory Functions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多尺度DeepOnet方法可缓解高频振荡函数学习中的谱偏差问题，对生物力学中高频波动问题的代理建模具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on operator learning for oscillatory PDEs without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 缓解DeepOnet在学习高频振荡函数映射时的谱偏差问题
summary_zh.method: 在分支和主干网络中引入多尺度神经网络结构
summary_zh.result: 在Helmholtz方程高频波散射问题上显著优于标准DeepOnet
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证多尺度DeepOnet的性能提升

summary_en.motivation: To mitigate the spectral bias of DeepOnet when learning high-frequency mappings between oscillatory functions.
summary_en.method: A multi-scale neural network architecture is integrated into both the branch and trunk networks of the original DeepOnet.
summary_en.result: The proposed Mscale-DeepOnet substantially outperforms the standard DeepOnet on high-frequency wave scattering problems governed by the Helmholtz equation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on the Helmholtz equation demonstrate the improvement in capturing high-frequency components.

title: MLPs and KANs for data-driven learning in physical problems: A performance comparison
relevance_to_user: 该论文比较了KAN和MLP在物理问题中的性能，对代理建模有参考价值，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification, and no validation on FEA surrogate tasks.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索KAN在物理问题中是否优于MLP
summary_zh.method: 在DeepONet和GNS框架中比较KAN和MLP的性能
summary_zh.result: KAN在浅层网络中表现更好，但深层网络中不总是优于MLP
summary_zh.validation: 在多个PDE基准问题上进行数值测试

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) outperform traditional MLPs in learning physical systems governed by PDEs.
summary_en.method: A comparative study integrating KANs and MLPs into DeepONet and graph network simulators, tested on PDE problems of varying scale and complexity.
summary_en.result: KANs show superior expressiveness in shallow networks but do not consistently outperform MLPs in deep architectures.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on multiple PDE problems.

title: Collaborative Bayesian Optimization via Wasserstein Barycenters
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于Wasserstein重心的高斯过程协同贝叶斯优化框架，其方法可迁移至植入物设计中的多代理优化场景，但未涉及有限元分析或生物力学约束。
why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element analysis, surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, or biomechanical constraints; it focuses on collaborative optimization with data privacy.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决黑箱优化中的数据隐私和通信限制问题
summary_zh.method: 利用Wasserstein重心融合多个高斯过程代理模型，构建协作采集函数
summary_zh.result: 算法渐近一致，数值实验优于基线方法，与集中式方法竞争力相当
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证算法性能

summary_en.motivation: To address black-box optimization under data privacy and communication constraints in collaborative settings.
summary_en.method: A collaborative Bayesian optimization framework that constructs a central model via Wasserstein barycenters of Gaussian processes and a collaborative acquisition function.
summary_en.result: The proposed algorithm is asymptotically consistent and outperforms baseline collaborative frameworks while being competitive with centralized approaches.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on benchmark functions demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

title: An Unsupervised Network Architecture Search Method for Solving Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无监督网络架构搜索方法用于求解PDE，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, no implant or biomechanics context, and only tested on standard PDE benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN网络结构选择依赖经验，缺乏自动化方法。
summary_zh.method: 将可微架构搜索(DARTS)融入PINN，无监督地搜索最优网络结构。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准PDE上，PINN-DARTS比传统方法架构精度更高，且最优结构受解复杂度和PDE类型影响。
summary_zh.validation: 在椭圆、抛物、波动和Burgers方程等基准PDE上验证。

summary_en.motivation: The selection of neural network architecture in PINNs is often ad hoc, lacking an automated and optimal approach.
summary_en.method: An unsupervised differentiable architecture search (DARTS) method is integrated into PINNs to jointly optimize network and architecture parameters based solely on PDE residuals.
summary_en.result: PINN-DARTS achieves higher architectural accuracy on benchmark PDEs, and the optimal architecture varies with solution complexity and PDE type.
summary_en.validation: Validated on elliptic, parabolic, wave, and Burgers' equations using numerical benchmarks.

title: An Adaptive Dropout Approach for High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种自适应丢弃变量的贝叶斯优化方法，可提高高维昂贵优化问题的求解效率，对用户研究中的代理模型优化具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification beyond standard BO, or implant/biomechanics design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维贝叶斯优化中采集函数优化困难，性能下降。
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应丢弃变量的方法，逐步降低采集函数维度。
summary_zh.result: 在数值实验中有效解决高维挑战，优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个高维基准函数上对比标准BO和最新方法。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization struggles with high-dimensional problems due to the difficulty of optimizing the acquisition function in high dimensions.
summary_en.method: An adaptive dropout approach is proposed that gradually reduces the dimensionality of the acquisition function over iterations.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments show that AdaDropout effectively tackles high-dimensional challenges and outperforms state-of-the-art high-dimensional BO methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on multiple high-dimensional benchmark functions, comparing against standard BO and recent high-dimensional BO approaches.

title: Virtual domain extension for imposing boundary conditions in flow simulation using pre-trained local neural operator
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种在神经算子中施加边界条件的通用框架，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型中的边界条件处理。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on flow simulation and does not address solid mechanics, implant design, or biomechanical constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决神经算子推理时计算域腐蚀导致的边界条件施加困难。
summary_zh.method: 构建虚拟扩展域，通过填充、直接施加、对称性和反向传播优化策略确定扩展域场值。
summary_zh.result: 虚拟域扩展方法能准确施加边界条件，获得合理的流场预测。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例与经典求解器对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of imposing boundary conditions in neural operator inference due to domain corrosion.
summary_en.method: A virtual domain extension framework is proposed, where field values on the extended domain are determined via padding, direct imposition, pressure symmetry, or backpropagation optimization.
summary_en.result: The virtual domain extension method accurately imposes boundary conditions and yields reasonable flow field predictions.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical examples with comparison to traditional solvers.

title: Towards Scalable Bayesian Optimization via Gradient-Informed Bayesian Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合梯度信息的贝叶斯神经网络方法，可提升贝叶斯优化的采样效率，对解决昂贵仿真中的代理模型构建问题具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraints, uncertainty quantification beyond point prediction, or biomechanics/implant design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升贝叶斯优化在高维问题中的采样效率
summary_zh.method: 提出梯度信息增强的贝叶斯神经网络损失函数
summary_zh.result: 在基准测试中预测更准且收敛更快
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准上验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve the sampling efficiency of Bayesian optimization for high-dimensional problems by incorporating gradient information into Bayesian neural network surrogates.
summary_en.method: A gradient-informed loss function is proposed for training Bayesian neural networks, augmenting function observations with local gradient data via automatic differentiation.
summary_en.result: The approach yields improved predictive accuracy and faster convergence on standard benchmarks as the number of decision variables increases.
summary_en.validation: Validated on well-known numerical optimization benchmarks.

title: Multi-objective Bayesian Optimization With Mixed-categorical Design Variables for Expensive-to-evaluate Aeronautical Applications
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多目标贝叶斯优化方法可处理混合类别变量和约束，适用于昂贵仿真问题，可迁移至植入物设计中的多目标优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant design, biomechanics, or FEA surrogate modeling; it focuses on aeronautical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对航空工程中昂贵仿真系统的多目标优化问题，提出高效方法。
summary_zh.method: 基于混合专家模型的贝叶斯优化框架SEGOMOE，处理连续/离散/类别变量及约束。
summary_zh.result: 在三个航空案例中验证了方法能高效构建精确Pareto前沿。
summary_zh.validation: 通过航空工程中的三个实际案例进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop efficient optimization methodologies for computationally expensive complex systems in aeronautical engineering.
summary_en.method: A surrogate-based Bayesian optimization framework, SEGOMOE, combining mixtures of experts to handle mixed-categorical design variables and constraints for multi-objective optimization.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrated favorable results on three realistic aeronautical problems, constructing accurate Pareto fronts with minimal function evaluations.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed on three practical aeronautical applications from the AGILE 4.0 project.

title: Engineered3D-Printable Nanohydroxyapatite Biocompositeswith Cold Plasma-Tailored Surface Features to Boost Osseointegration

why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, and no mechanical testing of porous structures for stiffness matching.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发可3D打印的纳米羟基磷灰石生物复合材料以提升骨整合。
summary_zh.method: 将纳米羟基磷灰石和掺杂锶的二氧化硅颗粒加入光固化单体，经冷等离子体处理。
summary_zh.result: 材料具有强力学性能，表面亲水性增强，体外和体内均诱导成骨活性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞实验和体内动物实验验证骨整合效果。

summary_en.motivation: To develop versatile 3D-printable nanohydroxyapatite biocomposites with enhanced osseointegration for orthopedic and dental implants.
summary_en.method: Nanohydroxyapatite and strontium-doped SiO2 glass particles were incorporated into a photocurable methacrylate monomer system, followed by cold atmosphere plasma irradiation.
summary_en.result: The biocomposite exhibited strong mechanical strength, improved surface hydrophilicity, and induced osteogenic activity in vitro and bone integration in vivo.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays and in vivo animal studies confirmed osseointegration and biocompatibility.

title: BO-SA-PINNs: Self-adaptive physics-informed neural networks based on Bayesian optimization for automatically designing PDE solvers
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于贝叶斯优化的自适应PINNs框架，可自动设计PDE求解器，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的超参数自动调优。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on automatic hyperparameter tuning for PINNs on standard PDE benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 手动调整PINNs超参数效率低，需自动化方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出BO-SA-PINNs框架，分三阶段：BO选超参数、全局自适应机制、L-BFGS稳定训练。
summary_zh.result: 在Helmholtz等方程上精度更高、迭代更少。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试与消融实验验证各模块有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Manual hyperparameter tuning for physics-informed neural networks is inefficient and hinders solver automation.
summary_en.method: A multi-stage framework BO-SA-PINNs is proposed, using Bayesian optimization for hyperparameter selection, a global self-adaptive mechanism for loss weights and sampling points, and L-BFGS for stable training.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves higher accuracy and fewer iterations on Helmholtz, Maxwell, Burgers, and high-dimensional Poisson equations.
summary_en.validation: Comparative and ablation experiments on standard PDE benchmarks validate the performance and contribution of each component.

title: Alginate-Dialdehyde-Based Reporter Ink Enabling Online Detection of Matrix Metalloproteinase Activity of Encapsulated Cells.
first_author_affiliation: Institute of Pharmacy and Food Chemistry, University of Würzburg, Am Hubland, 97074 Würzburg, Germany.

corresponding_authors.name: Tessa Lühmann
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Pharmacy and Food Chemistry, University of Würzburg, Am Hubland, 97074 Würzburg, Germany.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及生物打印中的实时监测，但未使用AI技术，与用户研究方向（AI用于生物打印）关联较弱。
why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on a FRET-based reporter ink for MMP activity monitoring without autonomous decision-making or model training.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现生物打印构建物中细胞MMP活性的实时监测。

summary_en.validation: Validation was performed using recombinant MMPs, cell-derived media, and multiple cell cultures in vitro.

summary_en.result: In cantilever plate case studies under healthy and damaged conditions, the agent adaptively repositions sensors, improving data acquisition quality and overall digital twin accuracy.

summary_en.result: The proposed strategy successfully solves a jet engine architecture problem with a 50% failure rate, which previous BO algorithms could not handle.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical test problems and a jet engine architecture optimization case.

title: Dimension reduction for derivative-informed operator learning: An analysis of approximation errors
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的导数信息降维方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，提高采样效率并支持不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, nor does it handle multi-objective constraints or experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高神经算子对PDE映射及其导数的逼近精度，支持外环任务。
summary_zh.method: 分析基于PCA和导数信息子空间的降维神经算子（RBNO）的逼近误差。
summary_zh.result: 导数信息子空间和输出PCA在算子及导数重建上优于输入PCA。
summary_zh.validation: 通过椭圆型PDE数值实验验证误差界。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the approximation accuracy of neural operators for PDE maps and their derivatives, which is critical for outer-loop tasks such as optimization and inverse problems.
summary_en.method: The paper analyzes approximation errors of reduced basis neural operators (RBNO) using PCA and derivative-informed subspaces (DIS) for dimension reduction, deriving bounds for both dimension reduction and latent network errors.
summary_en.result: Bases informed by the map (DIS or output PCA) yield accurate reconstructions and generalization errors for both the operator and its derivatives, while input PCA may underperform unless ranks and sample sizes are large.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on elliptic PDEs validate the theoretical error bounds.

title: An experimental workflow for bioprinting optimization: Application to a custom-made biomaterial ink

summary_zh.motivation: 生物打印缺乏标准化协议，打印质量难以保证。
summary_zh.method: 提出系统化生物打印协议，结合定制3D打印镜头支架和Python脚本进行图像分析。

summary_en.motivation: Bioprinting lacks standardized protocols, hindering reproducible high-quality prints.
summary_en.method: A systematic bioprinting workflow is presented, including a custom 3D-printed lens support and a Python script for quantitative image analysis of extrusion, deposition, and printability.

title: Gradient-based Sample Selection for Faster Bayesian Optimization

why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective or constrained optimization, nor does it include uncertainty quantification or validation on biomechanical or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准贝叶斯优化中高斯过程拟合计算成本高，限制了大预算问题的应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于梯度信息选择样本子集的方法，在保持多样性和代表性的同时去除冗余。
summary_zh.result: 显著降低计算成本，优化性能与基线方法相当。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实任务上进行了数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Bayesian optimization suffers from high computational cost due to cubic complexity of Gaussian process fitting, limiting its use in large-budget problems.
summary_en.method: A gradient-based sample selection strategy is proposed to construct the GP model on a subset of samples, removing redundancy while preserving diversity and representativeness.
summary_en.result: The approach significantly reduces computational cost while maintaining optimization performance comparable to baseline methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic and real-world benchmark tasks with numerical experiments.

title: A Novel Deep Learning Approach for Emulating Computationally Expensive Postfire Debris Flows
relevance_to_user: 该论文的深度学习方法可用于替代昂贵仿真，但应用于地质流动而非生物力学/植入物设计。

summary_zh.motivation: 传统物理模型计算昂贵，限制了大范围参数扫描和不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 基于改进U-Net的深度学习代理模型，采用分块预测拼接方法。
summary_zh.result: 最大点误差低于10%，泛化能力强，支持蒙特卡洛不确定性量化。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional physics-based models for geophysical flows are computationally expensive, limiting their use in large-scale parameter sweeps and uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A deep learning surrogate model based on a modified U-Net architecture with a patch-predict-stitch methodology is developed to predict debris flow dynamics from physics-based simulations.
summary_en.result: The surrogate achieves maximum pointwise errors below 10% on unseen parameter sets and terrain, and enables efficient Monte Carlo-based uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on unseen parameter sets and terrain using simulation data generated via Latin Hypercube Sampling.

summary_en.motivation: Existing model reduction techniques struggle to balance accuracy and ease of use, especially for nonlinear problems.

summary_en.result: The method demonstrates effectiveness and accuracy for both linear and nonlinear structural mechanics problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation cases of linear and nonlinear structural mechanics.

title: A residual weighted physics informed neural network for forward and inverse problems of reaction diffusion equations

summary_zh.result: 在非线性方程正反问题中精度优于标准PINN，并给出误差界分析

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and training stability of PINNs for solving reaction-diffusion equations.
summary_en.method: Proposes a residual-weighted PINN that incorporates scaled PDE residuals into the loss function via two weighting schemes.
summary_en.result: Achieves higher accuracy than standard PINN on forward and inverse problems of nonlinear equations, with theoretical error bounds.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical experiments on nonlinear reaction-diffusion equations with statistical error analysis.

title: Leveraging Axis-Aligned Subspaces for High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization with Group Testing
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过群组测试识别活跃变量，可提升高维贝叶斯优化效率，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计中的约束处理与不确定性量化。

summary_zh.motivation: 高维贝叶斯优化中轴对齐子空间假设的有效性常未验证且未充分利用。
summary_zh.method: 提出群组测试贝叶斯优化（GTBO），先测试变量组活跃性再聚焦活跃维度优化。

summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准函数上验证，无实际工程或生物力学案例。

summary_en.motivation: The axis-aligned subspace assumption in high-dimensional Bayesian optimization is rarely verified or fully exploited, limiting optimization efficiency.
summary_en.method: Group Testing Bayesian Optimization (GTBO) first identifies active variables via systematic group testing, then focuses optimization on the active subspace.
summary_en.result: GTBO outperforms state-of-the-art methods on benchmarks satisfying the axis-aligned subspace assumption while improving interpretability.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical benchmark functions without real-world engineering or biomechanical applications.

title: Large language models as uncertainty-calibrated optimizers for experimental discovery

summary_en.result: The method nearly doubles the discovery rate of high-yielding reaction conditions in Buchwald-Hartwig reactions from 24% to 43% within 50 iterations.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on 19 diverse optimization problems spanning organic synthesis, materials science, and catalysis, achieving top average rank.

title: Diffusion-based Models for Unpaired Super-resolution in Fluid Dynamics

summary_zh.motivation: 高分辨率流体模拟计算成本高，传统超分辨率需要配对数据难以获取。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity fluid simulations are computationally expensive, and traditional super-resolution requires paired datasets that are often unavailable.

summary_en.result: The method demonstrates effectiveness on three fluid dynamics problems and can be extended with a neural operator to improve evolutionary simulations.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on simulation cases of fluid dynamics problems.

why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding or fatigue testing for hip implants; it focuses on spinal fusion cages with static mechanical testing and in vivo osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发无需植骨的非窗口型多孔钽融合器以加速脊柱融合
summary_zh.method: 利用3D打印制备多孔钽融合器，并通过力学测试、体外细胞实验和体内羊模型评估
summary_zh.result: 3D打印多孔钽融合器力学性能类似松质骨，无需植骨即可实现优异骨融合
summary_zh.validation: 力学测试、体外细胞实验、羊体内模型及初步临床试验

summary_en.motivation: To develop a non-window porous tantalum cage that eliminates the need for bone grafting and accelerates spinal fusion.
summary_en.method: A 3D-printed porous tantalum cage was fabricated and evaluated via mechanical testing, in vitro assays, and in vivo sheep models.
summary_en.result: The cage exhibited trabecular bone-like mechanical properties and achieved superior osseointegration without bone grafting.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing, in vitro cellular assays, in vivo sheep model, and a pilot clinical trial.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及多孔钛基体降低刚度以匹配骨骼、减少应力遮挡，并采用LPBF制造和力学测试，但未涉及疲劳性能或表面形貌表征。
why_not_core: No fatigue testing, no as-built surface roughness or morphology characterization, and no osseointegration in vivo or in vitro cell studies.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决钛植入体感染、应力遮挡和骨整合差的问题
summary_zh.method: 制备多孔钛基体并涂覆壳聚糖-纳米银-纳米羟基磷灰石复合涂层
summary_zh.result: 60%孔隙率、355-500μm孔径的基体刚度29 GPa，涂层抗菌21天并诱导羟基磷灰石形成
summary_zh.validation: 力学测试验证刚度匹配，抗菌实验和仿生矿化实验验证生物活性

summary_en.motivation: To address infection risk, stress shielding, and poor osseointegration of titanium implants by combining porous substrates with bioactive coatings.
summary_en.method: Porous titanium substrates with 60% porosity and 355-500 μm pores were fabricated and coated with an optimized chitosan-silver nanoparticle-nanohydroxyapatite composite.
summary_en.result: The optimal substrate exhibited a stiffness of 29 GPa, close to cortical bone, and the coating showed excellent antibacterial activity for 21 days and induced hydroxyapatite formation.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing confirmed stiffness matching, while antibacterial assays and in vitro mineralization tests validated bioactivity.

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate low-modulus titanium matrix composites via selective laser melting for reducing stress shielding in orthopedic implants.
summary_en.method: Ag@GNSs-reinforced Ti-13Nb-13Zr composites were fabricated by optimizing laser volume energy density to achieve high density and mechanical performance.
summary_en.result: The composite achieved 99.52% relative density, 28.30 GPa elastic modulus (comparable to human bone), and 1169.46 MPa tensile strength at optimal energy density.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing including density, microhardness, tensile strength, and elastic modulus measurements was performed.

relevance_to_user: 该论文使用患者特异性有限元模型预测骨盆定制植入物失效，方法可迁移至髋关节假体应力遮挡和疲劳分析。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on pelvic custom implants, not femoral stems, and does not quantify micromotion or contact mechanics at the bone-implant interface.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估患者特异性有限元模型能否盲法预测骨盆定制植入物的机械失效。
summary_zh.method: 构建患者特异性骨盆-植入物FE模型，考虑应力遮挡和疲劳失效准则。
summary_zh.result: 盲法预测显示耻骨螺钉疲劳风险最高，应力遮挡模拟与骨溶解证据吻合。
summary_zh.validation: 与临床观察到的失效模式和骨溶解影像学证据对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate whether patient-specific finite element modeling can blindly predict the mode and location of mechanical failure in custom-made pelvic implants.
summary_en.method: Patient-specific FE models of pelvis-implant constructs were developed incorporating multiple failure criteria including stress shielding and fatigue.
summary_en.result: Blinded predictions identified pubic screws as having the highest fatigue risk, and stress-shielding simulations matched clinical osteolysis evidence.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed by comparing predicted failure modes and locations with clinically observed outcomes and radiographic evidence.

title: Bioxolography Using Diphenyliodonium Chloride and N ‐Vinylpyrrolidone Enables Rapid High‐Resolution Volumetric 3D Printing of Spatially Encoded Living Matter
relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及光基体积生物打印技术，但未集成AI或机器学习方法。
why_not_core: This paper does not integrate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on chemical formulation and printing process development without computational intelligence.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有双色光引发剂在水介质中溶解度和反应性不足，限制了活体材料的高分辨率生物打印。
summary_zh.method: 提出含二苯基碘鎓氯和N-乙烯基吡咯烷酮的三组分配方，增强光反应性，实现快速高分辨率Xolographic生物打印。
summary_zh.result: 成功打印>1 cm³结构，分辨率约20 µm正/125 µm负，细胞活力高，支持长期培养和蛋白沉积。
summary_zh.validation: 通过双色光流变学验证光反应性增强，并用多种细胞类型进行体外生物打印验证。

summary_en.motivation: The limited solubility and reactivity of current dual-color photoinitiators in aqueous media hinder high-resolution bioprinting of living matter.
summary_en.method: A novel three-component formulation incorporating diphenyliodonium chloride and N-vinylpyrrolidone is developed to drastically improve photoreactivity for Xolographic bioprinting.
summary_en.result: Centimeter-scale constructs with ~20 µm positive and 125 µm negative resolution are fabricated within minutes, demonstrating excellent cell viability and long-term culture compatibility.
summary_en.validation: Dual-color photo-rheology confirms enhanced photoreactivity, and in vitro bioprinting with multiple cell types validates cytocompatibility and functionality.

relevance_to_user: 该综述讨论了镁合金多孔支架的应力屏蔽、增材制造和生物功能化涂层，但缺乏LPBF制造和疲劳测试的具体实验数据。
why_not_core: This is a review paper with no original experimental data; it does not include LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (fatigue or static), or surface roughness/as-built morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 镁合金可降解支架可避免二次手术，但需控制腐蚀速率。
summary_zh.method: 综述合金元素、增材制造、点阵结构和生物功能化涂层的研究进展。
summary_zh.result: 镁合金力学性能接近骨组织，可减少应力遮挡，但腐蚀行为需优化。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: Magnesium alloys are promising for biodegradable orthopedic implants due to their bone-like mechanical properties and elimination of second surgery, but their high corrosion rate must be controlled.
summary_en.method: This review summarizes recent advances in alloying elements, additive manufacturing, lattice structures, and biofunctional coatings to tailor corrosion resistance, mechanical properties, and biocompatibility of Mg-based implants.
summary_en.result: Mg-based scaffolds can mitigate stress shielding and promote bone ingrowth, but managing degradation rate and surface properties remains critical for clinical success.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; this is a literature review.

title: Active Learning Design: Modeling Force Output for Axisymmetric Soft Pneumatic Actuators
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了主动学习在软体执行器设计中的应用，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理模型构建与实验设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or FEA surrogate modeling for biomedical applications; it focuses on soft pneumatic actuators and force-pressure-height modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效建模软体执行器力-压力-高度关系以优化设计。
summary_zh.method: 采用主动学习管道采集数据并训练代理模型，替代理论模型与朴素拟合。
summary_zh.result: 主动学习模型优于理论模型和曲线拟合，成功优化了不同举升任务的膜设计。
summary_zh.validation: 通过自动化测试平台对22个Ecoflex 00-30膜进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently model the force-pressure-height relationship of soft pneumatic actuators for design optimization.
summary_en.method: An active learning pipeline is used to collect experimental data and train a surrogate model that outperforms theory-based and naive curve-fitting approaches.
summary_en.result: The learned model enables optimization of membrane designs for different lifting tasks, demonstrating superior performance.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation is performed on 22 Ecoflex 00-30 membranes using an automated test rig.

summary_en.result: Magnetic stimulation activated mechanosensitive pathways and catabolic processes, leading to accelerated cartilage-to-bone transition.

summary_zh.motivation: 构建仿生神经替代物以促进脊髓损伤修复。
summary_zh.method: 设计含动态键和生物活性肽的生物墨水，3D打印神经干细胞。
summary_zh.result: 动态生物墨水促进神经干细胞分化与神经网络自组织，恢复大鼠运动感觉功能。
summary_zh.validation: 大鼠脊髓损伤模型体内验证。

summary_en.motivation: To construct biomimetic neural substitutes for spinal cord injury repair via 3D bioprinting.
summary_en.method: A dynamic bioactive bioink with reversible Schiff-base bonds and N-cadherin/BDNF-mimicking peptides was designed for 3D bioprinting of neural stem cells.
summary_en.result: The dynamic bioink enhanced mechanosensing, spreading, and migration of NSCs, accelerating functional neural network self-organization and leading to motor and sensory recovery in rats.
summary_en.validation: In vivo validation using a rat complete spinal cord injury model.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于傅里叶分解和随机边界条件训练的PINN方法，可泛化到任意边界条件，但仅验证了简单耦合振荡器系统，未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not handle constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN对任意边界条件的泛化能力
summary_zh.method: 学习傅里叶分解形式，结合随机边界条件训练
summary_zh.result: 训练后能正确预测任意边界条件的解，并插值
summary_zh.validation: 在双耦合振荡器系统上验证

summary_en.motivation: To enable PINNs to generalize to arbitrary boundary conditions without retraining.
summary_en.method: Proposes a PINN formulation that learns Fourier decomposition and uses randomized boundary conditions during training.
summary_en.result: The trained PINN correctly predicts solutions for unseen boundary conditions and interpolates between training samples.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a toy system of two coupled oscillators.
