title: Enhancing Physics-Informed Neural Networks with a Hybrid Parallel Kolmogorov-Arnold and MLP Architecture
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种混合KAN和MLP的PINN架构，可提高PDE求解精度，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计应用。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no FEA surrogate for design optimization, and no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN求解PDE的精度和效率
summary_zh.method: 并行集成KAN和MLP分支，通过缩放因子平衡两者输出
summary_zh.result: 在Poisson和Advection方程上相对误差降低两个数量级
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准测试上验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and efficiency of physics-informed neural networks for solving partial differential equations.
summary_en.method: Proposes a hybrid parallel architecture combining Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks and Multi-Layer Perceptrons with a scaling factor to balance interpretability and expressivity.
summary_en.result: Achieves two orders of magnitude reduction in relative error on canonical PDEs like Poisson and Advection equations compared to standalone KAN or MLP.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmarks on standard PDE problems.

title: DeepOFormer: Deep Operator Learning with Domain-informed Features for Fatigue Life Prediction
relevance_to_user: 该论文将算子学习用于疲劳寿命预测，方法可迁移至生物力学代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 小样本疲劳数据导致过拟合，需提升预测泛化能力。
summary_zh.method: 提出DeepOFormer，将S-N曲线预测建模为算子学习，结合Transformer编码器和领域特征。
summary_zh.result: 在铝合金数据集上R²达0.9515，优于DeepONet等基线。
summary_zh.validation: 在7种铝合金的54条S-N曲线上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Small fatigue experimental data cause overfitting in ML models, motivating a data-efficient operator learning approach.
summary_en.method: DeepOFormer formulates S-N curve prediction as an operator learning problem using a transformer-based encoder and domain-informed features from empirical fatigue models.
summary_en.result: The method achieves R² of 0.9515 on aluminum alloy datasets, outperforming DeepONet, TabTransformer, and XGBoost.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on 54 S-N curves from seven aluminum alloys.

title: Multi-fidelity Learning of Reduced Order Models for Parabolic PDE Constrained Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真度降阶模型与信任区域优化框架，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样与约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification for point predictions, and does not handle constraints beyond single-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决参数化抛物型PDE约束优化中全阶模型计算成本高的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出层次信任区域算法，在线构建多保真度降阶模型（FOM-ROM-ML）并自适应更新。
summary_zh.result: 数值实验表明该方法在优化效率上优于传统方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准数值算例验证算法效率。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of solving optimization problems constrained by parameterized parabolic PDEs by avoiding expensive full-order model evaluations.
summary_en.method: A hierarchical trust-region algorithm that constructs a multi-fidelity hierarchy of reduced order models (full-order, reduced-order, and machine learning) on-the-fly using an active learning enrichment strategy.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed approach in solving parabolic PDE-constrained optimization problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical benchmarks for parabolic PDE-constrained optimization.

why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or finite element analysis; it focuses on nonlinear model reduction for dynamical systems with non-normal behavior.

summary_zh.method: 提出一种斜投影技术近似稳定不变叶理，实现精确降阶

summary_en.motivation: To address the difficulty of pairing trajectories with reduced counterparts on spectral submanifolds in systems with strong non-normal behavior.
summary_en.method: An oblique projection technique is developed to approximate the stable invariant foliation, enabling accurate model reduction from limited data.
summary_en.result: The method effectively reduces a significantly non-normal and nonlinear beam dynamics using only a single experimental trajectory.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a numerical simulation case of a nonlinear beam.

title: Confidence Adjusted Surprise Measure for Active Resourceful Trials (CA-SMART): A Data-driven Active Learning Framework for Accelerating Material Discovery under Resource Constraints
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的主动学习框架CA-SMART通过置信度调整的惊奇度量平衡探索与利用，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的采样优化，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective or constrained optimization, nor does it include uncertainty quantification beyond point predictions, and it lacks application to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速材料发现中昂贵实验的采样效率，避免过度探索不确定区域。
summary_zh.method: 提出置信度调整惊奇度量(CA-SMART)的贝叶斯主动学习框架，动态平衡探索与利用。
summary_zh.result: 在基准函数和钢疲劳强度预测中，CA-SMART优于传统惊奇度量和贝叶斯优化方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个数值基准函数和钢材疲劳强度预测实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate material discovery by improving sampling efficiency in expensive experiments while avoiding excessive exploration of uncertain regions.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Bayesian active learning framework, CA-SMART, that uses Confidence-Adjusted Surprise to dynamically balance exploration and exploitation.
summary_en.result: CA-SMART achieves superior accuracy and efficiency on benchmark functions and fatigue strength prediction compared to traditional surprise metrics and Bayesian optimization methods.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two numerical benchmark functions (Six-Hump Camelback and Griewank) and a real-world fatigue strength prediction task for steel.

summary_en.motivation: To address persistent clinical failures of dental and orthopedic implants caused by microbial colonization, corrosion, and insufficient osseointegration.
summary_en.method: Zinc-doped coatings were fabricated on titanium implants via plasma electrolytic oxidation (PEO) and characterized for composition, roughness, wettability, and crystallinity.
summary_en.result: The Zn-doped coatings exhibited over 50% reduction in wear mass loss, enhanced corrosion resistance, complete inhibition of Escherichia coli growth, and improved preosteoblastic cell metabolism.
summary_en.validation: Validation included tribological tests, electrochemical corrosion tests, antimicrobial assays, in vitro cell studies, and ex vivo implant insertion into bovine rib bone.

title: Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Bayesian Optimization with Continuous Context
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的分布鲁棒贝叶斯优化方法可处理连续上下文分布的不确定性，对考虑不确定性的植入物设计优化具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on general black-box optimization under distributional uncertainty.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决连续上下文分布不确定下的序贯决策问题
summary_zh.method: 提出基于Wasserstein距离的分布鲁棒贝叶斯优化算法
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实问题上实现亚线性遗憾界，与现有方法相当
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成和真实世界问题对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To address sequential data-driven decision-making under context distributional uncertainty with continuous context distributions.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Wasserstein distributionally robust Bayesian optimization algorithm that maintains computational tractability for continuous context.
summary_en.result: Achieves sublinear regret bounds matching state-of-the-art results on both synthetic and real-world problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated through extensive comparisons on synthetic and real-world problems.

title: Invertible Koopman neural operator for data-driven modeling of partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的可逆Koopman神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, does not handle constraints or uncertainty quantification, and lacks biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有Koopman算子方法在构建可观测函数及其逆时存在不足，且处理偏微分方程效率低。
summary_zh.method: 提出可逆Koopman神经算子，利用可逆神经网络同时参数化可观测函数及其逆，并在频率空间学习低频模态演化。
summary_zh.result: IKNO在数值和真实案例上优于其他神经算子，且具有分辨率不变性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值基准和真实世界PDE案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing Koopman operator methods suffer from poor construction of observable functions and their inverses, and are inefficient for PDE modeling.
summary_en.method: The Invertible Koopman Neural Operator (IKNO) uses an invertible neural network to jointly parameterize the observable function and its inverse, and learns the evolution of low-frequency modes in frequency space.
summary_en.result: IKNO outperforms existing neural operators on numerical and real-world PDE examples while maintaining resolution invariance.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on multiple numerical benchmarks and real-world PDE datasets.

title: FLUME-FNO: data-efficient and scalable prediction of 3D wind and temperature fields in unseen urban morphologies
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种数据高效的傅里叶神经算子（FNO）框架，用于预测3D风场和温度场，其方法（如局部特征编码、深度集成不确定性量化）可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物或生物力学问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or bone-implant interface; it focuses on urban microclimate CFD surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 城市微气候CFD模拟计算昂贵，需要快速准确的替代模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出FLUME-FNO，利用多方向距离特征和局部补丁增强数据，从少量CFD数据学习。
summary_zh.result: 仅用23个CFD模拟即实现风速0.2 m/s、温度0.19°C的预测误差。
summary_zh.validation: 通过深度集成进行不确定性量化，验证预测可靠性。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional CFD for urban microclimate is computationally prohibitive, motivating a data-efficient surrogate model for rapid prediction.
summary_en.method: FLUME-FNO encodes local geometry via Multi-Directional Distance Features and uses patching to augment limited CFD data for training a Fourier Neural Operator.
summary_en.result: The model achieves mean absolute errors of 0.2 m/s for wind speed and 0.19 °C for temperature on unseen urban configurations using only 23 CFD simulations.
summary_en.validation: A deep ensemble provides uncertainty estimates, demonstrating trustworthy predictions within acceptable accuracy thresholds.

title: Causal Bayesian Optimization with Unknown Graphs
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过因果贝叶斯优化处理未知图结构，可迁移到生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification in the context of implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统因果贝叶斯优化需要已知因果图，限制了实际应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出无需先验因果图的方法，通过贝叶斯后验推断目标变量的直接因果父节点。
summary_zh.result: 在线性情况下推导出闭式后验，非线性情况使用高斯过程近似，性能与基准相当且可扩展。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准上验证优化性能，未涉及实际工程或生物力学案例。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional causal Bayesian optimization requires a fully specified causal graph, limiting its applicability in real-world scenarios where such graphs are unknown.
summary_en.method: A new method is proposed that learns a Bayesian posterior over the direct causal parents of the target variable, enabling optimization without prior knowledge of the causal graph, with a closed-form posterior for linear cases and a Gaussian process approximation for nonlinear cases.
summary_en.result: The proposed method performs competitively with existing benchmarks and scales well to larger graphs, demonstrating practical utility for optimization under causal uncertainty.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks, comparing against standard causal Bayesian optimization methods.

title: Bayesian Optimization of a Lightweight and Accurate Neural Network for Aerodynamic Performance Prediction
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用贝叶斯优化来设计轻量级神经网络，以提高气动性能预测的精度和效率，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的超参数优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on aerodynamic performance prediction in aerospace, not on FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高气动性能预测模型的精度和效率，降低计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 使用贝叶斯优化结合层次和分类核函数，优化轻量级神经网络的超参数。
summary_zh.result: 优化后的模型在阻力系数预测中MAPE从0.1433%降至0.0163%，在飞机自噪声预测中MAPE为0.82%，优于现有模型。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个气动性能预测案例验证，与基线模型和公开模型对比。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and efficiency of predictive models in aerospace multidisciplinary design optimization, which often requires numerous expensive evaluations.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian optimization framework with hierarchical and categorical kernels is proposed to optimize hyperparameters of a lightweight neural network for aerodynamic performance prediction.
summary_en.result: The optimized neural network achieves a MAPE of 0.0163% for drag coefficient prediction (an order of magnitude improvement) and 0.82% for aircraft self-noise prediction, outperforming existing models with lower computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on two aerodynamic benchmark cases, comparing against baseline models and publicly available neural networks.

title: HyperNOs: Automated and Parallel Library for Neural Operators Research
relevance_to_user: 该论文提供了一个用于神经算子超参数优化的自动化库，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的设计空间探索。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on hyperparameter optimization for neural operators in general PDE benchmarks, without any validation on FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经算子超参数调优耗时且缺乏自动化工具。
summary_zh.method: 开发基于Ray-tune的并行超参数优化库HyperNOs，支持FNO和CNO。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准上达到最优结果，支持固定参数训练和多分辨率数据。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准数据集上验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: Hyperparameter tuning for neural operators is time-consuming and lacks automated, parallelized tools.
summary_en.method: HyperNOs leverages Ray-tune for parallel hyperparameter optimization of Fourier and convolutional neural operators with a user-friendly interface.
summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art results on representative benchmarks and supports training with fixed parameter counts and multi-resolution datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical benchmarks (e.g., Darcy flow, Navier-Stokes) using Fourier and convolutional neural operators.

title: Enhancing Fourier Neural Operators with Local Spatial Features
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种增强傅里叶神经算子局部特征提取的方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on PDE surrogate accuracy without biomedical application.

summary_zh.motivation: 傅里叶神经算子忽略局部空间特征，影响PDE求解精度。
summary_zh.method: 引入CNN预提取局部特征，与FNO融合形成Conv-FNO架构。
summary_zh.result: Conv-FNO在多个PDE基准上显著提升预测性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE数值基准上验证，未涉及实验或生物力学案例。

summary_en.motivation: Fourier Neural Operators overlook local spatial features crucial for PDE solution accuracy.
summary_en.method: A CNN-based feature pre-extractor is integrated with FNO to capture local spatial dependencies, forming the Conv-FNO hybrid architecture.
summary_en.result: Conv-FNO significantly improves performance on challenging PDE benchmarks compared to standard FNO.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical experiments on standard PDE benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

title: Sample-Efficient Bayesian Transfer Learning for Online Machine Parameter Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯迁移学习方法可用于优化生物力学或植入物设计中的昂贵仿真参数，但未涉及FEA或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少生产机器参数优化所需的迭代次数以降低成本。
summary_zh.method: 利用贝叶斯优化和迁移学习，基于历史数据加速新任务优化。
summary_zh.result: 在激光切割机上验证了方法，显著减少了迭代次数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过真实激光切割实验验证优化效果。

summary_en.motivation: To minimize the number of iterations required for optimizing production machine parameters, thereby reducing costs.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian optimization algorithm enhanced with transfer learning leverages existing machine data to accelerate the search for optimal parameters.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrated significant reduction in iterations on a real laser cutting machine.
summary_en.validation: Validated through real-world experiments on a laser cutting machine for sheet metal.

title: QCPINN: Quantum-Classical Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Solving PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出量子-经典混合PINN以减少参数，可迁移至生物力学FEA代理模型，但未涉及约束优化或UQ。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no application to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 经典PINN参数多，求解复杂PDE精度有限。
summary_zh.method: 提出量子-经典混合PINN，用少量参数求解PDE。
summary_zh.result: 参数减少70-90%，精度相当或更优。
summary_zh.validation: 在五个基准PDE上对比经典PINN的L2误差。

summary_en.motivation: Classical PINNs require many parameters for accurate PDE solutions, especially for complex equations.
summary_en.method: A hybrid quantum-classical PINN (QCPINN) is proposed, combining quantum circuits with classical neural networks to reduce trainable parameters.
summary_en.result: QCPINN achieves comparable or better accuracy using only 10-30% of the parameters of classical PINNs, with L2 error reductions of 4-64% on several PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on five PDEs (Helmholtz, Klein-Gordon, etc.) comparing accuracy and convergence against classical PINNs.

visual.caption: Figure 3: Comparison of the loss history of the best models of DV-Circuit QCPINN (Angle-Cascade) with PINN (Model-2) for solving the Helmholtz equation. For loss history of additional models, see Fig. 10 in the appendix.

title: NeuralFoil: An Airfoil Aerodynamics Analysis Tool Using Physics-Informed Machine Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了物理信息机器学习在空气动力学代理建模中的应用，其方法（混合物理信息与数据驱动、不确定性量化、约束优化）可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的FEA代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on airfoil aerodynamics, not on biomedical implant FEA or biomechanics, and lacks validation on solid mechanics or implant-specific constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速翼型气动分析，替代传统XFoil工具
summary_zh.method: 混合物理信息机器学习与解析模型，嵌入对称性和领域知识
summary_zh.result: 速度提升8-1000倍，阻力预测误差低至0.37%
summary_zh.validation: 与XFoil数值结果对比，在简单和失速工况下验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop a rapid and accurate surrogate for airfoil aerodynamics analysis, replacing the traditional XFoil tool.
summary_en.method: A hybrid approach combining physics-informed machine learning with analytical models, embedding symmetries and domain knowledge into the architecture.
summary_en.result: Achieves 8x to 1000x speedup over XFoil with mean relative drag error as low as 0.37% on simple cases.
summary_en.validation: Validated by comparing predictions with XFoil numerical results across a wide range of conditions, including post-stall and transitional flows.

title: Enhanced Vascular Flow Simulations in Aortic Aneurysm via Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Deep Operator Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN和DeepONet应用于血管流场模拟，其方法可迁移至生物力学FEA替代建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: No implant mechanics, no contact mechanics, no structural FEA, no multi-objective or constrained optimization, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决4D MRI精度不足和CFD计算耗时的问题
summary_zh.method: 采用PINN、DeepONet及PI-DeepONet预测3D腹主动脉瘤血流
summary_zh.result: 与CFD基准对比验证，部分案例计算效率提升
summary_zh.validation: 与CFD仿真结果对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the limited accuracy of 4D MRI and the high computational cost of CFD in patient-specific hemodynamics.
summary_en.method: Physics-Informed Neural Networks, Deep Operator Networks, and their physics-informed extensions are applied to predict 3D Navier-Stokes flows in an idealized abdominal aortic aneurysm model.
summary_en.result: The models show good agreement with CFD benchmarks, with some cases demonstrating improved computational efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing predictions against CFD simulation results for benchmark datasets.

key_terms.zh: 物理信息深度算子网络

title: Efficient forward and inverse uncertainty quantification for dynamical systems based on dimension reduction and Kriging surrogate modeling in functional space
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过功能降维和Kriging代理模型实现动态系统的不确定性量化，可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的代理建模与不确定性分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics, lacks experimental validation, and focuses on generic dynamical systems without contact mechanics or stress constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决动态系统小样本下高维响应代理建模与不确定性量化的难题
summary_zh.method: 提出功能降维Kriging方法，将时变响应投影到低维潜在函数空间构建代理模型
summary_zh.result: 在三个数值算例中实现了高精度代理建模与高效不确定性量化
summary_zh.validation: 通过三个数值算例验证代理模型精度与UQ效率

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of constructing accurate surrogate models for high-dimensional dynamical system responses with limited training samples for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: The proposed Kriging framework based on functional dimension reduction (KFDR) projects time-variant responses onto a low-dimensional latent functional space via functional eigendecomposition and builds Kriging surrogates with noise terms.
summary_en.result: The KFDR method achieves high accuracy and efficiency in both forward and inverse uncertainty quantification for dynamical systems, demonstrated on three numerical examples.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on three numerical benchmark examples, showing accurate surrogate predictions and efficient UQ.

key_terms.zh: 正向与逆向不确定性量化

title: A PINN-enriched finite element method for linear elliptic problems
relevance_to_user: 该方法将PINN与有限元结合，可提高求解效率，但仅针对线性椭圆问题，未涉及生物力学或植入物设计中的约束与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No biomechanics or implant design context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and only tested on linear elliptic PDEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高有限元法求解线性椭圆问题的精度与效率
summary_zh.method: 用PINN解近似解，将其加入有限元空间，再求解
summary_zh.result: 相同收敛阶下精度更高，部分算例误差降低数个量级
summary_zh.validation: 一维到三维数值算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the accuracy and efficiency of finite element methods for linear elliptic problems by incorporating neural network solutions.
summary_en.method: A three-step hybrid approach: train a PINN for an approximate solution, enrich the finite element space with this solution via addition or multiplication, then solve using standard FEM.
summary_en.result: The enriched FEM achieves the same convergence order as standard FEM but with significantly higher accuracy, reducing errors by orders of magnitude in some examples.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks from 1D to 3D confirm theoretical convergence and accuracy improvements.

title: SEEK: Self-adaptive Explainable Kernel For Nonstationary Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自适应非平稳核方法可提升高斯过程在代理建模中的预测精度与不确定性量化能力，对生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真替代模型具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to any FEA or biomechanics design problem, nor does it address constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有高斯过程核函数难以处理非平稳数据，导致预测与不确定性估计不准。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种基于人工神经元启发的可学习核函数，通过基核映射实现自适应非平稳性。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准测试中，所提方法在预测精度和不确定性量化上均优于现有核函数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过敏感性分析和对比实验验证方法的鲁棒性与优越性。

summary_en.motivation: Standard stationary kernels in Gaussian processes limit predictive accuracy and uncertainty calibration for nonstationary real-world data.
summary_en.method: SEEK introduces a learnable kernel class derived from first principles, using a mapping from base kernels to achieve flexible nonstationarity.
summary_en.result: Comprehensive benchmarks show SEEK outperforms existing stationary and nonstationary kernels in both mean prediction and uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through sensitivity analysis and comparative studies on synthetic and real datasets.

visual.caption: Figure 1 : Schematic illustration of our kernel: SEEK has a set of weighted base kernels with learnable hyperparameters where the weights are learnable functions. These weighted kernels, along with a learnable bias term, are summed and then passed through an appropriate activation function to produce the final nonstationary covariance function.

title: Robot milling system integrated design and finite element analysis of custom femoral prostheses.
venue: Journal of orthopaedic surgery and research

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Orthopedic Surgery, The 82nd Hospital of People's Liberation Army, No. 100, Jiankang East Road, Qingjiangpu District, Huai'an, Jiangsu Province , 223001, China. yuepengju2024@163.com.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接涉及定制股骨假体的有限元分析，包括应力遮挡和微动，但缺乏详细的Gruen区分析或接触力学建模。
why_not_core: Does not report stress/strain in Gruen zones, micromotion values with contact/friction modeling, or comparison of intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决定制假体设计与手术植入后力传递不一致导致的微动和应力遮挡问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出CAD/CAM/机器人集成方法，结合有限元分析控制假体力传递。
summary_zh.result: 定制假体有限元分析可有效控制力传递，铣削误差小于1毫米。
summary_zh.validation: 通过有限元仿真验证力传递控制效果。

summary_en.motivation: To address the mismatch between designed and postoperative force transfer of custom femoral prostheses, which can cause excessive micromotion and stress shielding.
summary_en.method: A CAD/CAM/robot integrated design and manufacturing method combined with finite element analysis to control prosthesis force transfer.
summary_en.result: Finite element analysis of the custom prosthesis effectively manages force transfer, and milling errors are less than 1 mm.
summary_en.validation: Validation via finite element simulation of the custom prosthesis design.

title: Quantification of Uncertainties in Probabilistic Deep Neural Network by Implementing Boosting of Variational Inference
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的增强变分推断方法可用于提高代理模型的不确定性量化能力，但未涉及有限元仿真或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on general probabilistic deep learning with variational inference.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准变分推断使用单一密度近似导致后验估计差，需提升不确定性估计。
summary_zh.method: 提出Boosted Bayesian Neural Networks，通过迭代构建密度混合来增强权重分布近似。
summary_zh.result: 相比传统神经网络，准确率提升约5%，同时提供更优的不确定性量化。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准基准数据集上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard variational inference relies on a single-density approximation, leading to poor posterior estimates and limited uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: We propose Boosted Bayesian Neural Networks (BBNN) that iteratively constructs a mixture of densities via Boosting Variational Inference to achieve a more expressive posterior.
summary_en.result: BBNN achieves approximately 5% higher accuracy than conventional neural networks while providing superior uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on standard benchmark datasets for classification tasks.

visual.caption: Figure 2: Optimization of the true 1-Dimensional posterior after adding components in Boosting Variational Inference.

title: Hierarchical Gaussian Random Fields for Multilevel Markov Chain Monte Carlo: Coupling Stochastic Partial Differential Equation and The Karhunen-Loève Decomposition
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过多层级高斯随机场实现高维贝叶斯推断中的高效采样，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical FEA surrogate modeling or implant design; it only demonstrates on a subsurface flow benchmark.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有高斯随机场采样方法在维度缩减与精度之间存在权衡，缺乏统一框架。
summary_zh.method: 提出结合KL展开与SPDE的多层级分层分解方法，利用几何多重网格层次实现粗到细采样。
summary_zh.result: 在基准地下流问题中，新方法比现有方法更高效、准确且收敛性更好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准问题（地下流）验证计算效率与统计精度。

summary_en.motivation: Existing scalable hierarchical sampling methods for Gaussian random fields suffer from a trade-off between dimensionality reduction and inference accuracy, motivating a unified framework.
summary_en.method: A hierarchical decomposition integrating KL expansion dimensionality reduction with SPDE-based scalability is proposed, leveraging a geometric multigrid hierarchy for coarse-to-fine sampling while preserving covariance structure.
summary_en.result: The proposed method demonstrates superior computational efficiency, accuracy, and convergence properties compared to existing approaches on a benchmark subsurface flow problem.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a numerical benchmark problem (subsurface flow) to assess computational efficiency and statistical accuracy.

title: Bayesian Optimization with Lower Confidence Bounds for Minimization Problems with Known Outer Structure
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯优化方法可处理已知外部结构的约束问题，对植入物设计中的多目标优化和不确定性量化具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, biomechanics, or implant design; it focuses on theoretical BO with known outer structure and linear parametric models.

summary_zh.motivation: 经典贝叶斯优化未利用已知外部结构，导致采样效率低。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种利用已知外部结构的置信下界算法，分析凸损失和线性参数模型下的遗憾界。
summary_zh.result: 结构感知方法在数值示例中优于结构无关方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证算法性能。

summary_en.motivation: Classic Bayesian optimization ignores known outer problem structure, leading to inefficient sampling.
summary_en.method: A novel lower confidence bound algorithm exploiting known outer structure is proposed, with regret analysis for convex loss functions and linear parametric models.
summary_en.result: Structure-exploiting methods outperform structure-agnostic approaches on numerical examples.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via numerical benchmark examples.

title: 3D Bioprinting of Cultivated Meat Followed by the Development of a Fine-Tuned YOLO Model for the Detection and Counting of Lipoblasts, Fibroblasts, and Myogenic Cells.
first_author_affiliation: Research Laboratory "Medical Digital Images Based on the Basic Model", Department of Bioengineering, Faculty of Bioengineering and Veterinary Medicine, Don State Technical University, 344000 Rostov-on-Don, Russia.

corresponding_authors.name: Stanislav Rodkin
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Research Laboratory "Medical Digital Images Based on the Basic Model", Department of Bioengineering, Faculty of Bioengineering and Veterinary Medicine, Don State Technical University, 344000 Rostov-on-Don, Russia.

relevance_to_user: 该论文将AI用于生物打印后细胞检测，但未涉及打印过程控制或自主决策。
why_not_core: No AI integration into bioprinting workflow stages (pre/in/post); AI is only used post-printing for cell counting, not for process control or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发3D打印培养肉并利用AI检测细胞类型以监控培养过程。
summary_zh.method: 制备兔源细胞生物墨水进行3D打印，训练YOLOv8模型检测脂肪细胞、成纤维细胞和肌细胞。
summary_zh.result: 成功打印组织构建体，多类YOLO模型在细胞检测中达到92%召回率和精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过共聚焦和透射电镜验证细胞活力和代谢活性。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a 3D bioprinted cultured meat product and an AI-based cell detection system for monitoring cell growth in the construct.
summary_en.method: Rabbit-derived multipotent mesenchymal stem cells and fibroblasts were used to formulate bioinks for 3D printing, and YOLOv8-seg models were trained on annotated microscopy images to detect and count lipoblasts, fibroblasts, and myogenic cells.
summary_en.result: 3D-printed tissue constructs with viable cells were produced, and the multiclass YOLO model achieved 92% recall and 92% precision for cell detection.
summary_en.validation: Cell viability and metabolic activity were confirmed by confocal and transmission electron microscopy.

title: Mitigating Spectral Bias in Neural Operators via High-Frequency Scaling for Physical Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种缓解神经算子频谱偏差的方法，可提高多尺度物理系统预测精度，对生物力学代理模型有借鉴意义。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant-related FEA problems; no uncertainty quantification; no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经算子对高频模式不敏感，导致多尺度物理系统预测过于平滑。
summary_zh.method: 提出高频缩放方法，在潜空间直接放大高频分量，集成到UNet神经算子中。
summary_zh.result: 在单相和两相流问题中，高频缩放显著提高了预测精度，且计算成本低于傅里叶方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过单相和两相流数值基准测试验证精度提升。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators suffer from spectral bias, producing over-smoothed solutions for multiscale physical systems with high-frequency modes.
summary_en.method: A high-frequency scaling (HFS) method is introduced to amplify high-frequency components directly in the latent space of convolutional neural operators.
summary_en.result: HFS-integrated UNet operators achieve higher prediction accuracy on single- and two-phase flow problems, outperforming standard Fourier-based approaches.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on single- and two-phase flow problems demonstrate improved accuracy and reduced spectral bias.

title: Uncertainty Quantification for Data-Driven Machine Learning Models in Nuclear Engineering Applications: Where We Are and What Do We Need?
relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论了机器学习不确定性量化的一般框架，但未涉及FEA代理模型或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on nuclear engineering applications and does not address surrogate modeling for FEA, implant design, or biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 机器学习在核工程中广泛应用，但不确定性量化不足。
summary_zh.method: 综述了物理模型与数据驱动模型UQ的概念、来源和技术。
summary_zh.result: 强调了建立验证、确认和UQ框架对ML可信度的重要性。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为综述性讨论。

summary_en.motivation: The widespread adoption of ML in nuclear engineering lacks adequate uncertainty quantification, which is critical for model credibility.
summary_en.method: This review compares UQ concepts for physics-based and data-driven models, discusses uncertainty sources, and demonstrates several UQ techniques.
summary_en.result: It advocates for a verification, validation, and UQ framework to establish ML credibility in safety-critical applications.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a conceptual review with illustrative examples.

title: Probabilistic Neural Networks (PNNs) with t-Distributed Outputs: Adaptive Prediction Intervals Beyond Gaussian Assumptions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的t分布输出神经网络可用于不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的预测区间估计。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, lacks any biomechanics or implant design context, and does not address constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统高斯假设导致预测区间过宽，需更灵活的不确定性建模。
summary_zh.method: 提出t分布输出神经网络，用位置、尺度和自由度参数化预测分布。
summary_zh.result: 相比高斯PNN，t分布网络在保持覆盖的同时产生更窄的预测区间。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实数据集上评估区间覆盖与宽度平衡。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian output assumption in probabilistic neural networks yields overly wide prediction intervals, motivating a more flexible distribution.
summary_en.method: Propose t-Distributed Neural Networks (TDistNNs) that output t-distributions parameterized by location, scale, and degrees of freedom.
summary_en.result: TDistNNs produce narrower prediction intervals than Gaussian PNNs while maintaining proper coverage on synthetic and real-world data.
summary_en.validation: Empirical evaluation on synthetic and real-world regression datasets comparing coverage and interval width.

visual.caption: Figure 1: This plot compares the tail behavior of standard Gaussian and t-distributions, showing realizations of a target variable (x-axis) and shaded 0.10 tail probability regions (0.05 per tail). It highlights the t-distribution’s heavier tails and its enhanced ability to accommodate extreme values and model mismatch.

title: A new graph-based surrogate model for rapid prediction of crashworthiness performance of vehicle panel components
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的图神经网络代理模型方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但缺乏不确定性量化和约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or biomedical implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高车辆碰撞安全性分析中有限元仿真的计算效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于图U-Net和循环结构的代理模型ReGUNet预测B柱动态响应。
summary_zh.result: 最大侵入量预测相对误差0.74%，变形预测误差降低51%以上。
summary_zh.validation: 通过侧碰撞案例验证，对比基线模型评估精度和效率。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of crashworthiness finite element simulations for vehicle panel components.
summary_en.method: Proposes ReGUNet, a graph-based surrogate model combining U-Net architecture with recurrent layers for temporal prediction.
summary_en.result: Achieves 0.74% relative error for maximum B-pillar intrusion and reduces average deformation prediction error by over 51%.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a side crash test case of a B-pillar component with geometric variations.

why_not_core: This paper does not cover LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), stress shielding, or porous structure design for orthopedic implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统评估植入物表面成骨能力的方法耗时且效率低。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the curse of dimensionality and poor generalization in solving value functions for general-sum differential games with state constraints.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Hybrid Neural Operator (HNO) that leverages both supervised data and PDE-driven data across the entire spatiotemporal domain for model refinement.
summary_en.result: HNO outperforms a Supervised Neural Operator (DeepONet variant) in safety performance on 9D and 13D scenarios with nonlinear dynamics and state constraints.
summary_en.validation: Validated on high-dimensional simulation cases with nonlinear dynamics and state constraints, comparing against a baseline neural operator.

key_terms.zh: 哈密顿-雅可比-艾萨克斯方程

title: Learning and discovering multiple solutions using physics-informed neural networks with random initialization and deep ensemble
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PINN随机初始化和深度集成方法可迁移至生物力学FEA替代模型中的多解发现与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or expensive simulation sampling efficiency in a biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 非线性微分方程多解发现困难，传统方法对初值敏感。
summary_zh.method: 利用PINN随机初始化和深度集成方法发现多解，并作为传统求解器初值。
summary_zh.result: 成功识别Allen-Cahn方程和空腔流动的稳定与不稳定解。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值基准实验验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Capturing multiple solutions of nonlinear differential equations is challenging due to sensitivity to initial conditions in traditional solvers.
summary_en.method: A simple approach combining physics-informed neural networks with random initialization and deep ensemble is proposed to discover multiple solutions, which are then used as initial guesses for conventional solvers.
summary_en.result: The method successfully identifies both stable and unstable solutions for the Allen-Cahn equation and cavity flow problems.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical experiments on benchmark nonlinear ODEs/PDEs validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

title: Clustering-based Meta Bayesian Optimization with Theoretical Guarantee
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过聚类和元学习加速贝叶斯优化，可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 异构和大规模元任务下贝叶斯优化效率低，需可扩展鲁棒方法。
summary_zh.method: 通过聚类划分同质子任务，学习几何原型，在线阶段用统计距离加权合成元先验。
summary_zh.result: 在超参数优化任务上验证了鲁棒性和有效性，并提供理论保证。
summary_zh.validation: 在真实超参数优化基准上实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Meta-Bayesian optimization faces scalability and robustness issues when historical tasks are heterogeneous and large-scale.
summary_en.method: The proposed method partitions meta-functions into homogeneous clusters, learns geometry-based surrogate prototypes, and adaptively synthesizes meta-priors via statistical distance weighting.
summary_en.result: Experiments on hyperparameter optimization tasks demonstrate robustness and effectiveness, supported by theoretical guarantees.
summary_en.validation: Validated on real-world hyperparameter optimization benchmarks.

title: Physics-based machine learning for fatigue lifetime prediction under non-uniform loading scenarios
relevance_to_user: 该论文将物理约束嵌入神经网络预测疲劳寿命，其方法可迁移至生物打印中基于物理信息的寿命预测或数字孪生建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve bioprinting, bioink, or any biomedical context; it focuses on fatigue of concrete under cyclic loading.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统疲劳模拟计算成本高，需高效预测方法。
summary_zh.method: 将物理约束嵌入前馈神经网络，利用各向异性连续损伤模型生成训练数据。
summary_zh.result: 相比纯数据驱动模型，在有限数据下预测精度更高，能捕捉多载荷过渡下的损伤演化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过混凝土圆柱试件单轴压缩疲劳实验数据校准和验证。

summary_en.motivation: Accurate fatigue lifetime prediction under non-uniform loading is computationally expensive, motivating efficient surrogate models.
summary_en.method: A physics-based feedforward neural network embeds experimental physical constraints and is trained on simulations from an anisotropic continuum damage fatigue model.
summary_en.result: The proposed model outperforms purely data-driven networks, especially with limited data, and correctly predicts damage accumulation trends under multiple loading transitions.
summary_en.validation: The model is calibrated and validated against experimental fatigue data from concrete cylinder specimens tested in uniaxial compression.

title: From Theory to Application: A Practical Introduction to Neural Operators in Scientific Computing
relevance_to_user: 该综述介绍了神经算子方法，可迁移至生物力学代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper is a review of neural operators for PDEs, lacking application to implant biomechanics, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 为科学计算提供神经算子实用指南
summary_zh.method: 综述DeepONet、PCANet、FNO等架构及其在泊松方程和线弹性问题上的应用
summary_zh.result: 展示了神经算子在正向求解和贝叶斯推断中的有效性
summary_zh.validation: 在经典线性PDE基准上验证

summary_en.motivation: This review aims to provide a practical introduction to neural operators for solving parametric PDEs in scientific computing.
summary_en.method: It covers DeepONet, PCANet, and FNO architectures, demonstrating them on Poisson and linear elasticity problems, and extends to Bayesian inference.
summary_en.result: Neural operators effectively accelerate forward and inverse problems, but challenges in accuracy control and generalization remain.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks of linear parametric PDEs.

title: Exploiting Inexact Computations in Multilevel Monte Carlo and Other Sampling Methods
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种利用非精确计算加速多层蒙特卡洛方法的不确定性量化框架，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型中的高效采样与UQ。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on PDE discretization error and inexact solvers for general UQ, without addressing implant/biomechanics design constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 多层采样方法中粗层模型可容忍较大计算误差，如何利用此特性提升性能。
summary_zh.method: 分析多层蒙特卡洛中的计算误差，提出自适应算法确定每层最小计算精度。
summary_zh.result: 在椭圆PDE算例中，低精度求解器实现内存引用加速3.5倍，FLOPs加速1.5倍。
summary_zh.validation: 通过椭圆PDE数值算例验证，对比双精度求解器性能。

summary_en.motivation: To exploit the tolerance of coarse-level models to computational error in multilevel sampling methods for improved efficiency.
summary_en.method: An adaptive algorithm is formulated to determine the minimum required computational accuracy per level by analyzing computational error in multilevel Monte Carlo.
summary_en.result: Using low-precision solvers yields up to 3.5x memory reference gain and 1.5x FLOPs speedup for an elliptic PDE with lognormal coefficients.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on an elliptic PDE with lognormal random coefficients, comparing against double precision solvers.

title: BoGrape: Bayesian optimization over graphs with shortest-path encoded
relevance_to_user: 该方法将贝叶斯优化扩展到图结构数据，可迁移到植入物设计中的结构优化问题，但未涉及FEA或生物力学。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate modeling, no biomechanics or implant design context, and no uncertainty quantification beyond standard BO.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有贝叶斯优化难以处理图结构数据中的结构约束和全局探索。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于最短路径图核和混合整数规划的贝叶斯优化框架BoGrape。
summary_zh.result: 在合成基准和分子设计案例中表现竞争力。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成基准和分子设计案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing Bayesian optimization methods struggle to incorporate structural constraints and explore unseen graph structures in black-box optimization over graphs.
summary_en.method: BoGrape integrates shortest-path graph kernels with mixed-integer programming to enable principled acquisition optimization over graph structures and node attributes.
summary_en.result: The method achieves competitive performance on synthetic benchmarks and molecular design tasks with application-specific constraints.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic benchmarks and representative molecular design case studies.

title: BARK: A Fully Bayesian Tree Kernel for Black-box Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于树的贝叶斯优化方法，可处理混合特征空间并提供结构不确定性量化，对代理模型和优化方法有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA or biomechanical design, lacks validation on expensive simulation problems, and does not address constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有树核方法缺乏对树结构的不确定性量化，影响贝叶斯优化性能。
summary_zh.method: 提出BARK，通过树一致性和MCMC采样定义树核上的后验分布，构建采集函数。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和实际基准测试中，BARK优于现有方法，尤其适用于混合特征空间。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准优化基准上进行了数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing tree-based kernels for Bayesian optimization lack uncertainty quantification over the tree structure, limiting their effectiveness.
summary_en.method: BARK defines a posterior over tree kernels via tree agreement and MCMC sampling, enabling acquisition functions for Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.result: BARK demonstrates strong performance on synthetic and applied benchmarks, particularly in mixed-feature spaces.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard optimization benchmarks validate the method.

title: Utilizing 3d-printed patient-specific porous titanium cones in complex primary and revision total knee arthroplasty.
venue: European journal of orthopaedic surgery & traumatology : orthopedie traumatologie
first_author_affiliation: Center for Orthopedic Trans-Disciplinary Applied Research, Tehran University of Medical Sciences, Tehran, Iran.

corresponding_authors.name: Morad Karimpour
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical Engineering, College of Engineering, University of Tehran, Tehran, Iran. m.karimpour@ut.ac.ir.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D打印多孔钛锥体在膝关节置换中的应用，但未涉及应力遮挡、疲劳测试或表面形貌等核心方向。
why_not_core: No stress shielding quantification, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no surface roughness or as-built morphology analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决亚洲患者骨缺损重建中标准金属锥体尺寸不匹配的问题
summary_zh.method: 基于CT设计患者特异性多孔钛锥体，采用SLM制造并植入
summary_zh.result: 19个锥体成功植入，早期随访无松动或移位
summary_zh.validation: 临床病例验证，术前规划与术中结果一致

summary_en.motivation: To address size mismatch of off-the-shelf metal cones in Asian patients with bone defects during revision total knee arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Patient-specific porous titanium cones were designed from CT scans and fabricated via selective laser melting, then implanted in complex primary or revision TKA.
summary_en.result: Nineteen cones were successfully implanted with perfect alignment between preoperative planning and intraoperative outcomes; no loosening or migration at early follow-up.
summary_en.validation: Clinical case series with ten patients and early follow-up.

title: Neural Network Surrogate Model for Junction Temperature and Hotspot Position in $3$D Multi-Layer High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) Chiplets under Varying Thermal Conditions
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了神经网络代理模型在三维芯片热管理中的应用，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context; it focuses on electronic chip thermal management.

summary_zh.motivation: 快速预测三维高带宽存储器芯片的结温和热点位置。
summary_zh.method: 使用有限元数据训练神经网络代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 模型能准确快速预测任意热条件下的结温和热点位置。
summary_zh.validation: 通过有限元仿真数据集验证预测精度。

summary_en.motivation: To enable fast prediction of junction temperature and hotspot position in 3D HBM chiplets under varying thermal conditions for early design.
summary_en.method: A neural network surrogate model is trained on a dataset of 13,494 finite element simulations covering a high-dimensional parameter space.
summary_en.result: The surrogate model accurately and quickly predicts junction temperature and hotspot position for any thermal condition within and beyond the training parameter space.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using a held-out test set from finite element simulations, demonstrating good generalizability.

title: Microfluidic 3D Bioprinting of Foamed Fibers with Controlled Micromorphology.
first_author_affiliation: Department of Chemistry, University of Rome "La Sapienza", 00185 Rome, Italy.; Center for Life Nano- & Neuro-Science - CLN2S, Italian Institute of Technology (IIT), 00161 Rome, Italy.

corresponding_authors.name: Marco Costantini
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Physical Chemistry, Polish Academy of Sciences, 01224 Warsaw, Poland.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D生物打印，但未集成AI，与AI生物打印方向不直接相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not integrate AI into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on microfluidic foam generation and scaffold fabrication without machine learning or autonomous control.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现具有可控微孔形态的3D生物打印支架。
summary_zh.method: 微流控实时生成液态泡沫，凝胶化后3D打印成多孔纤维支架。
summary_zh.result: 可动态调节气泡尺寸，实现高空间精度的梯度孔隙分布。
summary_zh.validation: 通过机械测试、形态表征和细胞培养验证生物相容性。

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate porous functionally graded scaffolds with controlled micromorphology for bone tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: A microfluidic device generates liquid foam in real-time, which is gelled and 3D bioprinted into porous fibers with adjustable bubble size.
summary_en.result: The approach enables dynamic control of pore size during printing, achieving spatially defined porosity gradients.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing, morphological characterization, and in vitro cell culture with osteosarcoma cells confirmed biocompatibility and cell proliferation influenced by microporosity.

title: Weighted Euclidean Distance Matrices over Mixed Continuous and Categorical Inputs for Gaussian Process Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的WEGP方法可处理混合连续和分类输入，对生物力学设计中的离散参数（如材料类型、几何特征）建模有借鉴意义。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for expensive simulation sampling; it focuses on GP kernel construction for mixed inputs and Bayesian optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准高斯过程无法处理分类变量，限制其在工程优化中的应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出加权欧氏距离矩阵高斯过程，用基矩阵线性组合构建分类变量核函数。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和实际优化问题中，WEGP结合贝叶斯优化取得优越性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验和理论分析验证模型预测精度。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Gaussian processes cannot handle categorical inputs, limiting their use in engineering optimization with mixed variable types.
summary_en.method: The paper proposes Weighted Euclidean Distance Matrix Gaussian Process (WEGP), which constructs kernel functions for categorical inputs via linear combinations of predefined base Euclidean distance matrices.
summary_en.result: WEGP integrated with Bayesian optimization achieves superior performance on both synthetic and real-world optimization problems.
summary_en.validation: The model's predictive accuracy is validated through numerical experiments and theoretical analysis.

title: Volume-Sorted Prediction Set: Efficient Conformal Prediction for Multi-Target Regression
relevance_to_user: 该方法提供了一种高效的不确定性量化框架，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的多目标回归问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, implant design, or any biomedical context, and lacks validation on physical simulation data.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法在多目标回归中预测区域过大或缺乏覆盖保证。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于条件归一化流与共形校准的体积排序预测集，构造自适应非凸预测区域。
summary_zh.result: 在保证覆盖概率的同时生成更小、信息更丰富的预测区域。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准多目标回归基准数据集上验证覆盖率和区域体积。

summary_en.motivation: Existing uncertainty quantification methods for multi-target regression often produce overly large prediction regions or lack rigorous coverage guarantees.
summary_en.method: Volume-Sorted Prediction Set (VSPS) uses conditional normalizing flows with conformal calibration to construct flexible, non-convex predictive regions that adapt to the data density.
summary_en.result: VSPS yields smaller and more informative prediction regions while maintaining guaranteed coverage probabilities on benchmark datasets.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on standard multi-target regression benchmarks by comparing coverage and region volume against baselines.

visual.caption: Figure 1 : Scheme of the Volume-Sorted Prediction Set (VSPS) method. The CNF maps the original distribution to a standard normal distribution. Samples are generated, sorted, and selected based on their absolute Jacobian determinant. Top K K samples are transformed back to form the prediction region as balls of radius γ \gamma centered at the samples. γ \gamma is calibrated to ensure the desired 1 − α 1-\alpha coverage, whereas the optimal K K is determined using a validation set. See Section 4 for details.

title: Integrating Predictive and Generative Capabilities by Latent Space Design via the DKL-VAE Model
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的VAE-DKL框架结合了生成模型与高斯过程预测，可迁移至生物力学设计中的代理建模与多目标优化。
why_not_core: The paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification in the context of implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 结合生成模型与预测模型，实现高维数据的高通量材料发现。
summary_zh.method: 提出VAE-DKL框架，用VAE学习潜在表示，DKL通过高斯过程回归结构化潜在空间。
summary_zh.result: 在卡片和QM9数据集上实现了高精度属性预测和新型结构生成。
summary_zh.validation: 在结构化卡片和QM9分子数据集上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: To integrate generative and predictive capabilities for high-throughput material discovery by structuring the latent space with target property information.
summary_en.method: A VAE-DKL framework is proposed where a VAE learns a latent representation and Deep Kernel Learning uses Gaussian Process regression to structure the latent space for property prediction.
summary_en.result: The model achieves high-precision property prediction and generates novel out-of-distribution structures with desired characteristics on card and QM9 datasets.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on a structured card dataset and the QM9 molecular dataset with enthalpy as target.

title: HiGP: A high-performance Python package for Gaussian Process
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的高效高斯过程计算包可加速大规模回归任务，其可扩展性对代理模型构建具有潜在价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on computational efficiency of GP inference without addressing surrogate modeling for FEA, constraint handling, or biomechanical design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高斯过程在大规模数据上的计算瓶颈
summary_zh.method: 利用H²矩阵和自适应因子化Nyström预条件子实现近线性复杂度
summary_zh.result: 在空间数据集上实现存储和计算的近线性复杂度，加速迭代求解器收敛
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证计算效率和可扩展性

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the O(n^3) computational bottleneck of Gaussian Processes for large-scale datasets.
summary_en.method: Integrates H^2 matrices for near-linear complexity and an Adaptive Factorized Nyström preconditioner to accelerate iterative solvers.
summary_en.result: Achieves near-linear storage and computation for spatial datasets with robust convergence across kernel spectra.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmarks demonstrating scalability and efficiency compared to existing GP frameworks.

title: BLADE: Bayesian Langevin Active Discovery with Replica Exchange for Identification of Complex Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的主动学习与贝叶斯框架可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的采样效率优化，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on discovering governing equations of dynamical systems, not on surrogate modeling for expensive FEA simulations, and does not address constraint handling or implant-specific biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效识别复杂动力系统，降低数据采集成本
summary_zh.method: 结合副本交换随机梯度Langevin蒙特卡洛与主动学习的贝叶斯框架
summary_zh.result: 在Lotka-Volterra和Burgers方程上分别减少约60%和40%的测量需求
summary_zh.validation: 在标准基准系统上验证数据效率提升

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently discover governing equations of complex dynamical systems from scarce and expensive data.
summary_en.method: Proposes BLADE, a Bayesian framework combining replica-exchange stochastic gradient Langevin Monte Carlo with active learning for probabilistic parameter estimation and uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: Achieves 60% and 40% reduction in measurement requirements for Lotka-Volterra and Burgers' equations, respectively, compared to random sampling.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmark dynamical systems (Lotka-Volterra, Burgers' equation) demonstrating data efficiency gains.

title: Learning Actionable World Models for Industrial Process Control
relevance_to_user: 该论文将世界模型用于工业过程控制，其方法可迁移至生物打印中的主动控制，但缺乏生物打印实验验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not address bioprinting, lacks experimental validation in a biomedical context, and does not integrate AI into a specific bioprinting workflow stage.

summary_zh.motivation: 从被动监控转向主动过程控制，需从有限数据学习系统行为。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于世界模型的方法，通过对比学习解耦潜在表征中的过程参数。
summary_zh.result: 在注塑成型中验证了提出控制动作的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 在注塑成型工业案例上验证方法。

summary_en.motivation: To transition from passive process monitoring to active control, an AI system must learn system behavior from limited data.
summary_en.method: A world model learning approach that disentangles process parameters in latent space via contrastive learning within a joint embedding predictive architecture.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates practical relevance by proposing effective control actions for plastic injection molding.
summary_en.validation: Validated on an industrial plastic injection molding case study.

title: Gaussian Process Surrogate Models for Efficient Estimation of Structural Response Distributions and Order Statistics
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用高斯过程代理模型高效估计结构响应分布和顺序统计量，方法可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真替代。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, lacks constraint handling and uncertainty quantification beyond point prediction, and focuses on structural engineering SLS assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 物理仿真计算昂贵，难以生成统计有效的结构响应分布。
summary_zh.method: 用高斯过程代理模型基于有限仿真输出直接生成结构响应分布。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型在极低计算成本下获得与全仿真相当的结果。
summary_zh.validation: 通过历史天气数据下的结构响应顺序统计量评估验证。

summary_en.motivation: Physics-based simulations are computationally expensive, making it challenging to generate statistically valid structural response distributions for rare events.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian Process surrogate model is trained on a limited set of simulation outputs to directly estimate the structural response distribution and order statistics.
summary_en.result: The GP surrogate achieves comparable accuracy to full simulations while drastically reducing computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a serviceability limit state assessment using 25 years of historical weather data to estimate the 100th highest response.

summary_en.motivation: Solid dental implants suffer from stress shielding and poor osseointegration, motivating the design of porous implants to mitigate these issues.
summary_en.method: Three TPMS-based porous dental implants (Gyroid, Schwarz Diamond, Schwarz Primitive) were designed and evaluated using FEA and CFD.
summary_en.result: The Diamond implant reduced bone stress but increased micromotion in low-density bone; FEA slightly overpredicted stress, and Diamond's permeability matched cancellous bone.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through FEA and CFD simulations without experimental testing.

title: PINN-MG: A physics-informed neural network for mesh generation
relevance_to_user: 该方法将PINN用于网格生成，可间接提升FEA代理模型的输入质量，但未直接解决采样效率或UQ问题。

summary_zh.motivation: 结构化网格生成耗时且需人工，现有方法难以兼顾效率与质量。
summary_zh.method: 提出PINN-MG，用注意力网络学习计算域到物理域的映射，损失函数引入Navier-Lamé方程。
summary_zh.result: 无需数据集即可生成高质量结构化四边形网格，优于传统方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个几何域上测试网格质量指标。

summary_en.motivation: Structured mesh generation is labor-intensive and existing methods struggle to balance efficiency and quality.
summary_en.method: PINN-MG uses an attention network to learn the mapping from computational to physical domain, with the Navier-Lamé equation as a PDE loss term for unsupervised training.
summary_en.result: The method generates high-quality structured quad meshes without any training data, outperforming traditional algebraic and differential methods.
summary_en.validation: Mesh quality metrics (e.g., orthogonality, smoothness) are evaluated on multiple 2D geometries.

title: PABBO: Preferential Amortized Black-Box Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过元学习加速偏好贝叶斯优化，可迁移至植入物设计中的多目标约束优化问题。

summary_zh.motivation: 偏好贝叶斯优化计算开销大，不适合人机交互场景。
summary_zh.method: 提出全摊销偏好贝叶斯优化方法，元学习代理模型和采集函数。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实数据集上，速度提升数个数量级且精度更优。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实数据集上对比高斯过程策略。

summary_en.motivation: Preferential Bayesian Optimization suffers from high computational cost due to non-conjugate likelihood, hindering real-time human interaction.
summary_en.method: This work fully amortizes PBO by meta-learning both the surrogate model and acquisition function using a transformer neural process trained with reinforcement learning and auxiliary losses.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves several orders of magnitude speedup over standard GP-based strategies while often improving accuracy on synthetic and real-world benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic and real-world preferential optimization datasets, comparing against standard GP-based PBO methods.

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization struggles with high-dimensional black-box functions, and existing generative model approaches lack expressivity and uncertainty estimation.
summary_en.method: DiBO iteratively trains a diffusion model for data distribution and deep ensembles for uncertainty-aware function prediction, then fine-tunes the diffusion model to amortize posterior inference for candidate selection.
summary_en.result: The method outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on both synthetic and real-world high-dimensional optimization tasks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard black-box optimization problems.

visual.caption: Figure 1 : Motivating example of our method. In high-dimensional spaces, directly searching for input that maximizes UCB score may lead to sub-optimal results (As depicted in of the second figure). Sampling from the posterior distribution prevents overemphasized exploration in the boundary of search space and leads to efficient exploration (As depicted in of the last figure).

title: Gabor-Enhanced Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Fast Simulations of Acoustic Wavefields
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的Gabor增强PINN方法可加速高频波动方程求解，其处理振荡问题的思路对生物力学FEA代理模型中的高频响应模拟具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on acoustic wavefield simulation for seismic applications, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical FEA surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服PINN在模拟高频波场时的低频偏差和收敛慢问题
summary_zh.method: 将输入坐标映射到自定义Gabor坐标系，简化训练而不增加参数
summary_zh.result: 在复杂速度模型上精度更高、收敛更快、鲁棒性更好
summary_zh.validation: 在Marmousi和Overthrust等标准地震模型上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the low-frequency bias and slow convergence of PINNs for high-frequency wavefield simulations.
summary_en.method: A simplified PINN framework that maps input coordinates to a custom Gabor coordinate system, capturing oscillatory and localized wavefield features without increasing trainable parameters.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves superior accuracy, faster convergence, and better robustness on complex velocity models compared to traditional PINNs and prior Gabor-based PINNs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on Marmousi and Overthrust seismic velocity models demonstrate the method's effectiveness.

title: Distributionally Robust Active Learning for Gaussian Process Regression
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种分布鲁棒的主动学习方法，可提高高斯过程回归的采样效率，适用于昂贵仿真替代模型的构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有主动学习方法无法保证目标分布下的预测精度，且目标分布难以指定。
summary_zh.method: 提出两种分布鲁棒主动学习方法，最小化高斯过程回归在候选目标分布下的最坏期望误差。
summary_zh.result: 推导了最坏期望平方误差的上界，证明有限标签即可达到任意小误差。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Existing active learning methods lack theoretical guarantees for prediction accuracy under the target distribution, and specifying the target distribution is often difficult.
summary_en.method: Two distributionally robust active learning methods are proposed to minimize the worst-case expected error for Gaussian process regression over a set of candidate target distributions.
summary_en.result: An upper bound on the worst-case expected squared error is derived, showing that arbitrarily small error can be achieved with a finite number of labels under mild conditions.
summary_en.validation: Effectiveness is demonstrated on synthetic and real-world datasets.

title: Optimal Kernel Learning for Gaussian Process Models with High-Dimensional Input
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过最优核学习识别高维输入中的活跃变量，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的输入降维与解释性提升。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no uncertainty quantification beyond GP prediction.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维输入下高斯过程回归计算成本高且精度低。
summary_zh.method: 通过凸组合低维核函数并借鉴Fedorov-Wynn算法优化核学习。
summary_zh.result: 方法在识别活跃变量和预测精度上优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值算例验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian process regression suffers from high computational cost and low accuracy when dealing with high-dimensional inputs.
summary_en.method: An optimal kernel learning algorithm approximates the covariance function via a convex combination of low-dimensional kernels, inspired by the Fedorov-Wynn algorithm.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms alternatives in identifying active variables and improving prediction accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on multiple numerical benchmark examples.

title: Hard constraint learning approaches with trainable influence functions for evolutionary equations
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过可训练影响函数的硬约束策略提升PINN在长时间域上的精度，可迁移至植入物力学代理模型的约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on evolutionary PDEs and does not address implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate modeling, or design optimization under constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN在长时间域上精度低，需改进约束策略。
summary_zh.method: 提出带可训练影响函数的硬约束策略，结合时序学习和自适应时间域划分。
summary_zh.result: 在多个演化方程上验证了精度和稳定性提升。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，与标准PINN对比。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs suffer from low accuracy on large temporal domains, motivating a hard constraint approach with trainable parameters.
summary_en.method: A hard constraint strategy with trainable influence functions is integrated with sequential learning and adaptive time-domain partitioning.
summary_en.result: The method achieves improved accuracy and stability on several evolutionary PDE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard evolutionary equations compared against baseline PINNs.

title: Multi-Objective Causal Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种多目标因果贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移到植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: No validation on FEA or biomechanics problems; no uncertainty quantification beyond Bayesian optimization; no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 在多目标决策中，利用因果结构减少昂贵评估次数。
summary_zh.method: 提出多目标因果贝叶斯优化，分解为多个传统优化任务并平衡探索。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实因果图上优于非因果多目标贝叶斯优化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成数据和真实因果图验证算法性能。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently identify Pareto-optimal interventions in costly multi-objective decision-making problems by exploiting causal relationships.
summary_en.method: Proposes Multi-Objective Causal Bayesian Optimization (MO-CBO), which decomposes the problem into multiple single-objective tasks and balances exploration via relative hypervolume improvement.
summary_en.result: MO-CBO outperforms traditional multi-objective Bayesian optimization on synthetic and real-world causal graphs.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic and real-world causal graphs with numerical benchmarks.

visual.caption: Figure 4: Convergence to the causal Pareto front across all experiments, measured by the generational distance (upper row) and inverted generational distance (lower row). Lower values indicate better approximations of the ground-truth. The number of interventions refers to the count of intervention variables that were intervened upon. Shaded areas represent ± \pm standard deviation across 10 10 random seeds.

title: General Uncertainty Estimation with Delta Variances
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的不确定性量化方法，可迁移至代理模型，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling, no implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling or optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效估计大神经网络中的认知不确定性
summary_zh.method: 提出Delta Variances算法族，仅需一次梯度计算
summary_zh.result: 在天气模拟器上取得竞争性结果
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently estimate epistemic uncertainty in large neural networks for decision-making under limited data.
summary_en.method: Proposes Delta Variances, a family of algorithms requiring only a single gradient computation, without architectural changes.
summary_en.result: Achieves competitive uncertainty estimates on a weather simulator with a neural-network-based step function.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on a weather simulation case.

title: Bayesian Parameter Inference and Uncertainty Quantification for a Computational Pulmonary Hemodynamics Model Using Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用高斯过程代理模型加速心血管模型校准并量化不确定性，方法可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的代理建模与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or structural FEA; it focuses on pulmonary hemodynamics and microvascular parameter inference.

summary_zh.motivation: 临床数据有限，需要高效且考虑不确定性的个性化心血管模型。
summary_zh.method: 利用高斯过程代理模型加速一维血流动力学模型的贝叶斯参数推断。
summary_zh.result: 模型参数变化与疾病严重程度强相关，揭示了CTEPH的异质性微血管适应。
summary_zh.validation: 基于犬模型实验数据，比较基线与CTEPH条件下的参数差异。

summary_en.motivation: Subject-specific cardiovascular models require efficient uncertainty-aware calibration due to limited clinical data.
summary_en.method: Gaussian process emulators were employed to accelerate Bayesian inference of microvascular parameters in a 1D pulmonary hemodynamics model.
summary_en.result: Inferred parameters showed strong correlation with disease severity and revealed heterogeneous microvascular adaptation in CTEPH.
summary_en.validation: Model was informed by experimental data from a dog model of CTEPH, comparing baseline and disease conditions.

key_terms.zh: 慢性血栓栓塞性肺动脉高压

title: A control-oriented approach to optimal sensor placement
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种面向控制的传感器布局方法，可迁移至生物力学设计中用于减少不确定性，但未涉及植入物或生物力学具体应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or surrogate modeling for FEA; it focuses on optimal sensor placement for control-oriented inverse problems in heat transfer.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统贝叶斯最优实验设计未考虑控制目标，导致传感器布局对控制问题效率低。
summary_zh.method: 提出面向控制的OED框架，最小化控制目标不确定性，并开发可扩展计算方法。
summary_zh.result: 在热传导模型问题上验证了该方法能有效降低控制目标的不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过热传导数值算例验证传感器布局效果。

summary_en.motivation: Classical Bayesian optimal experimental design minimizes posterior uncertainty in inversion parameters but does not account for the demands of optimal control problems.
summary_en.method: A control-oriented OED framework is proposed that prioritizes sensor placements minimizing uncertainty in the control objective, with scalable computational methods for linear PDE-constrained problems.
summary_en.result: Numerical results on a heat transfer model demonstrate that the control-oriented sensor placements reduce uncertainty in the control objective more effectively than classical OED.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via numerical benchmarks on a heat transfer model problem.

title: A Neural Operator Emulator for Coastal and Riverine Shallow Water Dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: No implant mechanics, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真数值模型计算成本高，难以实时预测水动力过程。
summary_zh.method: 提出多输入时序算子网络(MITONet)，在潜空间学习算子以逼近参数化PDE求解器。
summary_zh.result: 在两种不同水流场景中实现高精度预测，加速比达100-1250倍。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个实际浅水方程案例（河口和河流）验证预测性能。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity numerical models are computationally prohibitive for real-time forecasting of coastal and riverine hydrodynamics.
summary_en.method: MITONet is an autoregressive neural emulator that learns latent-space operators to approximate high-dimensional numerical solvers for time-dependent parameterized PDEs.
summary_en.result: MITONet achieves anomaly correlation coefficients above 0.9 and computational speedups of 100x-1,250x on two distinct shallow-water flow scenarios.
summary_en.validation: Validated on 2D shallow-water equation simulations of Shinnecock Inlet and Red River with varying parameters and geometries.

title: Partially Observable Gaussian Process Network and Doubly Stochastic Variational Inference
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种处理部分观测的高斯过程网络方法，可迁移到生物力学代理模型中处理多源、不完整数据。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification for implant design, or any biomedical/mechanical application.

summary_zh.motivation: 高斯过程在高维时计算困难，且实际系统常存在间接、噪声、不完整的中间观测。
summary_zh.method: 提出部分可观测高斯过程网络，通过观测透镜和双重随机变分推断进行联合建模与推理。
summary_zh.result: 在基准问题上，利用部分观测可提升整体网络的预测性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准上验证，未涉及真实物理实验。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian processes suffer from the curse of dimensionality, and real-world systems often provide indirect, noisy, and incomplete intermediate observations.
summary_en.method: This work introduces the Partially Observable Gaussian Process Network (POGPN) that models joint distributions of latent subprocesses and incorporates observation lenses with doubly stochastic variational inference.
summary_en.result: On benchmark problems, incorporating partial observations during training and inference improves the predictive performance of the overall network.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical benchmarks without real-world experimental data.

title: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization for Networked Black-Box Systems: A Path to Greener Profits and Smarter Designs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多目标贝叶斯优化方法可处理约束和网络结构，对植入物/生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真优化具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical context; it focuses on general networked black-box systems in industrial design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有灰盒多目标优化方法对系统结构假设过于刚性，无法灵活建模反馈循环和多尺度仿真。
summary_zh.method: 提出MOBONS算法，利用网络表示和贝叶斯优化高效优化通用函数网络，支持约束和并行评估。
summary_zh.result: 通过两个案例（包括可持续过程设计）验证了方法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个仿真案例验证，未涉及实验或生物力学场景。

summary_en.motivation: Existing grey-box multi-objective optimization methods impose rigid structural assumptions, failing to model feedback loops and multi-scale simulations flexibly.
summary_en.method: MOBONS leverages network representations and Bayesian optimization to efficiently optimize general function networks with cyclic dependencies, constraints, and parallel evaluations.
summary_en.result: Two case studies, including sustainable process design, demonstrate the effectiveness of MOBONS.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via simulation case studies without experimental or biomechanical testing.
