title: Regularity and tailored regularization of Deep Neural Networks, with application to parametric PDEs in uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了针对参数化PDE的深度神经网络正则化方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on parametric PDEs in uncertainty quantification but does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维参数化PDE中DNN代理模型的泛化误差界问题。
summary_zh.method: 推导DNN混合导数显式界，提出周期DNN和定制正则化训练策略。
summary_zh.result: 证明在格点训练下泛化误差界为tol+O(N^{-r/2})，数值实验显示正则化显著提升性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在模拟参数化PDE的代数方程上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To establish generalization error bounds for deep neural network surrogates of high-dimensional parametric PDEs with smooth but costly target functions.
summary_en.method: Derives explicit bounds for all mixed derivatives of DNNs with respect to inputs, proposes periodic DNNs for periodic targets, and enforces tailored regularization during training.
summary_en.result: Proves a generalization error bound of tol + O(N^{-r/2}) for DNNs trained on lattice points, with numerical experiments showing significant improvement via tailored regularization.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on an algebraic equation mimicking parametric PDE problems demonstrate the effectiveness of tailored regularization.

title: Enhanced uncertainty quantification variational autoencoders for the solution of Bayesian inverse problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种增强的不确定性量化变分自编码器，用于贝叶斯逆问题，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的参数反演与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant design, lacks constraint handling, and is validated only on a simple Laplace equation without biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高变分自编码器在贝叶斯逆问题中的不确定性量化精度与泛化能力。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种新的损失函数训练变分自编码器，并理论证明其收敛性。
summary_zh.result: 新方法在精度和泛化性上优于现有方法，并在拉普拉斯方程上验证。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值测试和拉普拉斯方程算例，与MCMC对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the accuracy and generalization of variational autoencoders for uncertainty quantification in Bayesian inverse problems.
summary_en.method: A novel loss function is proposed for training variational autoencoders, with a theoretical proof of convergence to the posterior distribution under affine forward maps.
summary_en.result: The proposed VAE outperforms existing methods in accuracy and generalization, validated on a Laplace equation benchmark.
summary_en.validation: Numerical tests and a Laplace equation example with comparison to Markov Chain Monte Carlo.

title: Bayesian Physics Informed Neural Networks for Linear Inverse problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了贝叶斯物理信息神经网络框架，可处理不确定性和先验知识，对FEA代理建模中的不确定性量化有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on linear inverse problems in imaging, not on surrogate modeling for expensive simulations or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决逆问题中计算成本高和不确定性量化难的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出贝叶斯物理信息神经网络框架，结合先验知识和不确定性建模
summary_zh.result: 推导了监督和无监督训练下的后验概率表达式，MAP估计可退化为确定性PINN
summary_zh.validation: 理论推导，未进行数值或实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To address high computational costs and uncertainty quantification in inverse problems by integrating Bayesian inference with physics-informed neural networks.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian framework for PINN (BPINN) is proposed, deriving posterior distributions for network parameters under supervised and unsupervised training, with MAP estimation recovering the deterministic PINN.
summary_en.result: The framework provides a principled way to incorporate prior knowledge and quantify uncertainties, though implementation challenges remain for real applications.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical derivation only; no numerical or experimental validation is presented.

title: Sharp-PINNs: staggered hard-constrained physics-informed neural networks for phase field modelling of corrosion
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的硬约束PINN框架可用于解决生物力学设计中的多物理场耦合问题，但未涉及植入物或生物力学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or surrogate modeling for expensive simulations; it focuses on corrosion phase field modeling without any biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决传统PINN在强耦合相场腐蚀问题中精度和效率低的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出Sharp-PINN，采用交错训练方案和硬约束输出层，结合随机傅里叶特征和改进MLP。
summary_zh.result: 在多坑腐蚀模拟中精度和效率显著提升，三维算例比有限元快5-10倍。
summary_zh.validation: 通过二维和三维腐蚀模拟基准测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the accuracy and efficiency limitations of standard PINNs when solving strongly coupled phase field corrosion PDEs.
summary_en.method: A Sharp-PINN framework with a staggered training scheme that alternately minimizes residuals of Allen-Cahn and Cahn-Hilliard equations, enhanced by random Fourier features, a modified MLP, and hard output constraints.
summary_en.result: The approach achieves significantly improved accuracy and efficiency in multi-pit corrosion simulations, and is 5-10 times faster than FEM in 3D cases.
summary_en.validation: Validated through 2D and 3D corrosion simulation benchmarks comparing against finite element solutions.

title: Physics-Informed Gaussian Process Classification for Constraint-Aware Alloy Design
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息高斯过程分类方法可用于约束感知设计，可迁移至植入物设计中的约束满足问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on alloy design and does not address implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate modeling, or uncertainty quantification for mechanical simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 合金设计可视为约束满足问题，需高效建模可行设计空间边界。
summary_zh.method: 将物理信息先验均值函数嵌入高斯过程分类器，处理连续和分类属性约束。
summary_zh.result: 物理先验显著提升分类性能，主动学习加速满足约束的合金发现。
summary_zh.validation: 通过三个案例验证：相稳定性预测、相图修正、连续属性阈值满足。

summary_en.motivation: Alloy design is formulated as a constraint-satisfaction problem, requiring efficient modeling of feasible design space boundaries.
summary_en.method: Physics-informed prior mean functions are embedded into Gaussian Process Classifiers to handle constraints on continuous and categorical properties.
summary_en.result: Incorporating physics-based priors substantially improves classification performance and accelerates discovery of alloys meeting specific constraints via active learning.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through three case studies: phase stability prediction, phase diagram correction, and continuous property threshold satisfaction.

title: Multiscale Hierarchical Micro- and Nano-Surface Induced by High-Repetition-Rate Femtosecond Laser Promote Peri-Implant Osseointegration.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了钛植入体表面激光处理对骨整合的影响，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: No porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue).

summary_zh.motivation: 优化钛植入体表面微纳结构以促进骨整合。
summary_zh.method: 用高重复频率飞秒激光制备三种不同粗糙度的钛表面。
summary_zh.result: 高粗糙度表面促进成骨细胞分化与体内骨整合。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和体内动物实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To determine the optimal micro- and nanomorphology of titanium implant surfaces for enhanced osseointegration.
summary_en.method: Three distinct micro- and nanomorphologies with varying roughness were fabricated on titanium surfaces using a high-repetition-rate femtosecond laser.
summary_en.result: The high-roughness surface with multiscale hierarchical structures promoted early osteoblast adhesion, spreading, and osteogenic differentiation, as well as improved bone formation in vivo.
summary_en.validation: In vitro osteogenic differentiation assays and in vivo animal implantation studies were performed.

title: Neural Operators for Stochastic Modeling of Nonlinear Structural System Response to Natural Hazards
relevance_to_user: 该论文将神经算子用于结构系统的随机非线性动力学响应预测，其方法可迁移至生物力学中植入物设计的代理建模与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or bone-implant interface; it focuses on civil structural systems under natural hazards.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效预测结构系统在自然灾害下的非线性随机响应
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应FNO和基于FFT的DeepONet（DeepFNOnet）两种神经算子架构
summary_zh.result: 代理模型精度高，计算速度比高保真模型快数个数量级
summary_zh.validation: 通过地震和风荷载下的建筑结构数值案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently predict the nonlinear stochastic dynamic response of structural systems under natural hazards using neural operators.
summary_en.method: Proposes a self-adaptive Fourier neural operator and a Fast Fourier Transform-based DeepONet (DeepFNOnet) that learns the discrepancy between ground truth and DeepONet predictions.
summary_en.result: The trained metamodels achieve high accuracy and are orders of magnitude faster than high-fidelity simulations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical case studies of a six-story shear building under stochastic ground motions and a high-rise building under stochastic wind excitation.

title: Tensor parametric Hamiltonian operator inference
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种张量参数化算子推断方法，可构建参数化哈密顿系统的降阶模型，其结构保持和参数化处理能力可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and validates only on canonical PDEs (heat and wave equations) rather than solid mechanics or biomedical FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效构建参数化哈密顿系统的降阶模型，避免昂贵全阶求解。
summary_zh.method: 将参数变化算子表示为参数向量与常张量的缩并，通过最小二乘推断算子。
summary_zh.result: 在热方程和波动方程上验证了参数化降阶模型的精度和结构保持性。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试：变扩散系数热方程和变波速哈密顿波动方程。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently construct reduced-order models for parametric Hamiltonian systems while preserving canonical structure.
summary_en.method: Express parameter-varying operators as contractions of a generalized parameter vector against a constant tensor and infer them via convex least-squares optimization.
summary_en.result: The proposed tensor parametric operator inference yields accurate and structure-preserving surrogates for both non-Hamiltonian and Hamiltonian parametric PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on a heat equation with variable diffusion coefficient and a Hamiltonian wave equation with variable wave speed.

title: Reduced Order Modeling with Shallow Recurrent Decoder Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的SHRED-ROM方法可应用于生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或生物力学验证。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant mechanics problems; only demonstrated on fluid dynamics.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低高维时空场参数化推断的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 结合LSTM编码时序与浅层解码器重构高维状态，无需编码器逆映射
summary_zh.result: 在混沌和非线性流体动力学中准确重构状态动力学并估计未知参数
summary_zh.validation: 通过流体动力学数值基准测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To enable computationally tractable parametric analysis and uncertainty quantification for high-dimensional spatio-temporal fields.
summary_en.method: Proposes SHRED-ROM, combining a long short-term memory network for temporal encoding of sensor data with a shallow decoder for state reconstruction, bypassing unstable inverse approximation.
summary_en.result: Accurately reconstructs state dynamics for new parameters from limited sensors, handles multiple parametric dependencies, and estimates unknown parameters.
summary_en.validation: Validated on chaotic and nonlinear fluid dynamics benchmarks, including high-fidelity simulations and video data.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanics, School of Mechanical Engineering, Tianjin University, Tianjin 300350, China.

why_not_core: This paper does not report micromotion values or contact/friction modeling, and lacks experimental validation.

summary_zh.method: 建立废用性骨重塑模型，模拟电刺激参数对密度损失的影响

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether electrical stimulation can mitigate bone density loss caused by stress shielding after total hip replacement.
summary_en.method: A disuse remodeling model was developed to simulate density loss and the resistive effect of electrical stimulation under various parameters.
summary_en.result: Electrical stimulation placed at the femoral neck reduced the rate of bone mineral density decrease, indicating potential resistance to stress-shielding-induced bone loss.
summary_en.validation: The study relies solely on numerical simulation without experimental or clinical validation.

title: An adaptive importance sampling algorithm for risk-averse optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自适应重要性采样算法可加速风险厌恶优化，其方法可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA or biomechanics design, lacks constraint handling, and focuses on CVaR optimization rather than surrogate modeling for implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 风险厌恶优化中标准自适应采样算法样本量增长过快，需高效采样方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应调整样本量和采样分布的重要性采样算法，利用降阶模型偏置采样风险区域。
summary_zh.result: 算法在保持渐近收敛率的同时，显著减少每次迭代所需样本数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证了计算效率的提升。

summary_en.motivation: Standard adaptive sampling algorithms suffer from excessive sample size growth in risk-averse optimization, motivating a more efficient sampling strategy.
summary_en.method: A novel adaptive importance sampling algorithm is proposed that dynamically adjusts both sample size and sampling distribution, using a reduced-order model to oversample the risk region.
summary_en.result: The algorithm achieves substantial computational savings while preserving asymptotic convergence rate for CVaR minimization.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks demonstrate the efficiency gains of the proposed method.

title: Understanding High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了高维贝叶斯优化的挑战和解决方案，其方法可迁移到植入物/生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant design; it focuses on general high-dimensional BO without biomedical or biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维贝叶斯优化在实际任务中表现良好，但原因不明。
summary_zh.method: 通过实证分析识别高维BO的挑战，提出MSR方法。
summary_zh.result: MSR方法在多个实际应用中达到最优性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准基准和实际应用上验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: Recent work shows simple Bayesian optimization methods perform well on high-dimensional tasks, contradicting prior beliefs, motivating an investigation into the underlying reasons.
summary_en.method: The authors conduct empirical analysis to identify key challenges in high-dimensional BO, such as vanishing gradients from GP initialization, and propose a simple variant called MSR based on maximum likelihood estimation of length scales.
summary_en.result: MSR achieves state-of-the-art performance on a comprehensive set of real-world high-dimensional optimization tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks and real-world applications, with targeted experiments to confirm findings.

title: Learning large scale industrial physics simulations
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了工业级物理仿真替代模型的方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真加速。
why_not_core: No direct application to implant biomechanics, no uncertainty quantification beyond Gaussian processes, and no handling of multi-objective constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 工业仿真计算昂贵，需要快速可靠的替代模型。
summary_zh.method: 采用物理降阶建模和高斯过程回归构建替代模型。
summary_zh.result: 成功应用于涡轮叶片寿命预测和压缩机热分析。
summary_zh.validation: 通过工业案例验证模型准确性。

summary_en.motivation: Industrial physics simulations are computationally expensive, necessitating fast and reliable surrogate models to accelerate design processes.
summary_en.method: Two surrogate modeling technologies are developed: a physical reduced-order model for nonlinear structural mechanics and thermal analysis, and Gaussian process regression for non-parameterized geometric variability.
summary_en.result: The methods are successfully applied to predict the lifespan of high-pressure turbine blades and perform thermal analysis of high-pressure compressors.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through industrial simulation cases, demonstrating accuracy and efficiency.

title: Towards a Foundation Model for Physics-Informed Neural Networks: Multi-PDE Learning with Active Sampling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出多PDE联合训练的PINN基础模型，结合主动学习提高采样效率，方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型构建。
why_not_core: No validation on biomechanics or implant design problems; only tested on simple PDEs without constraints or uncertainty quantification for design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统PINN只能求解单一PDE，缺乏泛化能力，训练成本高。
summary_zh.method: 构建统一架构的多PDE PINN模型，采用MC Dropout主动学习策略选择高信息量样本。
summary_zh.result: 主动采样显著提升数据效率，仅用10%-50%数据即可保持较高精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在SHO、热方程、波动方程和拉普拉斯方程四个基准PDE上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional PINNs are limited to single PDEs, lacking generalizability and suffering from high training costs.
summary_en.method: A unified multi-PDE PINN framework is proposed, enhanced with MC Dropout-based active learning to select the most informative training samples.
summary_en.result: Active sampling substantially improves data efficiency, achieving competitive accuracy with only 10%-50% of the full dataset.
summary_en.validation: Validated on four benchmark PDEs: Simple Harmonic Oscillator, 1D Heat, 1D Wave, and 2D Laplace equations.

title: Long-term simulation of physical and mechanical behaviors using curriculum-transfer-learning based physics-informed neural networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的课程迁移学习PINN方法可解决长期仿真效率问题，对生物力学中的长时间尺度FEA代理建模具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: No validation on implant or biomechanics problems; no uncertainty quantification; no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决标准PINN在长时间域仿真中的精度和效率问题
summary_zh.method: 将长时间问题分解为短时间子问题，结合课程学习与迁移学习逐步求解
summary_zh.result: 在非线性波传播、Kirchhoff板动态响应和三峡库区水动力模型中验证了长期仿真能力
summary_zh.validation: 通过三个数值仿真案例验证方法的有效性和鲁棒性

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the inaccuracies and low computational efficiency of standard PINNs in long-term simulations.
summary_en.method: Decomposes long-term problems into sequential short-term subproblems, solved via curriculum learning with transfer learning from previous steps.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates superior accuracy and efficiency on nonlinear wave propagation, Kirchhoff plate dynamics, and a hydrodynamic reservoir model.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three numerical simulation cases without experimental or biomedical data.

title: Enhancing Physics-Informed Neural Networks Through Feature Engineering
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的特征工程方法可加速PINN收敛，对生物力学代理模型构建具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: No validation on FEA surrogate tasks, no biomedical or implant mechanics context, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN训练慢、精度低，需改进特征工程。
summary_zh.method: 提出SAFE-NET，使用傅里叶特征和单隐层网络简化架构。
summary_zh.result: 参数减少65%，训练轮次减少70%，每轮加速95%，误差降低数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个PDE基准问题上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Physics-Informed Neural Networks suffer from slow convergence and moderate accuracy, motivating improved feature engineering.
summary_en.method: SAFE-NET employs Fourier features and a single hidden layer with an effective optimizer to simplify the PINN architecture.
summary_en.result: It achieves orders-of-magnitude lower error with 65% fewer parameters, 70% fewer epochs, and 95% faster per-epoch time.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard PDE problems demonstrate accuracy and efficiency gains.

title: User Preference Meets Pareto-Optimality in Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法将用户偏好与帕累托最优结合，可迁移至植入物设计中的多目标优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics/implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有方法无法同时满足用户偏好与帕累托最优性。
summary_zh.method: 提出偏好-效用平衡的MOBO方法，结合局部多梯度下降。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准和实际问题上优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成基准和三个实际工程问题上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing multi-objective Bayesian optimization methods either ignore user preferences or produce dominated solutions.
summary_en.method: PUB-MOBO combines utility-based MOBO with local multi-gradient descent to refine user-preferred solutions to near-Pareto-optimality.
summary_en.result: PUB-MOBO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art competitors in proximity to the Pareto front and utility regret.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three synthetic benchmarks (DTLZ1, DTLZ2, DH1) and three real-world engineering design problems.

summary_en.method: 3D-printable filaments of amorphous magnesium phosphate (AMP) and PEEK were fabricated and characterized for in vitro degradation and in vivo osseointegration in a rat femoral model.

title: Microcanonical Langevin Ensembles: Advancing the Sampling of Bayesian Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯神经网络采样方法可迁移至代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元或生物力学设计。

summary_zh.method: 提出微正则朗之万集成方法，结合优化策略和MCLMC采样器。
summary_zh.result: 相比NUTS实现近一个数量级加速，保持或提升预测性能与不确定性量化。

summary_en.motivation: Sampling from multimodal posteriors of Bayesian neural networks remains computationally expensive and unpredictable in convergence time.
summary_en.method: An ensembling approach leveraging Microcanonical Langevin Monte Carlo with optimization strategies for efficient and robust sampling.
summary_en.result: Achieves up to an order of magnitude speedup over No-U-Turn Sampler while maintaining or improving predictive performance and uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks across diverse tasks and data modalities comparing against state-of-the-art MCMC samplers.

title: Epistemic Uncertainty in Conformal Scores: A Unified Approach
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的EPICSCORE方法可增强任意共形分数的认知不确定性，适用于代理模型中的不确定性量化，但未涉及FEA或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constrained optimization; it focuses on general conformal prediction with epistemic uncertainty.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有共形预测方法未显式建模认知不确定性，导致数据稀疏区域预测过于自信。
summary_zh.method: 提出EPICSCORE，一种模型无关方法，通过贝叶斯技术增强共形分数以整合认知不确定性。
summary_zh.result: EPICSCORE在数据稀疏区域自适应扩展预测区间，同时保持有限样本边际覆盖和渐近条件覆盖。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个数值基准上对比现有方法，验证了性能优势。

summary_en.motivation: Existing conformal prediction methods lack explicit modeling of epistemic uncertainty, leading to overconfident predictions in data-sparse regions.
summary_en.method: EPICSCORE is a model-agnostic approach that enhances any conformal score by integrating epistemic uncertainty via Bayesian techniques such as Gaussian Processes, Monte Carlo Dropout, or Bayesian Additive Regression Trees.
summary_en.result: EPICSCORE adaptively expands predictive intervals in data-sparse regions while maintaining compact intervals where data is abundant, preserving finite-sample marginal coverage and achieving asymptotic conditional coverage.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks demonstrate superior performance compared to existing conformal prediction methods.

visual.caption: Figure 1: A comparison of predictive intervals from standard split-conformal regression and our proposed EPICSCORE approach. While all methods maintain valid marginal coverage, standard conformal prediction often produces overconfidently narrow intervals in the data-scarce region (e.g. x ∈ ( 7 , 8 ) x\in(7,8) ). Our method explicitly accounts for epistemic uncertainty, resulting in appropriately widened predictive intervals that better reflect total uncertainty when extrapolating beyond the training distribution.

title: Bayesian Optimization by Kernel Regression and Density-based Exploration
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低贝叶斯优化中高斯过程的高计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出BOKE算法，结合核回归与核密度估计，构建置信界准则。
summary_zh.result: BOKE在保持竞争力的同时，将计算复杂度从四次降至二次。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实优化任务上验证，与GP方法及其他基线对比。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high computational cost of Gaussian processes in Bayesian optimization, which scales quartically with iterations.
summary_en.method: Proposes BOKE, which uses kernel regression for function approximation and kernel density for exploration, integrated into a confidence bound criterion.
summary_en.result: BOKE achieves competitive performance while reducing computational complexity from quartic to quadratic.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic and real-world optimization tasks, comparing against Gaussian process-based and other baseline methods.

title: dynoGP: Deep Gaussian Processes for dynamic system identification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的深度高斯过程方法可用于动态系统辨识并量化不确定性，对代理建模中的不确定性量化有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on dynamic system identification rather than FEA surrogate modeling, and does not address implant/biomechanics design or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 为动态系统辨识提供一种能输出概率分布的方法。
summary_zh.method: 将线性动态高斯过程和静态高斯过程互联构建深度高斯过程模型。
summary_zh.result: 在模拟和真实数据上验证了方法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 使用模拟数据和真实世界数据进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a system identification method for dynamical systems that provides probabilistic outputs with uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A deep Gaussian process model is constructed by interconnecting linear dynamic GPs and static GPs to capture both dynamics and nonlinearities.
summary_en.result: The proposed approach demonstrates effectiveness on both simulated and real-world datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using simulated data and real-world system identification benchmarks.

title: Self-supervised Conformal Prediction for Uncertainty Quantification in Imaging Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自监督共形预测方法可用于图像逆问题的不确定性量化，其思想可迁移至FEA代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on image restoration and does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constraint handling in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 图像逆问题中不确定性量化需要大量真实数据，但获取困难且存在分布偏移。
summary_zh.method: 提出自监督共形预测方法，利用SURE从噪声测量数据自校准，无需真实数据。
summary_zh.result: 在图像去噪和去模糊任务中，结果与监督方法相当。
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验验证，与监督共形预测对比。

summary_en.motivation: Uncertainty quantification in image restoration is hindered by the need for abundant ground truth data and sensitivity to distribution shift.
summary_en.method: A self-supervised conformal prediction method is proposed, leveraging Stein's Unbiased Risk Estimator (SURE) to calibrate directly from noisy measurements without ground truth.
summary_en.result: The method achieves accuracy comparable to supervised conformal prediction on image denoising and deblurring tasks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard image restoration benchmarks, comparing against supervised conformal prediction.

title: Complex Physics-Informed Neural Network
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进的PINN架构，可提高求解高维问题的精度，对代理模型方法有参考价值。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no biomechanics or implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升PINN在高维问题上的求解精度。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于柯西积分定理的可学习激活函数，仅用单隐层实现高精度。
summary_zh.result: 在复杂任务上精度提升一个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个高维基准问题上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy of physics-informed neural networks on high-dimensional problems.
summary_en.method: A novel PINN architecture with a learnable activation function derived from the Cauchy integral theorem, achieving high accuracy with a single hidden layer.
summary_en.result: The proposed method consistently improves accuracy by an order of magnitude on complex tasks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on high-dimensional PDE problems demonstrate the performance gains.

title: Capturing Extreme Events in Turbulence using an Extreme Variational Autoencoder (xVAE)
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的xVAE方法能够处理极端事件和不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学代理建模中的约束优化和鲁棒设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on turbulence and fluid dynamics, not on FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics or structural optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 湍流中极端事件难以用标准降维方法捕捉，需新模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出极端变分自编码器(xVAE)，嵌入重尾分布处理极端值。
summary_zh.result: xVAE比POD更鲁棒地捕捉极端事件，并提供不确定性量化。
summary_zh.validation: 在野火烟羽大涡模拟数据上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard dimensionality reduction methods fail to capture extreme events in turbulent flows, motivating a new generative model.
summary_en.method: An extreme variational autoencoder (xVAE) is introduced, embedding a max-infinitely divisible process with heavy-tailed distributions into the VAE framework.
summary_en.result: xVAE outperforms POD in capturing extreme values and provides a Bayesian uncertainty quantification framework.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on large-eddy simulation data of wildland fire plumes.

title: Mixture of neural operator experts for learning boundary conditions and model selection
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种混合神经算子专家模型，可处理边界条件和模型选择，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的约束处理和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, lacks validation on solid mechanics or FEA benchmarks, and does not address design optimization or stress shielding.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子在处理非平凡边界条件时存在局限性，且缺乏模型选择能力。
summary_zh.method: 结合体积惩罚法和混合专家模型，提出一种空间条件混合专家神经算子。
summary_zh.result: 在圆盘和四分之一圆盘上成功恢复非线性算子，并从DNS中提取LES模型，获得远超过DNS时间范围的预测样本。
summary_zh.validation: 通过圆盘上的非线性算子恢复和通道流LES模型提取进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators struggle with non-trivial boundary conditions and lack model selection capabilities, limiting their applicability to complex physical systems.
summary_en.method: A mixture of neural operator experts is introduced, combining volume penalization with a spatially conditioned Mixture of Experts to handle boundary conditions and enable model selection.
summary_en.result: The method successfully recovers a nonlinear operator on a disk and quarter disk, and extracts a large eddy simulation model from direct numerical simulation of channel flow, producing posterior predictive samples far beyond the DNS time horizon.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through nonlinear operator recovery on disk geometries and LES model extraction from DNS of channel flow.

title: Microstructure-Aware Bayesian Materials Design
relevance_to_user: 该论文将微观结构信息融入贝叶斯优化，可迁移至植入物设计中考虑骨小梁微观结构的优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate modeling, or constraint handling in multi-objective design.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统材料设计忽略微观结构，导致预测精度和优化效率不足。
summary_zh.method: 提出微观结构感知贝叶斯优化框架，利用活性子空间降维并整合微观结构描述符。
summary_zh.result: 在Mg2SnxSi1-x热电材料设计中，该方法加速收敛并提高预测精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成数据和真实热电材料案例验证框架有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional materials design overlooks microstructural information, limiting predictive accuracy and optimization efficiency.
summary_en.method: A microstructure-aware Bayesian optimization framework is proposed, integrating microstructural descriptors as latent variables and using active subspace for dimensionality reduction.
summary_en.result: The framework accelerates convergence and improves accuracy in designing Mg2SnxSi1-x thermoelectric materials.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic data and a real-world thermoelectric material case study.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于高斯过程的逆问题求解方法，可迁移至生物力学中的代理建模与不确定性量化。

summary_zh.result: 在波动方程波速识别中实现高精度与计算效率。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试验证方法准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a computationally efficient algorithm for solving inverse problems governed by linear PDEs.
summary_en.method: Model PDE solutions using Gaussian processes with priors derived from commutative algebra and implemented via Macaulay2.
summary_en.result: Achieves high accuracy and computational efficiency in identifying wave speed from noisy data for wave equations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks for classical wave equations.

title: Uncertainty Quantification with the Empirical Neural Tangent Kernel
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的神经网络不确定性量化方法，可迁移至代理模型，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanics/implant design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经网络预测需要可靠的不确定性量化，现有方法难以兼顾效率与准确性。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于经验神经正切核的线性化网络随机梯度下降采样方法，构建高效深度集成。
summary_zh.result: 该方法在计算效率上优于现有方法，并在回归与分类任务中保持最先进的不确定性量化性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值实验验证了方法的准确性和效率。

summary_en.motivation: Neural network predictions require reliable uncertainty quantification, but existing methods are either cheap or reliable, not both.
summary_en.method: A post-hoc sampling-based UQ method is proposed that constructs deep ensembles via stochastic gradient descent on linearized networks using the empirical Neural Tangent Kernel.
summary_en.result: The method achieves superior computational efficiency while maintaining state-of-the-art performance across various UQ metrics for regression and classification.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the method's accuracy and efficiency.

title: Physically consistent predictive reduced-order modeling by enhancing Operator Inference with state constraints
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种在降阶模型中嵌入状态约束的方法，可提高外推稳定性和计算效率，对生物力学代理模型中的约束处理有借鉴意义。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification, and focuses on combustion systems rather than biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 复杂多物理场仿真中状态变量需满足物理约束，现有降阶模型难以保证。
summary_zh.method: 在Operator Inference中嵌入状态约束，并基于关键性能指标选择正则化超参数。
summary_zh.result: 所提方法在稳定性、精度和外推能力上优于标准方法，外推超过训练范围200%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过煤燃烧数值模拟案例验证，对比多种稳定性增强方法。

summary_en.motivation: Numerical simulations of complex multiphysics systems produce state variables that must satisfy physical constraints, which are often violated by standard reduced-order models.
summary_en.method: We augment Operator Inference by embedding state constraints into the reduced-order model and propose a new regularization hyperparameter selection based on a key performance indicator.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves superior stability, accuracy, and extrapolation capability (over 200% beyond training regime) compared to standard Operator Inference and other stability-enhancing approaches.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a char combustion simulation case, comparing against multiple stability-enhancing methods.

title: Multivariate Conformal Prediction using Optimal Transport
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于最优传输的多变量共形预测方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及FEA或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics or surrogate modeling for biomechanics.

summary_zh.method: 利用最优传输定义多变量得分排序，构建共形预测集。
summary_zh.result: 在多元回归基准上验证了分布自由覆盖保证和计算效率。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准多元回归数据集上进行了数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Conformal prediction faces challenges in multivariate output spaces due to the lack of a canonical ordering for vectors.
summary_en.method: The paper leverages optimal transport to define a multivariate score ranking, enabling conformal prediction sets with distribution-free coverage guarantees.
summary_en.result: The proposed OTCP method demonstrates valid coverage and computational trade-offs on multivariate regression benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard multivariate regression benchmark datasets using numerical experiments.

title: Gaussian Process Regression for Uncertainty Quantification: An Introductory Tutorial
relevance_to_user: 该教程系统介绍了高斯过程回归在不确定性量化中的应用方法，可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计的代理建模与不确定性分析。
why_not_core: This is a general tutorial on GPR for UQ, not applied to FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics, and lacks domain-specific validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 为计算模型提供可靠的不确定性量化方法
summary_zh.method: 综述高斯过程回归在UQ各任务中的公式、核函数选择及主动学习策略
summary_zh.result: 提供了GPR用于不确定性传播、风险估计、优化及敏感性分析的系统框架
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为方法综述

summary_en.motivation: To provide a comprehensive tutorial on Gaussian Process Regression for uncertainty quantification in computational modeling.
summary_en.method: The paper reviews GPR formulation, covariance kernels, hyperparameter estimation, and active learning, and demonstrates their application to UQ tasks such as propagation, risk estimation, optimization, and sensitivity analysis.
summary_en.result: A unified framework is presented for leveraging GPR's probabilistic nature in various UQ tasks beyond standard surrogate modeling.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a methodological review and tutorial.

title: Efficient sampling approaches based on generalized Golub-Kahan methods for large-scale hierarchical Bayesian inverse problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的分层贝叶斯逆问题高效采样方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及FEA或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical design optimization; it focuses on inverse problems in geophysics and imaging.

summary_zh.motivation: 大规模逆问题的不确定性量化计算困难，尤其是分层贝叶斯设置下。
summary_zh.method: 基于广义Golub-Kahan方法的Metropolis-Hastings独立采样器，结合低秩近似和预处理Lanczos方法。
summary_zh.result: 在地震成像、动态光声断层扫描和大气逆建模中验证了采样效率。
summary_zh.validation: 通过三个数值算例（地震、光声、大气）验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Uncertainty quantification for large-scale inverse problems remains computationally prohibitive, especially under hierarchical Bayesian frameworks with multiple hyperparameters.
summary_en.method: We propose Metropolis-Hastings independence samplers within Gibbs, using generalized Golub-Kahan methods to construct proposal distributions via low-rank covariance approximation or preconditioned Lanczos.
summary_en.result: Numerical examples in seismic imaging, dynamic photoacoustic tomography, and atmospheric inverse modeling demonstrate efficient posterior sampling.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on three benchmark inverse problems from geophysics and imaging, showing improved sampling efficiency over standard methods.

summary_zh.method: 提出卷积转换器隐式估计条件概率分布，无需固定先验
summary_zh.result: 在多个指标上优于现有基线方法
summary_zh.validation: 在标准随机过程基准数据集上验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the limitations of strong or fixed prior assumptions in traditional stochastic process modeling.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Convolution-Based Converter that implicitly estimates conditional probability distributions without strong priors.
summary_en.result: Outperforms existing baselines across multiple metrics on stochastic process benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard stochastic process benchmark datasets.

title: Generalizable and Fast Surrogates: Model Predictive Control of Articulated Soft Robots using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN用于软体机器人实时预测控制，其数据高效、泛化性强的代理建模方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真替代。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or FEA-based design optimization; it focuses on soft robot control with pneumatic actuation.

summary_zh.motivation: 软体机器人实时控制需要快速且泛化性强的模型，传统方法难以兼顾速度与精度。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于PINN的代理模型，仅用单一域少量数据训练，实现高泛化预测。
summary_zh.result: PINN预测速度比精确第一性原理模型快467倍，精度略有降低，支持47 Hz的模型预测控制。
summary_zh.validation: 在气动软体机器人上通过六个动态实验验证了控制跟踪性能。

summary_en.motivation: Real-time control of soft robots requires fast and generalizable models, but first-principles models are slow and black-box models lack generalizability.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network surrogate is trained on minimal data from a single domain to achieve fast and generalizable predictions for articulated soft robots.
summary_en.result: The PINN surrogate achieves up to 467x speedup over an accurate first-principles model with slight accuracy loss, enabling nonlinear MPC at 47 Hz.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation on a pneumatic articulated soft robot demonstrates accurate position tracking in six dynamic experiments.

title: From Uncertain to Safe: Conformal Fine-Tuning of Diffusion Models for Safe PDE Control
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合不确定性量化和安全约束的扩散模型用于PDE控制，其方法可迁移到生物力学植入物设计的代理优化中。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks biomedical context, and focuses on PDE control rather than design optimization with structural constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有深度学习方法在PDE控制中缺乏安全约束，需要满足安全要求的控制方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出SafeDiffCon，利用共形预测估计不确定性分位数，通过重加权扩散损失和迭代微调实现安全约束下的最优控制。
summary_zh.result: 在三个控制任务中，SafeDiffCon是唯一满足所有安全约束的方法，同时实现了最佳控制性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在1D Burgers方程、2D不可压缩流体和核聚变控制任务上进行仿真验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing deep learning methods for PDE-constrained control rarely incorporate safety constraints, which are critical for real-world applications.
summary_en.method: SafeDiffCon post-trains a diffusion model with a reweighted loss using conformal prediction uncertainty quantiles, and dynamically adjusts generation during inference via iterative guidance and fine-tuning to satisfy safety constraints.
summary_en.result: On three PDE control tasks, SafeDiffCon is the only method that satisfies all safety constraints while achieving the best control performance.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on simulation cases including 1D Burgers' equation, 2D incompressible fluid, and controlled nuclear fusion.

title: Distribution Transformers: Fast Approximate Bayesian Inference With On-The-Fly Prior Adaptation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种快速贝叶斯推断方法，可应用于代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有贝叶斯推断方法计算昂贵且先验变化时需重新训练。
summary_zh.method: 提出分布变换器，学习从先验到后验的映射，使用高斯混合模型和注意力机制。
summary_zh.result: 计算时间从分钟级降至毫秒级，对数似然性能优于或持平现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在序列推断、量子系统参数推断和高斯过程后验推断任务上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing Bayesian inference methods are computationally expensive and require retraining when priors change, limiting their use in sequential inference.
summary_en.method: A Distribution Transformer architecture is introduced to learn arbitrary distribution-to-distribution mappings, representing priors as Gaussian Mixture Models and transforming them to posteriors via self- and cross-attention.
summary_en.result: The method reduces computation from minutes to milliseconds while achieving log-likelihood performance comparable or superior to existing approximate inference methods.
summary_en.validation: Validated on sequential inference, quantum system parameter inference, and Gaussian Process predictive posterior inference tasks.

title: BILBO: BILevel Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的双层贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的多层级优化问题，例如同时优化宏观几何与微观结构。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling in biomechanical design, or uncertainty quantification for implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决双层优化中重复下层优化导致的样本低效问题
summary_zh.method: 提出BILBO算法，基于置信界信任集同时优化上下层，单次查询策略
summary_zh.result: 理论保证亚线性遗憾界，合成与真实问题验证有效

summary_en.motivation: To address the sample inefficiency of repeated lower-level optimizations in bilevel optimization problems.
summary_en.method: Proposes BILBO, a Bayesian optimization algorithm that simultaneously optimizes both levels using confidence-bound-based trusted sets and a single query per iteration with conditional reassignment.
summary_en.result: Achieves sublinear regret bounds theoretically and demonstrates effectiveness on synthetic and real-world problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks and real-world optimization problems.

title: Physics-Informed Surrogates for Temperature Prediction of Multi-Tracks in Laser Powder Bed Fusion
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用物理信息神经网络和DeepONet构建激光粉末床熔融过程的温度场代理模型，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。

title: System Architecture Optimization Strategies: Dealing with Expensive Hierarchical Problems

summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on several single- and multi-objective test problems and a jet engine architecture optimization problem.

title: ProPINN: Demystifying Propagation Failures in Physics-Informed Neural Networks

summary_en.motivation: To formally analyze the root cause of propagation failure in PINNs beyond intuitive loss maps.
summary_en.method: Proposes ProPINN, a novel architecture that unifies gradients of region points to improve propagation, based on gradient correlation analysis.
summary_en.result: ProPINN reliably resolves PINN failure modes and achieves 46% relative improvement over Transformer-based models.
summary_en.validation: Validated on multiple PDE benchmark problems using numerical experiments.

summary_en.result: Demonstrates improved computational efficiency and accuracy on three benchmark ODE inverse problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark examples with known ground truth dynamics.

title: A hybrid Reduced Order Model to enforce outflow pressure boundary conditions in computational haemodynamics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的混合降阶模型方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或应力分析。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on haemodynamics and outflow pressure boundary conditions, not on solid mechanics, implant design, or stress shielding.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决心血管血流模拟中出口压力边界条件的高效降阶建模问题
summary_zh.method: 结合POD-Galerkin投影与神经网络，扩展提升函数法处理非均匀出口压力
summary_zh.result: 在2D理想血管和3D患者特异性主动脉弓上实现了高精度且计算成本显著降低
summary_zh.validation: 通过全阶有限体积法数值解对比验证降阶模型精度

summary_en.motivation: To develop a reduced-order model that efficiently handles nonhomogeneous outflow pressure boundary conditions in cardiovascular haemodynamics simulations.
summary_en.method: A hybrid ROM combining POD-Galerkin projection with a neural network to approximate the outflow pressure mapping, extending the lifting function method to outlet boundaries.
summary_en.result: The ROM accurately approximates the full-order model on both 2D idealized and 3D patient-specific aortic geometries with significant computational cost reduction.
summary_en.validation: Numerical comparison with finite volume full-order solutions for two test cases.

title: Optimizing the Optimizer for Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了PINN和PIKAN的优化器改进，可迁移至FEA替代模型的训练效率提升。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the optimizer to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, and lacks uncertainty quantification or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN优化器在非线性损失景观中收敛慢、易陷入局部极小。
summary_zh.method: 引入自缩放BFGS和Broyden方法，结合多种线搜索策略优化PINN和PIKAN。
summary_zh.result: 在多个挑战性PDE上实现数量级精度提升，无需自适应权重。
summary_zh.validation: 在Burgers、Allen-Cahn等标准PDE基准上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Current optimizers for PINNs and PIKANs struggle with slow convergence and local minima in highly non-linear loss landscapes.
summary_en.method: Self-scaled BFGS and Broyden methods with various line search strategies are applied to optimize PINNs and PIKANs.
summary_en.result: Orders-of-magnitude accuracy improvements are achieved on challenging PDEs without adaptive weights or other enhancements.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on Burgers, Allen-Cahn, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky, Ginzburg-Landau, and Stokes equations.

title: Nanostructured TiO
first_author_affiliation: Process Engineering Division, CSIR-Central Electrochemical Research Institute, Karaikudi, Tamilnadu 630003, India.; Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research (AcSIR), Ghaziabad 201002, India.

corresponding_authors.name: Deepak K Pattanayak
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Process Engineering Division, CSIR-Central Electrochemical Research Institute, Karaikudi, Tamilnadu 630003, India.; Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research (AcSIR), Ghaziabad 201002, India.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及钛表面纳米结构TiO2涂层与Ce离子掺杂，通过体内外实验验证了抗菌和成骨性能，但未涉及LPBF制造、疲劳测试或应力屏蔽匹配。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on surface coating and osseointegration of Ti scaffolds, but does not include LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), or stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过Ce掺杂调控TiO2涂层中Ce4+/Ce3+比例，提升抗菌和成骨性能。
summary_zh.method: 碱处理+热处理制备Ce掺杂TiO2纳米网络层，表征表面特性并评估生物学性能。
summary_zh.result: 600°C热处理样品具有高Ce4+/Ce3+比例，显著增强细胞相容性和体内骨整合。
summary_zh.validation: 大鼠骨缺损模型结合组织学、micro-CT和基因表达分析。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize the Ce4+/Ce3+ ratio in a nanostructured titania layer on Ti for improved antibacterial and osteogenic properties.
summary_en.method: An alkali-mediated surface modification followed by sequential heat treatment (200-800 °C) was used to incorporate Ce ions into a porous TiO2 network on Ti.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment at 600 °C yielded a high Ce4+/Ce3+ ratio, enhancing cell adhesion, mineralization, and in vivo osseointegration in a rat model.
summary_en.validation: In vivo bone defect study in rats with additively manufactured Ti scaffolds, evaluated by histology, micro-CT, and RT-PCR for osteogenic markers.

title: Information-theoretic Bayesian Optimization: Survey and Tutorial
relevance_to_user: 该论文综述了信息论贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移到植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper is a survey and does not include any FEA validation, implant mechanics, or biomedical application.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决昂贵黑箱函数优化问题，如超参数调优。
summary_zh.method: 综述信息论采集函数的贝叶斯优化方法。
summary_zh.result: 信息论采集函数性能通常优于其他方法，并适用于多目标、约束等复杂场景。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为理论综述。

summary_en.motivation: To address the optimization of expensive black-box functions, such as hyperparameter tuning in machine learning.
summary_en.method: This survey reviews information-theoretic acquisition functions in Bayesian optimization, detailing their theoretical foundations and approximations.
summary_en.result: Information-theoretic acquisition functions generally outperform other types and can be extended to multi-objective, constrained, and multi-fidelity settings.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a theoretical survey and tutorial.

title: Hybrid Two-Stage Reconstruction of Multiscale Subsurface Flow with Physics-informed Residual Connected Neural Operator
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的混合两阶段框架结合了数据驱动降维和物理信息神经网络，可迁移至生物力学代理建模中的多尺度问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on subsurface flow in porous media, not on implant biomechanics or FEA surrogate for structural mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高对比度多孔介质中达西流的高效精确模拟问题
summary_zh.method: 提出两阶段框架：先数据驱动重建多尺度基函数降维，再物理信息神经网络重建压力场
summary_zh.result: 基函数拟合和压力重建R2均超0.9，残差指标达1e-4量级
summary_zh.validation: 在多种渗透率与基函数组合的数据集上验证重建精度

summary_en.motivation: To achieve accurate and physically consistent reconstruction of Darcy flow in high-contrast fractured porous media.
summary_en.method: A hybrid two-stage framework combining data-driven multiscale basis function reconstruction and physics-informed neural network with Transformer-based global feature extraction.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves R2 values above 0.9 for both basis function fitting and pressure reconstruction, with residual indicators on the order of 1e-4.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on datasets with various permeability and basis function combinations, demonstrating high reconstruction accuracy and physical consistency.

title: Advanced Physics-Informed Neural Network with Residuals for Solving Complex Integral Equations
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过残差连接改进PINN求解积分方程，可迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模，但未涉及约束处理或UQ。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on solving integral equations with PINN, but does not address expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN求解复杂积分方程的精度和稳定性
summary_zh.method: 提出RISN架构，集成残差连接和高精度数值方法
summary_zh.result: RISN在多种积分方程上MAE显著低于经典PINN及变体
summary_zh.validation: 在多个数值基准问题上对比MAE

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and stability of PINNs for solving complex integral and integro-differential equations.
summary_en.method: Proposes the Residual Integral Solver Network (RISN) that integrates residual connections with high-accuracy numerical methods like Gaussian quadrature.
summary_en.result: RISN consistently achieves significantly lower Mean Absolute Errors than classical PINNs and advanced variants across various equation types.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks including one-dimensional, multi-dimensional, and fractional integral equations.

title: Uncertainty Quantification With Noise Injection in Neural Networks: A Bayesian Perspective
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的噪声注入不确定性量化方法可迁移至代理模型，用于评估植入物力学预测的置信度。
why_not_core: No FEA or surrogate modeling application, no implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling or optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升神经网络预测的可靠性，量化模型不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 理论证明权重噪声注入等价于深度高斯过程的贝叶斯推断，提出MCNI方法。
summary_zh.result: 在回归和分类任务上，MCNI优于基线模型。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成数据和标准基准数据集上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the reliability of neural network predictions by quantifying model uncertainty.
summary_en.method: Theoretically establishes equivalence between weight noise injection and Bayesian inference on deep Gaussian processes, proposing Monte Carlo Noise Injection (MCNI).
summary_en.result: MCNI outperforms baseline models on regression and classification tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic data and standard benchmark datasets.

title: The Finite Element Neural Network Method: One Dimensional Study
relevance_to_user: 该方法将神经网络与有限元弱形式结合，可迁移至生物力学代理模型构建，但未涉及不确定性量化或多目标约束。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, no implant/biomechanics application, only 1D numerical benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 融合神经网络与有限元方法，提升微分方程求解的精度与效率。
summary_zh.method: 在Petrov-Galerkin框架下，用神经网络生成全局试探解，卷积操作近似加权残差。
summary_zh.result: FENNM在多个一维算例中展现高精度，并支持自适应网格细化。
summary_zh.validation: 一维数值算例验证，包括自适应网格细化测试。

summary_en.motivation: To combine the expressivity of neural networks with the rigor of finite element methods for solving differential equations.
summary_en.method: FENNM employs a neural network as the global trial solution within a Petrov-Galerkin framework, using convolution to approximate the weighted residual.
summary_en.result: The method achieves high accuracy on multiple 1D benchmarks and supports adaptive mesh refinement.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on 1D problems with adaptive mesh refinement demonstrate robustness and accuracy.

title: A novel Trunk Branch-net PINN for flow and heat transfer prediction in porous medium
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的TB-net PINN架构可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics application, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, only forward/inverse PDE problems in porous media.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决原始PINN难以处理多孔介质中复杂流动传热问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出Trunk-Branch net PINN架构，主干网捕捉全局特征，分支网捕捉局部特征。
summary_zh.result: 在正问题、反问题和迁移学习任务中均表现良好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多孔介质流动传热正问题数值算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address the limitations of original PINNs in solving complex flow and heat transfer problems in porous media.
summary_en.method: A Trunk-Branch net PINN architecture is proposed, where a fully-connected trunk net captures global features and separate branch nets capture local features for each output.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves accurate predictions in forward, inverse, and transfer learning tasks for porous media problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical simulation cases of forward flow and heat transfer in porous media.

title: An Imbalanced Learning-based Sampling Method for Physics-informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的RSmote采样方法可提高PINN求解PDE的效率，有望迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective constraints, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics applications; it focuses solely on sampling efficiency for PINNs solving generic PDEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN求解高维PDE时的采样效率和内存使用
summary_zh.method: 提出基于残差的过采样方法RSmote，结合不平衡学习策略
summary_zh.result: RSmote在精度相当或更优下显著降低内存消耗
summary_zh.validation: 与RAD方法在多种维度和方程上对比数值基准

summary_en.motivation: To improve sampling efficiency and reduce memory consumption in Physics-Informed Neural Networks for solving high-dimensional partial differential equations.
summary_en.method: Proposes Residual-based Smote (RSmote), a local adaptive sampling technique that applies oversampling from imbalanced learning to high-residual regions.
summary_en.result: RSmote achieves comparable or better accuracy than the state-of-the-art RAD method while significantly reducing memory usage, especially in high-dimensional scenarios.
summary_en.validation: Benchmarked against RAD on a variety of differential equations across multiple dimensions.

title: In Vivo Study of Bone Growth Around Additively Manufactured Implants with Ti-6Al-4V and Bioactive Glass Powder Composites
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了增材制造Ti-6Al-4V/生物活性玻璃复合植入物的骨整合，与用户方向中的AM生物医学植入物相关，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not cover stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究生物活性玻璃在增材制造植入物中的骨整合效果。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备Ti-6Al-4V/58S BG复合材料，比较涂层与掺杂两种方式。
summary_zh.result: BG涂层和掺杂均加速早期骨生长，但12周后效果不显著。
summary_zh.validation: 动物体内实验，以BIC和BD为定量指标。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of bioactive glass incorporation methods on osseointegration of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V implants.
summary_en.method: Ti-6Al-4V/58S BG composites were fabricated via selective laser melting, comparing BG coating and doping approaches.
summary_en.result: Both BG-coated and BG-doped implants enhanced early bone ingrowth, but the effect diminished by 12 weeks post-implantation.
summary_en.validation: In vivo histological analysis in an animal model using bone-to-implant contact and bone density metrics.

title: Statistical Design of Thermal Protection System Using Physics-Informed Machine learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN与不确定性量化结合，加速热防护材料参数估计，其方法可迁移至植入物力学设计中的代理建模与UQ。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or stress shielding; it focuses on thermal protection systems.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效估计热防护材料参数，避免传统数值模拟的高计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 结合贝叶斯不确定性量化与参数化PINN，使用MCMC和SMC采样。
summary_zh.result: PINN+MCMC大幅降低计算时间，SMC进一步加速。
summary_zh.validation: 与传统数值解对比验证PINN精度。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently estimate material properties of thermal protection films while quantifying uncertainty, avoiding the high cost of conventional numerical simulations.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian uncertainty quantification framework is combined with a parametric Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) to solve the heat transfer problem, with sampling via MCMC and Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC).
summary_en.result: Integrating MCMC with PINN significantly reduces computational time compared to standard numerical methods, and combining SMC with PINN yields multifold speedup.
summary_en.validation: The PINN accuracy is verified against traditional numerical solutions of the heat transfer model.

title: Floating-embedded stems reduce tibial stress shielding in total knee revision arthroplasty.
venue: Journal of orthopaedic surgery and research
first_author_affiliation: Department of Engineering, School of Science, University of Siegen, Siegen, Germany.

corresponding_authors.name: Rene Burchard
corresponding_authors.affiliation: University of Marburg, Marburg, Germany. burcharr@staff.uni-marburg.de.; Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology, University of Giessen and Marburg, Marburg, Germany. burcharr@staff.uni-marburg.de.; Department of Orthopaedics and Trauma Surgery, Lahn-Dill-Kliniken, Dillenburg, Germany. burcharr@staff.uni-marburg.de.; Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology, University of Giessen and Marburg, Marburg Lahn-Dill-Kliniken, Rotebergstr. 2, 35683, Dillenburg, Germany. burcharr@staff.uni-marburg.de.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了膝关节翻修术中浮动嵌入柄对胫骨应力遮挡的影响，其方法学（应变能密度测量、表面水泥固定）可迁移至髋关节假体应力遮挡研究，但对象为胫骨而非股骨。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on tibial stress shielding in knee revision arthroplasty, not on femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, or hip implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索浮动嵌入柄能否减少胫骨翻修术中的应力遮挡。
summary_zh.method: 对6个胫骨标本植入表面水泥固定或全水泥固定的带柄假体，施加轴向载荷并测量骨表面应变能密度。
summary_zh.result: 浮动嵌入柄在干骺端和中段区域显著降低了应力遮挡，但在柄尖处效果不一致。
summary_zh.validation: 通过尸体胫骨标本的力学测试验证，使用DIC测量应变能密度。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether a floating-embedded, uncemented stem can reduce stress shielding in the tibial metaphysis after revision total knee arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Six cadaveric tibiae were implanted with stemmed tibial components using either surface cementing with a floating-embedded stem or full cementing, and axial loading was applied to simulate walking while strain energy density was measured on the bone surface.
summary_en.result: The floating-embedded stem significantly reduced metaphyseal stress shielding compared to full cementing, but the effect at the stem tip varied across views.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing on cadaveric tibiae with digital image correlation to measure strain energy density.

title: ELM-DeepONets: Backpropagation-Free Training of Deep Operator Networks via Extreme Learning Machines
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无需反向传播的算子网络训练方法，可显著降低计算成本，对代理模型的高效训练具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses solely on backpropagation-free training of operator networks for general PDEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低DeepONet训练的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 利用极限学习机将训练转化为最小二乘问题
summary_zh.result: 在非线性ODE和PDE基准上精度更高且计算成本大幅降低
summary_zh.validation: 在非线性ODE和PDE基准问题上验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high computational cost of training Deep Operator Networks (DeepONets).
summary_en.method: Proposes ELM-DeepONets, which reformulates DeepONet training as a least-squares problem using Extreme Learning Machines, eliminating backpropagation.
summary_en.result: Achieves superior accuracy and drastically reduces computational costs on benchmark nonlinear ODE and PDE problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark problems including nonlinear ODEs and PDEs.

title: Scalable Bayesian Physics-Informed Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种可扩展的贝叶斯物理信息KAN方法，具备不确定性量化和高效采样能力，可迁移至生物力学代理模型设计。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it handle multi-objective constraints; it focuses on general PDE surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决KAN在贝叶斯推断中计算效率低和过拟合问题
summary_zh.method: 结合dropout Tikhonov集成卡尔曼反演与Chebyshev KAN，并引入主动子空间降维
summary_zh.result: 新方法在精度、效率和稳定性上优于HMC，且具备可扩展性
summary_zh.validation: 在多个数值基准测试中验证，包括大数据和高噪声场景

summary_en.motivation: To address computational inefficiency and overfitting in Bayesian inference for Kolmogorov-Arnold networks, especially for large-scale datasets.
summary_en.method: A gradient-free approach combining dropout Tikhonov ensemble Kalman inversion with Chebyshev KANs, enhanced by active subspace dimensionality reduction.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves comparable or better accuracy, higher efficiency, and improved stability compared to Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, with scalability to large datasets.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical experiments on benchmark cases, including large datasets and high noise levels, demonstrate the method's efficacy.

title: Surrogate-based multilevel Monte Carlo methods for uncertainty quantification in the Grad-Shafranov free boundary problem
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的代理模型增强的多层蒙特卡洛方法可显著降低不确定性量化计算成本，对生物力学植入物设计中的高效仿真采样具有迁移潜力。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or patient-specific design; it focuses on plasma physics in fusion reactors.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低自由边界问题中不确定性量化计算成本
summary_zh.method: 将代理模型集成到多层蒙特卡洛方法中
summary_zh.result: 计算成本降低四个数量级，精度与直接计算一致
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试验证代理采样与直接计算结果吻合

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of uncertainty quantification in free boundary problems arising from magnetic equilibrium in fusion reactors.
summary_en.method: A surrogate-enhanced multilevel Monte Carlo method is developed by integrating a surrogate model into the multilevel Monte Carlo framework.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves up to 10^4-fold cost reduction compared to standard Monte Carlo while maintaining accuracy in capturing plasma boundary behavior.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks demonstrate that surrogate-based sampling closely matches direct numerical solutions of the Grad-Shafranov PDE.

title: Mechanics Informatics: A paradigm for efficiently learning constitutive models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种量化实验数据信息含量的框架，可用于优化材料本构模型的学习，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的构建与实验设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on constitutive model learning from experimental data, not on surrogate modeling for expensive finite element simulations, and does not address implant or biomechanics design constraints.

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the information content of experimental data for efficient and accurate learning of constitutive models.
summary_en.method: Introduces mechanics informatics with stress state entropy as a metric, integrated with Bayesian optimization for specimen design.
summary_en.result: High-entropy specimens enable accurate parameter identification, while low-entropy designs yield uniform stress states, demonstrating flexibility.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical examples of anisotropic inelastic constitutive laws, including uncertainty and transfer learning.

summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on several benchmark PDEs demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategies.

summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing against a brute-force data generation approach.

summary_en.motivation: To construct digital twins for PDE-governed physical systems enabling real-time simulation and control under varying conditions.

summary_en.result: Exact one-shot transfer learning is achievable for linear PDEs, while nonlinear PDEs require approximate one-shot or few-shot methods.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on linear and nonlinear diffusion PDE models demonstrate the approach.

title: Generalization of Urban Wind Environment Using Fourier Neural Operator Across Different Wind Directions and Cities
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了FNO在流体力学代理建模中的通用性，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真CFD计算成本高，难以用于实际城市风环境模拟。
summary_zh.method: 使用傅里叶神经算子（FNO）模型，基于大涡模拟数据训练，预测不同风向和城市布局下的流场。
summary_zh.result: FNO模型预测准确，计算时间减少99%，且通过分块训练和SDF数据增强泛化能力。
summary_zh.validation: 基于大涡模拟数据验证，对比不同城市布局和风向下的预测精度。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity CFD simulations are computationally prohibitive for real urban wind environment analysis.
summary_en.method: A Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) model is trained on large eddy simulation data to predict flow fields under varying wind directions and urban layouts, using spatial block training and signed distance function (SDF) inputs.
summary_en.result: The FNO model achieves accurate predictions with 99% reduction in computational time and improved generalization across different wind directions and cities.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing FNO predictions with large eddy simulation data for multiple urban configurations and wind conditions.

title: Probabilistic Skip Connections for Deterministic Uncertainty Quantification in Deep Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无需重新训练即可实现确定性不确定性量化的方法，可迁移至代理模型以提供预测不确定性估计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanical design; it focuses on general-purpose UQ for deep neural networks without any application to expensive simulation or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有确定性UQ方法需修改训练过程，本文旨在无需重新训练即可实现高质量UQ。
summary_zh.method: 利用神经坍缩度量识别敏感且平滑的中间层，对其特征向量拟合概率模型作为概率跳跃连接。
summary_zh.result: 该方法在UQ和OOD检测上匹配或超越需训练修改的现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准图像分类基准上评估UQ和OOD检测性能。

summary_en.motivation: Existing deterministic UQ methods require retraining with spectral normalization; this work aims to achieve high-quality UQ without modifying the training process.
summary_en.method: Proposes probabilistic skip connections (PSCs) by identifying a sensitive and smooth intermediate layer via neural collapse measures and fitting a probabilistic model to its feature vector.
summary_en.result: PSCs achieve UQ and OOD detection performance matching or exceeding existing single-pass methods that require training modifications.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on standard image classification benchmarks for UQ and OOD detection.

summary_en.motivation: To develop a data-driven framework for designing metastructured auxetic patches with tailored mechanical properties for tissue repair.
summary_en.method: Experimental fabrication and mechanical testing were combined with finite element simulations, greedy sampling for efficient data labeling, and two neural networks to predict Poisson's ratio and stress.
summary_en.result: Both neural networks achieved R² scores above 0.995, and the design model outperformed genetic algorithms in efficiency and precision.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through experimental fabrication and mechanical testing to determine material properties and verify finite element models.

summary_en.motivation: Standard Bayesian optimization treats the system as a black-box, limiting the exploitation of structural knowledge such as physics and interconnections.
summary_en.method: This work implements the BOIS framework, which uses adaptive linearizations of the composite function to obtain analytical expressions for statistical moments.
summary_en.result: BOIS performs as well as or better than existing grey-box methods on chemical process optimization benchmarks while being less computationally intensive.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via two numerical case studies in chemical process optimization and design.

summary_en.result: Higher viscosity bioinks and smaller cylindrical nozzles reduced cell viability due to increased shear stress, while translational flow speed had cell-type-dependent effects.
summary_en.validation: Cell viability assays were performed to validate the influence of each parameter on printed cell-laden constructs.

title: Design of a porous biodegradable internal fixation for the treatment of pauwels type III femoral neck fractures.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Shanxi Bethune Hospital, Shanxi Academy of Medical Sciences, Tongji Shanxi Hospital, Third Hospital of Shanxi Medical University, Taiyuan, China.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及股骨颈骨折内固定的应力遮挡问题，但未涉及髋关节假体或股骨柄的应力遮挡、微动或骨-植入物界面分析。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on biodegradable internal fixation for femoral neck fractures, not on hip implant stems, and does not quantify micromotion or contact mechanics at the bone-implant interface.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决股骨颈骨折内固定术后骨硬化和应力遮挡问题
summary_zh.method: 设计四种多孔AZ31b镁合金螺钉结构，通过有限元和CFD评估力学与渗透性能
summary_zh.result: 蜂窝状多孔内固定具有最佳力学性能，可匹配人骨弹性模量
summary_zh.validation: 有限元模拟股骨颈骨折愈合过程中的应力演变

summary_en.motivation: To address osteosclerosis and stress shielding caused by prolonged internal fixation in femoral neck fractures.
summary_en.method: Four porous AZ31b magnesium alloy screw structures were designed and evaluated via finite element analysis and CFD for mechanical and permeability properties.
summary_en.result: The honeycomb porous internal fixation exhibited superior mechanical properties and matched the elastic modulus of human bone.
summary_en.validation: Finite element simulation of stress evolution during healing stages of a Pauwels III femoral neck fracture model.

title: Custom 3D-printed split-type triflange implants for severe acetabular defects: mid-term clinical outcomes and biomechanical insights from finite element analysis.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D打印多孔植入物和有限元分析，但未聚焦于应力遮挡或疲劳性能，且缺乏LPBF制造和力学测试。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication or mechanical testing; no fatigue analysis; stress shielding not quantified; osseointegration inferred from micromotion but no surface roughness or as-built morphology reported.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估3D打印分体式三翼杯治疗严重髋臼缺损的中期效果
summary_zh.method: 回顾14例患者，术前CT设计植入物，术后临床评分和有限元分析
summary_zh.result: 临床评分显著改善，有限元显示低负荷下微动达标，高负荷下超阈值
summary_zh.validation: 临床随访和有限元模拟验证

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate mid-term clinical and biomechanical outcomes of custom 3D-printed split-type triflange cups for severe acetabular defects.
summary_en.method: Retrospective study of 14 patients with Paprosky 3B defects; implants designed from CT models with porous surfaces; clinical scores and finite element analysis under various loads.
summary_en.result: Significant improvement in Harris and Oxford hip scores; FEA showed micromotion below 40 μm at 700N but exceeded at higher loads.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up (mean 74.2 months) and finite element analysis.

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过计算模型模拟骨生长和植入物降解，但未涉及LPBF制造、力学测试或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not include LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), surface roughness, or as-built morphology; it focuses on computational modeling of bone growth and implant degradation without experimental validation of implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过计算模型预测植入物材料与骨组织的相互作用，减少实验成本。
summary_zh.method: 扩展基于常微分方程的骨生长和镁植入物降解数学模型。
summary_zh.result: 模型能模拟植入物降解和骨整合，预测骨体积分数误差低于6%。
summary_zh.validation: 与钛和镁钆植入物的实验数据对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce costly experiments by developing in silico models that predict bone-implant interactions for biodegradable and permanent implants.
summary_en.method: Extended ordinary differential equation models of bone growth and magnesium implant degradation, incorporating sensitivity analysis.
summary_en.result: The model accurately simulated implant degradation and osseointegration, predicting relative bone volume fraction with mean absolute errors below 6%.
summary_en.validation: Validated against experimental data from titanium and magnesium-gadolinium implants over 32 weeks of healing.

title: Animal experiment on osseointegration of porous titanium root analogue implants with composite CSn-TAK242 coating.

why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue behavior, or surface roughness of LPBF-fabricated porous structures.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究TLR4抑制剂涂层对多孔钛种植体骨整合的影响

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the role of TLR4 inhibitor coating in promoting osseointegration of porous titanium root analogue implants in vivo.
summary_en.method: Porous titanium root analogue implants were fabricated via 3D printing, coated with CSn-TAK242, and implanted into beagle jaws.
summary_en.result: The CSn-TAK242 group showed significantly higher BIC, BV/TV, and Tb.Th compared to control and CSn groups.
summary_en.validation: Animal experiment with X-ray, Micro-CT, and histological staining after 3 months.

title: Active and transfer learning with partially Bayesian neural networks for materials and chemicals
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的部分贝叶斯神经网络方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的主动学习与不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元仿真或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to finite element analysis, surrogate modeling, or implant biomechanics; it focuses on molecular and materials property prediction.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效表征材料化学性质空间，降低主动学习计算成本
summary_zh.method: 提出部分贝叶斯神经网络，仅部分层使用概率权重，其余保持确定性
summary_zh.result: 在主动学习任务上达到与全贝叶斯网络相当的精度和不确定性估计，计算成本更低
summary_zh.validation: 在分子性质预测和材料科学任务上验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of Bayesian neural networks for active learning in materials and chemicals property space.
summary_en.method: Proposes partially Bayesian neural networks (PBNNs) where only selected layers have probabilistic weights, initialized with pre-trained weights from theoretical calculations.
summary_en.result: PBNNs achieve accuracy and uncertainty estimates comparable to fully Bayesian networks at lower computational cost, and accelerate active learning of experimental data.
summary_en.validation: Validated on molecular property prediction and materials science tasks.

title: A finite element model to simulate intraoperative fractures in cementless hip stem designs.
first_author_affiliation: Medical Technology Lab, IRCCS Istituto Ortopedico Rizzoli, Bologna, Italy; Department of Industrial Engineering, Alma Mater Studiorum - University of Bologna, Italy.

corresponding_authors.name: Marco Viceconti
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Medical Technology Lab, IRCCS Istituto Ortopedico Rizzoli, Bologna, Italy; Department of Industrial Engineering, Alma Mater Studiorum - University of Bologna, Italy. Electronic address: marco.viceconti@unibo.it.

relevance_to_user: 该论文模拟了无骨水泥股骨柄植入过程中的术中骨折，与用户关注的股骨柄应力遮挡和微动相关，但重点在骨折而非应力遮挡或微动。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on intraoperative fracture propagation during stem insertion, not on postoperative stress shielding, micromotion, or primary stability under physiological loading.

summary_zh.motivation: 模拟无骨水泥股骨柄植入时的术中骨折，评估骨折风险。
summary_zh.method: 基于CT数据建立11个个体化有限元模型，模拟锤击加载和裂纹扩展。
summary_zh.result: 在6例中裂纹扩展至表面，2例无裂纹，3例裂纹未达表面。
summary_zh.validation: 通过虚拟患者队列的解剖和生理变异性验证模型可行性。

summary_en.motivation: To simulate intraoperative femoral fractures during cementless stem insertion and assess fracture risk related to stem design.
summary_en.method: Eleven subject-specific finite element models were built from CT data, with compressive loads up to 10,000 N to simulate hammering and element deactivation for crack propagation.
summary_en.result: Crack propagation to the surface occurred in six patients, no crack in two, and incomplete cracks in three patients.
summary_en.validation: The model was validated through a virtual cohort with anatomical and physiological variability, demonstrating feasibility of simulating intraoperative fractures.
